jobs.title: Er det deg vi leter etter?
jobs.description:
Er det deg vi leter etter? Vi ser etter dyktige vikarer i medlever og nattevakt stillinger, med mulighet for fast turnus til våre barnevernsavdelinger i Agder.

Arbeidsgiver: Stendi

Stillingstittel: Miljøterapeut/Miljøarbeider

Frist: 27. desember

Ansettelsesform: Tilkalling

Vi har avdelinger i Mandal, Farsund og Moi.

Velkommen til Stendi AS barnevern!

Hos oss får du en meningsfull jobb der du hver dag bidrar til å gi mennesker et godt og trygt liv. Samtidig får du verdifull erfaring og spennende muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.

Vi ser etter deg som har et ekte engasjement for mennesker, og som har erfaring med å stå i krevende situasjoner. Du finner glede i de små tingene, er en trygg og stabil voksenperson, og har en naturlig evne til å skape gode relasjoner med våre beboere. Mange av dem har opplevd utfordrende livssituasjoner, og kan derfor reagere uventet – da er din trygghet og tilstedeværelse avgjørende.

Vi ønsker oss en person som er trygg i seg selv, tillitsskapende og god på relasjonsbygging – spesielt med barn og ungdom. Du trives i et miljø der hverdagen kan være uforutsigbar, og der utviklingsarbeidet står i sentrum.

Vi ønsker deg som har en positiv innstilling, gode samarbeidsevner og et ønske om å jobbe tett sammen med både kolleger og beboere – for her skaper vi resultater sammen.

Personer med erfaring fra arbeid med barn og unge vil bli prioritert.

Typiske arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Daglig drift av boligen.

  • Samtaler med barn og unge.

  • Opprettholde god struktur og skape et trygt arbeidsmiljø sammen med dine kolleger.

  • Dokumentering/daglig journalføring/rapport skriving/ kartlegging.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Utdanning: 3-årig helse- og sosialfaglig høyskoleutdanning. Vernepleier, sosionom eller barnevernspedagog er vår kjernekompetanse, men annen utdanning på minimum bachelornivå kan bli vurdert

  • Relevant erfaring i institusjon, eller annet liknende arbeid, vil også bli vurdert opp mot kvalifikasjonskravet.

  • Studenter som er i ferd med å gjennomføre relevant utdanning er også velkommen til å søke.

  • Førerkort kl. B

  • Skriver og snakker godt norsk (tilsvarende nivå B1)

  • Gyldig politiattest.

  • Personlig egenhet vurderes svært viktig

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Vi ser etter deg som er trygg i voksenrollen og kan møte ungdommenes behov på en god måte

  • Du er fleksibel og trives med store utfordringer og du har evne til hurtig omstilling.

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter og evne til å opprettholde god struktur, ha et faglig perspektiv og kunne samarbeide i team.

  • Har godt humør, engasjert og bidrar positivt inn i arbeidsmiljøet.

  • Har erfaring fra lignende arbeid innen barnevern, skole og/eller rus/psykiatri.

  • Gode digitale ferdigheter

  • Evne til å formidle via dokumentasjon

  • Kan stille på kort varsel

  • Stor grad av ledig arbeidskapasitet i ferier

Hvorfor burde du jobbe hos oss?

Vi tilbyr en meningsfull og givende jobb der du virkelig ser hvilken forskjell din innsats gjør for barna og ungdommene du jobber med. Vi tilbyr gode utviklingsmuligheter slik at du kan videreutvikle og styrke din kompetanse.

På alle våre avdelinger har vi medlever turnus. Der jobber våre ansatte 3 døgn på, 7 døgn fri, 4 døgn på og 7 døgn fri. Dette gir våre ansatte mulighet til å følge opp når de er på jobb, samtidig som de får gode avbrekk med en ukes fri mellom skiftene. Den samme turnusen gjelder for våkne nattevakter.

På grunn av ønsket mangfold i tjenesten, oppfordres spesielt menn til å søke.

Merk søknaden om du ønsker å jobbe medlever eller våken nattevakt.

Kontaktperson:

Navn: Albert Veliqi

Tittel: Rekruttering ansvarlig

Nummer: 916 36 118

Informasjon til deg som søker jobb:

  • Dersom du blir innkalt til intervju bes det om at du har med CV, godkjente attester og andre relevante dokumenter eller at du har opplastet dette direkte i Teamtailor.

  • NB! Vær oppmerksom på linker du mottar i forhold til mulig svindelforsøk, vi ber aldri om bank ID eller personnummer i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprosessen.

Om arbeidsgiveren

Stendi er Norges største omsorgsaktør og har i over 30 år levert tjenester på vegne av det offentlige. Gjennom vår kjernevirksomhet ønsker vi å gjøre verden litt bedre, ett menneske av gangen. Sammen med våre oppdragsgivere skaper vi en trygg omsorg som ivaretar alle!

Vi har et landsdekkende tjenestetilbud innen barnevern, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA), heldøgns omsorg, hjemmebaserte tjenester og eldreomsorg.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stendi er Norges største private leverandør av omsorgstjenester, med et landsdekkende tilbud innen heldøgns bo- og omsorgstjenester, barnevern og brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA).

Hos oss blir du en del av et faglig sterkt team som arbeider etter traumebevisst omsorg, relasjonsarbeid og miljøterapeutiske prinsipper. Vi legger stor vekt på å skape trygge rammer, gode relasjoner og utviklingsmuligheter for ungdommene.

Som miljøterapeut i medleverturnus vil du:

  • Følge opp ungdom i hverdagen gjennom miljøterapeutisk arbeid

  • Skape struktur, trygghet og forutsigbarhet

  • Bidra til målrettet oppfølging i samarbeid med kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere

  • Delta i møter, dokumentasjon og faglig utviklingsarbeid

  • Være en trygg voksenperson som bygger gode relasjoner

Vi søker deg som:

  • Har relevant utdanning, eller er student innen helse-, sosial- eller pedagogiske fag

  • Har erfaring fra barnevern, psykisk helse eller miljøterapeutisk arbeid, eller et sterkt ønske om å utvikle deg innen feltet

  • Er trygg, tydelig og relasjonssterk

  • Er fleksibel, ansvarsbevisst og løsningsorientert

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner, samtidig som du kan arbeide selvstendig

  • Behersker norsk godt, både skriftlig og muntlig

  • Har førerkort klasse B

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfull og variert arbeidshverdag

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høy faglig kompetanse

  • God opplæring og veiledning

  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling og kompetanseheving

  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Personlig egnethet

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt. Vi ser etter medarbeidere som evner å skape tillit, vise omsorg og trygghet, og som kan stå stødig i krevende situasjoner.

Politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse i henhold til gjeldene regelverk.

Har du spørsmål om stillingene er du velkommen til å ta kontakt.

Kontaktperson:

Navn: Therese Olsen Skogheim

jobs.title: Engasjerte vikarer søkes til Stendi Deichmanske, omsorgsbolig for aktiv rus og psykiske lidelser
jobs.description:
Er du en trygg og positiv person som liker å møte utfordringer med strak arm? Er du en inspirerende pådriver som trives med å jobbe tett med mennesker? På Stendi avdeling Deichmanske leter vi etter de aller beste til å bli med på laget.

Stendi er best i det vi gjør og er ledende innen private helsetjenester i Norden. Vi utvikler bransjens beste medarbeidere, investerer i bærekraftig vekst og kvalitet i tjenestene.

Avdeling Deichmanske er en heldøgns omsorgsbolig midt i Oslo sentrum. Vi gir tjenester til mennesker med sammensatte og langvarige utfordringer knyttet til rus og psykisk helse. Våre beboere lever med alvorlige psykiske lidelser og er i aktiv rus. Dette stiller høye krav til faglighet, fleksibilitet og relasjonskompetanse.

Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i tydelige rammer, struktur og forventninger, samtidig som vi møter beboerne med varme, respekt og en fleksibel tilnærming. Vårt mål er å bidra til en mest mulig forutsigbar og meningsfull hverdag for den enkelte, og å legge til rette for små, men viktige endringer i livet deres – på deres egne premisser.

Vi søker nå tilkallingsvikarer til vår avdeling, og vi ønsker deg som finner arbeid med rus og psykiatri spennende og meningsfullt. Som ansatt vil du bidra til å hjelpe beboerne mot en meningsfull hverdag, med støtte til aktiviteter, opprettelse og oppfølging av avtaler, assistanse med ADL-aktiviteter, medisinadministrasjon og mye mer.

Vaktene går over 12-timer, 08:00-20:00/10:00-22:00. Du vil få varierte oppgaver og være involvert i ulike aktiviteter knyttet til beboerens liv. Ingen dager er like på Deichmanske, og hvis du trives med mangfold og spennende utfordringer, er dette den perfekte stillingen for deg!

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Miljøterapeutisk arbeid og relasjonsbygging med beboere i utfordrende livssituasjoner

  • Bistand i dagliglivets gjøremål (ADL), oppfølging av avtaler og aktiviteter

  • Medikamenthåndtering og observasjon

  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid internt og eksternt

  • Dokumentasjon og målrettet miljøarbeid

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har relevant utdanning, men ikke et krav

  • Har erfaring med ROP-problematikk, aktiv rus og alvorlig psykisk lidelse

  • Har erfaring med utagerings problematikk

  • Er lærevillig, motivert og løsningsorientert

  • Er trygg, ressurssterk og tydelig – men samtidig raus, empatisk og relasjonsorientert

  • Har godt humør og bidrar med positiv kultur på arbeidsplassen

  • Er selvstendig, men som også samarbeider godt i team

  • Tåler høyt tempo, og er rolig i møte med uforutsigbarhet og kravsituasjoner

  • Har et brennende engasjement for mennesker i krevende livssituasjoner

  • Mye kapasitet i perioder

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et sterkt og dedikert fagmiljø med fokus på refleksjon og utvikling

  • Tverrfaglighet og et høyt kunnskapsnivå

  • Opplæring, veiledning og intern kompetanseutvikling

  • En spennende og utfordrende arbeidshverdag med stor variasjon

  • Mulighet til å gjøre en reell forskjell i menneskers liv

  • En avdeling preget av godt samarbeid, samhold, og arbeidsmiljø

  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet for fri/bytte av vakter når du har behov for det

  • Måltidstilbud mens du er på jobb

jobs.title: 100% miljøarbeider i barnebolig i Steinkjer
jobs.description:
Vil du være med å skape et trygt hjem for ungdom?

I vår barnebolig møter du ungdom som trenger trygge voksne som ser dem, støtter dem og bidrar til gode dager. Vi søker engasjerte medarbeidere som ønsker å skape trygghet, mestring og livskvalitet gjennom sterke relasjoner og faglig godt arbeid. Hos oss får du en meningsfull jobb der du utgjør en forskjell, hver eneste dag.

Om stillingen

Vi etablerer et nytt botilbud for ungdom i Steinkjer og søker trygge, engasjerte medarbeidere som ønsker å være med fra start. Hos oss blir du en del av et fagmiljø som skal skape et hjem preget av trygghet, omsorg, utvikling og mestring.

Som medarbeider i barneboligen vil du være en viktig person i ungdommenes hverdag. Du bidrar til å bygge relasjoner, skape forutsigbarhet og legge til rette for gode opplevelser og utviklingsmuligheter. Arbeidet innebærer både miljøterapeutisk oppfølging og praktiske gjøremål, og du vil samarbeide tett med ungdom, pårørende, kollegaer og eksterne samarbeidspartnere.

Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i ungdommenes behov og hverdag. Derfor benytter vi en fleksibel turnus som følger skoleruta og tilpasses skoleuker, ferier, helger og høytider. Dette bidrar til kontinuitet, forutsigbarhet og et helhetlig tilbud for ungdommene.

Vi søker etter miljøarbeider i 100% stilling (35,5t/u) med arbeid hver tredje helg. Det vil være en blanding av ettermiddagsvakter og langvakter i denne turnusen.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Bidra til å skape et trygt og godt hjem for ungdommene

  • Bygge gode og tillitsfulle relasjoner

  • Legge til rette for mestring, utvikling og deltakelse i hverdags- og fritidsaktiviteter

  • Gi individuell oppfølging i tråd med vedtak, mål og tiltaksplaner

  • Samarbeide med pårørende, skole og øvrige samarbeidspartnere

  • Utføre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til drift av hjemmet

  • Dokumentasjon og journalføring

  • Delta aktivt i fagutvikling og kvalitetsarbeid

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Er trygg, varm og tydelig i møte med ungdom

  • Har evne til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit

  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team

  • Har engasjement for miljøterapeutisk arbeid og ungdoms utvikling

  • Bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljø og faglig fellesskap

Vi tilbyr

  • Muligheten til å være med å bygge opp et nytt og spennende tilbud for ungdom

  • En meningsfull arbeidshverdag hvor du gjør en forskjell

  • Fleksibel turnus tilpasset ungdommenes hverdag gjennom skoleår, ferier og høytider

  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging

  • Opplæring i Trygghet og Sikkerhet (TSS)

  • Opplæring i dokumentasjonssystemer, rutiner og faglige arbeidsmetoder

  • Veiledning, refleksjon og faglig utvikling

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og kompetente kollegaer

  • Muligheten til å være med å forme kultur, fagmiljø og arbeidsmåter fra oppstart

Derfor er denne stillingen litt annerledes

Dette er ikke bare en jobb i turnus. Dette er en mulighet til å være med på å bygge et hjem for ungdom som trenger trygge voksne rundt seg. Du får tid til å skape relasjoner, bidra til utvikling og være en viktig del av ungdommenes hverdag. Samtidig blir du en del av et fagmiljø som satser på kvalitet, kompetanse og kontinuerlig utvikling.

Hos oss handler jobben om mer enn oppgaver. Den handler om mennesker, relasjoner og å skape et hjem.

Øvrige kvalifikasjoner (må-krav):

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, skriftlig og muntlig (minimum B2)

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Gyldig politiattest i henhold til gjeldende lovkrav. Kontroll av politiattest gjennomføres via DigiPost.

jobs.title: Obchodník/obchodnice dravec, otevírač dveří - prodej nábytku a vybavení interiérů pro firmy, Obchodní referenti
jobs.description: Tak ten kšeft dopadl! Jestli máte rádi ten pocit a umíte si pro něj pravidelně dojít i do neznámé firmy, jste náš člověk. A tak trochu rozčísnete naše vody poklidného vyřizování poptávek.Hledáme samostatného obchodníka do oboru vybavení interiérů. Jde o aktivní oslovování našich neaktivních zákazníků i rozvíjení prvozákazníků. Bude na Vás si vybrat segment. Pomůže Vám, že nás lidi znají a doporučují. Každý rok rozesíláme 250.000 katalogů, fungujeme přes 30 let, zákazníky hýčkáme vlastní dopravou, výnosem kamkoli i montáží na místě v jimi určený čas. A festovním a hezkým nábytkem.Očekáváme, že budete hlavně otevírat dveře a vytvářet příležitosti. A nebudete na to sám! Za sebou budete mít návrháře interiérů, přípraváře, zkušené znalce nábytku. Pomůžou Vám s technickým řešením a nabídkami. Rádi budete zvát lidi do pardubického showroomu, je fakt povedený a lidi sem rádi jezdí. Budete mít svobodu koho oslovovat, kam a kdy jezdit a volat. My chceme výsledky, ne Vás komandovat :-)Hledáme:Nebojácnou pusu. Mail pošle někdo jiný.Cestovatele. Budete jezdit za klienty po celém Česku. Je na Vás kdy.Lidumila. S lidmi budujeme dlouhodobé vztahy. Žádná po nás potopa!Rozvíječe. Dobrých nápadů, zpětné vazby, i zakázek.Platíme penězi.. Slušný fix, krásné provize.Za co jsou u nás lidi rádi:Volí si cestu. My dáváme cíl. Mikromanagement se u nás nenosí.Říkají, co si myslí. A ostatní jsou za to rádi.Koučování. Kdo zná, ten ví. Kdo nezná, může využít.Zlepšováky vítáme. Stejně jako rozvojové chyby. Narozdíl od těch diletantských.Peníze. Výplata a vždy včas. I jakékoli době. Protože hypotéka, sunar ani dovolená nepočkají.Pěkné čisté prostředí, moderní stroje. Retro nevedeme. Kromě Kofoly a EsíčekDovolená podle sebe. Vy víte nejlépe, kdy chcete odpočívat, my do toho nemluvíme.     První kontakt e-mailem.

jobs.title: Senterleiar ved Senter for vitskapsteori
jobs.description:
Kunnskap som formar samfunnet

UiB skal vere blant Europas fremste universitet, internasjonalt kjent for høg kvalitet i forsking og utdanning. Som samfunnsinstitusjon skal vi bidra til ei berekraftig og demokratisk utvikling og vere ein attraktiv og inkluderande studie- og arbeidsplass.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LlM1uxJXqBQSenterleiar ved Senter for vitskapsteori

Vil du leie eit internasjonalt og tverrfagleg forskingssenter?

Det humanistiske fakultet ved Universitetet i Bergen søkjer senterleiar ved Senter for vitskapsteori (SVT) med tilsetjing frå 01.07.2027 eller så snart som mogleg etter dette. Senterleiarstillinga er ei åremålsstilling med tilsettingsperiode på fire år, med høve til å søkje om inntil ein ny åremålsperiode. 

Kvifor søkje?

Som senterleiar får du ei unik moglegheit til å leie, utvikle og påverke. 

Stillinga er både utfordrande, mangesidig og ansvarsfull. Du vil arbeide i eit spennande og mangfaldig miljø med dyktige og inspirerande kollegaer, der du skal vere med på å forme senteret slik at både tilsette og studentar får gode vilkår for læring, utvikling og trivsel.

I stillinga vil du få god moglegheit til å utvikle deg sjølv som leiar i nær samhandling med leiargruppa ved instituttet og med støtte frå fakultet, dekanat og universitetsleiing. I tillegg gir stillinga rom for å kombinere fagleg leiarskap med eigen fagleg aktivitet.

Om Senter for vitskapsteori 

Senter for vitskapsteori (SVT) er eit tverrfagleg og interfakultært senter med ansvar for vitskapsteoretisk forsking, utdanning og formidling ved Universitetet i Bergen. Senteret er del av Det humanistiske fakultet, men er òg arbeidsplass for tilsette ved ulike fakultet, og den faglege verksemda strekkjer seg på tvers av fagområde, fakultetsgrenser og vitskaplege tradisjonar.

SVT har ei sentral rolle i forskarutdanninga ved UiB gjennom undervisning i vitskapsteori og etikk for ph.d.-kandidatar. Senteret tilbyr òg tverrfaglege og forskingsbaserte danningsemne på bachelornivå og har programansvar for masterprogrammet i berekraft.

Forskinga ved senteret er prega av eit tett samspel mellom forsking, undervisning og formidling. SVT leier og deltek i eksternfinansierte forskingsprosjekt og samarbeider breitt med fagmiljø ved UiB, nasjonalt og internasjonalt. Forskinga omfattar mellom anna vitskapsfilosofi, vitskapshistorie, forskingsetikk, STS og studiar av vitskapen si rolle i samfunnet.

Senteret har omlag 16 årsverk og eit mangfaldig, tverrfagleg fagmiljø med forskarar, stipendiatar, postdoktorar og administrative medarbeidarar.

Ansvar og arbeidsoppgåver: 

Som senterleiar har du det faglege, administrative og strategiske leiaransvaret for verksemda ved senteret. Du er ansvarleg for dagleg drift, strategiske prioriteringar, personale, HMS-arbeid, ressursbruk og økonomi. Senterleiar har arbeidsgjevaransvar for tilsette ved senteret.

Du har det overordna ansvaret for den faglege og administrative verksemda ved senteret, inkludert forsking, undervisning og formidling. Ansvaret omfattar òg forvalting og vidareutvikling av senteret sine studieprogram, inkludert koordinering med samarbeidspartnarar. Gjennom samarbeid med tilsette og studentar skal du bidra til å sikre høg fagleg kvalitet i verksemda. 

Senterleiar har ansvar for utforming av årsplan og budsjett, og skal sikre rasjonell drift og budsjettbalanse innanfor rammevilkår fastsette av fakultetsstyret.

Du skal utøve fagleg og strategisk leiing av det faglege fellesskapet ved senteret, og leggje til rette for forskingsaktivitet, ekstern finansiering og forskingsformidling. Senteret er særskilt sterke på innhenting av ekstern finansiering, og prosjektinitiering vil vere ein særleg sentral del av stillinga. Vidare inkluderer rolla som senterleiar òg å koordinere, styrkje og vidareutvikle samarbeid med partnarar både lokalt, nasjonalt og internasjonalt. 

Senterleiar rapporterer til dekanen ved Det humanistiske fakultet.

Nødvendige kvalifikasjonar:
  • Søkjarar skal fortrinnsvis ha professorkompetanse (minimum førsteamanuensisnivå) i vitskapsteori, med forskings- og undervisingserfaring innanfor senterets fagområde eller liknande fagområde. Kompetansen må være oppnådd på søknadstidspunktet. Utdanningsfagleg kompetansekrav gjeld ikkje for søkjarar tilsett som professor eller førsteamanuensis før dette kravet blei innført 01.09.2019.
  • Fagleg-administrativ leiarerfaring frå sektoren eller andre komplekse organisasjonar med faglege oppgåver. 
  • God kjennskap til nasjonal og internasjonal forsking, utdanning og forskingsfinansiering for fagområda ved senteret. 
  • Gode norskkunnskapar, både skriftleg og munnleg. Administrasjonsspråket ved universitetet er norsk.

Det vil bli lagt stor vekt på personlege eigenskapar, inkludert:

  • Evne til strategisk tenking og planmessig handling innanfor gjevne ressursrammer. 
  • Evne til å arbeide resultatorientert mot fastsette mål. 
  • Høg integritet og evne til å skape tillit. 
  • Ein motiverande, open, målretta og inkluderande leiarstil. 
  • Evne til å leggje til rette for eit godt arbeidsmiljø. 
  • Solide kommunikasjonsevner og evne til å byggje relasjonar og samarbeid. 
  • Fokus på utvikling og å finne gode løysingar. 
  • Evne til å ivareta studentperspektiv gjennom aktiv involvering av studentane.

Tilsetting i stillinga vil bygge på ei heilskapleg vurdering.

Hos oss får du:
  • Interessante og utviklande leiaroppgåver.
  • Eit fagleg stimulerande arbeidsmiljø.
  • Dyktige og engasjerte tilsette i aktive fagmiljø.
  • Høve til å byggje sterke faglege nettverk.
  • Ein arbeidsstad i hjartet av Bergen - nær både byliv og natur.
  • Løn i stillingskode 1475 vert fastsett etter individuell vurdering innanfor eit spenn mellom kr 1 184 600 - 1 234 600, avhengig avkompetanse og erfaring. For særskilt kvalifiserte søkjarar kan det verte aktuelt å vurdere høgare løn. Frå bruttoløna vert det trekt 2 % til pålagt medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse.
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse, som inneber ei trygg tenestepensjonsordning, moglegheit for uføre- og etterlatnepensjon, og tilgang til gunstige bustadlån.
  • Ein trygg og fleksibel arbeidskvardag med gode velferdsordningar.
Slik søkjer du stillinga:

Søknad og CV skal sendast elektronisk via lenka «SØK STILLINGA» på denne sida. Søknaden skal innehalde: 

  • Søknadsbrev. I søknadsbrevet skal det gjerast greie for søkjaren sine ambisjonar for senteret si forskingsverksemd og vidare utvikling, inkludert leiing av forskingsmiljø, utdanning, samarbeid og strategisk utvikling. 
  • CV. 
  • Vitnemål og attestar. 
  • Fullstendig publikasjonsliste og anna dokumentasjon av relevant fagleg kompetanse, prosjekt- og leiarerfaring.
  • Referansar kan oppgivast i søknaden/CV-skjema eller på førespurnad.

Søknadstekst, CV og vedlegg må vere på norsk, eit anna skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. Dokumentasjon på andre språk må følgjast av attestert omsetjing. Vedlegga kan vere i Word- eller PDF-format, og må lastast opp i Jobbnorge innan søknadsfristen. Namngje vedlegga tydeleg.Nærare om tilsettingsprosessen her

Generell informasjon:

Utfyllande opplysningar om stillinga kan ein få ved å vende seg til dekan, professor Camilla Brautaset på telefon 55 58 23 06 / 473 29 832 eller e-post camilla.brautaset@uib.no, eller til fakultetsdirektør Kim Ove Hommen på telefon 55 58 93 41 / 908 85 702 eller e-post kim.hommen@uib.no. 

Spørsmål om den elektroniske søknadsprosessen kan rettast til Det humanistiske fakultet på e-post: fakadm@hf.uib.no.

Universitetet i Bergen nyttar meirinnsyn ved tilsetjing i vitskaplege stillingar. Opplysningar om søkjaren kan bli gjort offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har oppmoda om ikkje å bli ført på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje blir teke til følgje, skal søkjaren varslast om dette.

Vi oppmodar søkjarar med funksjonsnedsetjing, innvandrarbakgrunn eller hól i CV-en til å søke. Dersom du kryssar av for dette i søknaden kan du bli positivt særbehandla. Vi inviterer alltid minst ein kvalifisert søkjar frå kvar av desse gruppene til intervju. 

Mangfald er ein styrke og gjer at vi kan løyse oppgåvene våre endå betre. UiB treng difor kvalifiserte medarbeidarar uavhengig av kjønn, etnisitet, religion, livssyn, funksjonsnedsetjing, seksuell orientering, kjønnsidentitet, kjønnsuttrykk og alder.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Bergen er ein anerkjend utdannings- og forskingsinstitusjon, organisert i sju fakultet og omlag 54 institutt og faglege senter. Campus ligg i sentrale delar av Bergen med universitetsområde på Nygårdshøyden, Haukeland, Marineholmen, Møllendalsveien og Årstad.

Det humanistiske fakultet består av fire institutt og fire senter. Les meir om fakultet og tilhøyrande institutt.

Amsterdam (hybrid) | Part-time (freelance) 8 hours a week | €2,000 to €2,500 per month


Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys.

Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus.

Your Mission

As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR.

Your Job

  • Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early.

  • Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires.

  • Make sure our platform, and the content our customers publish with it, meets the European Accessibility Act and related standards.

  • Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data.

  • Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team.

  • Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team.


Your Competencies & Skills

  • Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you.

  • A practical communicator who explains complex regulation to product teams in plain language, with answers instead of memos full of caveats.

  • Proactive and curious: you spot gaps before they become problems and want to understand how the product actually works.

  • Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up.

Your Qualifications

  • A Master’s in Law (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at a tech or SaaS company.

  • Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products.

  • Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice.

  • Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act).

  • A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law.

  • GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E.

  • Experience working with scale-ups on a retainer or fractional basis is a plus.

  • Fluent English. Dutch is a plus.

Note: All our hiring is done in-house, so we’re not looking for agency support for this role. Thanks for understanding!

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick.

Who we are

Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen.

The role

As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible.

Your responsibilities include

  • Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential.

  • Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work.

  • Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back.

  • Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on.

  • Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers.

  • Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings.

Who you are

To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements:

  • You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role.

  • You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production.

  • You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration.

  • You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value.

  • You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations.

  • You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences.

What we offer

A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer.

  • Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop.

  • An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave.

  • An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee.

If this sounds like you

Interested in a conversation to further explore and enquire? Please apply below and we will contact you a.s.a.p. Or contact via +31 6 2520 3984 or

Recruitment, consulting other temp/secondment agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we seek all our candidates directly. We understand that you would like to present your candidates our interesting positions, but this is not how we have structured our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered will be treated as direct applications to our vacancies.

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Store Operations
jobs.description:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Lederindustrie! 🌍✨

Du hast keine Lust auf einen typischen Studi-Job, bei dem du nur zuarbeitest? Bei uns bist du von Anfang an nah am operativen Filialgeschäft und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für eine feste Gruppe von Stores.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Retail Operations wirst du Teil unseres Retail-Teams in Rostock und arbeitest eng mit unseren Store Managern und verschiedenen Bereichen der Zentrale zusammen. Dabei lernst du, wie Stores wirtschaftlich gesteuert, Teams koordiniert und operative Herausforderungen gelöst werden.

Dabei lernst du, wie erfolgreiche Filialsteuerung in der Praxis funktioniert – mit dem Ziel, dich langfristig auf eine Position als Area Manager vorzubereiten.

Deine Mission 🧭

  • Stores begleiten: Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung von 5–6 Stores und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team dafür, dass Prozesse, Standards und Abläufe funktionieren.

  • Kennzahlen verstehen: Du arbeitest mit Umsätzen, Warenbeständen und Reportings, erkennst Entwicklungen und leitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lead passende Maßnahmen ab.

  • Kommunizieren & koordinieren: Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Store-Teams und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen in der Zentrale zusammen.

  • Organisation übernehmen: Du koordinierst Store-relevante Themen, behältst offene Aufgaben im Blick und sorgst für strukturierte Abläufe und Dokumentationen.

  • Führung kennenlernen: Du begleitest Gespräche mit Store Managern und Team Leads und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Führung und Entwicklung von Teams.

  • Eigene Projekte übernehmen: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du selbstständig eigene Themen und Projekte – zum Beispiel bei der Eröffnung eines neuen Stores.

Das bringst du mit 💼

  • Wirtschaftliches Studium: Idealerweise studierst du BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Handelsmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig anstehen.

  • Analytisches Denken: Du hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und Interesse an Kennzahlen und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, kommunizierst lösungsorientiert und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen.

  • Deutsch & Englisch: Du kannst dich in beiden Sprachen sicher in Wort und Schrift verständigen.

  • Erfahrung ist kein Muss: Du brauchst keine umfangreiche Erfahrung im Einzelhandel. Wichtiger sind uns deine Lernbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative und dein Interesse daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wir geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken auszubauen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Was Dich bei Gusti Leder erwartet 🌿

  • Faire Vergütung: 17–19 € Stundenlohn zzgl. Bonusmodell sowie 20 % Mitarbeiterrabatt und zusätzliche Prämien.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Deine Arbeitszeiten lassen sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren.

  • Karriereperspektive: Sammle praktische Führungserfahrung und entwickle dich bei entsprechender Eignung perspektivisch in Richtung Area Management weiter.

  • Onboarding & Weiterbildung: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, Unterstützung durch deinen Team Lead sowie Zugang zu internen und externen Trainings.

  • Gestaltungsfreiheit: Bring deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte unsere Abläufe aktiv mit.

  • Teamkultur: Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien, direkte Kommunikation, regelmäßige Teamevents und ein Arbeitsumfeld rund um Nachhaltigkeit und Slow Fashion.

  • Zentrale Lage: Unser Büro liegt nahe der Universität und dem Rostocker Hauptbahnhof und ist mit Fahrrad und öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut erreichbar. Kostenlose Parkplätze stehen ebenfalls zur Verfügung.

  • Gut versorgt: Zweimal pro Woche gibt es ein frisch gekochtes Mittagessen. Kaffee, Tee, Wasser und frisches Obst stehen dir täglich kostenfrei zur Verfügung.

  • Langfristige Zusammenarbeit: Eine Übernahme nach deinem Studium und deine weitere Entwicklung bei Gusti sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Klingt nach mehr als einem klassischen Studi-Job? Genau das ist es.

Bewirb dich jetzt als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Retail Operations und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit uns weiter.

Wir freuen uns auf dich! 💫

Die HyPlus ist Dein Wegbegleiter im digitalen Wandel. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen entwickeln wir strukturiert, partnerschaftlich und mit klarem Fokus auf nachhaltigen Mehrwert deren digitale DNA.

Wir begleiten Unternehmen von der Anforderungsanalyse über Architektur, Softwareentwicklung und Implementierung bis hin zum Betrieb. Mit rund 800 Kolleg:innen in Deutschland, Polen, Litauen, Rumänien und Indien verbinden wir technologische Exzellenz mit Branchenkompetenz in unterschiedlichsten Marktsegmenten.

Wir begrüßen Bewerberinnen und Bewerber, die sich bereits mit modernen KI-gestützten Entwicklungstools und generativer KI beschäftigen oder Interesse daran haben, diese sinnvoll in ihren Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren.   • Mitarbeit bei der Automatisierung von Deployments sowie der Weiterentwicklung von CI/CD-Prozessen

  • Unterstützung bei Refactoring-, Reengineering- und Cloud-Transformationsprojekten

  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland, idealerweise Nähe Ratingen/Frankfurt

  • Gute Kenntnisse in SQL und im Arbeiten mit relationalen Datenbanken

  • Vertrautheit mit Microservice-Architekturen, Docker, Kubernetes und gRPC

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb verteilter Backend-Systeme

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen, hohe Eigenverantwortung und Freude an der Arbeit im Team

  • Offene und wertschätzende Kommunikation im Austausch mit Kund:innen und Kolleg:innen

Nice-to-have Anforderungen:

  • Erfahrung mit weiteren Programmiersprachen oder Technologien

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Observability, Monitoring oder Logging in verteilten Systemen

  • Erfahrung im Cloud-Umfeld (z. B. AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Interesse an DevOps-Praktiken

Das erwartet dich:

  • Attraktive Vergütung & Benefits – wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Gesundheitsbudget, Team-Offsites, moderne Tech-Ausstattung, Mobilitätspaket, Jobrad etc.

  • Karriereperspektive – klar definierte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten & Jahresgespräche

  • Weiterentwicklung – kontinuierliche Trainings, Zertifizierungen und Zugang zu Branchen-Events

  • Flexibilität – Hybrid-/Remote-Modell, flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Unternehmenskultur – kollegiales, politikarmes Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen und Ergebnisse zählen

HyPlus ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und setzen uns aktiv für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich alle Mitarbeitenden willkommen und wertgeschätzt fühlen.

jobs.title: Lead Software Planning & Delivery (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei Adlares machen wir Methanemissionen aus der Luft sichtbar – hochpräzise, zertifiziert und entscheidend für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur und den Klimaschutz. Mit unserem laserbasierten Messsystem CHARM® setzen wir den Industriestandard für die luftgestützte Gasfernüberwachung – und entwickeln aktuell die nächste, plattformunabhängige Systemgeneration (CHARM®3) sowie modernisierte Daten- und Auswerteprozesse im laufenden Betrieb.

Damit diese Neuentwicklung verlässlich gelingt, suchen wir eine Person mit hohen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere Softwareentwicklung verbindlich planen und zum Ziel führen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement die Ziele, übersetzt sie in einen realistischen Plan und trägst die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. So bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson im Planungsprozess.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ziele & Anforderungen: Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Leiter IT und dem PO definierst du die Ziele der Softwareentwicklung. Du holst Anforderungen bei Operations, Laser- und Hardwareentwicklern und Nutzenden ein, erkennst Lücken und Widersprüche und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Arbeitspakete für die Softwareentwicklung.

  • Planung & Kapazitäten: Du zerlegst Vorhaben in Epics und Tasks, planst Kapazitäten realistisch – inklusive Puffer für Betrieb und Tagesgeschäft – und machst Abhängigkeiten zu Hardware, Physik und Systemintegration frühzeitig sichtbar.

  • Umsetzungsverantwortung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden: Du leitest das Daily, machst Fortschritt und Risiken transparent und steuerst nach, wenn etwas aus dem Plan läuft.

  • Entscheidungen herbeiführen: Offene Fragen bleiben bei dir nicht liegen. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, führst sie im Team oder mit dem Produktmanagement herbei, hältst sie fest und verfolgst ihre Umsetzung.

  • Architektur im Team: Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team gemeinsam mit der IT-Leitung. Du moderierst diese Runden, bringst die Perspektive von Aufwand, Risiko und Planbarkeit ein und überführst die Ergebnisse in den Plan – auch bei der Frage, was wir am Bestand weiterführen und was wir schrittweise ablösen.

  • Mitentwickeln: Rund 20–30 % deiner Zeit arbeitest du selbst im Code, in Reviews oder an Prototypen. So kannst du Machbarkeit und Aufwand fundiert einschätzen.


  • Planungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Softwareentwicklung mit agilen und strukturierten Methoden – idealerweise in einem Umfeld, in dem Software, Hardware und Messtechnik zusammenkommen.

  • Verbindlichkeit: Du schaffst Klarheit und Verbindlichkeit.

  • Teamgeist: Unser multidisziplinäres Team aus Physikern, Software- und IT Entwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Datenanalysten bringt 25 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von LIDAR Systemen mit. Du bindest alle Stakeholder in den Zielfindungsprozess ein.

  • Analytisches Gespür: Du ziehst aus Gesprächen mit sehr unterschiedlichen Beteiligten das fachlich Relevante heraus und erkennst Lücken und Missverständnisse früh.

  • Entscheidungsstärke: Du führst Entscheidungen aktiv herbei, auch wenn noch nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und hältst nach, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

  • Technisches Fundament: Fundierte Entwicklungspraxis mit Python, sicherer Umgang mit Prinzipien guter Softwareentwicklung und Verständnis für C++.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit der Ablösung gewachsener Systeme (z. B. LabVIEW), mit Datenbanken, Messdaten und Signalverarbeitung sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung. Dazu Neugier auf Spektroskopie, Laserphysik und Optik.

Was dich erwartet

  • Wirksamkeit: Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem zentralen Neuentwicklungsprojekt, in der du Planung, Arbeitsweise und Verlässlichkeit unserer Softwareentwicklung maßgeblich prägst.

  • Interdisziplinäres Team: Zusammenarbeit mit Fachleuten aus Physik, Ingenieurwesen und Softwareentwicklung – mit kurzen Wegen und offener Kommunikation.

  • Sinnstiftende Mission: Eine zertifizierte Technologie mit direktem Beitrag zu Anlagensicherheit und Klimaschutz.

jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We are looking for a highly structured, hands-on Senior People Operations Project & Process Manager (m/f/d) to join our European HR Operations team. This is a senior role for someone who takes on our tougher operational problems and drives them forward together with the teams involved. You will be a driving force behind scaling, harmonizing, and digitizing our People Operations processes. Your scope is Europe, with selected global projects and touchpoints on top.

At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a seat at the table. As one of the senior drivers of our process landscape, you work alongside the wider team rather than alone, and you are a trusted senior voice on how our processes and projects fit together across markets. Your work directly shapes how HR operations functions at Flix, today in Europe and tomorrow on a global scale.

Our People Operations team is going through a significant digital transformation, with AI as a central part of how we are rethinking the way we work. Multiple projects are running in parallel across European and global scope, and this role contributes directly to that agenda. You do not need to arrive with deep AI expertise, but you need to be someone who is genuinely interested in exploring what AI-driven approaches can do for People Operations and who wants to grow with us in that direction. We have the people and the knowledge to develop these capabilities together.

jobs.title: Client Success Senior Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Client Success Senior Manager to our Client Success team in Munich!

You'll manage a set of high-profile corporate accounts in Germany, ensuring that our clients remain focused on our mission of making wellbeing universal. You'll also drive the commercial agenda within your portfolio of clients, and collaborate with other teams to ensure that take-up of Wellhub is high within all of the accounts that you manage. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team and work with talented people and some of Germany's most innovative companies. We're looking for a superstar candidate who can help the team to achieve new levels of success.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Own client relationships for a portfolio of large corporate accounts throughout the entire post-sale client lifecycle in Germany, leading all in-person and virtual client communications and meetings.
  • Ensure trusting, high-value partnerships with HR contacts, Procurement counterparts, and C-level executives by articulating Wellhub's mission to enhance employee health, engagement, and happiness.
  • Drive the commercial agenda across your account portfolio, leading annual contract renewals, expansions, and renegotiations to deliver continuous value.
  • Lead client launches, ongoing strategic relaunch initiatives, and awareness events in close partnership with the Wellhub Wellbeing Engagement Team for end-to-end execution.
  • Present and implement best-practice workflows, evaluate member growth metrics, suggest targeted adoption strategies, and provide continuous platform updates.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners—including Customer Experience, Operations, User Growth Marketing, Fitness Partnerships, Business Development, and Wellbeing Engagement teams—to build adoption strategies and hit shared goals.
  • Analyze client data and metrics to deliver actionable findings, shaping tailored communication and awareness campaigns that boost user engagement and defeat inactivity.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.


WHO YOU ARE

  • An accomplished relationship leader with 5+ years of experience managing complex client relationships in a client-facing capacity.
  • A commercial driver with proven expertise leading end-to-end contract negotiations for renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, aligning client growth goals with company revenue targets.
  • A dynamic and collaborative partner who thrives in team environments, brings creative problem-solving skills, and works seamlessly with cross-functional groups.
  • An exceptional communicator who provides superior customer service to both internal stakeholders and executive-level external clients.
  • A detail-oriented project manager with deep experience orchestrating multiple complex client deliverables and priorities concurrently.
  • An analytical thinker fluent in tracking data, interpreting performance reports, and leveraging insights into concrete operational strategies.
  • A process innovator capable of refining job protocols, optimizing workflows, and proactively navigating change in a fast-paced global business environment.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in enterprise client relationship management and commercial contract negotiations are mandatory requirements.


WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager with a demonstrated ability to lead and grow distributed teams of strong engineers working remotely around the world. You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership.

Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and empower several teams, working closely with their team leads, to deliver outcomes that matter to our users and the business, from long-term planning through to execution
  • Spot early risks to releases, team performance, or the business, and plan how to address them
  • Stay close to the technical work through design discussions, investigations, reviews, and guidance
  • Communicate clearly and early with other teams, departments, and stakeholders to meet release deadlines and business objectives
  • Cultivate a supportive team environment that encourages transparency and collaboration; support the personal and professional growth of everyone on your teams
  • Make the most of AI tools in your own work, and support your teams as they find new ways to build with AI

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in a technical leadership role (3+ years in an Engineering Manager role)
  • Have managed more than one engineering team, working alongside team leads
  • The technical depth to serve as a partner to your engineers; you can challenge technical direction and identify risks early
  • Experience with a JVM-based product
  • Proven track record of leading complex initiatives that ship customer-facing products
  • Strong product and business mindset, coupled with a get-things-done attitude
  • Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills
  • Experience in leading and growing software teams and engineers
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills
  • A genuine interest in how AI is changing software development, and hands-on experience using AI tools in your own work

Preferred qualifications

  • Expertise in developer tooling, developer experience, or developer productivity
  • Experience managing remote, distributed teams
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up
  • Experience with AI-powered developer products, such as agents or MCP servers

What We Offer

  • Work on a widely used product with a clear vision for the future
  • Contribute to how software teams build and ship in the age of AI agents
  • Close interactions with customers from leading tech organizations
  • Close collaboration with experienced and dedicated peers and engineers
  • Room to grow your leadership scope
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite and team meetings
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment 
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants

Location

  • Remote, Europe-friendly timezone, with working conditions allowing seamless collaboration with your colleagues through email, chat, and video calls

Helfen macht stark: Sie tragen dazu bei, Menschen ein sicheres Zuhause zu geben und damit Stabilität und Lebensqualität zu schaffen. Darauf können Sie stolz sein.

Insgesamt beschäftigen wir ca. 1800 Mitarbeiter*innen.

Wir leben Vielfalt! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung/Beeinträchtigung, Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Sie sind bei uns willkommen! Für einen renommierten Produktionsbetrieb aus der Konsumgüterbranche suchen wir ab sofort eine engagierte Verstärkung für das Instandhaltungsteam.

* Wartung & Betriebssicherheit: Du übernimmst die elektrische Wartung und Instandhaltung moderner Produktionsanlagen und gewährleistest so einen störungsfreien Fertigungsablauf.

* Anlagen-Inbetriebnahme: Du begleitest die Inbetriebnahme neuer oder umgebauter Anlagen und stellst deren reibungslose Funktion sicher.

* Prozessoptimierung: Du initiierst und realisierst eigenständig Kleinprojekte sowie Maßnahmen im Rahmen des kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozesses (KVP).

* Dokumentation: Du pflegst Wartungspläne und dokumentierst alle durchgeführten Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen sorgfältig.

Dein Profil

* Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Ausbildung (z. B. Lehrabschluss, Fachschule, HTL oder Meisterprüfung) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

* Erfahrung: Idealerweise mehrjährige Berufspraxis in der Instandhaltung eines industriellen Produktionsbetriebs (vorzugsweise in der Konsumgüter- oder Prozessindustrie).

* Fachkenntnisse: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Steuerungstechnik, insbesondere in der Programmierung und Fehlersuche mit Siemens S7.

* Arbeitsweise: Selbstständige, strukturierte und belastbare Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Teamfähigkeit und Hands-on-Mentalität.

* Rahmenbedingungen: Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Mehrschichtbetrieb sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse.

Das erwartet dich

* Attraktive Vergütung: Ein Bruttomonatsgehalt zwischen € 3.000,- und € 3.200,- (abhängig von Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung) zuzüglich einer Nachtschichtzulage von 30 % pro Stunde.

* Work-Life-Balance: Einarbeitungsmodelle für zusätzliche freie Tage (z. B. an Brückentagen) sowie planbare Erholungszeiten durch einen bis zu zweiwöchigen Betriebsurlaub im Sommer.

* Mobilität & Verpflegung: Fahrtkostenzuschuss für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, gestützte Verpflegung in der betriebseigenen Kantine sowie regelmäßige Produktpakete aus eigener Herstellung und kostenfreies Obst.

* Gesundheit & Extras: Betriebliche Gesundheitsvorsorge (Betriebsarzt), regelmäßige Teamevents sowie attraktive Einkaufs- und Reisevergünstigungen.

* Good written and spoken English.

Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.

Unsere Vision ist es, das zu ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik - wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.

jobs.title: VP of Sales, EMEA
jobs.description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

This is the seat where EMEA goes from early traction to a real engine: you own the number, you build the team, and you stay close enough to the deals to feel every one of them.

What that looks like day to day

Our GTM team is growing quickly. In London we already have pods across Enterprise Sales, Commercial Sales, Customer Success, BDR and Solutions Engineering, with a mix of internally promoted and externally hired first-line and segment leaders in place.

You own the EMEA revenue number, including new business and the bulk of net retention across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise. You lead the EMEA sales org directly, setting the bar on hiring, performance, coaching and territory design. You partner with in-region CS, SE, BDR and expansion account management to make the full regional motion work.

This is not a role you can do from behind a forecast. You'll be in the deals, running exec-level conversations with CTOs, CIOs and CISOs, inspecting and coaching pipeline personally, and carrying the deals that need you. You'll also drive operational excellence across pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, recruiting, enablement, fiscal planning and territory design.

Our leaders are close to the product, close to customers, and close to cross-functional peers. You'll work closely with our founders, COO, CMO, VP Finance, RevOps and Product, and build trust with Engineering, Marketing, Finance and company leadership. What you hear in region should influence the roadmap, and you'll contribute to company-wide planning and exec discussions, helping shape our global growth trajectory.

We want a real point of view on AI in GTM. How your team prospects, researches, qualifies, forecasts and closes should look different because of it.

You also set the cultural tone in London: a high performance bar, and a culture people want to be part of.

Who you are

  • You're based in or around London, and you're up for travelling across EMEA and occasionally to the US.

  • You've built an EMEA revenue engine from roughly $XXM to $XXXM at a high-growth B2B software company, and you have the appetite and resilience to take us from early traction to sustained scale in a Series B environment.

  • You've built and scaled sales teams across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise, and you know how the motion, hiring bar and cadence differ across each.

  • You're hands-on. You still get into deals, run discovery, coach live calls and hold a point of view on the product. You're not two layers removed from the customer.

  • You understand technical sales and have a track record selling to CTOs, CIOs and CISOs.

  • You have a real point of view on leveraging AI in GTM, grounded in things you've actually rolled out rather than things you've read about.

  • You keep a high performance bar while building a culture aligned with our values. We want both, and candidates who can only do one are not a fit. You're also an exceptional recruiter who attracts and retains A-players, and people follow you.

  • You build trust extensively across Engineering, Product and company leadership, and you're operationally excellent, with a bias for clarity, measurement and predictable execution.

Bonus points if you have experience scaling footprint into other European markets such as France, DACH and the Nordics. VP of EMEA Sales experience at a high-growth SaaS company scaling from $XXM to $XXXM+ is a plus, as is senior regional leadership at a $10B+ B2B software company with material revenue responsibility. We'd also love experience selling to engineering and SRE buyers in the reliability, observability, monitoring or DevOps space, early channel and alliances go-to-market experience, and the ability to lead cross-cultural teams across Europe.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build reliable software for a complex, real-world AI product.

The Platform team works across a broad range of problems at Gigaton, from CI/CD for our monorepo and networking and data integration with on-premise plant systems, to hardening our IoT OS image and building customer-facing software around our control systems.

The work is currently split across two squads:

  1. Enablement, focused on helping engineers move faster.

  2. Product, focused on supporting our control software.

Whichever squad you join, you’ll work across technically challenging problems with plenty of scope to learn, contribute and shape how we build software.

Your main responsibilities

  • Write reliable, well-tested software in Python and Terraform.

  • Monitor, support and improve software running in production.

  • Mentor less experienced engineers and help them develop their craft.

  • Identify, articulate and drive architectural improvements.

  • Bring strong software engineering practices to code developed across the wider engineering and ML teams.

  • Contribute to improving the quality, maintainability and reliability of our systems.

Bonus experience

You don’t need all of these, but experience in any of the following would be useful:

  • Control engineering, machine learning or MLOps.

  • AWS IoT, Greengrass or Mender for managing device fleets.

  • Working across multiple cloud environments, such as AWS, GCP or Azure.

  • Managing CI/CD environments using GitHub Actions.

  • Building production artefacts using tools such as Docker.

  • Functional programming languages such as Haskell, F# or Elm.

  • Building or working with more complex AI-enabled workflows beyond simple prompting.

You’ll excel if you are

  • Excited by complex technical domains and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar systems.

  • Highly collaborative and comfortable working across software, ML and other disciplines.

  • Familiar with practices such as testing, pairing, mobbing and iterative software development.

  • Pragmatic about engineering trade-offs and know when good enough now is better than perfect later.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

  • Able to improve existing systems, not just build new ones from scratch.

  • Happy to take ownership of problems and follow them through into production.

💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process

Our interview process is designed to help us understand your experience, how you think and how you work with others, while giving you plenty of opportunity to get to know Gigaton too.

1. Talent Partner conversation

You’ll start with a conversation with our Talent Partner. We’ll talk through your background, what you’re looking for and what interests you about Gigaton.

We’ll also give you more context on the role, the team and the interview process, and answer any initial questions you have.

2. Hiring Manager interview

Next, you’ll meet the hiring manager for a deeper conversation about your experience and some of the technical problems you’ve worked on.

We’ll explore the work you’ve owned, the decisions you’ve made, how you approach engineering trade-offs and whether the role feels like a strong match on both sides.

3a. Pair Programming - remote session

You’ll work with one of our engineers on a small technical exercise using Python and Terraform.

We’re not assessing memorised syntax or speed under pressure. We’re interested in how you reason, collaborate, use tests to guide your work, learn from documentation or tools, and communicate while solving an unfamiliar problem.

3b. Technical Onsite

This technical stage takes place in our London office and consists of one session.

System design

You’ll walk us through a real system you’ve worked on and had meaningful influence over.

We’ll ask about the problem, constraints, operational characteristics, design decisions, trade-offs and how the system evolved over time.

This isn’t a formal presentation. You’ll introduce the system for around 10–15 minutes, then we’ll explore it together in more depth.

4. Operating Principles interview

We’ll discuss examples from your past experience that relate to how we work at Gigaton:

  • Concrete Honesty

  • Autonomous Ownership

  • Go Gig or Go Home

  • Cement It with Fun and Kindness

We’re interested in specific examples of how you’ve demonstrated these behaviours in practice rather than abstract culture-fit questions.

5. CEO conversation

Finally, you’ll meet Josh, our CEO.

This is a chance to talk more broadly about Gigaton, our mission, where the company is heading and whether this feels like the right move for both sides.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll conduct reference checks before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us too by speaking with team members you haven’t yet met.

Once interviews are complete, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to provide feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

Compensation: £60K – £105K • Multiple Ranges

  • Senior Level • £85K – £105K
  • Mid Level • £60K – £85K

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

Our Strategic Sales team works on the largest and most complex opportunities at hx: multi-year, seven-figure partnerships that sit at the centre of our customers’ underwriting and pricing transformation. These deals involve long, high-touch sales cycles and require you to win the trust of actuaries, underwriters, IT leaders, and C-suite executives.

This is not transactional sales. The people who thrive here take ownership of ambiguity, build deep credibility with customers, and solve problems others can’t. They move seamlessly between strategy and execution, shaping how enterprise insurers adopt and scale AI-powered decision-making.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own and execute a strategic territory plan across the UK and EMEA, building and closing a pipeline of high-value opportunities with enterprise insurers in your named accounts.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Operated in long, high-touch, multi-stakeholder sales cycles where success depended on education, alignment, and trust, translating complex technology and abstract value into clear commercial outcomes.

  • Owned a territory with care and discipline, using tools like Salesforce for accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and planning, and demonstrating an ownership mindset in how you drive outcomes.

How we build in an AI-forward company

hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work.

We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible.

Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools.

The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world.

Benefits

Our Commitment to Diversity

Next Steps
