Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our Account Executive, Digital Natives, you will grow Mistral's business with companies building AI-native products across DACH. These are engineering-led companies whose products run on models: coding tools, voice agents, document automation, customer support platforms, search, and more. Their buyers are founders, CTOs, and AI engineering leads, and they choose models on performance, cost, reliability, and data residency.

You will be the first member of the Digital Natives team based in Europe. You will own deals end to end, from first conversation through production launch and expansion, working alongside our solutions engineering, product, science, and legal teams.

This role is based in London, with regular travel across the region and to our Paris headquarters.

What You Will Do:

Pipeline development (targeted outbound and qualified inbound):

  • Identify and engage the most promising AI-native companies in your territory, and build relationships with the founders and engineering leaders who select models

  • Qualify and convert inbound interest from teams already building on our API into commercial relationships

Technical evaluation:

  • Guide customers through evaluations of our models on their real workloads, working with our solutions engineers to keep the process fast and the results clear

  • Turn successful evaluations into production usage and long-term commercial agreements

Deal management and closing:

  • Own the commercial cycle end to end: qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, together with our legal and solutions teams

  • Manage deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders on both sides, and keep everyone aligned on timelines and next steps

Account growth:

  • Grow usage within existing customers as they ship new products and features on our models

  • Stay close to customers' roadmaps so Mistral is positioned for their next workload before it reaches production

jobs.title: Technico-commercial sédentaire (H/F)
jobs.description: Vous souhaitez évoluer vers une fonction commerciale dans l'univers industriel ? Je suis Léo Terrier, consultant chez Fed Business, et je recrute pour un acteur de la distribution de produits techniques à destination des professionnels de l'industrie, un Technico-commercial sédentaire, basé à Nancy. Vous souhaitez allier expertise technique, conseil client et développement commercial au sein d'une structure familiale ? Cette opportunité pourrait vous intéresser !Rattaché au Responsable d'agence, vous intégrez une équipe de 7 collaborateurs. Vous prenez en charge la gestion et le développement d'un portefeuille de clients professionnels, en leur apportant des solutions techniques et commerciales adaptées à leurs besoins.  Vous travaillez en binôme avec un Technico-commercial itinérant afin d'assurer la complémentarité entre le suivi des clients à distance et les actions commerciales sur le terrain.  Vos principales missions :  Gérer et développer un portefeuille de clients B2B en identifiant leurs besoins et en proposant des solutions adaptées.  Élaborer les devis, négocier les conditions commerciales, suivre les offres et effectuer les relances.  Développer les ventes par des actions de prospection téléphonique et de fidélisation.  Conseiller les clients sur les solutions techniques, notamment dans l'univers de la transmission mécanique.  Assurer le suivi des commandes, traiter les éventuels litiges et collaborer avec le Technico-commercial itinérant.  Une formation aux produits, aux processus et aux outils est prévue dès votre arrivée afin de vous accompagner dans votre prise de poste.  Rémunération et avantages :  Rémunération fixe : entre 30 et 35 K€ brut annuel selon profil et expérience.  Intéressement et participation aux bénéfices.  Tickets restaurant.  Mutuelle familiale prise en charge à 60 % par l'employeur.  3 RTT et 6 vendredis complets à poser dans l'année.Formation  Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation Bac +2/3 commerciale et/ou technique : BTS Maintenance, Électrotechnique, BUT Génie mécanique et productique (GMP), Génie industriel et maintenance (GIM) ou équivalent.  Expérience  Vous disposez d'une première expérience en B2B sur une fonction similaire ou dans un environnement technique et industriel.  Les profils issus de la maintenance, de l'électrotechnique ou de la mécanique souhaitant évoluer vers une fonction commerciale seront également étudiés. Une alternance réussie peut convenir.  Compétences  Comprendre des problématiques techniques et identifier les solutions adaptées aux besoins industriels.  Élaborer des devis et négocier des conditions commerciales.  Développer un portefeuille clients grâce à la prospection téléphonique et aux actions de fidélisation.  Assurer le suivi des commandes et gérer les éventuels litiges.  Travailler en complémentarité avec un commercial itinérant pour développer les ventes.  Ce qui fera la différence : votre capacité à associer compréhension technique des produits, sens du conseil et approche commerciale. Votre aisance dans la relation client et votre intérêt pour les environnements industriels seront essentiels.  Processus de recrutement  - Premier échange en visio avec moi - Entretien téléphonique la RRH. - Entretien sur site avec le Responsable d'agence. - Entretien en visioconférence avec le Responsable des commerciaux.  Vous ne correspondez pas à 100 % au profil recherché ? N'hésitez pas à postuler ! Je pourrai également vous proposer d'autres opportunités correspondant à votre parcours. Et si vous connaissez une personne susceptible de correspondre à ce poste, n'hésitez pas à lui transmettre cette annonce et à l'inviter à postuler !

jobs.description: Rattaché-e à la directrice de la BAI, vous rejoignez l'équipe des banquiers conseil, dédiée aux entreprises et à la clientèle de l'économie sociale et solidaire. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Models in Production (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Anyone can train a model in a notebook these days. Getting it into production, keeping it accurate month after month and turning its output into decisions people actually make is a different story. That's the job.

For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who builds models that matter for a premium brand. You work with structured and unstructured data, take models all the way into production and make sure they keep delivering. Your results shape strategic decisions and the experience of customers who expect nothing less than premium.

What makes this role different

You don't build models that end up in a slide deck. You own them end to end, from the raw data to the deployed model to the insight a decision maker acts on. One client, one location, one team in Munich, with direct access to the people who use your work.

And you are the person who brings machine learning into the business. You explain what a model can and cannot do, teach colleagues how to use it and help them ask better questions of their data.

Degree or not, what counts is what you have built. If you have a proven track record of shipping machine learning applications, for example in open source, that is as valuable to us as a degree.

The goal is ambitious. Move machine learning out of experiments and into the decisions a premium brand makes every day, from strategy to the experience of its customers.

What you will do

  • Develop and implement machine learning models for premium automotive applications
  • Collect, clean and prepare structured and unstructured data so your models are built on something solid
  • Deploy models to production, monitor them and keep them performing over time
  • Turn results into clear insights that support strategic decisions and enhance the customer experience
  • Document your work and teach others how machine learning and AI can be used in their daily business

What you bring

  • A degree in a technical field with a strong focus on machine learning, or a proven track record of building machine learning applications, for example in open source projects
  • Outstanding Python skills and a real appreciation for clean, well documented code
  • Experience developing and running applications in the cloud
  • Hands-on experience taking models into production and monitoring them, ideally with MLOps tools
  • A genuine passion for machine learning and AI and their potential in real business applications
  • The ability to explain a complex topic to a manager in the morning and dig into a data pipeline in the afternoon
  • Fluent English; German is a plus, but not a must

You'll stand out if you have shipped models that are used in day-to-day business, maintained or contributed to open source machine learning projects, or worked with automotive or industrial data.

The essentials

Start on 1 February 2027 in Munich, 35 hours per week, with an engagement until the end of 2027. You will be employed by advanced engineering GmbH and work directly with our client's project team.

Interested?

Apply with the button on this page. No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Har du lyst til å jobbe med barn som assistent i skole og sfo?
jobs.description:
For oppdragsgiver på Ringerike (skole) søker vi nå etter en skoleassistent til skole/sfo. Dette er et vikariat/engasjement som kan bli langvarig og vi ønsker oppstart så raskt som mulig.

Skolen har delt i grupper. I den ene gruppen er det barn fra 1-3 trinn og i den andre gruppen 4-6 trinn og i tillegg er det behov på sfo. 

Vi tenker i hovedsak at det ikke kreves noen spesiell bakgrunn men det er en fordel om man er barne- og ungdomsarbeider eller har vært assistent i barnehage/skole eller har erfaring fra arbeid med barn. 

Men det viktigste for oss er at vi finner den rette personen; personlig egnethet teller mest. 

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • veilede elever i undervisningen
  • være en lærerstøtte
  • oppfølging av enkeltelever som har behov for ekstra støtte
  • følge opp elever når de gjør arbeid eller trenger hjelp
  • er støttende med elevene i lek og samhandling
  • delta på friminutt og uteskole. 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

Det kan være en fordel om man er barn og ungdomsarbeider eller har vært assistent i barnehage/skole eller har erfaring fra arbeid med barn. (ikke noe av dette er krav).

Det viktigste er at man trives med arbeid med barn og at man får energi av å se de utvikle seg og man bidrar til trivsel og trivelig dager. 

Personlig egnethet teller mest for oss.

Vi ser for oss at du er nysgjerrig og interessert i å bli kjent med elevene.

 

Vi tilbyr

  • Varierte og givende arbeidsdager sammen med barn
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter 
  • Hyggelig arbeidsmiljø og gode kollegaer

Høres dette spennende ut?Søk ved å trykke på «Søk på stillingen» og registrer/last opp CV, søknad, attester, vitnemål mm på Temp-Team hjemmeside. 

Har du spørsmål så kontakter du Temp-Team v/Glenn G. Hovde på 

tlf. 982 44 777 eller epost gho@temp-team.noSøknadsfrist: Snarest (og oppstart snarest)

(relevante kandidater kontaktes fortløpende) 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Temp-Team leier ut personell og rekrutterer kandidater til faste stillinger innen de fleste bransjer og stillingskategorier. Vår målsetning er å levere dyktige og motiverte medarbeidere som innfrir våre kunders krav til både faglige kvalifikasjoner og personlige egenskaper. I vår forretningsmodell fokuserer vi på tett personlig oppfølging, etisk forretningsførsel og leveranse som avtalt. Temp-Team ble etablert i Norge i 1985, og har nå 15 avdelinger lokalisert i Bergen, Drammen, Follo, Hønefoss, Kristiansand, Oslo, Romerike, Sandvika, Sarpsborg, Stavanger, Trondheim, Tromsø, og Tønsberg. Vi har også en egen spesialistavdeling for bil og mekanikk. Vårt hovedkontor ligger ved Nationaltheatret i Oslo.Temp-Team inngår i Juhler Group, en internasjonal gruppe av rekrutterings- og bemanningsbyråer med kontorer i Norge, Sverige, Finland, Danmark, og England. I Norge har gruppen om lag 50 internt ansatte og hadde en omsetning på 222 mill. i 2025.

jobs.description: **Haluatko suunnitella koneita ja automaatiojärjestelmiä, jotka näkyvät ja toimivat oikeassa tuotantoympäristössä?**Kone Kuusisto Oy etsii mekaniikkasuunnittelijaa vahvistamaan suunnitteluosaamistaan.Toimimme automatisoitujen kappaleenkäsittely- ja sisälogistiikkaratkaisujen toimittajana. Tehtävän sisältöä voidaan painottaa osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**Toivomme, että sinulla on:- Soveltuva tekninen koulutus, esimerkiksi konetekniikan insinööri (AMK) tai diplomi-insinööri, tai vastaava käytännössä hankittu osaaminen. - Kokemusta 3D-mekaniikkasuunnittelusta. - Ymmärrystä koneenrakennuksesta, rakenteista ja valmistusmenetelmistä. - Kykyä ratkaista teknisiä ongelmia ja viedä suunnittelutehtäviä eteenpäin. - Oma-aloitteinen ja yhteistyökykyinen työskentelytapa. **Eduksi katsomme:**- Invertor ja muun Autodesk osaamisen. - Kokemuksen teollisuusautomaatiosta, robotiikasta tai materiaalinkäsittelyjärjestelmistä. - Koneenosien, voimansiirron, pneumatiikan ja toimilaitteiden tuntemuksen. - Kokemuksen koneiden turvallisuuteen liittyvistä suunnitteluratkaisuista. - Kokemuksen suunnittelun ja valmistuksen välisestä yhteistyöstä. jobs.title: B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du machst aus Content messbaren Impact. Mit durchdachten Automation- und Nurturing-Strecken, relevanten Newslettern und smartem CRM-Einsatz sorgst du dafür, dass Bring! Labs qualifizierte Leads gewinnt, Kontakte gezielt weiterentwickelt und langfristige Beziehungen aufbaut – entlang der gesamten Customer Journey. Datenbasierte Inhalte wie Success Stories und Branchen-Reports setzt du in diesen Strecken ein. Dafür suchen wir, im Kontext einer Mutterschaftsvertretung bis Ende Januar 2028, eine:n B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/x) mit Fokus auf Marketing Automation & Growth.

Was dich erwartet

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du Marketing Automation, E-Mail-Marketing und Lead-Generierung mit klarem Fokus auf die FMCG- und Retail-Branche im DACH-Raum. Du baust in HubSpot automatisierte Strecken auf, die qualifizierte Kontakte gewinnen und gezielt weiterentwickeln, und setzt dafür passende Inhalte ein.

Marketing Automation & Lead-Generierung

  • Aufbau und Optimierung von Inbound-, Automation- und Account-Based-Marketing-Strecken in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Sales-Team
  • Planung und Umsetzung von E-Mail-Marketing & Newslettern in HubSpot
    Segmentierung, Lead-Scoring und Lead Nurturing, inklusive Reaktivierung bestehender Kontakte

Content & Formate

  • Mitarbeit an datenbasierten Branchen-Reports, Kategorie Insights, Success Stories und potenziell weiteren Content Pieces
  • Konzeption zielgruppenspezifischer Inhalte entlang der gesamten Customer Journey als Basis für Automation-Strecken und Newsletter

Performance & Optimierung

  • Analyse, Tracking und kontinuierliche Optimierung sämtlicher Maßnahmen entlang relevanter KPIs

Dein Profil

Bei Bring! Labs denken wir groß und suchen Menschen, die das mit Eigeninitiative, strukturierter Arbeitsweise und Teamgeist mitgestalten wollen. Wir freuen uns darüber, wenn du Teil unseres Teams werden willst und Folgendes mitbringst:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Marketing Automation, E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung im Content Marketing oder Copywriting
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation- und CRM-Tools, idealerweise HubSpot (Workflows, Segmentierung, Reporting)
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Lead-Generierung und Reaktivierung von Kontakten
  • Starkes Verständnis für KPIs, Data Storytelling und Datenvisualisierung
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT routiniert, um Daten auszuwerten, Content-Varianten zu erstellen oder Abläufe zu automatisieren
  • Kenntnisse der Media-Branche oder Erfahrung im Digital Marketing von Handel und Marken von Vorteil
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Warum wir?

Wir sind ein Tech-Unternehmen mit der Vision, die Kommunikation zwischen Marken und Konsument:innen neu zu denken. Bei Bring! Labs legen wir Wert auf eine professionelle und offene Arbeitskultur, in der unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Hintergründe willkommen sind. Wir bieten dir einen großartigen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du direkten Impact haben und deine Karriere weiterentwickeln kannst. Weiter bieten wir:

  • Ein attraktives und modernes Arbeitsumfeld im Herzen von Berlin, inklusive kostenlosem Barista-Grade Kaffee
  • Für deine Arbeit bekommst du das neuste MacBook/HP, inklusive Maus, Tastatur und hochwertigen Kopfhörern
  • Dein Geburtstag wird bei uns groß geschrieben. Daher hast du, ergänzend zu den 25 Tagen Urlaub, an deinem Geburtstag einen zusätzlichen freien Tag
  • Genieße die Flexibilität des hybriden Arbeitens: Treffe deine Kollegen in unserem Büro oder arbeite gelegentlich von zu Hause aus
  • Umweltfreundliche Reisemöglichkeiten, inklusive einer BahnCard 50
  • Wir lieben Social-Events: Alle 6 Monate treffen wir uns als gesamte Company in Zürich für ein geselliges Beisammensein. Die Reise inkl. Übernachtung wird selbstverständlich von Bring! Labs übernommen!

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und beschreib uns in drei bis fünf Sätzen eine Automation-Strecke, die du selbst aufgebaut hast: Ziel, Auslöser, Ergebnis.

Willst du mehr wissen?

Wir berücksichtigen Bewerbungen unabhängig von Nationalität, ethnischem Hintergrund, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlecht, Behinderung oder familiärer Situation. Wir fördern auch die Bewerbungen von Berufsrückkehrern.

jobs.title: Sopimusasiantuntija
jobs.description: Suomalainen arki vaatii energiaa. Ja tekijöitä. Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan polttamatonta ja joustavaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Helen Oy on vähittäissähkönmyynnin markkinajohtaja Suomessa. Tarjoamme sähkön, lämmön ja jäähdytyksen lisäksi ratkaisuja alueelliseen sekä uusiutuvaan energiaan. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme kehittäen fiksumpaa energiajärjestelmää tavoitteena nettonollapäästöt sekä polttoon perustuvasta energiantuotannosta irtautuminen vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Päästäksemme kunnianhimoisiin tavoitteisiimme ja palvellaksemme asiakkaitamme entistä paremmin etsimme sopimusasiantuntijaa Asiakaslaskutus ja tiedonvaihto -tiimiimme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Mitä pääset meillä tekemään? Sopimusasiantuntijana varmistat, että sähkösopimuksiin ja sähköyhtiöiden väliseen tiedonvaihtoon liittyvät prosessit toimivat oikein ja asiakkaiden asiat etenevät sujuvasti. Työsi on tärkeä osa kuluttaja-asiakkaidemme sähkönmyynnin ja sähkönsiirron asiakkuuksien sekä sopimusten hallintaa. Vastaat sähköyhtiöiden välisestä Datahub-tiedonvaihdosta ja selvität tilanteita, joissa tieto tai prosessi ei ole edennyt odotetusti. Työssäsi seuraat sopimus- ja tiedonvaihtoprosessien toimivuutta ja selvität tilanteita, joissa kaikki ei ole mennyt suunnitellusti. Teet yhteistyötä muiden energia-alan toimijoiden kanssa, selvität asiakkaiden tilanteita ja viestit heille ratkaisuista. Lisäksi käsittelet laskutustietoja, teet sähkösopimuksia sekä korjaat sopimus- ja asiakastietoja järjestelmissä. Työ ei kuitenkaan ole vain yksittäisten tilanteiden ratkaisemista: tunnistat myös toistuvia ongelmia ja osallistut toimintatapojen ja prosessien kehittämiseen. Työssä yhdistyvät tarkkuutta vaativa asiantuntijatyö, ongelmanratkaisu, yhteistyö ja asiakastilanteiden selvittäminen. Kaikki tilanteet eivät tule valmiin kaavan mukaan, joten pääset käyttämään myös omaa harkintaasi ja selvittämään asioita aktiivisesti. Mitä odotamme sinulta? Tehtävässä auttaa aiempi kokemus energia-alasta, sopimusten hallinnasta, asiakasprosesseista tai muusta vastaavasta tarkkuutta vaativasta työstä. Työssä kohtaat myös vaihtelevia ja ajoittain kiireisiä tilanteita, joten arvostamme kykyä säilyttää huolellinen ja tarkka työote myös paineen alla. Erityiseksi eduksi katsomme Datahub-sanomaliikenteen, sähkömarkkinoiden menettelytapaohjeiden ja tiedonvaihdon käytäntöjen tuntemuksen. Myös CIS-asiakastietojärjestelmän tai muiden asiakas- ja sopimushallinnan järjestelmien tuntemuksesta on hyötyä. Haemme joukkoomme aktiivista ja oma-aloitteista tekijää, joka tarttuu asioihin ja ottaa vastuuta niiden etenemisestä. Arvostamme uteliasta ja kehittävää työotetta sekä halua ratkaista ongelmia, kyseenalaistaa totuttuja toimintatapoja ja löytää yhdessä entistä parempia tapoja toimia Millainen tiimi sinua odottaa? Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata ensimmäisenä työpäivänä. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen ja ympärillesi ison joukon osaavia kollegoita. Tiimissämme työskentelee yhdeksän tiedonvaihdon sopimusasiantuntijaa ja yhdeksän asiakaslaskutuksen laskutusasiantuntijaa. Meillä tieto ja osaaminen kuuluvat kaikille. Autamme toisiamme, jaamme kokemuksiamme ja opimme jatkuvasti toisiltamme. Uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät silloin, kun erilaiset näkemykset uskalletaan tuoda avoimesti esiin. Emme halua tyytyä siihen, miten asiat tehdään tänään. Haluamme kehittyä, kokeilla uutta ja nostaa rimaa yhdessä. Siksi arvostamme ihmisiä, jotka ottavat omistajuutta, uskaltavat haastaa rakentavasti ja haluavat tehdä asioita huomenna vielä hieman paremmin kuin tänään. Toimistomme sijaitsee WeLandissä Ruoholahdessa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Jäikö jokin vielä mietityttämään? Voit kysyä tehtävästä ja tiimistä tarkemmin tiimin esihenkilöltä Hanna Surakalta (+358503377313, hanna.surakka@helen.fi). Kohtasivatko energiamme? Mahtavaa! Voit lähettää hakemuksen ja ansioluettelosi helposti rekryjärjestelmämme kautta (helen.fi/rekry), viimeistään 10.12.2026 mennessä. Huomioithan, että haastattelemme sopivia ehdokkaita jo hakuaikana ja työsuhde alkaa heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian! Yhdistetään voimat!

jobs.title: Quality Manager (all genders) – Quality & Sustainability
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist Teil des Produktteams und verantwortest den gesamten Qualitätsbereich sowie die Einhaltung relevanter Qualitäts- und Futtermittelstandards bei mammaly.
  • Du stehst im engen Austausch mit unseren Lieferanten, führst regelmäßige Audits durch und begleitest wichtige Produktionen vor Ort.
  • Du analysierst regelmäßig Kundenreklamationen und überprüfst unseren Warenbestand, um mögliche Qualitätsprobleme frühzeitig zu identifizieren.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams im Lager und an den Produktionsstandorten zusammen. Dazu gehören auch regelmäßige Dienstreisen für Vor-Ort-Besprechungen und Abstimmungen mit unseren Partnern.
  • Du führst detaillierte Ursachenanalysen und Untersuchungen durch und leitest geeignete Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen (CAPA) ein.
  • Du leitest Qualitätsinitiativen abteilungsübergreifend und stellst sicher, dass diese gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern umgesetzt werden.
  • Du verantwortest den weiteren Aufbau unserer internen Qualitätssicherung und des Qualitätsmanagements. Dazu gehören die Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Qualitätssystemen, Dokumentenmanagement, SOPs, Formularen und Richtlinien.
  • Du unterstützt uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstandards und ESG-Themen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Lieferanten, Verpackungen und verantwortungsvollen Beschaffungsprozessen.
  • Du koordinierst qualitäts- und nachhaltigkeitsbezogene Anforderungen im Rahmen von B Corp und weiteren relevanten Standards und unterstützt die entsprechende Dokumentation und Umsetzung im Unternehmen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Lebensmitteltechnologie, Lebensmittelchemie, Lebensmittelverfahrenstechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung.
  • Du bringst 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Lebensmittel-, Tiernahrungs-, Supplement- oder Functional-Food-Industrie mit – idealerweise in der Produktentwicklung, R&D, Lebensmitteltechnologie oder im Quality Management.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der industriellen Herstellung und bereits Produktionsversuche, Bemusterungen oder Prozessoptimierungen direkt an der Linie oder gemeinsam mit Produktionspartnern begleitet.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle, idealerweise einschließlich Laboranalytik, Reklamationsbearbeitung, CAPA und Freigabeprozessen.
  • Du bringst gute Kenntnisse der relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen im Lebensmittel- oder Futtermittelrecht mit.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Nachhaltigkeits- und ESG-Themen, beispielsweise im Bereich nachhaltiger Verpackungen, Lieferantenstandards, verantwortungsvoller Beschaffung oder Zertifizierungen wie B Corp.
  • Du hast eine hohe Reisebereitschaft und bist flexibel, bei Bedarf auch kurzfristig für Vor-Ort-Termine bei unseren Partnern verfügbar zu sein.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und hast Freude daran, Prozesse eigenständig aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du bist offen für den Einsatz neuer Technologien und KI-gestützter Tools, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  • Télétravail — 2 jours par semaine

  • Démarrage — 6 mois renouvelable

Contexte de la mission

ImaginePartners recherche un contrôleur de gestion pour rejoindre l’équipe Finance Services d’un acteur international des achats stratégiques dans les télécommunications et l’informatique. Vous interviendrez principalement sur l’entité française et suivrez le processus achats-paiement pour quatre entités juridiques.

Vos missions

  • Piloter les clôtures financières mensuelles et annuelles selon les normes IFRS, en coordination avec les prestataires comptables internationaux.

  • Suivre le processus achats-paiement (Purchase-to-Pay) des quatre entités et collaborer avec les clients internes et les représentants des actionnaires.

  • Analyser les résultats du mois et du cumul annuel, avec une vision d’ensemble des comptes.

  • Établir chaque mois les prévisions de charges opérationnelles de personnel et hors personnel, par nature de coûts.

  • Piloter le processus budgétaire annuel ou y contribuer.

  • Assurer les échanges avec les auditeurs internes et externes, réaliser les analyses demandées par la direction et contribuer à la digitalisation du reporting interne.

Livrables attendus

  • Clôtures mensuelles et annuelles IFRS couvrant le compte de résultat et le bilan.

  • Revues analytiques des résultats mensuels (MTD) et cumulés depuis le début de l’année (YTD).

  • Prévisions mensuelles des charges de personnel et hors personnel par nature de coûts.

  • Contributions au budget annuel et analyses ponctuelles pour la direction.

Profil recherché

Exigences

  • Bac+5 en finance et comptabilité ou en administration, et au moins cinq ans d’expérience professionnelle dans ce domaine.

  • Connaissances approfondies en comptabilité et en contrôle de gestion.

  • Maîtrise professionnelle d’Excel et de PowerPoint.

  • Français et anglais courants.

  • Capacités d’analyse et de synthèse, autonomie, sens du service et diplomatie dans un environnement multiculturel.

Atouts

  • Expérience en comptabilité ou en contrôle de gestion de bout en bout dans une entreprise internationale.

  • Maîtrise de Power BI.

  • Allemand opérationnel.

Candidature

Pour postuler via JOIN, merci de transmettre les éléments suivants.

  • CV à jour.

  • Date de disponibilité.

  • TJM HT.

  • Statut freelance.

  • Localisation et capacité à intervenir à Issy-les-Moulineaux.

  • Un exemple de clôture IFRS ou de prévision de charges que vous avez pilotée, en précisant votre rôle.

jobs.title: MaKo Specialist Forderungsmanagement (d/w/m)
jobs.description:
Deine Mission

Als MaKo Specialist Forderungsmanagement bei SpotmyEnergy sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Forderungen gegenüber Netzbetreibern vollständig, korrekt und fristgerecht abgerechnet und realisiert werden. Im Fokus stehen die Abrechnung der Preisobergrenze (POG) im Messstellenbetrieb sowie Modul 1 und Modul 3 nach § 14a EnWG. Du baust diesen Bereich bei uns maßgeblich mit auf und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass unser Geschäftsmodell als Lieferant und wettbewerblicher Messstellenbetreiber wirtschaftlich stabil läuft.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung des Forderungsmanagements gegenüber Verteilnetzbetreibern für POG-, Modul-1- und Modul-3-Forderungen
  • Abrechnung des Zählerrückversands gegenüber den Netzbetreibern
  • Erstellung, Prüfung und Versand von Abrechnungen sowie Abgleich der Zahlungseingänge und Zahlungsavise (INVOIC/REMADV)
  • Klärung von Abweichungen, Rechnungsablehnungen und Kürzungen in Abstimmung mit den Netzbetreibern
  • Mahnwesen und Eskalation offener Posten
  • Prüfung der abrechnungsrelevanten Stammdaten (MaLo/MeLo, Zeitscheiben, Konfigurationen) als Grundlage für korrekte Rechnungen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Billing, Finance, MaKo-Kolleg:innen sowie externen Dienstleistern
  • Reporting zu offenen Forderungen und Klärfällen
  • Mitarbeit an der Automatisierung und Optimierung der Abrechnungs- und Forderungsprozesse

Dein Profil

  • Kaufmännische oder energiewirtschaftliche Ausbildung bzw. ein entsprechendes Studium
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Forderungsmanagement oder in der Abrechnung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in der Netznutzungs- oder MSB-Abrechnung

jobs.title: Klantenbegeleider
jobs.description:
Feeling voor interieur, bouw & mensen? Als klantenbegeleider bij een projectontwikkelaar in regio Ninove begeleid je toekomstige eigenaars doorheen hun nieuwbouwtraject. Je bent hun aanspreekpunt van begin tot einde, denkt mee na over hun keuzes en zorgt ervoor dat alles vlot verloopt. Een afwisselende functie waarin je commercieel contact combineert met organisatie en opvolging. Benieuwd? Lees dan zeker verder.Om je al een eerste beeld te geven van de job:
  • Eens een residentieel project verkocht is, neem jij het dossier over en word je het vaste aanspreekpunt voor de koper tijdens het volledige afwerkingstraject.
  • Klanten begeleiden bij hun materiaalkeuzes, van vloeren en binnendeuren tot keuken, sanitair en andere afwerkingsdetails.
  • Zorgen voor een correcte administratieve opvolging van dossiers, berekeningen en gemaakte afspraken.
  • Vlot schakelen met leveranciers en partners om alles in goede banen te leiden en de kwaliteit van het project te bewaken.
  • Communiceren met klanten in het Nederlands & af en toe in het Frans en/of Engels.
Je komt terecht bij een ontwikkelaar die zich specialiseert in residentiële nieuwbouwprojecten, zowel appartementen als woningen. Van ontwerp en vergunning tot verkoop, uitvoering en oplevering wordt het volledige traject intern opgevolgd, waardoor kwaliteit en betrokkenheid centraal staan in elk project.Intern kom je terecht in een hecht team van een15tal medewerkers. De communicatielijnen zijn kort, deuren staan letterlijk en figuurlijk open en collega's staan klaar om elkaar te helpen. Er wordt hard gewerkt, maar minstens evenveel belang gehecht aan een aangename werksfeer en een goede verstandhouding binnen het team.De bedrijfscultuur wordt gekenmerkt door gedrevenheid, ambitie en een positieve ingesteldheid. Mensen die initiatief nemen, verantwoordelijkheid opnemen en vooruit willen, krijgen hier alle kansen om zichzelf verder te ontwikkelen. Misschien ben jij wel degene die we zoeken? :-)
  • In het bezit van een bachelor- of masterdiploma. Een achtergrond in interieurvormgeving sluit perfect aan, maar ook architectuur of een andere bouwgerelateerde richting komt zeker in aanmerking.
  • Nauwkeurig werken zit in je natuur. Administratie schrikt je niet af en dossiers worden door jou correct opgevolgd.
  • Graag initiatief nemen, zelfstandig werken en energie halen uit een afwisselende job met veel klantencontact.
  • Interesse in nieuwbouw, interieur of vastgoed? Dan heb je alvast een mooie voorsprong.
  • Kennis van AutoCAD is een plus, maar zeker geen must.
  • Positieve energie, enthousiasme en een hands-on mentaliteit zijn minstens even belangrijk als ervaring. We zoeken iemand die zich graag smijt, verantwoordelijkheid opneemt en mee wil bouwen aan het succes van het bedrijf.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a leading IT security solutions provider, we are looking for a highly motivated, commercially driven and transformational Director Distribution EMEA Central to lead our distribution business across approximately 20 countries, with a primary focus on the DACH region (Germany, Austria and Switzerland).

This is a senior leadership role with end-to-end responsibility for the performance, development and transformation of our distribution ecosystem across EMEA Central. The Director will lead and develop a Distribution-Team and work closely with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Operations and Finance to ensure that distribution effectively supports our overall go-to-market strategy.

The role goes beyond traditional distributor relationship management. It requires a strong focus on profitable growth, operational excellence, scalable partner activation and the continued transformation of distribution towards cloud, MSP/MSSP, managed services and subscription-based business models. This reflects a broader cybersecurity channel shift toward managed services, platformization and resilience-led solutions.

 

What You'll Do

  • Oversee the development and execution of distribution strategies across approximately 20 countries, with a primary focus on the DACH region. Build and strengthen strategic distributor relationships, ensuring alignment with company objectives and driving growth across the Sophos cybersecurity portfolio.

  • Drive MSP distribution, cloud marketplace adoption and recurring business models as integral elements of the overall channel and distribution strategy.

  • Own the strategic relationship with key distributors, including joint business planning, executive alignment, performance management and growth initiatives.

  • Maintain a detailed understanding of distributors’ businesses, including market dynamics, pain points, investment priorities, profitability drivers and growth opportunities.

  • Manage relevant financial and credit topics in close collaboration with Finance, ensuring sustainable and profitable distributor relationships.

  • Develop short-, medium- and long-term joint business plans with distributors, including clear objectives, growth initiatives and accurate forecasts.

  • Drive significant improvements in automation and operational scalability, including APIs, order processing, provisioning, reporting and data integration.

  • Take an active role in executing agreed business plans and ensure successful delivery against defined objectives and KPIs.

  • Conduct structured quarterly business reviews to evaluate distributor performance, identify gaps and opportunities, and agree on corrective or growth actions.

  • Drive partner recruitment, activation and development through distribution, ensuring distributors continuously expand and develop a productive partner ecosystem.

  • Ensure distributors have the required sales, technical and operational capabilities to position, sell and support Sophos solutions effectively.

  • Drive appropriate training and enablement programs across the distributor ecosystem to support strategic Sophos solutions and initiatives.

  • Engage distributors in joint demand generation, co-marketing and lead-generation activities, with a clear focus on measurable pipeline and business outcomes.

  • Build strong relationships with senior distributor decision-makers across Sales, Finance, Marketing, Services, Cloud and Operations to identify new markets and growth opportunities.

  • Cultivate strong consultative relationships with key distributor stakeholders and ensure effective collaboration between Sophos, distributors and partners.

  • Consistently communicate the Sophos value proposition and strategic direction to strengthen Sophos' position and increase share of business within key distributors.

  • Ensure high standards of CRM/PRM data quality, pipeline visibility and forecasting accuracy across the distribution organization.

  • Lead, coach and develop the Distribution Team, creating a collaborative, accountable and high-performance culture focused on sustainable growth.

  • Lead the team through strategic and organizational change required to support Sophos' ambition to be a next-generation cybersecurity leader.

  • Recruit and onboard Distribution Account Team members as required and ensure the organization has the skills and capabilities needed for future growth.

  • Proactively address challenges and resistance related to transformation and change initiatives.

  • Establish an open feedback and continuous-improvement culture that supports both team development and organizational transformation.

  • Execute Distribution and Channel Go-to-Market strategies in alignment with regional and corporate priorities.

  • Identify evolving market, distributor and partner requirements and translate them into actionable recommendations for Sophos.

  • Set clear objectives for team members, monitor performance against agreed KPIs, OKRs and business targets, and ensure formal performance and development reviews are conducted.


What You'll Bring


Required:

  • Several years' of leadership experience

  • Several years' of experience in distribution account management, channel management or sales leadership, preferably in the IT security industry

  • Experience developing business plans

  • Experience developing and monitoring business and opportunity plans

  • Broad business background, including knowledge of financial, marketing and sales concepts

  • Ability to engage with all levels of an organisation to achieve strategic and tactical objectives

  • Excellent relationship management skills and the ability to resolve conflicts

  • Understanding of financial management and business investment planning

  • Ability to learn quickly and adopt new approaches and techniques

  • Ability to understand the technical background of our solutions

  • Ability to understand partners’ business models

  • Knowledge of software channel ecosystems in the territory

  • Strong presentation skills, communication and interpersonal skills

  • Strong motivational skills

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Willingness to travel extensively across the EMEA Central region to engage with distributors, partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Flexibility and availability during critical business periods, particularly quarter- and year-end, as well as key company, distributor and partner events.

  • Carry personal and team quota responsibility, with clear accountability for achieving regional revenue, ACV and growth objectives.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and drive change across both the Distribution team and the broader distributor ecosystem, ensuring successful adaptation to evolving market dynamics, technologies, business models and company strategies.

Preferred:

  • Experience selling IT security solutions

  • Experience managing distributors within a defined territory

  • Knowledge of the security software industry, including competitors, market needs and trends

  • Familiarity with Sophos solutions or comparable competitive products

  • Familiarity with the requirements, expectations and benefits of being a Sophos distributor

What does remote mean at Sophos?
Sophos supports flexible ways of working, with many roles offered remotely and others working in a hybrid model. For remote roles, you may work remotely within the location specified in the job posting. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in that location. Our teams collaborate across locations and time zones, using technology to stay connected and deliver results.

 

Our Commitment To You

Sophos welcomes applicants with diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We believe great ideas come from different ways of thinking, and we are committed to building a workplace where people can contribute, grow, and succeed.

We evaluate all candidates based on job-related skills, qualifications, and experience, and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities consistent with applicable laws and regulations.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Plentific, we’re redefining property management in real time. Our mission, is to lead real estate through the transformative journey into “The World of Now,” enabling us to empower property professionals through our innovative, cloud-based platform.

We harness cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights to streamline operations for landlords, letting agents, and property managers enabling them to optimize maintenance, manage repairs, and make informed decisions instantly. Our platform is designed to create seamless, real-time workflows that transform traditional property management into a dynamic, digital experience.

Backed by a world-class group of investors including Noa, Highland Europe, Brookfields, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures, and Target Global. Plentific is at the forefront of the proptech revolution. Headquartered in London with a global outlook, we’re continually expanding our reach and impact.

We’re looking for forward-thinking, passionate professionals who are ready to contribute to our mission and drive industry innovation. If you’re excited about making an immediate impact and shaping the future of property management, explore career opportunities with us at Plentific.

About the role

Plentific is growing, and so is the number of teams who need clear, reliable data to make decisions. We're hiring a Data & Strategy Analyst to help teams across the business make better data led decisions. You'll turn commercial questions into the right KPIs, dashboards and insights.

This is a Commercial role. You'll sit in the Supply Chain team and work with Customer Excellence, Supply Chain Delivery, Go-to-Market and the leadership teams, alongside Data Engineering. Data Engineering builds and models the data. Your job is to understand what the business needs, pick the right measures and give teams answers they can act on. You'll also use AI in your daily work to get to insight faster and cut down on manual reporting.

What you'll do

  • Build and own a KPI framework. For each team, work out which KPIs matter, agree clear definitions and keep them consistent so everyone works from one version of the truth.

  • Build dashboards in Looker. Turn existing data into clear, well-designed dashboards for areas such as transactional revenue, contractor supply and performance, and client health.

  • Build predictive workflows. Move teams from looking back to looking ahead. Use trends and leading indicators to flag issues early, such as contractor capacity gaps, at-risk clients or slowing job volumes, and build them into workflows and alerts so teams act before problems land.

  • Identify and size growth opportunities. Spot where we can grow, such as clients with headroom, under-used services, regions with unmet demand or gaps in supply with a clear recommendation and next step.

  • Run commercial analysis. Carry out ad-hoc and strategic deep dives for business cases, board and leadership packs, client reviews and commercial decisions.

  • Work with Data Engineering. When the business needs new data fields or models, turn that need into a clear requirement for the team.

  • Use AI to explore data. Draft insights and speed up analysis, and apply the judgement and checks that keep the output accurate.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • An agreed, documented KPI set for Supply Chain Delivery and Customer Excellence teams.

  • Used data to map a core process end to end, find where it breaks down, and redesign it to improve the team's performance

  • Core dashboards live and used by those teams in their regular reviews

What we're looking for

  • 4-5 years experience in a data, business intelligence, commercial analyst or strategy analyst role

  • Strong hands-on business intelligence tool experience (Looker is preferred), including building dashboards and explores from modelled data

  • A commercial mindset. You can take a vague business question, work out what's really being asked and choose the metrics that answer it.

  • A track record of turning insight into change. You've used data to redesign a process, shape a decision or unlock revenue, not only to report on what happened.

  • Confidence working with stakeholders at every level, from operational teams to senior leadership, including challenging requests and managing priorities

  • Clear communication. You can present data as a story, not just a chart.

  • Well organised, able to juggle requests from several teams at once

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplace, property or housing businesses

  • Background in strategy, consulting or operations-focused roles

  • Familiarity with SaaS KPIs such as ARR, NRR, ARPU, NPS and transactional or marketplace KPIs such as GMV, take rate, conversion and supply/demand balance

  • Basic SQL knowledge

Benefits

As you can see, we are quickly progressing with our ambitious plans and are eager to grow our team of doers to achieve our vision of managing over 2 million properties through our platform across various countries. You can help us shape the future of property management across the globe. Here’s what we offer:

  • Flexible working environment including the option to work abroad

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 180+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring Product Engineers at Staff, Senior Staff, and Principal level across three of our engines: Buy, Sell and Third Party Access (TPA).

A Product Engineer at tem gets handed a problem, not a ticket. You sit inside an engine, next to the account managers, partners and customers who live with the problem. You work out what to build, build it, and stay with it after launch until you can show it moved the metric. Product sets the bet and the guidance, not the feature list, so nobody writes your tickets for you.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. We will talk to you about which engine fits you best, and where your experience and interests line up.

Buy: Buy is where businesses pay less for clean power. It's the side of tem that runs RED for the UK businesses on it: quotes with every cost up front, bills itemised line by line, and a switch from quote to live in minutes, not days. You'd build the products and systems behind that, from tender to signed contract to a bill with nothing to hide, and make it work just as well for the next thousand sites as it does for the first.

Sell: Sell is where generators earn more for what they produce. We contract with UK solar, wind, hydro, anaerobic digestion, biomass and EfW sites, from single farms to multi-site portfolios, through broker partners and direct. You'd build the tools that get generators signed faster, show them exactly what they're earning, and get them paid on time, every time. You'd also open up new kinds of sites we can't contract today, so there's more clean power to put in front of businesses.

Third Party Access (TPA): TPA builds the new transaction rails for our partners. It lets brokers, banks, affiliates and generators sell tem's energy under their own brand, running on Rosso, our pricing engine. You'd design and build the partner APIs, branded portals, billing and settlement that make that work, and take a 0 to 1 product from pilot to production. In TPA you'll also be partner-facing, embedding with partners to get them integrated and live.

jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

Responsibilities
Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts.

  • Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes.

  • Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range.

  • Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results.

  • Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware.

  • Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins.

  • Quantify the performance envelope, including the limits set by actuator bandwidth, sensor noise and latency, and the agility gained in return.

  • Build a reusable toolchain: a Python simulation workflow (for example JSBSim or Gazebo) validated on flight data, hardware-in-the-loop tests, flight test procedures and a data analysis pipeline.

  • Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.

Candidate Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Control, Robotics, or a related field.

  • Solid foundations in flight mechanics and control theory, ideally with experience in system identification or stability analysis.

  • Proficiency in Python. C/C++ and embedded firmware experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on building experience, such as RC aircraft, drones, or any fabrication project. Familiarity with PX4 or ArduPilot is a plus.

  • Comfort with flight testing, debugging in the field, and learning from the occasional crash.

  • Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly.

As a Flight Mechanics Engineer - System Identification, working out of Zurich, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

jobs.title: Stellvertretende Ärztliche Leitung der Ovivamed Clinic
jobs.description:
Warum Ovivamed?
Bei Oviva und Ovivamed Clinic verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschliesslich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

Die Rolle

Als Stellvertretende Ärztliche Leitung verbindest du die direkte Arbeit mit Patient:innen mit klinischer Verantwortung. Rund 60% deiner Zeit verbringst du in Konsultationen, in denen du Patient:innen auf ihrem Weg begleitest. Die übrigen 40% arbeitest du eng mit der ärztlichen Leitung zusammen: Du vertrittst sie in Besprechungen und Entscheidungen, unterstützt deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen und bist bei Abwesenheit die erste Ansprechperson für klinische Fragen. Du arbeitest sowohl hybrid sowie wahlweise an einem unserer Praxisstandorte (Zürich, Bern, Basel oder Luzern).

Deine Aufgaben

  • Behandlung: Du führst Konsultationen und medizinische Abklärungen durch und begleitest Patient:innen mit Adipositas und Begleiterkrankungen langfristig, auch mithilfe unserer digitalen Werkzeuge.

  • Qualität: Du achtest auf eine sorgfältige Dokumentation und Abrechnung und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran.

  • Stellvertretung: Du vertrittst die ärztliche Leitung in Fachgremien und bei betrieblichen Besprechungen.

  • Unterstützung im Team: Du begleitest Ärztinnen und Ärzte durch gemeinsame Fallbesprechungen, Hospitationen und gibst ehrliches, wertschätzendes Feedback.

  • Sicherheit: Du unterstützt die Umsetzung medizinischer Richtlinien gemäss den Schweizer Vorgaben (FMH, BAG, Datenschutz) und bist erste Anlaufstelle bei Fragen zur Patientensicherheit.

  • Abläufe: Zusammen mit dem Team Medical Operations sorgst du dafür, dass Termine gut geplant sind und die Versorgung reibungslos läuft.

  • Einarbeitung: Du begleitest neue Ärztinnen und Ärzte in ihren ersten Wochen bei Oviva.

  • Digitale Angebote: Du bringst deine klinische Erfahrung ein, wenn wir neue digitale Funktionen gemeinsam mit unseren Produktteams testen und verbessern.




Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in der Anleitung oder Führung medizinischer Fachpersonen, idealerweise im ambulanten Bereich

  • Fundiertes Fachwissen in Adipositasmedizin, Diabetologie oder Innerer Medizin und Freude an der direkten Arbeit mit Patient:innen

  • Gute Kenntnisse des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens und der ambulanten Tarife (TARDOC bzw. ambulante Tarife)

  • Die Fähigkeit, Abläufe zu verstehen, Engpässe zu erkennen und pragmatische Lösungen umzusetzen

  • Eine klare, einfühlsame Kommunikation, auch in heiklen Situationen

  • Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (Schweizerdeutsch ist von Vorteil, weitere Sprachen sind willkommen)

  • Qualifikation: Facharzttitel FMH in Innerer Medizin oder Endokrinologie/Diabetologie

Was Ovivamed dir bietet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld, in dem sich Strukturen und Prozesse laufend weiterentwickeln.

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, in der das Wohl der Patient*innen im Mittelpunkt steht

  • Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget und attraktive Konditionen bei der beruflichen Vorsorge

  • Moderne Arbeitsmethoden und flexible Arbeitsmodelle

  • Eine offene, wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, die Zusammenarbeit und Eigeninitiative fördert

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:

Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb dich noch heute!

jobs.title: Occupational Health & Safety Expert , Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV).

  • Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths.

  • Subject-Matter Expertise: You are the key expert for safety in laboratory and MRI environments (magnetic fields, hazardous and biological substances) and set the standard for quality in this area.

  • Projects: You lead complex, cross-functional safety projects, such as new labs and build-outs, and coordinate contractor safety.

  • Incidents & Root Cause Analysis: You investigate incidents and near-misses, run root cause analyses and follow every corrective action through to closure.

  • Training & Mentoring: You build the training and instruction programme, document knowledge, give internal talks and mentor colleagues and the safety contacts in the teams.

  • ESG: Support the team with knowledge, advice and guidance on environmental and sustainability topics, and help develop how ESG fits into Orbem as the topic grows.

  • Authorities & Audits: You are the contact for authorities, auditors and external partners on specialist matters.

Your responsibilities include:

Keeping Orbem compliant with German occupational health and safety law, from risk assessments and training to incident follow-up and contact with authorities. You will also be focusing on the development of the OHS function at Orbem.

Your Experience and Skills

  • You hold the Sifa qualification under § 7 ASiG, on top of a degree in engineering, safety engineering or natural sciences, occupational health & safety or a related discipline.

  • 6+ years of experience in occupational health and safety, with proven depth

  • Strong knowledge of German regulations (ArbSchG, ArbStättV, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, BioStoffV,).

  • You have worked in laboratory or high-tech environments. If MRI and magnetic field safety is new to you, we will help you build that side.

  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional safety projects and of setting standards and building systems, not only applying them.

  • You drive corrective actions to closure and win buy-in, not just the technical argument.

  • You have the standing to give independent advice and hold your position with management, engineers, and scientists, while staying pragmatic.

  • You share what you know: you document, train and mentor instead of becoming a single point of failure.

  • Although you work locally, you think across locations and see exchanges with colleagues at other sites as an opportunity to grow, both virtually and through occasional business trips.

  • Excellent communication in German (C1+) & English (B2+).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Knowledge of electrical safety (VDE standards, DGUV Vorschrift 3)

  • Strong knowledge of StrlSchG

  • Experience with facilities in a deep-tech or high-tech environment.

  • Skilled at interpreting and adapting regulatory frameworks to ensure compliance in new geographical regions,

  • Experience with ESG topics such as sustainability reporting or a carbon footprint.

  • Knowledge of US requirements (OSHA)

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

jobs.description:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include:

  • Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions

  • Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds

  • Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping

  • Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms

  • Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware

What we expect from you

  • Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development

  • Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization)

  • Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA)

  • Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome)

Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer vision. Because our graphics work is tightly coupled with our perception stack, strong vision fundamentals will let you have an even bigger impact:

  • Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry

  • Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation

General

  • Full-time availability during the internship period.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

What can we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

jobs.title: Finance Manager (Finance, Data & Automation) (gn) @ Atlantic, Berlin
jobs.description:
About Atlantic

Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring.

As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. Since 2016, we have partnered with over 150 European founders in their earliest days, including those behind category-defining companies such as Choco, GetYourGuide, Wandelbots, Softr, Harmattan, Again, Synthflow and Mirelo.

For us, there is no 'too bold' or 'too early'. Just founders venturing into the unknown.

The role

As our Finance Manager, you'll run the day-to-day of Atlantic's fund finance: across portfolio monitoring, cash flow and invoicing, fund accounting and reporting, compliance, and special projects. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor.

Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on.

What you'll own

Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value.

Portfolio monitoring. You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on.

Cash flow and invoicing. You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions.

Fund accounting and reporting. You review the work of our fund administrator and support the preparation of quarterly LP reports, annual financial statements and tax filings.

Compliance. You keep our funds and management company compliant, from regulatory reporting to KYC/AML checks.

Special projects. You take on ad hoc projects across finance, from new reporting requirements to supporting FX management.

The mission

Fast-forward - here's what you've built:

  • Half the manual work is gone. Processes that used to eat your week now run on their own, because you automated them

  • The portfolio talks back. AI pulls the numbers from 150+ startups, spots what's moving and puts it in front of the team before anyone asks

  • Portfolio reporting is an end-to-end system. One trusted source the whole team relies on

The moonshot: Automating the full path from term sheet to financial statements. Few funds work this way today. We want to be one of the first, and you'd be the one who helps us build it.

About you

You'll feel at home here if you:

  • Learned finance where the bar is high. Maybe in fund finance at a VC or PE firm, at a fund administrator, in Big Four audit or advisory, or in a strong controlling team. 

  • Know your accounting inside out, and enjoy putting it to work on a fund

  • Think AI-first. Claude is already part of your workday, and anything you do twice, you want to automate

  • Love turning data into insight, not just reconciling it

  • Own your numbers. You work independently, follow through, and double-check because you care

  • Roll up your sleeves. You're as happy running payments today as building the automation that runs them tomorrow

  • Are curious about startups, deep tech and the founders building them

  • Speak fluent German and English

Bonus points if you've worked in or around venture capital, or built your own dashboards, BI reports or no-code automations.
