jobs.title: Research Assistant followed by a Double Degree PhD position in Urban Design and Planning for Pedestrianization and Walkability
jobs.employer: KU - SCIENCE - IGN frb campus omr. 3
jobs.description:
Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen Within the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (MSCA), University of Copenhagen is offering a 1-year Research Assistant (RA) position starting 1 April 2027 (or as soon as possible thereafter), which then leads to a 3-year PhD fellowship for a Doctoral Candidate (DC). The combined position is part of the research project STEP-UP (Safe, Thriving, and Engaged Pedestrians in Urban Public Spaces), which is funded by the European Union’s Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA), Doctoral Networks (DN), Call: HORIZON-MSCA-2025-DN-01. The STEP-UP network supports 10 PhD Candidates in investigating pedestrian behaviour and mobility in urban environments. The 10 PhD projects are closely linked, contributing complementary perspectives to a shared research agenda in three areas: individual and interpersonal aspects of pedestrian behaviour, environmental and infrastructural barriers to walking, and interactions between pedestrians and other road users. The aim is to improve the understanding of pedestrian mobility and support the development of safer and more inclusive urban public spaces. STEP-UP brings together academic and non-academic partners to train 10 doctoral candidates through an international Joint Doctorate programme. The candidates benefit from joint supervision by researchers at partner institutions, an integrated doctoral training programme, and opportunities for interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral collaboration, including research secondments at partner organisations. In addition to specialised scientific knowledge, they develop transferable skills in areas such as research communication and dissemination. The programme prepares them for careers in research and other fields related to transport and urban development. For a description of the STEP-UP project and descriptions of all 10 PhD positions, please visit the STEP-UP project’s website https://www.project-stepup.eu/ STEP-UP is based on 4-year double PhD degree programs. This means that the successful applicant will also be enrolled in a partner university’s PhD programme. Job and project description The RA position will entail carrying out a literature review of the research field, identifying current research gaps, and preparing for data collection. The PhD position will entail carrying out the research activities of the research project as described below. Your key tasks as a PhD fellow at the Faculty of SCIENCE are to:
  • Conduct an independent research project under supervision.
  • Complete PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participate in active research environments including a mandatory stay for a minimum of 12 months at the partner university (see below for further details).
  • Contribute to teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project (e.g., at conferences, meetings, etc.)
  • Write a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
About the research project The project “Urban space transformation projects for improved and inclusive walkability”. will investigate how planning and design approaches applied in urban space transformation projects impact pedestrians’ behaviour and perceived safety and accessibility (walkability). Urban transformation projects are increasingly proposed to respond to the evolving needs of contemporary cities. Combining urban planning and transport engineering is essential, as planning shapes the spatial and social context of urban spaces while transport engineering ensures safe, efficient and accessible movement. The PhD project will: (1) collect data on goals and practices of urban space transformation projects; pedestrian pedestrians’ behaviours, preferences and perceptions of walkability in relation to the transformation interventions; (2) identify walkability indicators across diverse groups of pedestrians; (3) comprehensively evaluate pedestrians’ perceived impacts of current transformations for enhanced liveability and pedestrianisation; and (4) develop a methodological framework for local adaptation and upscaling of approaches for enhanced perceived walkability. Partner university: National Technical University of Athens (NTUA) Planned secondments at NTUA: M16–M24 and M37–M48. Pricipal supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Trine Agervig Carstensen, University of Copenhagen, email: tac@ign.ku.dk. Co-supervisor: Prof. Konstantinos Kepaptsoglou, National Technical University of Athens (NTUA), email: kkepap@central.ntua.gr Place of employment The primary place of employment will be Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art hardware and software. More information on the department can be found here: https://ign.ku.dk/english/ During the PhD programme of research the candidate will be on a secondment for minimum 12 months in total at the partner university. Required qualifications As an applicant you must have:
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at UCPH, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Urban Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Psychology, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Sociology, or related-disciplines. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at the National University of Athens, you are required to fulfil the requirements described here: https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.survey.ntua.gr%2Fen%2Fstudies%2Fpostgraduate%2Fdoctoral-studies&data=05%7C02%7Ctac%40ign.ku.dk%7Ce197702553f44a00a12308df44a25d10%7Ca3927f91cda14696af898c9f1ceffa91%7C0%7C0%7C639305136264965933%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=62PInKwPpyGrwa3VViUOFLlXisPlz4b7rgs6kdWwhNI%3D&reserved=0
  • Fluency in English and excellent communications skills.
Applicants will also be required to meet the European Commission’s MSCA Doctoral Network eligibility criteria, notably:
  • Mobility Rule - Applicants can be of any nationality and must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the start of their employment at UCPH. Compulsory national service, short stays such as holidays, and time spent as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention are not considered.
  • Doctoral Candidate requirement – the applicant must not be in possession of a doctoral degree at the first day of the employment. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis, but who have not yet been awarded the doctoral degree are not eligible.
Please note that you will only be considered for the position if you fulfil both above eligibility criteria. Who are we looking for? We are looking for candidates within the field(s) of spatial, engineering, or behavioural sciences. Applicants can have a background in Urban and Regional Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Psychology, Sociology, or related disciplines. The following experiences and skills will be emphasised. Applicants are encouraged to provide relevant details and supporting evidence, where applicable:
  • Urban design / urban planning
  • Human-environment interactions
  • Qualitative case study methods
  • Data analysis / statistical analysis
Personal attributes that are desirable:
  • Strong motivation for high-quality research
  • Collaborative spirit
  • Systematic approach to research
  • Attention to detail
Key criteria for the assessment of applicants
  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Relevance of studies, coursework, and thesis
  • Relevant work experience (if any)
  • Publications (if any)
  • The grade point average achieved
  • Other professional activities
  • Language skills
  • Quality and relevance of project proposal
  • The successful applicant is also required to be enterprising and to possess good interpersonal skills
Terms of employment The arrangement concerns two separate fixed-term positions: initially as a Research Assistant, leading towards an appointment as a PhD fellow. The respective durations of the two positions are 1 year and 3 years. The position as a PhD fellow is contingent upon the successful enrolment of a suitable candidate in the PhD School at the University of Copenhagen, as well as satisfactory completion of the Research Assistant period. These assessments will be carried out 3-6 months prior to the expiry of the Research Assistant contract. The start date is 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the requirements from the European Commission related to the MSCA programme and the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,850 DKK/roughly 4,260 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund. Application and assessment procedure Your application, written in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” below and must include the following documents in PDF format:
  • Motivation letter of application (max. one page)
  • A project proposal (max 5 pages where the candidate presents a proposal on how they wish to approach their project including theory and methods)
  • CV incl. education, experience, language skills, publication list (if any), and other skills relevant for the position
  • Certified copy of original master’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD position employment, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. Applicants with a master´s degree from abroad should also enclose a short description of the grading scale used. Certified copy of original bachelor’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If the applicant has completed a combined bachelor’s and master’s education (e.g. 5-year combined master’s), the applicant should submit the combined diploma, transcript of records, and authorised English translations if issued in other language than English or Danish.
  • Language diplomas or language test results (if any)
The deadline for applications is 20 December 2026, at 23.59pm CET. We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements. The further process After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. The assessor makes a non-prioritised assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement. Once the assessment work has been completed, each applicant can comment on the part of the assessment that relates to him/herself. The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. You may read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/ For more information on working and living in Denmark visit http://ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility) and https://www.workindenmark.dk. Interviews are expected to take place in the beginning of February 2027. Questions For specific information about the PhD position, please contact the principal supervisor, Trine Agervig Carstensen. The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Open Pit Mining Engineer
jobs.description: Experienced in open pit mining? Take on broad technical responsibilities and help shape the future of mining at Björkdalsgruvan.Would you like to use your experience in open pit mining to influence both technical solutions and operational practices? As a Senior Open Pit Mining Engineer at Björkdalsgruvan, Sweden, you’ll take on broad responsibilities covering mine design, mine planning, drilling, blasting and water management.You’ll join a lean organisation with short decision-making processes, working closely with production and seeing your recommendations put into practice. In this newly established role, you’ll share your expertise and contribute to both the existing open pit operation and the planning of a larger future open pit.This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with a broader perspective on mine development in an international environment where English is the working language.Purpose, Offer and Benefits    Work in a lean organisation with close collaboration and the opportunity to see your technical recommendations put into practice.    An international and collaborative work environment where people, safety, practical problem-solving and continuous improvement are key priorities.    A flexible and rewarding work environment with competitive employment conditions and benefits, including a wellness allowance and a healthcare fund.    Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of annual leave.Your Responsibilities    Develop and optimise open pit mine design, mining sequences and short- and long-term production planning.    Plan bench development and mining sequences, contributing to the future development of Björkdal´s open pit operations.    Provide technical support for drilling and blasting, including design, quality control and performance monitoring.    Work with dewatering, drainage and water management to prepare new mining areas.    Monitor production performance and technical data, translating analysis into improvements in safety, productivity and cost efficiency.    Support production technicians through technical problem-solving, knowledge sharing and the development of operational practices.The Bigger PictureThis is a full-time, permanent position based at Björkdalsgruvan, near Skellefteå, Sweden. You will work regular daytime hours with flexible working arrangements based on trust and responsibility. The role is primarily site-based, with some flexibility depending on operational needs.This is a newly established position where you will work closely with a small team consisting of two production technicians and a supervisory function. Initially, you will report directly to the Mine Manager and collaborate with the mine´s other planning functions.Björkdal´s open pit operations are entering an exciting phase of development. The existing open pit has an expected remaining operational life of 3–4 years, while a potential expansion of the original Björkdal main open pit could extend operations by at least another 5–6 years. This offers you the opportunity to contribute to both ongoing production and technical challenges that will shape the mine´s long-term development.Our ExpectationsThe most important qualification is several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining operations. You may have worked as a Mining Engineer, Open Pit Engineer, Mine Planner or Drill and Blast Engineer.To succeed in this role, you will need:    Several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining.    A solid understanding of mine design, mine planning, drilling and blasting.    A degree in Mining Engineering or equivalent relevant experience.    Experience with mine planning and design software, along with the ability to learn new systems.    A valid Category B driving licence and good English communication skills.It would be an advantage if you have:    Swedish language skills.    Experience supporting and developing other technical team members.As a person, you are solution-oriented and confident in your technical judgement. You can identify challenges, develop practical solutions and clearly communicate your recommendations to colleagues with different areas of expertise. You are comfortable working independently while also valuing close collaboration with production and technical teams.Interested?The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with Talent Navigation Group (TNG), a recruitment and staffing company, and the technical recruitment specialists at TNG Tech. By taking a broader perspective on technical expertise, they identify more engineers, technicians and managers who match the needs of Swedish employers, both today and in the future.We look forward to receiving your application with your CV or LinkedIn profile. No cover letter is required.Please note that we do not accept applications via email, but you are always welcome to contact the recruiter by email if you have any questions.Once you have submitted your application, we will anonymise your personal information and invite you to complete a couple of recruitment assessments before conducting an initial objective evaluation. You will receive more information about each step as the process progresses, and you can track the status of your application in real time through our website.Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.We look forward to receiving your application!

Stillingsprosent: 20 - 40%

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som klargjører er du ansvarlig for at våre leiebiler er klargjort og vasket i henhold til standard. I samarbeid med våre utleierepresentanter planlegger du behovet for leiebiler og leverer disse i henhold til plan. Du har også ansvar for produkter (barneseter, skistativ mm), skaderegistrering, oppfølging av servicer og dekkomlegg i samarbeid med stasjonsleder. Det vil også være dager hvor du møter våre kunder og må hjelpe disse på en best mulig måte.

  • Yte utmerket kundeservice i alle situasjoner 

  • Oversikt og kontroll på bestillinger og tilgjengelig bilpark

  • Oversikt og kontroll på skader, servicestatus og dekklager

  • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg

  • Holde orden i utstyr og på arbeidsplassen

Kvalifikasjoner

Som klargjører har ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer til våre kunder. Vår hverdag styres av våre kunders behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. 

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (politiattest)

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor fysisk arbeidskapasitet

  • Strukturert med ordenssans

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

We are The Robotics Company, building the infrastructure that enables robots to be deployed at scale.

In just six months, we’ve grown from $0 to $1M in revenue, driven by strong demand for what we’re building. We’re backed by leading investors, researchers, and operators across AI and robotics, including Dr. Marc Pollefeys, the founder of Hugging Face, SV Angel, and leaders from Google DeepMind, Google Cloud, Scale AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, and more.

Our mission is to build the foundational infrastructure that brings intelligent robots out of the lab and into the real world.

About the Internship

We’re looking for exceptional students who are excited to work at the intersection of robotics, AI, and real-world deployment.

As an Engineering Intern, you’ll work directly alongside our research and engineering teams on meaningful technical problems, contribute to systems running on real robots, and gain hands-on experience building at an early-stage robotics company.

Depending on your background and interests, you may work across robot learning, computer vision, 3D perception, manipulation, navigation, simulation, or robotics software and infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Work alongside our researchers and engineers to develop and test robotics and AI systems.

  • Contribute to projects across robot learning, perception, manipulation, navigation, simulation, or robotics infrastructure.

  • Prototype, implement, and evaluate new algorithms and technical approaches.

  • Test software and models in simulation and on real robotic systems.

  • Take ownership of a meaningful technical project with direct mentorship from the team.

What We Look For

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, AI/ML, Computer Vision, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++.

  • Hands-on experience through robotics projects, research labs, internships, competitions, or open-source work.

  • We especially love candidates with experience in leading robotics and research labs, including SLAM, RAI, Boston Dynamics, and similar environments.

  • Familiarity with PyTorch, JAX, ROS/ROS2, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or similar frameworks is a plus.

  • Strong technical curiosity and excitement about solving difficult problems in robotics.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment.

We care more about what you’ve built, explored, and learned than checking every box.

If you’re excited about building intelligent robotic systems that operate in the real world, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Healthcare AI
jobs.description:
Position: Software Engineer - Healthcare AI
Job Type: Full-Time
Start Date: By agreement
Location: Zürich - hybrid, with most working days in the office
Language: English; German is a plus

About the Role

At Enzian Labs, we believe technology can make healthcare work better for everyone - from patients and clinicians to the people operating complex healthcare systems. We build software and AI solutions that turn fragmented information and difficult workflows into useful, reliable products.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to improve and extend our existing healthcare products. Your initial work will focus on data pipelines, and integrations, including workflows that turn healthcare documents into usable data. As our products evolve, you will contribute to new projects, including web or mobile applications.

You will develop AI-enabled workflows that transform complex healthcare data into dependable, usable systems. You will work closely with our technical lead and product stakeholders, owning substantial parts of implementation from initial design through production deployment.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for an experienced engineer who enjoys data-intensive systems, pragmatic architecture, and solving meaningful problems in healthcare, while embracing the entrepreneurial spirit of a growing start-up.

What you’ll do

  • Build Full-Stack applications to enable operation workflows for clinician and healthcare staff.

  • Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that support healthcare workflows.

  • Develop and improve pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and export structured and unstructured data.

  • Integrate AI capabilities where they help solve a product problem, with appropriate evaluation, validation, and failure handling.

  • Work with product stakeholders to clarify requirements, make practical trade-offs, and deliver features that address user needs.

  • Build with care for sensitive healthcare data, including privacy, access control, and auditability.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, with examples of features or systems you’ve owned through production.

  • Practical experience with backend services, APIs, and relational databases, including work that involved processing or validating data.

  • Sound engineering judgment around testing, maintainability, security, and diagnosing production issues.

  • Comfort working through ambiguous requirements and learning new tools or parts of the stack as projects evolve.

Experience that would be helpful

  • Building or operating software on GCP or another major cloud platform.

  • Working in Healthcare or another environment that handles sensitive data.

  • Experienced with EU MDR or similar medical certifications.

  • Building user-facing features for web or mobile applications.

  • German is a plus for our client interactions.

Engagement Details

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, with most working days spent together in the office.

You will join a small team where engineers remain close to product decisions and the real-world impact of their work. You will have meaningful ownership without being expected to manage a team or act as the technical lead.

jobs.title: Social- og sundhedsassistentelev i Læsø Kommune 2027(GENOPSLAG)
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at uddanne dig som fremtidens velfærdsmedarbejder og overvejer du en karriere, hvor du varetager pleje og omsorg for andre mennesker? Søger du et job hvor høj faglighed er vigtig og hvor du bliver en del af et professionelt fællesskab?  Hvis du bliver en af kommunens social- og sundhedsassistentelever tilbyder vi dig et målrettet læringsforløb med struktur, dygtige oplæringsvejleder samt en hverdag, hvor du har mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt.

Du vil blive uddannet i at planlægge, udføre og koordinere komplekse sygeplejefaglige problemstillinger, som f.eks. medicinadministration, at give sondeernæring, pleje kroniske sår mm. Arbejdsdagen er meget alsidig og kan indeholde grundlæggende sygepleje og rehabilitering i borgernes eget hjem eller i det nære sundhedsvæsen.

Uddannelsen indebærer oplæringsperiode i både kommunale oplæringssteder og oplæring på sygehuset. Skoledelen foregår på SOSU skolen i Hjørring.

Du skal sende os en ansøgning om elevplads hvis:

  • Du er i gang med eller allerede har bestået SOSU - grundforløb 2
  • Du bestået en social- og sundhedshjælperuddannelse. 
  • Du har dele af en sygeplejerskeuddannelse.

For at komme i betragtning til en Social- og sundhedsassistent elevplads skal du: 

  • Være klar på at blive udfordret fagligt og personligt og være klar på at bruge tiden på en krævende uddannelse
  • Være dygtig i relationen til andre og kunne arbejde ud fra andres behov
  • Være ordentlig og samvittighedsfuld
  • Overholde aftaler og møde ind velforberedt.
  • Være nysgerrig på andre og reflekterende over egne og andres handlinger.
  • Tage medansvar for din egen læring og udvikling
  • Være forberedt på, at der i din oplæring forekommer weekend, aften -og nattevagter 
  • Du skal kunne arbejde 37 timer/ uge i gennemsnit og forvente, at arbejdsdagen typisk starter kl. 7.00

Vil du være med på elevholdet?Vi har løbende ansættelse af elever, så send endelig din ansøgning, hvis denne karrierevej er noget for dig. Du bedes i den sammenhæng se bort fra ansøgningsfristen. Vil du gerne vide mere om at være elev i Læsø Kommune er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesvejleder Birgitte Nielsen på 29903711.

Du kan finde mere information på https://sosunord.dk/uddannelser/social-og-sundhedsassistent/Yderligere oplysningerStraffeattest skal fremvises før ansættelse. 

Du må forvente, at der kan forekomme oplæringsperioder som kræver at du har kørekort til almindelig bil eller kræver cykel/cykling.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Translational Research
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

Do you want to contribute to research about non-coding RNAs in sperm health and infertility?

A PhD position is available at the Department of Clinical Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences in the Translational Vascular Research group, working on the project ´Developmental non-coding RNA signatures of sperm health and infertility´

The Translational Vascular Research group includes both basic scientists and clinicians. We perform research spanning across disciplines, from the analysis of patient samples to laboratory based investigation of cell behaviour. Parts of our research group are based at Karolinska Institute/KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden, with the opportunity for close collaborations with these institutes.The fertility department at the Women’s clinic at the University Hospital of North Norway (UNN) is a collaboration partner and will contribute with expertise in andrology and analysis of semen samples.

The position is for a period of four years. The nominal length of the PhD program is three years. The fourth year is distributed as 25% each year and will consist of teaching and other duties for the Department of Clinical Medicine. The objective of the position is to complete research training to the level of a doctoral degree. Admission to a PhD programme is a prerequisite for employment, and the programme period starts on commencement of the position. 

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The project 

Male infertility is an increasing global health concern, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying impaired sperm function remain poorly understood. Previously, our group identified more than 2,000 testis-enriched non-coding RNAs and characterised their expression across germ-cell development. In this project, you will investigate which of these non-coding RNAs persist into mature sperm and whether their expression is associated with sperm quality and fertility. In collaboration with the fertility clinic atthe University Hospital of North Norway (UNN), you will analyse sperm samples from fertility patients and healthy donors. Using sperm phenotyping, cell sorting and RNA sequencing, you will examine differences in non-coding RNA expression between sperm populations with different functional characteristics, including motility and morphology. Selected transcripts will also be investigated in matched testicular tissue using imaging and in situ hybridisation to study their expression during germcell development. By integrating molecular and clinical data, the project aims to identify non-coding RNA signatures associated with sperm health and their potential as biomarkers of male fertility.

You must submit a cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests. 

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Professor Lynn Butler 

  • phone: +47 776 25 104
  • email: lynn.m.butler@uit.no
Qualifications

Required Professional Qualifications

  • A Candidate Medicine, or a Master’s degree in biological sciences . If you are near completion of your Master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis. You must document completion of your degree before commencement in the position.
  • Documented fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications, but not required:

  • Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language
  • Prior experience with cell culture-based laboratory projects, bioinformatics is beneficial. The candidate must be flexible and keen to work as part of a larger team.

Applicants must document fluency of in English and be able to work in an international environment. Nordic applicants can document their English capabilities by attaching their high school diploma. Working knowledge of Norwegian or a Scandinavian language is also beneficial.

In the assessment, the emphasis is on the applicant's potential to complete a research education based on the master's thesis or equivalent, and any other scientific work. In addition, professional experience and other experience of significance for the completion of the doctoral programme will be taken into consideration.

Required Personal Qualifications

  • An enthusiasm for research and learning
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a larger team
  • Willingness to collaborate with others During the assessment, emphasis will be put on your potential, motivation and personal suitability for the position.

As many people as possible should have the opportunity to undertake organized research training. If you already hold a PhD or have equivalent competence, we will not appoint you to this position.

Admission to the PhD programme 

For employment in the PhD position, you must be qualified for admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Health Sciences and participate in organized doctoral studies within the employment period.

Admission normally requires:  

  • A bachelor's degree of 180 ECTS and a master's degree of 120 ECTS, or an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 30 ECTS for a master's degree of 120 ECTS. 
  • A master's thesis with a scope corresponding to at least 20 ECTS for an integrated master's degree of 300 ECTS. 

 

Applicants must have a grade of C or better on the master's thesis and have a grade point average of C or better for the master's degree. A more detailed description of admission requirements can be found here.

If you are employed in the position, you will be provisionally admitted to the PhD programme. Application for final admission must be submitted no later than two months after taking up the position. 

Applicants with a foreign education will be subjected to an evaluation of whether the educational background is equal to Norwegian higher education, following national guidelines from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills. Depending on which country the education is from, one or two additional years of university education may be required to fulfil admission requirements, e.g. a 4-year bachelor's degree and a 2-year master's degree. UiT normally accepts higher education from countries that are part of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.

Inclusion and diversity

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity are a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite at least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics.

We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • PhD Fellows are normally given a salary of 580 000 NOK/year with a 3% yearly increase

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information about working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility

Application 

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include: 

  • Cover letter explaining your motivation and research interests
  • CV
  • Official diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language 
  • Official transcripts of grades/academic record for Bachelor's and Master's degree in the original language
  • Official translation of diplomas and transcripts of records (ToR) to English or a Scandinavian language, if applicable
  • Explanation of the grading system for foreign education (Diploma Supplement if available)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • References with contact information
  • Master’s thesis, and any other academic works

Qualification with a master’s degree is required before commencement in the position. If you are near completion of your master’s degree, you may still apply and submit a draft version of the thesis and a statement from your supervisor or institution indicating when the degree will be obtained. You must still submit your transcript of grades for the master’s degree with your application.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 

Assessment 

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. 

General information 

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

Remuneration for the position of PhD Fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1017. A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension: You may be entitled to financial support if you become ill or disabled, your family may be entitled to financial support when you die, you become insured against occupational injury or occupational disease, and you can get good terms on a mortgage. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

A shorter period of appointment may be decided when the PhD Fellow has already completed parts of their research training programme or when the appointment is based on a previous qualifying position PhD Fellow, research assistant, or the like in such a way that the total time used for research training amounts to three years. 

We process personal data given in an application or CV in accordance with the Personal Data Act (Offentleglova). According to the Personal Data Act information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. You will receive advance notification in the event of such publication, if you have requested non-disclosure. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective. Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at UiT The Arctic University of Norway represents a newly created entity gathering almost all possible health study programs. This facilitates an unique interdisciplinarity and innovation in health education and research. We work closely with the services in the North to solve tomorrow's challenges. Read more about us at uit.no/helsefak

Close To Known),- Support Production Center during SB authoring phase,- Perform optional SB Technical Approval as per DOS delegations (after a period of training),- Answer to customer queries (Tech Request) and support working parties, provide RDAF (Technical Adaptation) if necessary,- Identify and develop new products/retrofit solutions in collaboration with Airframe Services and Design Office.You boarding pass:  - Graduated from an Master in electronic or Aeronautical Engineering diploma- Strong knowledge of aircraft avionics systems (at least one of the following ATA 22, 23, 27, 31, 34, 45, 46)- Aircraft configuration management- Airworthiness and safety- Project management- Aircraft maintenance experience would be a plus- Proactive, good team player and good organizational skills- Good communication skills and customer minded- Curious and open-minded for change and continuous improvementGood level in French- Fluent in EnglishYour working environment:Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!How we care for you:Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.Work / Life Balance:  Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). jobs.title: Deputy restaurant manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a conscientious Deputy restaurant manager of our restaurant. In this role, you will be required to greet and welcome guests, tend to their questions and complaints, manage booking and appointment schedules, and promote the restaurant in different medias. 

To be a successful Deputy restaurant manager, you should provide exceptional customer service and strong leadership skills. 

Deputy restaurant manager Responsibilities:

  • Managing budgets, records, and contracts.

jobs.title: Lagermedarbeider søkes til Doka på Lønningshaugen
jobs.description:
Ønsker du en aktiv arbeidshverdag i et solid internasjonalt selskap? Har du erfaring fra lager eller terminal, trucksertifikat og trives med fysisk arbeid? Da kan dette være muligheten du ser etter!

På vegne av Doka søker vi nå en lagermedarbeider til deres avdeling på Lønningshaugen. Her blir du en del av et godt arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kollegaer, høy fagkompetanse og spennende arbeidsoppgaver innen håndtering og klargjøring av utstyr til store byggeprosjekter.Oppstart er ønskelig i desember eller januar. Det er gode muligheter for et langvarig engasjement for rett kandidat.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Daglig drift av lager og vask-/reparasjonslinje
  • Mottak og håndtering av returutstyr fra prosjekter
  • Vask og klargjøring av forskalingsutstyr
  • Kvalitetskontroll og vurdering av utstyrets tilstand
  • Enklere reparasjoner og vedlikeholdsarbeid
  • Klargjøring og utsendelse av utstyr til nye prosjekter
  • Bidra til orden, struktur og et sikkert arbeidsmiljø

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har erfaring fra lager, terminal eller annen logistikkvirksomhet
  • Har gyldig trucksertifikat
  • Trives med fysisk arbeid og tunge løft som en naturlig del av arbeidsdagen
  • Er praktisk anlagt og liker å jobbe med både utstyr og logistikk
  • Har interesse for å lære nye produkter og arbeidsmetoder
  • Er pålitelig, arbeidsom og samarbeider godt med andre
  • Ønsker en langsiktig jobb i et stabilt selskap

Vi tilbyr

  • Mulighet for et langvarig engasjement hos en markedsledende aktør
  • Et inkluderende og sosialt arbeidsmiljø
  • Grundig opplæring og tett oppfølging
  • Verdifull erfaring fra et internasjonalt konsern
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver og gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Arbeidssted på Lønningshaugen

Doka er en av verdens ledende leverandører av forskalings- og stillasløsninger til byggebransjen. Her får du muligheten til å bli en del av et selskap med sterke verdier, høy faglig kompetanse og fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhet og samarbeid.Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og oppfordrer interesserte kandidater til å søke så snart som mulig.

Dersom du har spørsmål kontakt gjerne Senior HR-konsulent / Rådgiver Katrine Grotle, katrine.grotle@adecco.no eller 99 50 03 16

jobs.title: Erfarne kokke søges til det asiatiske køkken / Experienced cook Wanted for Asian Cuisine
jobs.description:
Erfarne kokke søges til det asiatiske køkken

Vi søger to engagerede og erfarne kokke til vores restaurant i svendborg. Har du erfaring med det asiatiske køkken og sushi, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Erfaring fra sushirestauranter eller catering er en fordel.

Dine kvalifikationer:

- Du har erfaring med det asiatiske køkken og kendskab til sushi.

- Du har erfaring med at arbejde i et travlt køkken.

- Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig samarbejde godt med dine kolleger.

- Du er ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og engageret i dit arbejde.

- Du kan kommunikere på dansk, engelsk eller kinesisk.

- Du har et godt humør og kan bevare overblikket, også når der er travlt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

- Tilberedning af asiatiske retter og sushi.

- Samarbejde og koordinering med det øvrige køkkenpersonale.

- Bestilling og modtagelse af varer samt opfølgning.

- Kvalitetskontrol af maden til både restaurantens gæster og takeaway.

- Sikring af god køkkenhygiejne og overholdelse af fødevaresikkerhedsregler.

Vi tilbyder:

- En fuldtidsstilling med arbejdstider mellem kl. 12.00 og 21.00 efter vagtplan.

- Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø med kolleger fra forskellige lande.

- Grundig oplæring ved opstart.

- Løbende ledelsestræning og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Vi lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed.

Der er 2 ledige fuldtidsstillinger.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

---

Experienced cook Wanted for Asian Cuisine

We are looking for two dedicated and experienced cooks to join our restaurant in svendborg. If you have experience in Asian cuisine and knowledge of sushi, we would love to hear from you. Previous experience in sushi restaurants or catering is an advantage.

Your qualifications:

- Experience in Asian cuisine and knowledge of sushi.

- Experience working in a busy kitchen.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- Responsible, reliable and committed to your work.

- Ability to communicate in Danish, English or Chinese.

- A positive attitude and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Your responsibilities:

- Preparing Asian dishes and sushi.

- Cooperating and coordinating with other kitchen staff.

- Ordering and receiving goods and following up on deliveries.

- Ensuring food quality for both dine-in guests and takeaway orders.

- Maintaining high standards of kitchen hygiene and food safety.

We offer:

- A full-time position with working hours between 12:00 and 21:00 according to a shift schedule.

- An international working environment with colleagues from different countries.

- Thorough training upon starting.

- Ongoing leadership training and opportunities for professional development.

We highly value quality, teamwork and responsibility.

There are two full-time positions available.

We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Controls Lead – Subsea Compression Projects | Bergen
jobs.description:
• Location: Bergen, Norway – mainly remote, with on-site visits to the client's plant in Bergen for testing, technical reviews and client meetings when required

  • Start date: December 2026 or January 2027 (immediate availability preferred)

  • Contract duration: Until the end of August 2027

  • Openings: 1–2 Controls Leads (we are also hiring Senior Control System Engineers for the same projects)

Role overview

On behalf of our client, a global energy technology company in Bergen, we are looking for an experienced Controls Lead to take full responsibility for the control systems scope on major subsea compression projects. Experience from Åsgard Subsea Compression, Jansz-Io Compression or similar subsea compression and processing developments is highly desirable.

What you'll do

  • Own and manage the complete control system scope on assigned subsea compression projects.

  • Lead and guide a team of 3–15 control system engineers.

  • Coordinate technical interfaces with the process, subsea, electrical and instrumentation disciplines.

  • Manage technical risks, schedules, engineering deliverables and supplier interfaces.

  • Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), System Integration Testing (SIT), commissioning and startup.

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automation, Cybernetics, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • At least 6 years of relevant control systems engineering experience.

  • Proven leadership experience within control systems engineering, such as a lead engineer, discipline lead or package lead role.

jobs.title: Teamleder til CNC – stærk faglighed og lyst til at gå forrest.
jobs.description:
Er du en dygtig CNC-fræser, der har lyst til at tage ansvar og være med til at få både mennesker og produktion til at spille? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Vi søger for vores kunde en engageret Teamleder til vores CNC-afdeling, hvor du får en central rolle i den daglige produktion og i samarbejdet med teamets medarbejdere. Der er tale om en fuldtids stilling på daghold.

Virksomheden tilbyder en stor bredde af driftssikre hydrauliske cylindre, der kan løse alle former for funktioner og arbejdsopgaver.

Vi leder efter dig, der har erfaring med CNC-fræsning, en god teknisk forståelse og lysten til at være tæt på både maskinerne og medarbejderne. Du behøver ikke at have erfaring med en formel lederrolle – det vigtigste er, at du trives med at tage ansvar, gå forrest og være den, som kollegerne naturligt søger sparring hos.

En hverdag tæt på produktionen

Stillingen er meget hands-on, og du skal trives med at være synlig og til stede i produktionen. Omkring 80 % af din tid foregår på gulvet, hvor du følger op på produktionen, hjælper med tekniske udfordringer og sikrer, at hverdagen fungerer. De resterende 20 % bruges på planlægning, opfølgning og administrative opgaver.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:

  • Skabe retning og engagement i teamet og få hverdagen til at fungere.

  • Sikre en effektiv daglig drift og god koordinering af opgaverne.

  • Være faglig sparringspartner ved tekniske og produktionsmæssige udfordringer.

  • Holde fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og løbende forbedringer.

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en stærk holdånd.

Hvem er du?

Du har erfaring med CNC-fræsning og en faglig interesse for maskiner, processer og produktion. Du er teknisk velfunderet, gerne med en god systemforståelse, og du har lyst til at tage et større ansvar i hverdagen.

Som person er du:

  • God til mennesker og trives med at få andre til at lykkes.

  • Engageret, ansvarsbevidst og løsningsorienteret.

  • En, der tager fat, går forrest og følger op.

  • Nysgerrig og lærevillig med lyst til at udvikle dig.

Det vigtigste er ikke, at du kan det hele fra dag ét , men at du har den faglige ballast, lysten og engagementet til at være den, der går forrest og får teamet til at lykkes.

Hvad tilbyder virksomheden?

Du får en vigtig rolle i en produktionsafdeling, hvor din faglighed og din indsats gør en synlig forskel. Du får mulighed for at præge hverdagen, sætte dit aftryk på teamet og udvikle dig i rollen.

Medarbejderne ApS håndterer ansættelsen for virksomheden. Personlige samtaler vil foregår på vores kontor i Viborg.

Du ansøger om jobbet via dette link;https://medarbejderne.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1020206 Bemærk at CV og ansøgninger via mails ikke behandles!

Medarbejderne ApS er et veldrevet Rekrutterings & Vikar Bureau med mere end 20 års erfaring på marked. Vi er medlem af Dansk Industri Vikarbrance foreningen, som blandt andet forpligter os til at overholde et sæt regler, som har værdi for både arbejdsgiver samt arbjdstager. Du er i gode hænder hos os.

Vi glæder os til at modtage dit CV & ansøgning!

jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager, Finland / Nordic region
jobs.description:
Are you ready to grow a business and make a difference in plant health?

Lallemand Plant Care is looking for a commercially driven and technically skilled Technical Sales Manager to lead business development across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

This is an exciting opportunity for a professional who combines a passion for agriculture and plant health with strong sales capabilities and a strategic business mindset. You will play a key role in expanding Lallemands market presence and bringing innovative microorganism-based plant protection and biofertilizer products to distributors, growers and industry partners.

Your role and key responsibilities

 * Principle contact to sales for Lallemand Plant Care customers in assigned territory.
 * Take ownership of the annual sales budget and maximize sales growth.
 * Build and strengthen long-term relationships with existing and new customers.
 * Lead commercial negotiations with distributors, strategic partners and key accounts.
 * Identify new business opportunities, monitor market trends and translate customer needs into growth opportunities.
 * Collaborate with sales, marketing, regulatory and field solutions teams to ensure consistent market offering and high customer satisfaction.
 * Report on business development and sales performance regularly to the Commercial Director.

Be a trusted technical partner

 * Manage and provide technical support to customers, including support for product demonstrations and field trials.
 * Deliver customer training and technical presentations, helping customers understand product performance and best practices.
 * Represent Lallemand Plant Care at industry events, trade shows and professional forums.

What will help you succeed?

We are looking for an experienced professional who understands the micro-organism-based solutions market and knows how to turn technical expertise into commercial success.

You will ideally bring:

 * A bachelors or masters degree in agricultural sciences or a related field. Additional qualifications in business, management or plant protection are an advantage.
 * At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven success in technical sales and business development within the agricultural input sector.
 * A strong understanding of agricultural markets, distribution channels and commercial business practices.
 * Excellent sales, negotiation and business development skills.
 * An established network within the agricultural input industry is an advantage.
 * Fluency in English and Swedish – Finnish and other Scandinavian language skills are a bonus.
 * Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools.

In addition

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

 * Entrepreneurial and self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve results.
 * Adaptable and curious, willing to learn quickly and embrace new challenges.
 * Collaborative and communicative, able to build trust with customers and colleagues.
 * Reliable and honest, with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering on promises.

What to expect

 * A regional role with responsibility for business growth across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.
 * The opportunity to combine commercial leadership with technical expertise in plant care.
 * Close collaboration with customers, distributors and cross-functional teams.
 * A hybrid working arrangement.
 * Travel of up to approximately 50% of working time, mainly within Nordic territory, with occasional international travel for training and meetings.

A valid passport and driving license are required. The role also involves occasional visits to agricultural, field and factory environments.

How to get more information about the position 

For further information about the position, please email professional@visiohr.fi  or contact Visio Professionals Talent Managers Sanna Majava, tel. +358 45 860 7556 or Tarja Laakso, tel. +358 45 858 8441.

About Lallemand Plant Care

Lallemand is a privately held Canadian company founded in the late 19th century, which develops, produces, and markets microorganisms for various markets. Lallemand Plant Care brings value to growers through innovative microorganism-based solutions for agriculture, horticulture, forestry, and turf. From selecting the right strains to delivering high-quality products and application expertise, we focus on solutions growers can trust. Our broad portfolio is designed to integrate easily into existing practices and address specific challenges. Read more: Lallemand Plant Care  or Lallemand Finland Oy 

Visio Professional

Visio Professional is a recruitment company specialising in professional and white-collar recruitment. It is part of the Visio Group, established in 2020. We are constantly looking for talented professionals across a wide range of industries and experience levels, from entry-level positions to senior roles. We take a personal approach to recruitment and strive to find solutions that benefit both candidates and employers. Whether you are at the beginning of your career or an experienced professional, we are here to help you find a role that matches your skills and expertise.

jobs.description:
Do you have an eye for detail and take pride in leaving behind a high-quality result? Then you may be our new colleague in the Cleaning Services team.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

You will carry out cleaning and service tasks for Jeudan’s customers, focusing on the quality and standards that characterize Jeudan. You will be responsible for checking the quality of your own work and ensuring that all tasks are completed thoroughly.

You will also be responsible for ordering and replenishing consumables. If you identify any issues, defects, or maintenance needs in a customer’s premises, you must report them so that we can maintain a high level of quality and service in accordance with our service agreements.

You will perform ongoing self-inspections and maintain a dialogue with the Operations Manager regarding tasks and the quality of the work performed.

ABOUT YOU

We are looking for someone with experience in commercial cleaning and service.

You are positive, service-minded, and able to work independently in a structured manner. You have a keen eye for detail and can communicate in both Danish and English, verbally and in writing, at a level that enables you to interact effectively with customers, colleagues, and others.

In addition, it is important that you enjoy working independently and are comfortable working evening shifts.

The properties you will be responsible for, or provide cover for, are located in central Copenhagen. Therefore, you must be comfortable cycling around the city using an electric cargo bike.

WHAT WE OFFER

A workplace where your employment conditions are well organized and professionally managed. At Jeudan, we take pride in having you as part of a team that helps maintain and care for the classic and heritage-listed properties in central Copenhagen.

We offer an attractive position with competitive employment terms, including a pension scheme, health insurance plan, and flexible benefits package in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

Working hours are generally Monday to Friday from 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM, with mutual flexibility to accommodate customer needs.

APPLICATION

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Operations Manager Gitte Enright through Jeudan’s main switchboard on +45 7010 6070.

jobs.title: Chef de projet informatique (m/f/d) (réf. G) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Fonctionnaire, Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Agence pour le développement de l'emploi Missions L'ADEM est le service public de l'emploi luxembourgeois. Elle accompagne les demandeurs d'emploi et les employeurs, indemnise les demandeurs d'emploi et met en œuvre les mesures et aides en faveur de l'emploi. Dans le cadre de sa stratégie « ADEM », elle poursuit la modernisation de ses services, notamment par la digitalisation et l'automatisation de ses processus, en partenariat avec le CTIE. L'environnement applicatif comprend deux ensembles. D'une part, MEDA, la nouvelle plateforme cœur de métier de l'ADEM, fondée sur une architecture microservices hébergée dans le GovCloud du CTIE. D'autre part, le système legacy ADEM COMMON (J2EE) et ses applications satellites, qui couvrent encore une grande partie du cœur de métier et fonctionnent en SaaS sur le mainframe du CTIE. Cet ensemble sera migré progressivement vers l'architecture microservices au cours des prochaines années.  Le service IT est chargé du développement des applications cœur de métier de l'ADEM, de SharePoint et de la GED, ainsi que des opérations liées à la plateforme MEDA. Pour accompagner cette transformation, l'ADEM souhaite renforcer son service IT par le recrutement d'un(e) chef de projet informatique. Vous piloterez des projets de développement, de leur cadrage jusqu'à la mise en production, notamment dans le cadre de programmes transversaux comme la mise en œuvre de la révision du règlement (CE) n° /, qui devrait entraîner une forte hausse du nombre de demandeurs d'emploi inscrits à l'ADEM. Vous êtes rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement au chef du service IT. Dans le cadre des programmes transversaux, notamment le programme « » de mise en œuvre de la révision du règlement, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le coordinateur de programme. Vous travaillez entre autres en équipe avec les analystes-développeurs, les experts du métier, le CTIE et les prestataires externes. Traduire les besoins en solutions informatiques : transformer, avec l'équipe projet, les besoins issus des chantiers métier en solutions informatiques ; participer à la définition de l'architecture fonctionnelle et technique ; définir les tests, assurer la documentation fonctionnelle et valider la documentation technique. Planifier et piloter les développements : participer au cadrage des projets (objectifs, périmètre, charges, planning) ; planifier les développements et répartir les tâches au sein de l'équipe projet ; coordonner les mises en production en releases ; gérer les délais, la qualité et les risques techniques, et définir les besoins en ressources et en compétences. Coordonner les intervenants : coordonner les équipes de l'ADEM, du CTIE et des prestataires, notamment pour les interfaces d'échange de données avec les institutions des autres États membres ; assurer les interactions avec les autres acteurs publics. Communiquer et rendre compte : préparer les réunions de pilotage et assurer le flux d'informations avec le chef de service et le coordinateur de programme ; maintenir une relation de confiance entre les parties prenant/antes. Profil Compétences techniques Master en informatique, ingénierie ou domaine similaire; Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de projets informatiques; Maîtrise des techniques de gestion de projet (planification, gestion des risques, gestion des releases); Bonne compréhension des architectures microservices et de l'environnement Java / J2EE; Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projet (MS Project, JIRA ou équivalent) et de SharePoint; Connaissance de la législation sur les marchés publics; Très bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit et à l'oral. Compétences comportementales Capacité de conceptualisation et vue d'ensemble technique; Capacité à accompagner le changement; Capacité à fédérer et à animer une équipe projet; Capacité à conseiller les équipes métier sur les solutions possibles; Ouverture d'esprit, et implication. Atouts Connaissance de l'allemand et/ou du luxembourgeois; Connaissance de l'environnement du CTIE (GovCloud, mainframe); Expérience d'interfaces d'échange de données entre institutions, par exemple EESSI; Certification en gestion de projet (PMP, PRINCE2 ou équivalent); Expérience des méthodes agiles. Conditions d'admission Ce poste peut être pourvu sous le statut de fonctionnaire de l'État ou d'employé de l'État. Vous n'avez pas à choisir votre statut au moment de postuler : celui-ci est déterminé au terme du processus de recrutement, en fonction des conditions à remplir pour chaque statut. Le poste est également ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons actuellement un Corporate Governance Officer (H/F). Description du poste Ce poste vise à garantir une gouvernance efficace, la coordination et la documentation de tous les comités établis dans le cadre des réglementations AIFMD et OPCVM (UCITS). Il soutient l'Organe de Direction en veillant à ce que les comités fonctionnent avec des mandats clairs, des processus cohérents et des décisions dûment documentées.Le poste est centré sur la gouvernance et n'exerce pas de fonction de contrôle de conformité (compliance) ni de gestion des risques. Cadre de gouvernance des comitésLe/La Responsable Gouvernance maintient le cadre de gouvernance des comités, notamment :L'inventaire de tous les comités ;Le suivi des chartes et mandats approuvés (Terms of Reference) ;Le calendrier des revues périodiques.Il/Elle veille à ce que les mandats, responsabilités et circuits d'escalade soient documentés et appliqués de manier/ière cohérente dans toute l'organisation, conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux standards internes de gouvernance. 2. Il/Elle collabore également avec l'équipe Compliance pour l'application pratique des procédures relatives aux conflits d'intérêts. 3. Il/Elle rédige des procès-verbaux clairs et précis reflétant :Les discussions essentielles ;Les questionnements et analyses ;Les décisions prises ;Les actions à entreprendre.Il/Elle coordonne également leur revue, leur approbation et leur archivage sécurisé, ainsi que celui des documents associés. 5. Suivi des actions et tenue des registresLe poste :Assure le suivi des plans d'actions des comités ;Veille à leur attribution et à leur clôture ;Escalade les sujets lorsque nécessaire. Il/Elle maintient également un référentiel complet et structuré de la documentation de gouvernance :Chartes et mandats ;Ordres du jour ;Dossiers de réunion ;Procès-verbaux ;Décisions ;Registres des actions. Cette documentation doit pouvoir être produite rapidement en cas d'audit, de revue interne ou d'inspection réglementaire. jobs.title: Juriste en droit de la concurrence (m/f/d) (réf. G) (H/F)
jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Autorité de la concurrence est un établissement public indépendant dont le rôle est de garantir la libre concurrence et de veiller au bon fonctionnement des marchés. Sa mission primaire consiste en la recherche et la sanction des comportements anticoncurrentiels tels que les ententes entre entreprises et les abus de position dominant/ante. L'Autorité dispose également de nouveaux domaines de compétences, à savoir les pratiques commerciales déloyales dans le domaine agroalimentaire, les services dans le marché intérieur ou encore les relations entre les plateformes en ligne et leurs utilisateurs professionnels. Nous offrons un environnement de travail et des projets intéressants, une atmosphère collégiale et internationale, la valorisation des compétences des collaborateurs et un cadre de travail flexible.  Missions La personne recrutée rejoindra l'équipe d'instruction en qualité d'enquêteur-juriste ou d'enquêteur-économiste; L'enquêteur contribue à la procédure d'instruction des affaires concernant des pratiques anticoncurrentielles, en participant aux enquêtes menées par les conseillers instructeurs en charge de ces dossiers au sein de l'Autorité; Conduite d'enquêtes : participer aux enquêtes sur de potentielles infractions aux règles de concurrence (collecte et analyse d'informations au moyen des pouvoirs et outils d'investigation de l'Autorité); Rédaction et soutien juridique/économique : préparer les actes de procédures (demandes de renseignements ; rapports d'enquête ; projets de décision) et assister les conseillers instructeurs dans l'instruction des affaires de concurrence; Analyses sectorielles : participer aux enquêtes sectorielles et évaluer le fonctionnement de la concurrence dans les secteurs concernés; Veille juridique et économique : assurer une veille des évolutions législatives, réglementaires et jurisprudentielles en matier/ière de droit de la concurrence au niveau national, européen et international; Mission consultative : rédiger des avis sur les projets de textes législatifs ou réglementaires impactant le jeu de la concurrence; Représentation : participer aux comités d'experts et groupes de travail au niveau européen et international, en représentant l'Autorité dans les discussions relatives aux nouvelles régulations de la concurrence. Profil Compétences techniques Le poste est à dominance juridique et/ou économique; Droit de la concurrence : connaissances significatives, théoriques et/ou appliquées, en matier/ière de droit de la concurrence; Économie industrielle : capacité à analyser les marchés et les interactions stratégiques des acteurs via le cadre analytique de la théorie des jeux et de la microéconomie; Expertise interdisciplinaire : compréhension des liens entre le droit de la concurrence et d'autres domaines du droit et de l'économie (ex. : régulations sectorielles, marchés publics, professions réglementées); Maîtrise des logiciels usuels de bureautique (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.); Langues : maîtrise indispensable des langues française et anglaise; Capacités rédactionnelles, d'analyse et de synthèse : excellentes compétences rédactionnelles en français. Compétences comportementales Gestion de projet : capacité à mener des enquêtes complexes de bout en bout, en définissant des priorités claires et un échéancier réaliste; Esprit d'équipe : capacité à collaborer au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, tout en prenant des initiatives; Discrétion : capacité à traiter les dossiers avec la plus grande discrétion; Esprit d'initiative et d'ouverture : ouverture aux nouvelles technologies et aux nouvelles méthodes d'investigation. Nous accompagnons principalement des investisseurs privés et des structures patrimoniales dans la constitution, la gestion, l'optimisation et la valorisation de leur patrimoine immobilier au Luxembourg. Notre philosophie est simple : nous gérons les biens de nos clients comme s'il s'agissait de nos propres biens. Cela implique une attention particulier/ière à la préservation de leur valeur, à l'optimisation de leur rendement, à la maîtrise des coûts et à la qualité de leur entretien sur le long terme. Nos activités s'articulent autour de trois pôles complémentaires :-   La gestion immobilier/ière et l'optimisation de portefeuilles : gestion administrative, technique et locative de biens immobiliers appartenant à différents propriétaires, avec une attention particulier/ière portée à leur rentabilité, leur entretien et leur valorisation. -   La promotion immobilier/ière : identification d'opportunités d'investissement, développement et réalisation de projets immobiliers, notamment résidentiels. -   La construction et la rénovation : à travers notre société AMAK Construction S.à r.l., nous réalisons et coordonnons des projets de construction, de transformation et de rénovation immobilier/ière.Cette complémentarité nous permet d'intervenir à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie d'un bien immobilier, de son acquisition à sa gestion, son développement et son éventuelle revente. Le poste sera principalement consacré à la gestion et à l'optimisation des portefeuilles de nos clients, en assurant un service de qualité à nos propriétaires et locataires. Les missions comprendront notamment :-   Gestion quotidien/ienne des biens : être l'interlocuteur des propriétaires, locataires et prestataires, traiter les demandes et trouver des solutions aux problèmes rencontrés.-   Suivi technique et coordination des interventions : organiser les réparations, travaux d'entretien et interventions des différents corps de métier, demander et comparer des devis, suivre leur bonne exécution.-   Gestion locative : organiser les visites, assurer le suivi des candidatures, participer à la préparation des contrats de bail, coordonner les entrées et sorties des locataires et les états des lieux.-   Optimisation et valorisation du portefeuille : identifier les possibilités d'amélioration des biens, contribuer à l'optimisation des revenus locatifs, à la maîtrise des charges et à la préservation de la valeur des actifs à long terme.-   Suivi administratif : assurer le suivi des dossiers immobiliers, des contrats, des factures et des différentes démarches administratives.-   Relation client : maintenir une communication régulier/ière et professionnelle avec les propriétaires et locataires, dans un esprit de disponibilité, de discrétion et de recherche de solutions.Nous attachons une importance particulier/ière à une gestion proactive. Au sein de notre structure à taille humaine, les responsabilités peuvent évoluer en fonction des compétences, des intérêts et de l'engagement de chacun. Vous serez garant(e) de l'expérience utilisateur et du design system de ces services, qu'ils soient développés en interne, par le CTIE ou par des prestataires, notamment dans le cadre de programmes transversaux comme la mise en œuvre de la révision du règlement (CE) n° /, qui devrait entraîner une forte hausse du nombre de demandeurs d'emploi inscrits à l'ADEM. Vous êtes rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement au Digital Channel Manager. Dans le cadre des programmes transversaux, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le coordinateur du programme concerné, par exemple le coordinateur du programme « » de mise en œuvre de la révision du règlement. Vous travaillez en équipe avec le Digital Product Manager, les équipes métier, le service informatique, le Contact Center, le CTIE et les prestataires externes.
