jobs.title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS-SBR)---Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================ Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.The Department of Process Engineering has a vacancy for aMaster thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in , which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design. **We are looking for** a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. **The preferred starting date is** September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\. **At Eawag**, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Persischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)---Persischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)===========================================nach VereinbarungPersischer Spezialitäten Koch 100% (m/w/i)===========================================nach Vereinbarung  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.     Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab nach Vereinbarung eine/n:      Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören* das Sicherstellen eines authentischen \& neuzeitlichen Speisenangebotes unter Berücksichtigung der Saisonprodukte des Originallandes sowie das Erstellen der ükarte in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Küchenchef* die Zubereitung der Gerichte sowie der einwandfreie Umgang mit Produkten, Produktion\- und Kochtechniken* die Verantwortung der Einhaltung der Hygienerichtlinien sowie der Arbeitssicherheit* das Kochen in der offenen Showküche vor demSie sind ein ausgebildeter und berufserfahrener Koch mit fundiertem Fachwissen über die persischen Spezialitätenküche sowie umfangreichen Kochtechniken. Sie haben Erfahrung in der internationalen gehobenen Gastronomie und Hotellerie. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen Sie fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist von Vorteil. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind leidenschaftlich und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und gästeorientiert. Unternehmerisches Handeln und Denken zeichnet Sie aus.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.    Auszeichnungen:  Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»   Travel \+ Leisure«500 List 2021»  Handelszeitung «Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»  Connoisseur Circle «Best Gourmet Hotel»  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Lukretia  Human Resources Manager  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon    ******jid15365bfjm jit1148jm jiy26jm

This role sits at the intersection of Portfolio Management and Artificial Intelligence, requiring active engagement with autonomous cognitive systems for strategy development. **What You’ll Do*** Focus on machine learning and agentic systems to manage a live trading book while working with cognitive reasoning architectures that enable autonomous systems to solve complex financial problems and reason through multi\-step solutions.* Utilize and interact with agentic systems, including planning algorithms, memory architectures, reflection mechanisms, and collaborative reasoning patterns that support autonomous decision\-making in quantitative trading environments.* Fine\-tune genetic algorithms hyperparameters to optimize adaptive system performance, decision\-making quality, and contribute to deep learning model development for the PM model layer and custom agentic workflows.* Responsible for portfolio management: take risk, manage P\&L, and make trading decisions within defined risk parameters while developing expertise in quantitative portfolio management principles.* Utilize agentic systems, deploying and working with cognitive reasoning systems for quantitative modeling problems, leveraging planning, tool use, memory, reflection, and collaboration capabilities.* Contribute to machine learning model building for PM model layer applications specific to portfolio management objectives.* Build and customize agentic workflows and tools tailored to portfolio management needs and specific trading strategies.* Execute human\-in\-the\-loop decisions and checks ensuring that traded strategies meet quant trading acceptance criteriaThis position combines portfolio management with cutting\-edge agentic AI technology. Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!Wat ga je doen?Als Transportplanner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren, plannen en optimaliseren van transporten naar schepen in heel Europa. Je houdt overzicht over de planning, schakelt met verschillende partijen en zorgt ervoor dat goederen efficiënt en volgens afspraak op de juiste bestemming aankomen.Je werkzaamheden zijn afwisselend en vragen om een goede planning, sterke communicatie en het vermogen om snel te schakelen wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt.Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:Het monitoren van scheepsbewegingen en aankomsten in havens.Het plannen en coördineren van transporten naar schepen door heel Europa, van begin tot eind.Het bewaken van de operationele efficiëntie en het naleven van service level agreements (SLA's).Het optimaliseren van routes, ladingen en beschikbare middelen om kosten te besparen en levertijden te verkorten.Het monitoren van vervoerders en het oplossen van operationele vraagstukken.Het onderhouden van contact met klanten, magazijnen, agenten en logistieke partners.Het oplossen van problemen wanneer transporten niet volgens planning verlopen.Het administratief verwerken van transportopdrachten en transportfacturen.Het toezien op de naleving van transportwetgeving en veiligheidsnormen.

jobs.title: ODMS Coordinator
jobs.description: Heb jij affiniteit met managementsystemen, kwaliteit en continue verbetering? Ben je organisatorisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en vind je het leuk om verschillende afdelingen te ondersteunen bij het verbeteren en bewaken van werkprocessen? Dan is deze functie als ODMS Coordinator een mooie uitdaging! Voor een internationale organisatie in de regio Terneuzen zijn wij op zoek naar een ODMS Coordinator. Wat ga je doen? Als ODMS Coordinator ondersteun je een afdeling bij het onderhouden, verbeteren en optimaal benutten van het Operations Discipline Management System (ODMS). Dit managementsysteem helpt de organisatie om werkprocessen, verantwoordelijkheden en afspraken goed vast te leggen en te bewaken. Je bent binnen de afdeling het aanspreekpunt voor het managementsysteem en werkt nauw samen met afdelingsverantwoordelijken, element owners en vakspecialisten. Je zorgt ervoor dat afspraken worden nageleefd, verbeterpunten worden opgepakt en wijzigingen goed worden doorgevoerd. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden: Coördineren van activiteiten rondom het onderhouden en verbeteren van het ODMS binnen de afdeling. Ondersteunen van verschillende element owners bij hun verantwoordelijkheden binnen het managementsysteem. Adviseren en begeleiden van collega's bij wijzigingen in procedures, werkwijzen en managementsysteemvereisten. Bewaken en stimuleren van de Plan-Do-Check-Act-cyclus (PDCA) om continu verbeteringen door te voeren. Samenwerken met het afdelingsmanagement om verbeterkansen te signaleren en op te pakken. Coördineren, voorbereiden en begeleiden van Management System Reviews met het managementteam. Uitvoeren van interne audits op toegewezen onderdelen van het managementsysteem en signaleren van afwijkingen en verbeterpunten. Afstemmen met andere ODMS-collega's en vakspecialisten om een goede implementatie en naleving van het managementsysteem te ondersteunen. Wat kun jij? Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde mbo-4 opleiding, bij voorkeur in een administratieve ofbedrijfskundige richting. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring. Je hebt affiniteit met managementsystemen, kwaliteitsprocessen en continue verbetering. Kennis van ISO-managementsystemen, projecten rondom kwaliteit of interne audits is een pré. Je communiceert gemakkelijk in het Nederlands. Daarnaast heb je voldoende basiskennis van het Engels om binnen een internationale werkomgeving te kunnen communiceren. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent organisatorisch sterk en neemt initiatief. Je kunt goed samenwerken met verschillende afdelingen en weet mensen op een prettige manier mee te nemen in veranderingen. Je hebt goede computervaardigheden en kunt overweg met het Microsoft Office-pakket. Ervaring met managementsystemen of digitale documentbeheersystemen is een pré. Wat krijg je? Een fulltime functie van 40 uur per week. Werken in dagdienst. Mogelijkheid om één dag per week vanuit huis te werken. Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring. 25 vakantiedagen. Een 13e maand. Reiskostenvergoeding en eventuele vergoeding van tunnelkosten. Een functie binnen een internationale, technische werkomgeving. Je gaat aan de slag bij een internationale organisatie in de chemische industrie, met een grote productielocatie in de regio Terneuzen. Op deze locatie werken professionals uit verschillende disciplines samen aan de ontwikkeling en productie van hoogwaardige materialen en innovatieve oplossingen. Veiligheid, kwaliteit en continu verbeteren staan centraal. Je komt terecht in een professionele, technische werkomgeving waar verschillende afdelingen nauw met elkaar samenwerken en waar jouw bijdrage aan goed ingerichte werkprocessen belangrijk is.

jobs.title: Télépilote de drone (H/F)
jobs.description: Innov'ATM et votre rôleLa société Innov'ATM a été créée en 2014 avec l'ambition de proposer des produits et des services innovants pour la gestion de trafic aérien (ATM) et de gestion du trafic aérien des drones (UTM). Aujourd'hui, Innov'ATM permet à tous les acteurs de l'écosystème de gérer en toute sécurité et en toute simplicité l'ensemble des opérations dans un espace aérien (ATM et UTM).Depuis 2024, Innov'ATM a créé DroneMed: un service de livraison médicale par drone, il permet aux établissements de santé et aux laboratoires d'acheminer des prélèvements biologiques et des médicaments par des autoroutes aériennes.Précurseur de la livraison médicale par drone en France, et premier U-space Services Provider Français, DroneMed propose une alternative au transport routier traditionnel et opère déjà plusieurs lignes dans différentes régions, en métropole comme en outre-mer, et poursuit activement son déploiement.Rejoindre DroneMed, c'est contribuer au développement d'un service innovant, utile et en forte croissance, au croisement des secteurs de la santé, du drone et de la mobilité aérienne.Le posteInnov'ATM recrute un-e télépilote pour assurer la supervision des opérations DroneMed sur les lignes en France métropolitaine comme en outre-mer.* Sur le terrain : une supervision au plus près des opérations. Pendant les phases de test, de validation et de transition vers l'exploitation, vous êtes présent-e sur les sites afin de préparer, superviser et sécuriser les vols. Cette présence terrain constitue aujourd'hui le cœur du poste.* Depuis nos bureaux : une supervision à distance, depuis le centre de contrôle DroneMed, pour les lignes déjà en phase d'exploitation.Vos missions* Vous assurerez la supervision des vols DroneMed, en tant que télépilote/superviseur de vols.À ce titre, vous serez responsable de l'opération, de sa préparation jusqu'à sa clôture, et vos missions seront les suivantes :Préparer l'opération :* Rédiger la fiche mission et analyser le contexte : météo, informations aéronautiques, zones survolées, espaces aériens voisins, mesures de contingence et Plan de Réponse d'Urgence (PRU).* Déployer le matériel (drone, vertiport, batteries, etc) sur site, réaliser les vérifications avant vol selon les checklists et animer le briefing de l'équipage.Superviser les vols :* Surveiller en continu le drone, sa trajectoire et son environnement, et coordonner l'équipage (second télépilote, personnel au sol) avec une phraséologie normalisée.* Appliquer les procédures de contingence et d'urgence, déclencher le PRU si nécessaire, et retarder, interrompre ou annuler un vol dès que la sécurité l'exige.* Assurer l'après-vol : inspection du drone, carnet de vol, fiche mission et rangement du matériel.Gestion de la sécurité et amélioration continue* Animer le débriefing après chaque opération, consigner tout événement et remonter les anomalies observées sur le terrain.* Appliquer les consignes de sécurité, participer aux exercices PRU et aux formations, et proposer des améliorations des procédures.Missions complémentaires possiblesSelon les besoins, vous pourrez aussi participer à la maintenance du drone, à l'installation des équipements sur les sites, à la formation du personnel des sites partenaires et à la mise en service de nouvelles lignes.Profil recherchéNous recherchons une personne rigoureuse, fiable et ingénieuse, qui aime le travail sur le terrain, au plus près des usagers.Formations et CertificatsVous avez déjà vos certificats de télépilote ? C'est un vrai atout :* l'attestation pour la catégorie ouverte (A1/A3) et la formation complémentaire A2 ;* le certificat théorique de télépilote (CATS) et une formation pratique aux scénarios STS.Vous ne les avez pas encore ? Postulez quand même. Nous cherchons d'abord une personne motivée, débrouillarde et à l'aise sur le terrain. Les certifications nécessaires pourront être passées après l'embauche et prises en charge par Innov'ATM.Dans tous les cas, nous assurons à la prise de poste les formations sur le drone, sur les lignes DroneMed et sur nos procédures internes.Seul impératif : le permis B, car les missions impliquent des déplacements en véhicule avec le matériel.Compétences et qualités attendues* Anglais : certains manuels sont rédigés en anglais.* Ingéniosité : vous trouvez des solutions concrètes face aux imprévus du terrain (matériel, logistique, site).* Rigueur : vous suivez les procédures et les checklists à la lettre.* Sang-froid : vous gardez votre calme et savez prendre une décision quand la situation se complique.* Esprit d'équipe : vous communiquez de façon claire et concise avec l'équipage.* Sens de la sécurité : vous signalez ce qui ne va pas et tirez les leçons de chaque opération.* Adaptabilité : vous êtes à l'aise sur des sites variés, en déplacement, et savez vous organiser seul-e.* Aisance avec les outils numériques : logiciels de pilotage, de planification et de s...

jobs.title: VP of Brand and Communications
jobs.description:
About Oscilar

Oscilar is building the Agentic Risk Platformâ¢ for banks and fintechs, reimagining how financial institutions manage fraud, credit risk, compliance and onboarding in the AI era.

Our platform brings decisioning, data and AI agents together in one system, so risk teams can make better decisions in real time and automate increasingly complex work. Agent Hub gives them 30+ specialized AI agents across fraud, AML, credit, onboarding, sanctions and disputes.

Oscilar is trusted by 100+ fintechs and financial institutions, including SoFi, MoneyGram and Nuvei, and makes tens of billions of risk decisions a year. ARR has grown 15x in the last 2 years.

Oscilar was founded by Neha Narkhede, co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent, which went public at a valuation of about $10 billion and later agreed to be acquired by IBM for $11 billion.

The Role

We're hiring our first VP of Brand and Communications to lead Brand, PR and Communications and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

You'll own how Oscilar shows up in the market: the story we tell, the voice we tell it in, and where it gets heard. That means directing our PR to land Oscilar in Tier 1 publications and keep a steady drumbeat of coverage around every launch and milestone; defining a brand voice and guidelines that make us instantly recognizable as the agentic risk platform; launching brand campaigns that get financial services leaders talking; and turning our founder's industry profile into reach with the buyers we sell to.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy for brand, PR and comms, and personally get the first versions of the most important work out the door. You'll lead our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our PR agencies from day one, hire your first team member soon after joining, and build the team as results come in. You'll also build the playbook for an AI-native brand function, using agents and automation so a small team can do far more than its size suggests.

You'll report to Tomas Lobo, VP of Marketing and Growth, and work closely with our CEO and executive team, Product Marketing, Growth, Events and Design. This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on Oscilar's growth and reputation.

What You'll Own

Brand Strategy & Category Leadership

  • Own Oscilar's brand strategy end to end, and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

  • Work with our founders to sharpen the agentic risk narrative, and turn it into a point of view the market repeats back to us.

  • Turn executive alignment into a cohesive brand voice and brand guidelines, and make sure the brand shows up consistently across the website, sales, content, social and events.

  • Evolve the brand as the company grows: new products, new markets and new audiences.

  • Own the brand budget and investment plan, and decide where each dollar builds the most awareness and trust.

  • Make sure Oscilar shows up in AI search and LLM answers, not just traditional search and media.

PR & Communications

  • Set the bar for what great PR looks like, and direct our agencies (including Highwire) to get there.

  • Land Oscilar's story in Tier 1 publications such as Fortune and the Wall Street Journal.

  • Build a steady drumbeat of earned media around product launches, customer stories, company milestones and timely news.

  • Build lasting relationships with the media, analysts and industry voices that shape our market.

  • Run PR as the long game it is, while making sure Oscilar shows up in today's conversations.

  • Own crisis communications readiness and the corporate narrative around major company moments.

  • Partner with People on our employer brand, so the story we tell the market also attracts great talent.

Social Strategy

  • Own Oscilar's social strategy across founder-led, executive-led, employee-led and company channels.

  • Make each channel amplify the others, so a single story travels from Neha to our executives, our employees and the company page.

  • Build an employee advocacy program that turns our team into a distribution channel.

  • Measure social by reach and engagement with the buyers we sell to, not vanity metrics.

Founder & Executive Presence

  • Manage Neha's presence across social media, video, media, podcasts and events, building on her 50K followers and her standing in the industry.

  • Own her roadmap of speaking, media and social moments, so she shows up in the right places at the right time.

  • Build the platforms that make Neha and our executives and experts the voices people seek out on AI, fraud, credit and compliance.

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Set the long-term content strategy that builds Oscilar's authority in AI and risk: original research, data assets, signature franchises and executive points of view.

  • Bring Product Marketing, PR and content together around one shared plan, so every launch and campaign tells part of the same story.

  • Build content that compounds over time and becomes the reference point for our industry.

Brand Campaigns & Programs

  • Launch fast, high-ROI brand campaigns alongside long-term programs. Our first is the Agents of Risk awards program.

  • Run several bets in parallel, set clear goals for each, measure results, and decide quickly what to scale or stop.

  • Turn what works into flagship programs, partnerships and experiences that become recognized across financial services.

Team & AI-Native Operations

  • Lead and grow our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our agency partners from day one.

  • Build the Brand, PR and Communications team over time, adding your first hire soon after joining and growing the function as results come in.

  • Build an AI-native function: automate brand, PR and social workstreams with agents so a small team can do far more.

  • Define the function's priorities, operating rhythm and how we measure brand impact.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You've set the brand and PR strategy, are directing our agencies with a clear point of view, and have early wins on the board: earned media around our launches, a brand voice the company has adopted, and the first brand campaigns live and measured.

  • First year: Oscilar is recognized as the defining name in agentic risk. We have Tier 1 coverage and a steady drumbeat of earned media, a social presence that reaches the buyers we sell to across founder, executive, employee and company channels, and flagship programs the industry looks forward to.

  • Long term: You've built a high-performing, AI-native Brand, PR and Communications team, and brand has become one of Oscilar's biggest competitive advantages.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in brand, PR and communications, including leading brand and PR or comms at VP or Head-of level at a successful, sales-led B2B SaaS company.

  • Deep PR judgment. You've directed agencies to Tier 1 coverage and know what great looks like.

  • You've built a brand voice and guidelines that teams actually used, and you can take a messy draft and make it sharp.

  • You've run fast, measurable brand campaigns alongside long-term programs.

  • You're a hands-on player-coach: proactive, responsive, and quick to ship rather than theorize.

  • You're AI-native and have automated real marketing work with AI tools or agents.

  • You've managed experienced people and agencies, and aligned teams such as PMM and content on one plan.

  • You've owned a brand budget and managed creative teams and agencies across PR, design and video.

  • Clear, concise communication and strong creative instincts.

Bonus Experience

  • Selling to fintech, financial services, payments, identity, security or other risk and trust buyers.

  • Running a founder-led social program, especially for a technical founder.

  • Launching an awards program or other industry-recognition campaign.

  • Building a brand or comms function from scratch, or leading through a major moment such as an IPO or large announcement.

Why This Role Is Unique

  • Build from scratch, without the typical startup risk. You'll build Oscilar's brand function from the ground up at a company that already has product-market fit and has grown ARR 15x in 2 years.

  • A proven, second-time founder. Work directly with Neha Narkhede, who co-created Apache Kafka and co-founded Confluent, taking it to a roughly $10 billion IPO and an $11 billion acquisition agreement with IBM.

  • A manager who has done this before. Tomas Lobo helped build Samsara from $1M to close to $500M in ARR in about 5 years.

  • A category to name. Help define agentic risk, a new category at the intersection of AI, risk and financial infrastructure.

  • Room to build. A VP title, a seat with the founders, a PR partner already in place, and room to hire and build your team.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k plan.

  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture.

  • Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top-tier plan for you and your dependents. (US)

  • Balance: Unlimited PTO policy.

  • Culture: Family-friendly environment; regular team events and offsites.

  • Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Impact: Help make the internet safer by protecting online transactions and building the infrastructure powering the future of financial risk.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jobs.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.


Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🩺 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase


Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

Compensation: $180K – $225K • Offers Equity

Type of contract:                   Paid internship

Background

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty-bearers and the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support for designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work.

 

Role Summary

The Systems & Digital Solutions Intern provides part-time operational support across GSF’s systems, business intelligence, data quality, information management and IT support services. The intern contributes to first-line user assistance, routine administration, testing, documentation, data cleansing and validation, and the organisation of information within GSF Online, SharePoint and other approved systems. Assignments are prioritised through a six-month work plan and include a structured handover to support continuity between successive internship placements.

 

Position Responsibilities

Systems and User Support

  • Provide first-line support for GSF Online and other assigned systems, record support requests and contribute to an initial response within one business day;

  • Support routine user-account and access administration under supervision, including approved access requests and periodic access reviews;

  • Assist with system configuration, testing, issue reproduction and validation of fixes or new releases;

  • Escalate unresolved, recurring, security-related or access-control issues promptly.

Data Quality and Information Management

  • Support data cleansing, migration, validation and follow-up of identified data-quality issues;

  • Assist with routine data preparation and testing of Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs under technical guidance;

  • Support consistent organisation of information in SharePoint, GSF Online and other approved systems, including naming, storage and permissions;

  • Maintain clear records of completed checks, identified issues and follow-up actions.

Documentation, Training and Continuity

  • Prepare and update user guides, FAQs, process documentation and training materials;

  • Support system demonstrations, training sessions and user-adoption activities;

  • Complete priority assignments agreed through the six-month work plan and provide regular progress updates;

  • Prepare a structured handover of open tasks, documentation and learning for the next internship placement.

 

Position Requirements

Education and Experience

  • The position is open to students currently enrolled in a master’s program in information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a related field. Please note a tripartite agreement is mandatory for this internship;

  • Interest or initial experience in business systems, data quality, reporting, user support or information management;

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365; experience with Power BI, SharePoint or similar platforms is an asset.

Other Requirements

  • Good written and spoken English; French or another GSF working language is an asset.

  • Analytical, organised and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail and confidentiality;

  • Ability to learn quickly, document work clearly and escalate issues appropriately;

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and predominantly remote environment;

  • Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and responsible use of data and technology.

jobs.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS.

  • Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code.

  • CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk.

  • Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken.

  • Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Onze doorgroeipaden zijn nog in ontwikkeling, en omdat we tracks verwachten richting lead DevOps, principal engineering en engineering management, ben jij er vroeg bij.

  • Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling.

  • Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag.

  • Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie.

MEER WETEN?
Wij vertellen je graag alles over het team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Nadine op 0628556265.

jobs.description: Requisition ID: R-797556Position: SSBI IT Transformation PMO & IT Material Change Control Teams Lead, Vice PresidentLegal Entity: State Street Bank International GmbHNumber of vacancies: 1Who We Are Looking ForWe are looking for an experienced, hands-on Vice President to lead the SSBI IT Transformation PMO and IT Material Change Control teams. Reporting to the Head of IT Transformation - Strategic & Regulatory Affairs, SSBI, this role will serve as the senior day-to-day leader for these capabilities, translating strategic direction into effective execution, transparent reporting, strong governance and continuous capability maturation.The successful candidate will bring a strong combination of IT transformation, portfolio management, IT risk and controls, compliance, EU/EMEA regulatory knowledge, emerging technologies, governance and executive reporting, together with exceptional stakeholder-management capability.Candidates must have demonstrable experience building and maturing an IT PMO and be able to apply that experience to strengthen and continuously mature the existing SSBI IT Transformation PMO. They must be comfortable navigating a complex, highly matrixed and international environment, building trusted relationships across organizational boundaries and influencing senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.This is a senior leadership role with a strong hands-on component. The successful candidate must be comfortable moving between leadership and detailed execution and, where resource capacity, complexity or urgency requires, personally driving critical analysis, reporting, governance and IT Material Change Control deliverables. Why This Role Is Important to Us ...This role provides day-to-day leadership across the SSBI IT Transformation PMO and IT Material Change Control teams, helping ensure strategic, regulatory and material IT change is effectively governed, transparently reported and executed in alignment with SSBI priorities.The role will Chair the SSBI IT Change Control Forum and serve as a non-voting member of the SSBI Transformation Change Management Committee (TCMC), providing an important connection between IT-level change governance and broader SSBI transformation governance. IT Material Change Control• Lead the day-to-day operation and continuous maturation of the SSBI IT Material Change Control capability and team, providing effective governance and oversight of material IT change across Run the Bank, Protect the Bank and Change the Bank• Maintain a comprehensive and forward-looking view of potentially material IT change across these portfolios, ensuring changes are identified and brought into the appropriate governance pathway early.• Lead the identification, assessment, governance, tracking and escalation of potentially material IT changes.• Ensure materiality assessments appropriately consider technology, regulatory, operational resilience, cybersecurity, data, privacy, third-party and emerging-technology impacts.• Provide credible and constructive challenge to materiality assessments, governance requirements and supporting evidence.• Ensure IT Material Change Control is effectively integrated with the broader technology change lifecycle and relevant SSBI and enterprise governance.• Ensure decisions, approvals, conditions, risks and actions are transparent, traceable and audit-ready.• Identify recurring themes, emerging risks, dependencies and control weaknesses across Run the Bank, Protect the Bank and Change the Bank, providing appropriate reporting and escalation.• Lead and develop IT Material Change Control resources and continuously strengthen capability, consistency and ways of working.• Remain hands-on as needed, personally supporting assessments, analysis, reporting and governance deliverables where resource capacity, urgency or complexity requires. Reporting & Management Information• Lead and continuously enhance SSBI IT Transformation and IT Material Change Control reporting, ensuring management information is accurate, timely, transparent, consistent and decision-oriented.• Produce and oversee executive and governance reporting covering portfolio health, transformation delivery, material IT change across Run the Bank, Protect the Bank and Change the Bank, regulatory commitments, risks, issues, dependencies, financials, resource capacity, decisions and key actions.• Translate complex technology, regulatory and risk information into concise, actionable narratives for senior management and governance committees.• Provide forward-looking insight, identifying trends, deteriorating indicators and emerging concerns before they become significant delivery, control or regulatory issues.• Establish and maintain appropriate KPIs/KRIs, reporting standards, data-quality controls and management-information disciplines.• Ensure traceability between underlying portfolio information and executive and governance reporting.• Support regulatory, supervisory and audit information requests through accurate reporting and appropriate supporting evidence.• Drive simplification and automation of reporting through data, analytics, AI and other emerging technologies, where appropriate and within established controls.• Remain hands-on in the preparation, analysis and quality assurance of critical executive, governance and regulatory reporting where required. Governance & Stakeholder Leadership• Chair the SSBI IT Change Control Forum, setting its agenda and operating rhythm and ensuring effective discussion, challenge, decision-making, escalation and action closure.• Ensure forum submissions are complete, transparent and of sufficient quality to support informed governance and decision-making.• Ensure decisions, conditions, actions, accountable owners and due dates are clearly documented, communicated and tracked through closure.• Serve as a non-voting member of the SSBI Transformation Change Management Committee (TCMC), representing the IT Transformation PMO and IT Material Change Control perspectives.• Maintain effective connectivity and information flow between the IT Change Control Forum, TCMC and other relevant SSBI and enterprise governance forums.• Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across SSBI and regional and global organiza [...]

jobs.title: Flight Line Technician NH90 (m/w/d) für AIRBUS Helicopters (Kraftfahrzeugmechatroniker/in - Personenkraftwagentechnik)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Flight Line Technician; Fertigung / Produktion; Hydraulik; WartungStellenbeschreibung:Flight Line Technician NH90 (m/w/d) für AIRBUS Helicopters________________________________________________________________Starten Sie als Flight Line Technician mit uns in eine gemeinsame und erfolgreiche Zukunft. Bei AIRBUS als Luft- und Raumfahrtunternehmen erwarten Sie anspruchsvolle Tätigkeiten in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld, das zukunftssicher ist und Ihnen sehr gute Karrierechancen bietet. Sie besitzen eine hohe Eigenmotivation und das entsprechende Engagement?  Sie fühlen sich angesprochen? Dann bewerben Sie sich noch gleich heute auf unser Stellenangebot. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie:- Betreuung der Bereiche Mechanik und Hydraulik am Hubschraubermodell NH90- Einbauen von Komponenten im Luftfahrzeug- Durchführung und Unterstützung bei Fehlersuche am System- Abarbeitung von digitalen Fertigungsaufträgen- Verwendung von manuellen Werkzeugen, Maschinen oder Testequipment- Umgang mit Bauunterlagen, Fertigungsvorschriften und fertigungsbegleitenden Dokumenten- Durchführung von Wartung und Inspektionstätigkeiten- Dokumentierung der durchgeführten Arbeiten- Kenntnisse in militärischer Bordbuchführung- Sicherstellung der Konformität und regelkonformer Dokumentation- Montage, Fehlersuche und Basisprüfungen- Beschreibung von Fehlern im digitalen FertigungssystemWir wünschen uns:- Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum/r Fluggerätmechaniker/in, KFZ-Mechatroniker/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation- Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Fertigung / Produktion, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Wartung / Instandhaltung sowie Hydraulik- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, ein hohes Maß an Belastbarkeit und Flexibilität sowie eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse- Tools: MS-Office, SAPWas SimpleXX unter anderem auch ausmacht:Unser zusätzliches Angebot – was wir Ihnen bieten und was Sie von uns erwarten können- Generell ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag- Perspektive auf Übernahme durch Kundenbetrieb - Recruiting Strategie: temp 2 perm- Equal Pay & Equal Treatment Modell beim Kunden (Konditionen richten sich nach AIRBUS Tarifeingruppierungen)- Übertarifliche Vergütung mit attraktiven Zuschlägen und Zulagen- Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld- Zahlung von Sonderprämien- Generell eine 35-Stunden-Woche und ein Arbeitszeitkonto zur freien Verfügung (Kombinierung zwischen Freizeitausgleich oder Auszahlung für geleistete Mehrarbeit)- Möglichkeit auf Home-Office in Absprache mit unserem Kunden- Bis zu 30 Tage Jahresurlaub- Arbeitgeberzuschuss zum ÖPNV- Zusätzliche Boni: Erfolgreiche Mitarbeiterempfehlungen werden extra vergütet (Vermittlungsprämie)- Mitarbeiter-Support: Ein hervorragender Mitarbeitersupport (schnelle Rückmeldung zu administrativen Fragen und bei zusätzlichem Support – menschliche, persönliche und qualifizierte Beratung sowie mehrsprachig)- Sie erhalten professionelle Schutz- und Arbeitskleidung gemäß Einsatzbedingungen und Einsatztätigkeit- Sie erhalten eine exzellente medizinische Vorsorge durch unsere Kooperationen mit diversen Betriebsarztzentren (Kostenübernahme für Gesundheitsuntersuchungen)- Förderung durch Weiterbildungs- und Qualifizierungsmöglichkeiten bei Bedarfssituationen während der Projektlaufzeit im Rahmen Ihrer Tätigkeiten- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss- Arbeitgeberzuschuss für vermögenswirksame Leistungen optional- Expat-Partner: wir begleiten unsere Mitarbeiter auch bei den besonders attraktiven und beliebten Auslandsentsendungen- Natürlich ist SimpleXX auch in der Zukunft gerne Ihr Partner, gerade wenn es auch um andere Kundenbetriebe (sei es zur Direktvermittlung oder Arbeitnehmerüberlassung) geht. Wir arbeiten deutschlandweit mit namenhaften Kunden zusammen (innovative und führende nationale und internationale Kundenbetriebe).________________________________________________________________Weitere interessante Stellenangebote finden Sie in unserer Jobbörse auf unserer Homepage: http://www.go-simplexx.de/special-pages/jobboerse-liste/Zusätzlich haben wir auch Personalbedarf zu dem es keine veröffentlichten Stellenanzeigen gibt. Funktionsprüfungen, Testläufe und Qualitätskontrollen- Installation und Inbetriebnahme neuer Anlagen beim Kunden, Begleitung der ersten Produktionsläufe sowie Einweisung und Schulung der Verständnis und Freude an praktischer Montage- Die Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen und Stromlaufpläne zu lesen und praktisch umzusetzen- Grundkenntnisse in der SPS-Technik und Interesse daran, diese jobs.description: Company DescriptionArvato is an innovative and globally leading 3PL service provider in Supply Chain Management and E-commerce. With around 20,000 team members across more than 100 locations, we focus on the industries Consumer Products, Tech, Healthcare, Automotive, and Publishing.You will work in an environment built on collaboration, respect, commitment, and curiosity, where you can grow, contribute your ideas, and make a real impact. Become part of the team that delivers logistics excellence and shapes global supply chains. Because working at Arvato means: Together, we're on it.Job DescriptionAre you ready to take ownership of our growing inbound operations while creating clarity and enabling your team to deliver at its best? Join us as Supervisor Inbound (m/f/x) at our site in Egelsbach (near Frankfurt am Main) and take responsibility for smooth day-to-day operations in a dynamic logistics environment. By listening to your team, setting clear priorities and staying curious as processes evolve, you will help us grow together and reliably deliver results. Are you on it?Your Tasks- Lead Inbound Operations: Take ownership of daily inbound activities and ensure that processes are understood and executed reliably from end to end. Set clear priorities, coordinate operational tasks and keep the team aligned throughout the day.- Coordinate & Enable Your Team: Organize employees according to operational requirements and ensure the right staffing and qualifications are available when needed. Provide clear guidance, listen to your team and create the conditions that enable everyone to perform at their best.- Manage Systems & Operational Issues: Work confidently with our SAP and customer-specific systems, including reporting, ticket creation and processing, follow-ups and operational research. Resolve issues within your area of responsibility and escalate them transparently when further support is required.- Identify Opportunities for Improvement: Stay curious and keep a close eye on everyday operations. Recognize process gaps or inefficient workflows, share your observations and learnings openly, and provide transparency so that the Area Manager or Operations Manager can initiate sustainable improvements.- Ensure Reliable Operational Execution: Keep track of staffing needs, qualifications, shift requirements and operational priorities to ensure stable inbound performance. Take responsibility for results, communicate challenges early and contribute to reliable execution in a growing operation.Qualifications- Professional Experience: You have solid experience in warehouse operations, logistics or a comparable operational environment and understand warehouse processes from end to end. Previous experience coordinating employees, teams or operational workflows is an advantage.- Leadership Experience: You know how to provide clear direction, coordinate employees in daily operations and create an environment in which people can contribute their strengths. You take responsibility for decisions and results while keeping the team goal in focus.- IT & System Skills: You are confident working with digital tools and warehouse or ERP systems and are willing to become proficient in our systems.- Language Skills: You have very good English skills, good German skills are a plus, enabling you to communicate confidently with employees, colleagues and stakeholders in an international environment.- Mindset & Working Style: You communicate clearly and remain solution-oriented when challenges arise. You take ownership and stay curious and flexible as processes and operational requirements evolve.Additional Information- ArvatoCare – Company Health Insurance: We provide you with complimentary supplementary health insurance including an attractive annual health budget, with no health check required.- Responsibility from Day One: Take ownership of your operational area from the start and actively contribute to creating reliable structures and successful teamwork.- Corporate Benefits: Benefit from attractive discounts and offers from numerous well-known brands and partners.- Capital Formation Benefits: Take advantage of additional financial benefits that support your long-term wealth creation.- Open & Collaborative Culture: Experience a workplace built on teamwork, transparency and open communication, where learnings are shared, ideas are welcomed and everyone contributes to achieving results together.We welcome applications from people who contribute to the diversity of our company. For us, diversity particularly includes cultural or social background, religion, age, disability, gender, and sexual identity.We want to make the application process as simple as possible for you: Focus on submitting a meaningful CV, as a detailed cover letter is not required. Please understand that we can only accept applications through our online application portal.Do you have any questions? information- Prepare and maintain compliance-related documents, declarations and certificates- Maintain product and compliance data in SAP, PIM and other relevant systems- Work closely with Product Management and Purchasing during the creation and introduction of new products to identify and implement compliance requirements at an early stage- Support Master Data Management in defining and maintaining legally required product information- Support customers and our subsidiaries with product compliance-related questions and provide relevant regulatory documentation and information- Contribute to the implementation of new and changing regulatory requirements as well as the continuous improvement and digitalization of Product Compliance processesYOUR PROFILE- Academic degree or Regulation- Cosmetic Product Regulation- Knowledge of PPE legislation is an advantage- Experience in creating and maintaining Safety Data Sheets is an advantage- Experience with SDS authoring via collaborating with different business functions, suppliers, customers and external partners- Good English skills; German or additional European language skills are an advantage WHY BERNER? - Job bike Solltest du während des Einstellungsprozesses Unterstützung benötigen, lass es uns bitte wissen – wir sind für dich da.Erfahre mehr über unser Engagement für ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld: https://jobs.zalando.com/de/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion (https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion)WARUM DIE ROLLE FÜR DICH SPANNEND IST…- Du verantwortest die Zufahrts- und Zugangskontrolle, überwachst unser Gebäude über Videoanlagen, betreust unsere Alarm- und Notrufsysteme und übernimmst den Schließdienst. Zudem verwaltest du die Zugangsrechte und betreust die Schlüsselverwaltung für Gäste und externe Partner*innen.- Auf Grundlage unserer Betriebsordnung führst du zahlreiche Sicherheitskontrollen durch. Hierzu zählen unter anderem Personenkontrollen unserer Mitarbeitenden beim Betreten und Verlassen der operativen Fläche sowie Spind- und Fahrzeugkontrollen.- Bei Alarmeingängen koordinierst du externe Rettungs- und Sicherheitsdienste und führst Schutzmaßnahmen durch. Zudem verantwortest du Maßnahmen zur Diebstahlprävention. Bei Regelverstößen sicherst du Beweismaterial und erstellst Berichte, observierst verdächtige Personen und intervenierst bei kriminellen Handlungen. Bei Bedarf leistest du Erste Hilfe- und leitest Brandschutzmaßnahmen ein.- Zudem sicherst du kritische Gespräche ab, führst Kontrollgänge inkl. Berichtswesen durch und unterstützt bei Serviceaufgaben wie beispielsweise der Erstellung von Ausweisen für Mitarbeiter*innen oder der Verwaltung von Fundsachen.- Für deine Aufgaben übernimmst du die volle Verantwortung und baust dein Wissen und deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich aus, um unsere Sicherheitsprozesse gemeinsam im Team stetig zu verbessern.WIR MÖCHTEN DICH GERNE KENNENLERNEN, WENN…- Idealerweise hast du die Sachkundeprüfung nach §34a GewO erfolgreich absolviert und verfügst über Zusatzqualifikationen in den Bereichen Erste Hilfe und/oder Brandschutz. Zudem bringst du mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung  im Umgang mit Menschen sowie in Verwaltungstätigkeiten mit.- Um die vielfältigen Aufgaben des Security Guards zu erfüllen, zeichnest du dich durch Teamfähigkeit, eine hohe Leistungsbereitschaft sowie körperliche und psychische Belastbarkeit aus. Zudem bist du bereit, unsere interne Zalando Fortbildung “Zalando Security" zu durchlaufen und erfolgreich zu absolvieren. Lerne Kommunikationsgrundlagen, Präventionstechniken und Einsatztaktiken ebenso wie Erste Hilfe, Brandschutz und den Umgang mit unserer Sicherheitstechnik kennen.- Es fällt dir leicht, dich in neue Software einzudenken. Du freust dich darauf, mit Google Workspace, diversen Apps und Webtools zu arbeiten, um alle Vorgänge im Blick zu haben und korrekt zu dokumentieren.- Du bist kommunikationsstark und gibst dein Wissen, verständlich, nachhaltig und angepasst an den Wissensstand deiner Kolleg*innen, weiter. Mit deinen guten Deutschkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift erstellst du fehlerfreie Berichte. Grundlegende Englischkenntnisse auf A2-Niveau vereinfachen die Kommunikation im Team und ermöglichen einen hervorragenden Sicherheitsservice im Wechselschichtsystem.UNSERE VORTEILEZalando bietet eine Reihe von Vorteilen, hier ist ein Überblick darüber, was du erwarten kannst. Allein in Deutschland arbeiten Tausende Mitarbeiter*innen aus über 100 Nationen an mehreren Zalando Logistik-Standorten.Das Logistikzentrum in Lahr im Schwarzwald ist der jüngste unserer deutschen Standorte. Das Gebäude mit 130.000 Quadratmetern Fläche setzt neue Maßstäbe für die Branche und vereint eine Infrastruktur der neuesten Generation mit intelligentem Denken und einem großartigen Teamzusammenhalt.Wir haben 2016 unser erstes Paket aus dem Standort im Schwarzwald versendet und bieten  Arbeitsplätze für rund 2.500 Kolleg*innen an. Neben Einstiegsmöglichkeiten in der Lagerlogistik, suchen wir in Lahr auch Interessierte in der Verwaltung und in technischen Abteilungen.Bitte beachten, dass alle Bewerbungen auf dieser Seite über das Online-Formular erfolgen müssen – wir akzeptieren keine Bewerbungen per E-Mail. jobs.title: PhD Student in Acute Leukemia Research - Department of Hematology / Oncology (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: ...you're in the middle of itThe Department of Hematology/Oncology  of the university hospital in Frankfurt offers a broad diagnostic and therapeutic spectrum for patients with solid tumors, as well as malignant diseases of the hematopoietic system and investigates its development, progression, as well as therapy resistance. The Max-Eder Junior Research Group (funded by the German Cancer Aid) lead by Dr. med. Anjali Cremer is dedicated to deciphering oncogenic signaling transduction mechanisms, identification and characterization of viability regulators, as well as the analyses of resistance mechanisms to targeted therapies in acute leukemia.Dr. med. Anjali Cremer's team investigate new therapeutic vulnerabilities, that overcome resistance mechanisms in acute leukemia. The lab itself is embedded in the excellent re-search infrastructure of the university hospital in Frankfurt. Leukemia research and re-search on clonal hematopoiesis is one of the main focusses of the Department of Hematology/Oncology, as well as of the Frankfurt Cancer Institute and the DKTK partner site Frankfurt. Moreover, there are multiple possibilities for collaborations with scientists from all over the world.The position is fixed-term for a period of three years .Your Role :- The project is based on a recently published study by Bröchtel et al., in which USP22 was identified as key regulator of MEIS1 expression in KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemia. Results were published in the top hematology journal Blood (https://doi.org/10.1182/blood.2025031845).- The PhD project aims to further dissect the interplay between epigenetic regulation and the ubiquitin-proteasome system in order to identify new potential therapeutic interventions.- Your tasks include the design of scientific projects as well as planning, establishing and critically analyzing in vitro as well as in vivo experiments.- To answer our scientific questions, we apply the following experimental techniques (among others): innovative CRISPR-Cas9 knockout and screening technologies, quantitative global, phospho and ubiquitin proteomics, RNAseq, CUT&Tag/ChIP-based chromatin profiling, next-generation DNA Sequencing, FACS analysis and cell sorting, analysis of proteasomal degradation, work with primary patient samples, access to clinical patient data, and in vivo mouse models (C57BL/6 or NSG mice).... your skills are what we're looking for- The applicant should hold a master degree or equivalent in biology, biochemistry, molecular medicine or related fields.- A high level of motivation, flexibility and responsibility as well as very good communication skills in German or English are expected.- Expertise in experimental techniques (e.g. genome editing; high throughput sequencing analyses, flow cytometry) is an advantage.- Experience in animal experiments (FELASA B or C certificate) is an advantage.- Motivation to learn, apply and establish new techniques, ability to critically analyze and reflect data.- Experience with bioinformatic analyses (e.g. RNAseq, NGS) is an advantage.- Good skills with the following programs GraphPad Prism, FlowJo, Adobe Illustrator is an advantage.- Good English language skills.- Due to legal requirements, valid proof of measles immunity or measles vaccination is required.... you'll be offered a lot- In addition to an attractive salary based on acollective agreement (TV-G-U)with an annual special payment, you benefit from long-term security through company pension schemes- Internal and external training for your professional development- Benefit from our attractive health offers. We offer regular online and face-to-face courses on nutrition, relaxation, sports and exercise- Part-time employment is possible, we offer childcare in our daycare center (if you have any questions, please contact UKF-Familienservice), child care during holidays- Free public transport in all Hessen (Free State Ticket Hessen)- Uniklinik-Campus, Mensa, Cafés- Insights: Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn- FAQ´s for new employees**It's time to join our team! **Contact: Dr. rer. nat. Sarah BröchtelPhone: 069 / 6301-6358Email: broechtel@med.uni-frankfurt.deApplication Deadline: 31.12.2026We welcome applications from candidates of all genders. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal personal and professional qualifications.

jobs.title: Postdoc Researcher (f/m/d) in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as soon as possible :Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals(Full time / part time ** ** options available)﻿Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: Full-time; part time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.Your tasks- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures (possibly QTL and GWAS, genetic load) of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party fundingYour profile- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R- Very good written and oral communication skills in English- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigeneticsWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, gender, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application as a single PDF by 10 December2026 , including:- CV- Letter of motivation- Academic transcripts and certificates/credentials- Two relevant publications- Contact details of two potential referencesPlease compress the files where possible. If the two publications cause the file to exceed the upload limit, they may be uploaded separately.Please submit your application via our online application system. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our careers page and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Axel Janke ataxel.janke@senckenberg.deFor data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.
