jobs.title: Finnglass: Quality Manager
jobs.description: **Type**: Full-time, permanent**Location**: Asematie 46, 63400 Alavus**Application deadline**: 10.12.2026From Alavus to the skyscrapers of New York – join Finnglass as a **Quality Manager** and shape the quality behind demanding architectural glass solutions worldwide!Finnglass is a forward-thinking glass processing company delivering technically demanding and customized glazing solutions for harsh climates, creative architectural designs, and for the defence industry. The company has clients both in Finland and worldwide, for example in the US, Japan, South Korea and Singapore, to name a few. As the company continues to grow internationally, Finnglass is now looking for a Quality Manager to take ownership of its quality management function in Alavus, Finland.**Your role with Finnglass:**In this newly established role, your primary responsibility is to develop and implement a comprehensive quality management framework covering both operational and product quality. You will establish systematic quality processes, develop internal and customer-facing documentation, and ensure compliance with industry-specific standards, CE marking requirements, and Factory Production Control (FPC). Your initial focus will be on establishing a quality management framework that becomes an integral part of Finnglasss daily operations.You will lead a team of two quality control professionals, organizing product testing and developing testing protocols for processes such as glass tempering, lamination, and insulating glass production. Working closely with production, product development, and international customers, you will also investigate quality deviations, manage technical customer complaints, and introduce best practices. You will have a unique opportunity to visit customers internationally, learn from their quality management practices, and translate these insights into Finnglasss operations.**What makes you a great fit?**We hope to find a person with experience in industrial quality management and the ambition to develop into a leading expert in your field. You combine a systematic and analytical approach with the ability to turn technical requirements into practical processes. You are comfortable taking ownership, leading people, and engaging in technical discussions with demanding international customers.Previous experience in glass processing is highly valued but not essential. Above all, we appreciate your ability to absorb complex technical information, your curiosity toward glass as an engineering material, and your commitment to continuous professional development.**We hope you have:**- Relevant professional experience in industrial quality management, quality assurance, or quality process development - A solid understanding of quality management systems, industrial standards, and auditing practices - Strong documentation skills and the ability to establish systematic quality processes - Good leadership, collaboration, and analytical problem-solving skills - Good written and spoken English skills and willingness to travel internationally **We consider as an asset:**- Experience in the glass processing, window, or construction products industry - Knowledge of construction product regulations, CE marking, and relevant EN standards - Previous experience in a supervisory or team leadership role - Experience working with international industrial customers and suppliers - German language skills **Finnglass offers you:**- A unique opportunity to work with technically challenging glazing solutions for some of the worlds most ambitious architectural projects - Ownership of an entire quality management function, giving you genuine influence over the companys operations and international growth - Opportunities to develop into an internationally recognized glass industry expert through training and collaboration with leading industry professionals - A forward-thinking and collaborative work environment where your expertise is valued and investments support continuous development - Comprehensive health insurance and support with housing arrangements to help you settle into your new role in Alavus, if needed **Practicalities:**In this full-time and permanent position, you will be employed directly by Finnglass Oy. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible. You will work on-site at Finnglasss production facility in Alavus for at least 60% of your working time.The role involves international travel, amounting to approximately one month or more annually, potentially more during the initial stages of your employment.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX
jobs.description:
Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX

Location: Netherlands – regular travel within BENELUX

Start date: Q1 2027

Compensation: €65K - €85K base annually (depending on experience and location) +OTE

Employment type: Full-time

About DTACT

DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data.

As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most.

The Role

We're looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) to make their mark in a brand-new role, with the rare chance to build a function rather than inherit one. As DTACT’s first BDM, you’ll grow our business across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg through system integrators and other integrator partners, shaping how the function is designed and scaled. You’ll be the primary commercial contact for a portfolio of partners, building relationships, agreeing joint business plans and turning partner activity into a steady flow of qualified pipeline and closed deals. Reporting to the Head of Sales BENELUX & South, you’ll work closely with Customer Experience, Product and Pre-sales to make every joint deal a success, with plenty of room to run your own agenda.

We’re looking for an enterprising, resourceful self-starter who treats every result as their own and flourishes with real independence. You’re a relationship builder with strong commercial drive who understands how integrators make money and how their sales and delivery teams work. You earn trust quickly with partner leaders and technical teams alike, you’re comfortable working across cultures and languages in BENELUX, and you pair a collaborative attitude with the discipline to hit your number. If you’d rather build something than step into something, we’d love to hear from you.

What you'll do

  • Own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of BENELUX integrator partners and be their first point of contact at DTACT.

  • Build and execute joint business plans with clear targets for pipeline, revenue, enablement and customer wins.

  • Identify, qualify and recruit new integrator partners that fit DTACT's market and strategy.

  • Own and accurately forecast the partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue for your portfolio.

  • Co-sell with partners: join customer meetings, support proposals, build joint pipeline and drive complex deals to close, applying deal registration, pricing and margin rules consistently.

  • Make sure partner teams are trained, certified and confident; run regular business reviews; and work with Customer Experience on joint customer delivery.

  • Keep the CRM accurate, report on pipeline and partner performance, and bring partner feedback to Product, Engineering and Marketing.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of B2B sales or account management in IT, software or cybersecurity, focused on channel, partner or integrator sales.

  • A proven track record of meeting revenue targets through partners and building joint business plans.

  • An existing network or strong knowledge of system integrators and IT partners in BENELUX.

  • Enough technical understanding to hold credible conversations with partner engineers.

  • Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Proactive, hands on approach. Does not need close supervision.

  • Professional English and Dutch; German is a strong plus.

  • Nice to have: experience in cybersecurity, AI or data; building partner programs; or public-sector and tender sales.

What's in for you

  • Competitive compensation and equity participation, including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success.

  • Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs.

  • A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication, empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams.

  • Generous time off, including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Home office support, including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace.

  • An international and diverse team, where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives.

  • High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats.

We believe diverse teams build better solutions.

DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply.

Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Heel werkend Nederland op de fiets! Dat is de krachtige missie van Lease a Bike, waar we ons dagelijks vol passie voor inzetten. Om onze marktleidende positie verder uit te bouwen en nog meer impact te maken, zijn wij op zoek naar een commercieel gedreven Senior Customer Success Manager.

In deze rol krijg jij de verantwoordelijkheid over een portfolio van middelgrote en grote accounts. Je helpt nieuwe klanten succesvol te onboarden en bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. Een hoge klanttevredenheid en zo veel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen zijn hierbij jouw belangrijkste doelen. Dit doe je natuurlijk niet alleen: je werkt nauw samen in een gedreven team van 6 collega’s.

Jouw rol als Customer Success Manager

Als Senior Customer Success Manager ben jij de centrale spil tussen jouw klanten en onze interne organisatie. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. In jouw portefeuille richt jij je specifiek op bedrijven met 500+ medewerkers.

Zodra Sales de samenwerkingsovereenkomst heeft getekend, neem jij het stokje over. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen!

Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat.


Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement;

  • Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk;

  • Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift;

Wat bieden wij? 

Naast een uitdagende rol met veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en een grote impact op de verdere groei van Lease a Bike bieden wij nog veel meer:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.950,- en € 4.450. 

  • 8% vakantiegeld, een bonusregeling van 10% én een jaarlijkse winstuitkering;

  • Een jaarlijkse toekenning van 20 wettelijke verlofdagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Een gloednieuwe leasefiets naar keuze (Pon-merk) met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage;

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding of Shuttel-kaart voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist;

  • Focus op ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onder andere onze Winter- en Summerlabstrainingen;

  • Een gezonde lunch op kantoor in Amersfoort tegen een kleine bijdrage;

  • Een thuiswerkplek door ons gefaciliteerd met de mogelijkheid voor een netto thuiswerkvergoeding voor als je af en toe thuis wil werken;

  • Een collectieve Zorgverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis met een werkgeversbijdrage;

  • Én, last but not least, een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling bij het Pon Pensioenfonds van 30% waarbij Lease a Bike 20% bijdraagt.

Over de organisatie

Lease a Bike is ontstaan vanuit liefde voor mensen en fietsen. Voor ons is fietsen niet zomaar een manier van vervoer. Voor ons is fietsen een ‘way of life’. Fietsen is goed voor je gezondheid. Goed voor je portemonnee. Goed voor de wereld. Anderen stimuleren om de fiets te pakken, daar gaan wij voor! Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan een duurzamere wereld, waarbij vitaliteit en fun hand in hand gaan? Join the ride en draag bij aan de verwezenlijking van onze missie. Als scale-up is Lease a Bike onderdeel van mobiliteitsprovider Bike Mobility Services Group (Pon)!

Overige informatie

Ben je enthousiast over Lease a Bike en over de rol van Senior Customer Success Manager? Solliciteer dan direct via de knop ‘Solliciteren’ en stuur ons je cv en motivatiebrief.

Heb je naar aanleiding van de vacature vragen voor ons? Dan kan je contact opnemen met (HR Adviseur).

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. You will be the customer's primary point of contact for delivery, represent their priorities inside Vultr, and make sure what we commit to deliver is what they receive. The engineering and operations teams own and run their work; you connect it into a single delivery view for the customer and keep it moving. You will also lead cross-functional initiatives that improve how Vultr operates.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader with a record of delivering large infrastructure programs for demanding enterprise customers, who earns the trust of executives and engineers alike. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require sound judgment under pressure, candid communication when plans change, and the ability to lead teams you don't manage. You'll work on some of the largest AI infrastructure programs Vultr has ever taken on, in close partnership with senior leadership. Service Delivery is a new function at Vultr, so you will also help shape how it works. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery for one to two concurrent strategic customer programs, from the late stages of the sale through go-live and stable operation.

  • Own the customer relationship for delivery as primary contact and accountable owner, running executive governance such as steering committees, regular delivery reviews and escalations.

  • Partner with sales and account management before contract signature to confirm that what we commit to is deliverable, then make sure every commitment is tracked and met.

  • Coordinate the work of multiple engineering, infrastructure and operations teams, each with its own program managers, without taking over their plans: understand the dependencies between them, spot risks early and drive resolution.

  • Advocate for the customer inside Vultr, making sure their priorities shape decisions and challenging delays that can be avoided.

  • Communicate schedule changes to customers early and honestly, and lead difficult conversations about dates and scope with customer executives.

  • Manage each customer's path, from sales to delivery to ongoing support, leading formal customer acceptance once the service is live, ensuring nothing promised to the customer is lost along the way.

  • Lead cross-functional internal initiatives that improve how Vultr serves its customers, from planning through to a measurable outcome.

  • Coach Service Delivery Managers and build the methods, templates and standards the team uses.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 5 years managing customer-facing delivery of large, complex technology programs in cloud, data center, HPC, AI or telecommunications.

  • Proven ability to lead through influence across engineering, operations and commercial teams you don't manage.

  • Executive presence, including experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with senior customer stakeholders.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure delivery (data centers, networking, servers and GPUs, storage), enough to ask engineers the right questions and judge the answers.

  • Sound judgment under pressure, with a habit of raising risks early and bringing options rather than waiting for problems to escalate.

  • Experience moving customers from project delivery into ongoing operations and support.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, from detailed working sessions to executive summaries.

  • Proficiency with Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence and Salesforce, or similar program management, collaboration and CRM tools.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% to customer sites and data centers.

  • Flexibility to work extended hours, including some weekends, around major customer launches and across customer time zones.

  • Preferred: PMP, PgMP or equivalent certification; experience building a new delivery function or practice.

Compensation

$150,000 - $160,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

jobs.title: Staff Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

Enterprise customers trust us with real-time audio, video and data belonging to their own end users, and before they build on LiveKit they want proof that we protect it. Our compliance program gives them that proof, and enterprise deals close on it. We are hiring a Compliance Engineer to lead the customer-facing side of that program. You will share the day-to-day running of the compliance program with the rest of our Compliance team. We want someone who works themselves out of a job on the repeatable work. You will automate and simplify what you own, so your time goes to the larger deals and our compliance work grows more slowly than our customer base. jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Raaseporiin
jobs.description: Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalleHaemme hoiva-avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Raaseporissa.Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/applyMitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:suihkuapua voinnin tarkkailua kotona pärjäämisen tukemista liikkumisessa tukemistaLisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa.""Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Kom i mesterlære som tjener på Hindsgavl Slot
jobs.description:
Begynd din tjeneruddannelse hos os - med løn fra dag ét. I flotte og historiske rammer på Hindsgavl Slot lærer du alt det, en dygtig tjener skal kunne - inden for mad, vin, service og drift. Ingen skole det første år.

"Som elev på Hindsgavl Slot har jeg været omgivet af dygtige fagfolk, der gerne vil lære fra sig. De har fået mig til at føle mig som en ligeværdig kollega, og jeg fik også tidligt en del ansvar. Det har udviklet mig meget - og det har været en god måde at lære på. Samtidig er det sjovt at gå på arbejde, og dagene er så forskellige."

Sådan fortæller vores tidligere tjenerelev Laura om sin læretid på Hindsgavl Slot. Laura fortsætter på slottet som udlært tjener, og vi søger nu en ny elev til vores erfarne og fagligt stærke tjenerteam. Her står Laura og hendes tjenerkolleger klar til at lære dig alt det, en dygtig tjener skal kunne - inden for mad, vin, service og drift.

I tjenerteamet såvel som i resten af huset er vi gode til at hjælpe og sparre med hinanden. Her går vi det ekstra skridt, som vores gæster husker os for.

Om Ny mesterlære

Ved et tage din grunduddannelse i Ny mesterlære kan du gennem praktisk, lønnet arbejde kvalificere dig til hovedforløbet.

  • Løn fra dag ét
  • Praktisk læring og erfaring
  • Ingen skole det første år
  • Afsluttende praktisk prøve

OBS: Har du allerede gennemført grundforløbet, er du også velkommen til at søge elevpladsen.

Om dig

Du er nysgerrig og klar til at lære nyt hver eneste dag. For to dage er sjældent ens på Hindsgavl Slot. Den ene dag servicerer du gæster i vores hyggelige café, og den næste kan det være 700 gæster til stående frokost i Slotsladen eller 3.000 til koncert i parken. Og så er der alt det derimellem.

Du har et godt humør og er af natur smilende, udadvendt og ansvarsfuld. Du bidrager til holdånden og samarbejdet i tjenerteamet såvel som på tværs af slottets forskellige afdelinger.

Om dine opgaver

På Hindsgavl Slot kommer du godt omkring i tjenerfagets discipliner. Sammen med dine kolleger arbejder du med alt fra planlægning til afvikling.

Du bliver desuden klogere på både gastronomiens og vinens verden, og du vil erfare, at gæster er forskellige og har forskellige forventninger og behov. Her lærer du at komme dem alle i møde på en professionel måde.

Om Hindsgavl Slot 

Hindsgavl Slot ligger mellem vand og skov lidt uden for Middelfart på Vestfyn. Stedets historie går helt tilbage til det 12. århundrede, og i disse historiske rammer driver vi et moderne hotel og konferencecenter. Her er plads til både store og små arrangementer, fest og farver samt afslapning og hygge.

Gennem tider har vi udlært mange dygtige tjenere. Vi er derfor vant til at lære fra os og hjælpe vores elever til gode resultater og en fremtidig karriere inden for hospitalitybranchen. Flere af vores elever har desuden valgt branchen til, efter at de har prøvet kræfter med den her hos os.

Hindsgavl Slot er en mangfoldig og ansvarlig arbejdsplads med ordentlige forhold og vilkår.

Send os en ansøgning 

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, til vi finder den rette kandidat. Send os derfor din ansøgning snarest. Skriv lidt om dig selv, og hvorfor du gerne vil være tjener.

Ansøgningen sender du sammen med et vellignende foto af dig selv til F&B chef Peter Vinther-Wilhelmsen på pvw@hindsgavl.dk. Det er også ham, du skal kontakte, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Enten på mailen eller ved at ringe 64 41 88 00.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig - og forhåbentlig byde dig velkommen på vores elevteam.

jobs.title: Handledare
jobs.description: **Vi söker två handledare till Luna Familjecenter**Vill du arbeta nära barn, unga och familjer? Luna Familjecenter söker två handledare. Den ena tjänsten finns på **Lunabackens barnskyddsenhet i Munsala** och den andra inom **öppenvården med Jakobstad som utgångspunkt**. Båda tjänsterna innebär skiftarbete.**Handledare till Lunabackens barnskyddsenhet i Munsala**Lunabacken är en barnskyddsenhet med sju platser där vi tar hand om barn och unga dygnet runt. Som handledare är du en trygg vuxen i deras vardag. Du stöttar barnen med skolgång, fritid och vardagsrutiner och hjälper dem att hantera situationer som kan kännas svåra. Du finns till hands för samtal och deltar i det praktiska arbetet på enheten.Tillsammans med kollegorna planerar du vardagen och anpassar stödet efter varje barns behov. Du dokumenterar det som är viktigt för barnets vård och ser till att kollegorna får den information de behöver när nästa skift tar vid.Arbetstiden är **75–100 %**, med tyngdpunkt på kvällar, helger och nätter. Anställningen är tillsvidare eller tidsbunden enligt överenskommelse.**Handledare till öppenvården**Inom öppenvården arbetar du med barn, unga och familjer i olika livssituationer. Tjänsten kombinerar uppdrag inom exempelvis familjearbete, periodiskt professionellt stöd och familjerehabilitering. Du kan till exempel stötta en familj i att få vardagsrutinerna att fungera, arbeta med ett barn under ett stöddygn eller tillsammans med kollegorna ge föräldrar stöd i samspelet med sitt barn.Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på uppdraget. Du arbetar mot de mål som satts upp för barnet eller familjen och dokumenterar hur arbetet går. Samarbete med kollegor, socialarbetare och andra personer kring barnet hör också till arbetet. Vi planerar vilka uppdrag du främst arbetar med utifrån din kompetens och verksamhetens behov.**Du utgår från Jakobstad, men uppdragen kan också finnas på andra orter.** Arbetstiden är **75–100 %**. Arbetet sker i skift och kan beroende på uppdraget utföras hemma hos familjen eller i våra lokaler.**Vem söker vi?**Vi söker dig som har en **utbildning inom social- eller hälsovård**, till exempel som närvårdare, socionom eller sjukskötare.Du har lätt för att skapa kontakt med barn och unga och bemöter föräldrar med respekt, även i svåra situationer. Du kan hålla dig lugn när planerna ändras, sätta tydliga gränser när det behövs och samarbeta med dina kollegor kring det stöd barnet eller familjen behöver. Vi jobbar på både svenska och finska.**Vad erbjuder vi?**Hos Luna får du ett varierande arbete där du får använda dina styrkor och utveckla din kompetens inom barnskydd eller öppenvård.Vi värnar om ett **välmående arbetsklimat**. I vardagen betyder det att vi hjälper varandra när det är mycket att göra, delar med oss av vår erfarenhet och pratar öppet om det som fungerar och det som behöver förändras. När en situation känns svår har du kollegor att bolla den med.Vi har ett **nära ledarskap**. Din chef är insatt i det dagliga arbetet, tillgänglig för frågor och följer upp hur du har det på jobbet. Du får stöd när du behöver prioritera eller fatta svåra beslut och utrymme att påverka hur vi tillsammans utvecklar arbetet.**Så söker du**Skicka en fritt formulerad ansökan och ditt CV. **Ange i ansökan om du är intresserad av tjänsten på Lunabacken, tjänsten inom öppenvården eller båda tjänsterna.** Berätta gärna om din utbildning, din tidigare erfarenhet och vad du kan bidra med i arbetet med barn, unga och familjer.

jobs.title: Senior Energy Markets Analyst, PJM
jobs.description:
Voltus runs demand response programs across North American wholesale markets and utilities. As the Senior Energy Markets Analyst for PJM, you will own our PJM utility programs end to end. You will run one established utility program and help launch a second, newer one. You will also support Product and Partnerships in sizing and designing the next set of PJM utility programs, where much of our future revenue and margin sits.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will manage your own work, with your manager setting priorities and reviewing results rather than directing day-to-day tasks. For each program you own, you will be the go-to expert inside Voltus and the main contact for the utility.

What you will do

Run our PJM utility programs end to end: registrations, nominations, dispatch, performance calculations and settlements.

Help launch a new program and identify the next ones with Product and Partnerships.

Advise Product and Partnerships on program design, opportunity sizing and utility proposals. You will not draft formal regulatory filings.

Explain program rules in plain language to Sales, customers and Dispatch Ops, and write to utilities and PJM on registration and settlement issues.

Support PJM - ELRP (Load Management) registrations starting in 2028.

Guide and review the work of co-op and junior analysts. This role has no direct reports.

What success looks like

Within 60 days, you know the established program well enough to run it without the team's involvement.

Registrations, nominations, tests, events and quarterly settlements are on time and accurate, and your manager reviews rather than does.

New program registrations are submitted on time with no missed deadlines, and enrolled MW is at or near target.

Baseline and performance methodology is agreed with Engineering and Product before the first dispatch.

A written playbook for the new program exists that someone else could pick up.

Product, Partnerships, Dispatch Ops and utility contacts come to you directly.

Your analysis has informed a program design discussion with Product and Partnerships.

What you bring

Required

3 to 5 years of hands-on energy markets experience in demand response or a closely related area (registrations, performance calculations, settlements), in any ISO or utility program.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, baseline-versus-metered-load calculations, and settlement reconciliations that others can audit.

Basic SQL: read-only queries with joins, aggregations and filters to pull site, interval and dispatch data.

Basic Python, with familiarity with Pandas, to process interval data across many sites and automate repetitive registration and settlement prep.

Clear written communication, including plain-language explanations of program rules and professional correspondence with utilities and ISOs.

Ownership: you make judgment calls on ambiguous program rules, know when to escalate, and build process where none exists.

Availability during core Eastern hours and during test and event windows. PJM, the utilities and all program deadlines run on Eastern time.

Preferred

PJM experience, in this order of relevance: DR programs (ELRP, utility DR programs in PJM states); settlements and performance calculations; capacity market basics (PLCs, nominations, delivery year calendar); wholesale market operations.

Strong DR candidates from ERCOT, NYISO or MISO are encouraged to apply.Â 

Please note that at this time, we do not sponsor visas or transfers for new hires. Voltus teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location (in the US or Canada, unless otherwise indicated on the role description).

Additionally, while Voltus is an all-remote workplace, we have limitations on where employees are able to work for regulatory and security reasons. We expect that Voltans are working primarily from their home country. Working while traveling to other countries must be approved as per our Global Remote Travel Policy.

At Voltus, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer because we recognize that a diverse organization begins with a diverse candidate pool. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status, or marital status.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer, Foundations
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to join Raya Foundations, the platform team that owns the shared foundation every other Raya engineering team builds on. On the client side that means the architecture of our iOS codebase, its modularization and build system, shared libraries and design-system components, CI and release tooling, crash and performance infrastructure, and the AI-collaborative development tooling our iOS engineers use every day.

This is a senior client engineering role with deep technical impact across a large, long-lived swift iOS codebase. The ideal candidate has built and operated high-scale consumer iOS applications end to end, has been the engineer other iOS engineers come to for architecture and tooling, and is excited about modernizing a mature Swift codebase while keeping it shipping every week. Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app.

We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity.

Responsibilities

Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams.

Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally.

Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling).

Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client.

Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app.

Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns.

Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs.

Requirements

5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, and MVVM.

Strong experience with RxSwift or similar reactive programming frameworks, and with Redux-style state management patterns.

A track record of shipping consumer mobile apps to large audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance, and user experience.

Experience owning client platform or infrastructure work that other engineers depend on (modularizing a large iOS codebase, build and CI systems, shared libraries, design systems, or release tooling) and driving its adoption.

Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balance speed and quality, and own what you ship after it ships.

You use AI coding tools in your daily work, help the team adopt them, and look for opportunities to improve the engineering harness.

What Sets You Apart

Deep experience with SwiftUI alongside UIKit and with Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, strict concurrency), including migrating a mature codebase to them. CoreData a plus!

a related discipline from a recognised university (equivalent to a BSc (Hons) in Applied Accounting or a Bachelor's degree in Finance).•    A recognised professional accounting qualification is required; ACCA membership (or equivalent, e.g. CPA / CPA Affiliate holding substantial examination passes) is strongly preferred.•    Demonstrated continuing professional development through completion of major stages of an internationally-recognised accounting qualification pathway.•    Sound grounding in financial accounting, cost accounting, revenue recognition and audit principles acquired through formal university-level study.Professional Experience•    Minimum 2–3 years of progressive experience in accounts receivable, billing & settlement, or financial operations, in a collection — including high-volume transaction processing (e.g. 50+ accounts and 200,000+ monthly transaction rows).•    Proven track record in bill verification and exception resolution, with a time-savings results.•    Data analytics and reporting: ability to generate periodic settlement analytics and translate data into actionable insights for management.•    Proficiency in core office jobs.title: Senior Category Lead Modern Art
Senior scientific project coordinator
jobs.employer: NORCE RESEARCH AS AVD NATURVITENSKAP BERGEN
jobs.description:
About the position

The research group DARWIN (Data, AI, and Robotics) at the NORCE Technology and digital systems division is looking for a senior scientist in a permanent 100% position with the main role of initiating and coordinating large national and EU research proposals for the research group and scientifically coordinating them as well as designing novel concepts and solutions for AI and robot deployments. The group has strong technological professional expertise in data science, AI, computer vision, machine learning, robotics, mechatronics, cybernetics, computer engineering, visual sensing, visualization, advanced maintenance and smart instrumentation.

The place of work and employment can be any NORCE location. Travelling is expected.

Work tasks

The main tasks of the position will be to drive new large national and EU research possibilities, initiate and coordinate scientific proposal writing and applications, carry out the scientific coordination and management of projects within AI and robotics. Additional tasks include carrying out technological research and development projects in collaboration with industrial partners and research organization in Norway and in Europe, as well as collaborative projects with other groups and divisions within NORCE.

Required skills, expertise and experience

  • Scientific background: minimum master’s degree in mechanical electronics, computer science and/or mechatronics or a related scientific area, with extensive knowledge in robotics, AI and perception systems.

  • Documented experience of at least 10 years in national and EU research funding programs with a track record on initiating scientific large national and EU project applications, writing scientific national and EU project proposals and coordinating national and EU projects is particularly relevant to the position.

  • Industrial experience is an advantage

  • Being and having a certified project management with IPMA, PMP or similar

  • Proficiency in English. Knowledge of the Norwegian language is an advantage.

  • Good team working skills while being proactive.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

We offer

  • A good and professionally challenging working environment

  • Exciting interdisciplinary projects together with national and international partners

  • A nationwide network of researchers in NORCE

  • Exciting, varied and flexible workday

  • Interdisciplinary work in teams with experts in other fields

  • Great opportunities for professional and personal development in a new and expansive competence environment

  • A social and creative work environment where you have a large influence on your own workday

  • Good pension and insurance schemes, good welfare schemes and competitive wages

How to apply

Please upload your application by pressing the application button. Your application should be written in English and must include the following:

  • CV

  • A cover letter with a description of your professional qualifications and motivation to apply for the position

  • Names and contact information of two references

  • Copy of diplomas, transcripts and relevant certificates from your higher education

Application deadline: 3 January 2027

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting research leader Nabil Belbachir, tel. 401 08 137, or nabe@norceresearch.no.

At NORCE, we are committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for available positions regardless of gender, age, disability, or ethnic background.

Candidates are expected to openly offer relevant information about themselves during the recruitment process. Furthermore, one can expect background checks to be conducted on candidates in the final phase of the recruitment process. NORCE uses external actors to carry out such background checks.

NORCE is subject to the Security Act and there are strict requirements for our employees to have a security-conscious behavior. For this position, you must satisfy the security clearance requirements for SECRET/NATO SECRET.

Further information about security clearance can be found on the National Security Authority's (NSM) website: NSM.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vil du bruke kunnskapen din til noe som virkelig betyr noe? I NORCE blir du med på et lag som leverer viktig forskning og bærekraftige løsninger – regionalt, nasjonalt og globalt.

Vi er et av Norges største forskningsinstitutter, med over 800 ansatte i 10 byer langs Norges kyst. Hos oss er kunnskap, nytenkning og godt samarbeid nøkkelen til å lykkes.

Sammen med næringsliv og offentlig sektor skaper vi verdier og utvikler innovative løsninger på mange av de store utfordringene samfunnet står overfor. Det gjør vi med vår ekspertise og ledende kunnskapsmiljøer innen energi, helse, klima, miljø, samfunn og teknologi. Vi deler ikke bare din lidenskap for kunnskap. Vi kombinerer den med lang erfaring, unik bredde og sterke nettverk som gir gjennomslag nasjonalt og internasjonalt.

jobs.description: Kotirinki-yrittäjä, kotisiivous- ja kotiapupalvelutEtsimme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja motivoitunutta Kotipalveluyrittäjää liittymään osaavien Kotirinki-yrittäjien joukkoon. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa menestystäsi joustavasti.Työ sisältää: Siivouspalvelut arkipäivisin asiakkaiden kodeissa esimerkiksi säännöllisesti tehtävät kotisiivoukset tai kertaluoteisia palveluita muuttosiivouksia tai ikkunoidenpesua. Mahdollisuus laajentaa tehtäviä myös ikäihmisten Kotiapupalveluihin, kuten asiointiapuun, seuranpitoon ja arjen tukitehtäviin jos sinulla on siihen soveltuvuutta ja kiinnostustaEdellytämme: Vähintään B-ajokorttia (Suomalainen ajo-oikeus) ja auton käyttömahdollisuus Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, minimi taso B2 (asiakasviestintä tapahtuu suomeksi suullisesti ja kirjallisesti) Nuhteeton tausta ja luottotiedot kunnossa Hyvä fyysinen ja henkinen kuntoArvostamme: Asiakaspalveluasennetta ja aitoa halua auttaa Kiinnostusta markkinointiin ja oman toiminnan kehittämiseen Valmiin toimintamallin arvostamista Tahtoa menestyä yrittäjänä ja tehdä töitä yhdessäTarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä osana lämminhenkistä ja tyytyväistä Kotirinkiläisten joukkoa. Jos tunnet kutsumusta auttaa ihmisiä arjessa ja haluat rakentaa omaa yrittäjyyttäsi tuetusti ja kannustavasti tämä voi olla juuri sinulle!Joustavat aikataulut ja itsenäisyys: Päätä itse, milloin ja kuinka paljon haluat työskennellä. Tämä työ joustaa elämäntilanteesi mukaan mahdollisuus rauhallisiin aamuihin, aikaisiin iltapäiviin tai vapaiden viikonloppujen suunnitteluun on omissa käsissäsi.Vahva tuki markkinointiin ja asiakashankintaan: Saat käyttöösi valmiin verkkokaupan ja nautit Kotiringin tekemästä markkinointi- ja myyntityöstä, joka tukee yrityksesi kasvua. Vaikutat omaan menestykseesi omilla paikallisilla markkinointitoimilla ja aktiivisella asiakastyöllä.Valmis konsepti ja helppokäyttöiset työvälineet: Kotiringin kehittämät järjestelmät tekevät yrittäjyydestä yksinkertaista. Hallinnolliset työt, kuten laskutus ja työvuorosuunnittelu, hoituvat muutamalla klikkauksella, joten aikaa jää itse työlle, asiakkaille ja omasta vapaasta ajasta nauttimiseen.Koulutus ja jatkuva tuki: Oli sinulla aiempaa kokemusta alalta tai ei, Kotirinki kouluttaa sinut tuottamaan kotipalveluitamme konseptimme mukaisesti. Tukemme ja kattavat ohjeemme varmistavat, että onnistut laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisessa yrittäjänä.Kenelle Kotirinki-yrittäjyys sopii? Tämä mahdollisuus on sinulle, joka: Haluat itsenäisyyttä ja vapautta päättää omasta ajankäytöstäsi. Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.Kotirinki on kotimainen ketju, joka on tarjonnut palveluita asiakkaiden kotiin jo vuodesta 2002. Ketjussa toimii jo yli 80 tyytyväistä yrittäjää. Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.Testaa vastaammeko me sinun haaveisiisi paremmasta työstä ja sujuvammasta arjesta: Hyppää uudenaikaiseen kotipalvelutyöhön! Käy tekemässä onnellisuustestimmeNyt on täydellinen hetki hypätä mukaan kasvavaan kotipalvelualaan tukea, asiakkaita ja etuja heti alusta alkaen. Vapaita koulutuspaikkoja vuoden 2027 koulutuksiin!Hae mukaan jo tänään ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä olisit sopiva Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi. Haastattelut käynnistetään jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakemuksen ja infopaketin löydät sivuiltamme,Tervetuloa nauttimaan siistimmästä arjesta kanssamme!Avainsanoja: siivous, kotiapu, kotipalvelu, kotisiivous, lisätyö, osa-aikatyö, lisäansio, lisätulo, kotipalvelu, asiakaspalvelu, asiakaspalvelutyö, yrittäjä, yrittäjyys, siivousala, puhtausala, siivooja, lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, kotihoiva, siistijä, kokoaikatyö, hoiva-avustaja, kodinhuoltaja, päivätyö, laitoshuoltaja, puhtausala, hoitoala, kotipalveluala, siivoustyö, avointyöpaikka, palvelutyö, yrittäjyys, kotipalvelutyö,

jobs.title: Bilmekaniker med fagbrev
jobs.description:
Vi søker en dyktig og selvstendig bilmekaniker med fagbrev til en jobb på Askøy. Dette er en jobb som passer for deg som ønsker videreutvikle deg som mekaniker, og på sikt ønsker større oppgaver på verkstedet.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Fagbrev som bilmekaniker er et krav.

  • Praktisk erfaring fra verksted og god teknisk innsikt.

  • Gode ferdigheter i feilsøking og bruk av diagnoseverktøy.

  • Førerkort klasse B.

  • God arbeidsmoral, punktlighet og evne til å jobbe selvstendig.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Utføre service, vedlikehold og reparasjoner på person- og varebiler.

  • Feilsøking og diagnose av mekaniske og elektriske feil.

  • Oppfølging og dokumentasjon av utført arbeid.

  • Samarbeid med verkstedleder og kolleger for god fremdrift og kvalitet.

  • Bidra til et ryddig og sikkert arbeidsmiljø.

Vi tilbyr

  • Gode vilkår og konkurransedyktig lønn etter avtale.

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og profesjonell oppfølging fra vår rådgiver.

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke snarest.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordvest Bemanning AS er et bemanningsbyrå med lang erfaring innen formidling og utleie av faglært arbeidskraft. Vi rekrutterer i dag medarbeidere til et bredt utvalg av fagområder. Selskapet ble etablert i 2005, og har siden den gang hatt en positiv utvikling i forhold til kunder og oppdrag. Vårt hovedkontor ligger på Askøy like utenfor Bergen og vi er i dag et team på 150 medarbeidere.

Nordvest Bemanning AS is a recruitment agency with great experience in provision and hiring of skilled labour. We are currently recruiting employees for a wide range of specialist areas. The company was established in 2005, and since then has had a positive development in relation to customers and assignments. Our head office is located on Askøy just outside Bergen and we are at the moment a team of 150 co-workers.

Bli bedre kjent med oss/ get to know us:

https://www.instagram.com/nordvestbemanning/ https://www.facebook.com/nordvestbemanning www.nvb.no

Mahdollisuus laajentaa tehtäviä myös ikäihmisten Kotiapupalveluihin, kuten asiointiapuun, seuranpitoon ja arjen tukitehtäviin jos sinulla on siihen soveltuvuutta ja kiinnostustaEdellytämme: Vähintään B-ajokorttia (Suomalainen ajo-oikeus) ja auton käyttömahdollisuus Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, minimi taso B2 (asiakasviestintä tapahtuu suomeksi suullisesti ja kirjallisesti) Nuhteeton tausta ja luottotiedot kunnossa Hyvä fyysinen ja henkinen kuntoArvostamme: Asiakaspalveluasennetta ja aitoa halua auttaa Kiinnostusta markkinointiin ja oman toiminnan kehittämiseen Valmiin toimintamallin arvostamista Tahtoa menestyä yrittäjänä ja tehdä töitä yhdessäTarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä osana lämminhenkistä ja tyytyväistä Kotirinkiläisten joukkoa. Jos tunnet kutsumusta auttaa ihmisiä arjessa ja haluat rakentaa omaa yrittäjyyttäsi tuetusti ja kannustavasti tämä voi olla juuri sinulle!Joustavat aikataulut ja itsenäisyys: Päätä itse, milloin ja kuinka paljon haluat työskennellä. Tämä työ joustaa elämäntilanteesi mukaan mahdollisuus rauhallisiin aamuihin, aikaisiin iltapäiviin tai vapaiden viikonloppujen suunnitteluun on omissa käsissäsi.Vahva tuki markkinointiin ja asiakashankintaan: Saat käyttöösi valmiin verkkokaupan ja nautit Kotiringin tekemästä markkinointi- ja myyntityöstä, joka tukee yrityksesi kasvua. Vaikutat omaan menestykseesi omilla paikallisilla markkinointitoimilla ja aktiivisella asiakastyöllä.Valmis konsepti ja helppokäyttöiset työvälineet: Kotiringin kehittämät järjestelmät tekevät yrittäjyydestä yksinkertaista. Hallinnolliset työt, kuten laskutus ja työvuorosuunnittelu, hoituvat muutamalla klikkauksella, joten aikaa jää itse työlle, asiakkaille ja omasta vapaasta ajasta nauttimiseen.Koulutus ja jatkuva tuki: Oli sinulla aiempaa kokemusta alalta tai ei, Kotirinki kouluttaa sinut tuottamaan kotipalveluitamme konseptimme mukaisesti. Tukemme ja kattavat ohjeemme varmistavat, että onnistut laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisessa yrittäjänä.Kenelle Kotirinki-yrittäjyys sopii? Tämä mahdollisuus on sinulle, joka: Haluat itsenäisyyttä ja vapautta päättää omasta ajankäytöstäsi. Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.Kotirinki on kotimainen ketju, joka on tarjonnut palveluita asiakkaiden kotiin jo vuodesta 2002. Ketjussa toimii jo yli 80 tyytyväistä yrittäjää. Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.Testaa vastaammeko me sinun haaveisiisi paremmasta työstä ja sujuvammasta arjesta: Hyppää uudenaikaiseen kotipalvelutyöhön! Käy tekemässä onnellisuustestimmeNyt on täydellinen hetki hypätä mukaan kasvavaan kotipalvelualaan tukea, asiakkaita ja etuja heti alusta alkaen. Vapaita koulutuspaikkoja vuoden 2027 koulutuksiin!Hae mukaan jo tänään ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä olisit sopiva Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi. Haastattelut käynnistetään jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakemuksen ja infopaketin löydät sivuiltamme,Tervetuloa nauttimaan siistimmästä arjesta kanssamme!Avainsanoja: siivous, kotiapu, kotipalvelu, kotisiivous, lisätyö, osa-aikatyö, lisäansio, lisätulo, kotipalvelu, asiakaspalvelu, asiakaspalvelutyö, yrittäjä, yrittäjyys, siivousala, puhtausala, siivooja, lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, kotihoiva, siistijä, kokoaikatyö, hoiva-avustaja, kodinhuoltaja, päivätyö, laitoshuoltaja, puhtausala, hoitoala, kotipalveluala, siivoustyö, avointyöpaikka, palvelutyö, yrittäjyys, kotipalvelutyö,

jobs.title: Sales Engineer High Voltage products
jobs.description: **The opportunity**We are now looking for an enthusiastic and skilled Sales Engineer to join Hitachi Energy, Transformers business in Vaasa, Finland. You will support HV product sales team. You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders, support and run sales operations, maintain product and sales data, and provide both technical and commercial support to customers throughout the project lifecycle. If you are ready to support our sales teams and contribute to our continued growth, we want to hear from you!**How you'll make an impact**· Prepare quotations for customers of dedicated products.· Create and maintain customer relationships.· Update and maintain price lists.· Act as a link between the factory, FES, and customers· Update product data in SAP (including new product launches and information changes).· Support opening business deals.· Support claim handling process.· Manage price order changes.· Forward RFQs to appropriate factories.· Support segment sales activities in dedicated segment.**Your background**· Bachelors degree in Engineering or Technology, preferably in Electrical Engineering, Energy Technology, or Industrial Management.· A driven and self-motivated approach, combined with excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong, long-lasting stakeholder relationships.· 2-3 years of relevant work experience.· Strong ability to understand customer needs and a genuine interest in solving operational challenges.· Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Salesforce, and SAP.· Strong Finnish and English communication skills, both written and spoken.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
Horizon3.ai is seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Customer Marketing Manager to build engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and advocacy across our EMEA customer base. You will create programs that help customers realize more value from Horizon3, strengthen customer relationships, and turn successful outcomes into credible customer proof.

This role brings together customer lifecycle marketing and customer advocacy. You will develop regional customer communications and campaigns while building a repeatable advocacy engine across customer stories, references, third-party reviews, speakers, and other strategic opportunities. You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, and the broader Marketing team to turn customer needs and business priorities into useful, measurable programs.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic planner and a hands-on operator. You can build trust with customers, coordinate complex projects across teams and markets, use data to improve programs, and make it straightforward for customers to participate.

What you will do

Customer lifecycle marketing

  • Plan and execute customer marketing programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal support, and expansion.

  • Define customer segments, lifecycle stages, journey maps, messaging, and campaign playbooks that can be adapted for EMEA audiences.

  • Partner with Customer Success and Customer Enablement to promote onboarding, education, product engagement, and other programs that help customers achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Develop proactive re-engagement programs for at-risk or under-engaged accounts using customer health, product usage, support, engagement, and renewal signals.

  • Create signal-based campaigns tied to customer needs, product usage, account changes, renewal timing, and expansion fit. Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Customer Success Managers and account executives.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to translate customer feedback into product communications, release messaging, educational content, and lifecycle campaigns.

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with customer-centric messaging, adoption resources, executive business review materials, playbooks, and clear follow-up paths.

Customer advocacy and proof

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of EMEA customer advocates based on customer outcomes, engagement, use cases, and willingness to participate.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify customers for case studies, video testimonials, customer quotes, social content, references, and events.

  • Manage customer participation from outreach through briefing, approvals, production, publication, and follow-up. Coordinate logo rights, quotes, and other customer permissions with the appropriate internal teams.

  • Create and manage a practical customer reference program that supports sales opportunities, renewals, expansions, and strategic marketing needs. Maintain an organized reference pool and manage requests from intake and matching through scheduling, follow-up, and recognition.

  • Own day-to-day Peerbound administration and adoption, including customer profiles, advocacy requests, reference activity, permissions, and reporting. Help Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success use the platform consistently and make fuller use of its capabilities.

  • Develop and execute a focused third-party review strategy across relevant platforms, such as G2 and Gartner Peer Insights. Coordinate authentic customer outreach and track review volume, ratings, sentiment, category placement, competitor positioning, and progress against award criteria.

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline of customer speakers for webinars, user groups, events, panels, and other marketing programs. Confirm speakers early enough to include them in event promotions, landing pages, emails, and social campaigns, and manage briefing, preparation, logistics, approvals, and follow-up.

  • Own the customer invitation process for Customer Advisory Board opportunities and support customer recruitment for analyst interviews, research, awards, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Work with Content, Product Marketing, Social, Events, Communications, Analyst Relations, and Creative to elevate customers alongside the Horizon3.ai brand and turn customer outcomes into reusable marketing assets.

Program operations and measurement

  • Build annual and quarterly customer marketing plans for EMEA, manage budgets and resources, and lead cross-functional execution.

  • Work with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success Operations to improve segmentation, data quality, trigger detection, nurture, automation, attribution, and reporting.

  • Establish dashboards and operating rhythms that connect program engagement to adoption, customer advocacy, renewal health, retention, expansion pipeline, and influenced revenue.

  • Define success measures, analyze results, identify opportunities to improve, and iterate on program strategy, messaging, and execution.

  • Communicate timelines, owners, status, risks, and next steps clearly across teams. Create practical templates, trackers, and workflows that make customer marketing easier to execute and scale.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, customer advocacy, customer success enablement, or a related discipline.

  • Experience building customer journeys and programs across adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, expansion, or advocacy.

  • A track record of managing customer stories, references, reviews, speakers, or other advocacy programs, ideally alongside lifecycle marketing responsibilities.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.

  • Strong project management and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines across teams and markets.

  • Analytical and operational skills, including the ability to connect customer behavior and program performance to business outcomes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the judgment to represent customer perspectives accurately and authentically.

  • Familiarity with customer advocacy, reference, review, CRM, or marketing automation platforms. Peerbound experience is a plus.

  • Understanding of B2B SaaS or cybersecurity customer environments is a plus.

  • Ability to work effectively across EMEA markets and time zones. Additional language skills are a plus.

How success is measured

  • Lifecycle program engagement and contribution to customer adoption, retention, renewal health, and expansion.

  • Growth and health of the EMEA customer advocate and reference pool, including references fulfilled and customer participation.

  • Customer proof produced, including case studies, videos, quotes, approved logos, and social or event participation.

  • Customer speakers confirmed in time to support event and webinar promotion.

  • Peerbound adoption, data quality, and program activity.

  • Review volume, ratings, sentiment, and progress against award criteria.

  • Customer experience and internal stakeholder satisfaction.

jobs.title: Auto Electricians, Mechanics or Electrical Fitters – job in Denmark, 3 weeks a month – Build Custom Vans and Trucks
jobs.description:
Become a key player as we build mobile workplaces – custom-built vans and trucks at Danlad in Denmark - Flexible work planning with monthly home visits and accommodation help.

Do you want to help build the vans and trucks of the future?

With us, you get the chance to make a real difference for our customers as you and your team create professional, top-quality van and truck builds. The work is varied and ranges from standard orders to tailor-made special solutions, where your technical and practical skills really come into play.

We are looking for a qualified auto electrician, automotive technician or mechanic – or someone with strong technical skills and solid, relevant experience from previous jobs.

YOUR TASKS

  • Installation and connection of electrical components on vans and trucks

  • Installation of lift and crane solutions

  • Installation of work lights, marker lights and relay controls

  • Installation of solar panel solutions

  • Installation of battery, charger and inverter solutions

  • Special assignments – e.g. building complete electrical systems for service vehicles

ABOUT YOU

  • Have relevant training or qualifications

  • Ideally have experience from a similar company - this is not a criteria

  • Work in a focused and independent way

  • Are structured and adaptable in a busy everyday environment

  • Are flexible and in good spirits

  • Speak Danish or English – Danish is not a requirement

WE OFFER

  • Varied and exciting tasks in a good working environment

  • A versatile workplace with an informal and friendly atmosphere

  • Fixed salary, free-choice account (fritvalg), pension and health insurance

  • A workplace where you can help make a difference

  • Flexible work planning with monthly home visits and accommodation help

 

Location

Danlad A/S, Ejby, Denmark

Start date

As soon as possible

Sounds like you?

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to call Morten Michaelsen on +45 20 60 30 74.

No application needed. Please submit your contact details and answer a few questions via the link below – we look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, Esperi Koti Suistamo
jobs.description: Hei vammaistyöstä innostunut lähihoitaja! Miltä kuulostaisi työ kodinomaisessa ja pienessä yksikössä, jossa asukkaat tulevat aidosti tutuiksi? Etsimme nyt lähihoitajaa vanhempainvapaan sijaisuuteen 15.11.2027 saakka. Lue lisää ja tule mukaan rempseään joukkoomme!Meidän kotimme - Esperi Koti SuistamoKoti Suistamo tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista 15 kehitysvammaiselle henkilölle. Asukkaamme ovat pääosin nuoria aikuisia, mutta kodissamme asuu myös iäkkäämpiä asukkaita.Sijaitsemme luonnon läheisyydessä Iisalmessa, jossa meillä on katettu terassi ja viihtyisä piha-alue ulkoporealtaineen. Toimintamme perustuu aktiiviseen arkeen, jossa tärkeää on monipuolinen viriketoiminta ja mielekäs tekeminen. jobs.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at

Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated.

Vaikutat omaan menestykseesi omilla paikallisilla markkinointitoimilla ja aktiivisella asiakastyöllä.Valmis konsepti ja helppokäyttöiset työvälineet: Kotiringin kehittämät järjestelmät tekevät yrittäjyydestä yksinkertaista. Hallinnolliset työt, kuten laskutus ja työvuorosuunnittelu, hoituvat muutamalla klikkauksella, joten aikaa jää itse työlle, asiakkaille ja omasta vapaasta ajasta nauttimiseen.Koulutus ja jatkuva tuki: Oli sinulla aiempaa kokemusta alalta tai ei, Kotirinki kouluttaa sinut tuottamaan kotipalveluitamme konseptimme mukaisesti. Tukemme ja kattavat ohjeemme varmistavat, että onnistut laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisessa yrittäjänä.Kenelle Kotirinki-yrittäjyys sopii? Tämä mahdollisuus on sinulle, joka: Haluat itsenäisyyttä ja vapautta päättää omasta ajankäytöstäsi. Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.Kotirinki on kotimainen ketju, joka on tarjonnut palveluita asiakkaiden kotiin jo vuodesta 2002. Ketjussa toimii jo yli 80 tyytyväistä yrittäjää. Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.Testaa vastaammeko me sinun haaveisiisi paremmasta työstä ja sujuvammasta arjesta: Hyppää uudenaikaiseen kotipalvelutyöhön! Käy tekemässä onnellisuustestimmeNyt on täydellinen hetki hypätä mukaan kasvavaan kotipalvelualaan tukea, asiakkaita ja etuja heti alusta alkaen. Vapaita koulutuspaikkoja vuoden 2027 koulutuksiin!Hae mukaan jo tänään ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä olisit sopiva Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi. Haastattelut käynnistetään jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakemuksen ja infopaketin löydät sivuiltamme,Tervetuloa nauttimaan siistimmästä arjesta kanssamme!Avainsanoja: siivous, kotiapu, kotipalvelu, kotisiivous, lisätyö, osa-aikatyö, lisäansio, lisätulo, kotipalvelu, asiakaspalvelu, asiakaspalvelutyö, yrittäjä, yrittäjyys, siivousala, puhtausala, siivooja, lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, kotihoiva, siistijä, kokoaikatyö, hoiva-avustaja, kodinhuoltaja, päivätyö, laitoshuoltaja, puhtausala, hoitoala, kotipalveluala, siivoustyö, avointyöpaikka, palvelutyö, yrittäjyys, kotipalvelutyö,
