jobs.title: Kom og bliv en del af Danmarks bedste krisecenter
jobs.description:
Krisecenter Guldborgsund søger en socialrådgiver til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse den 1. februar 2027.

Brænder du for at gøre en reel forskel for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer? Kan du kombinere høj socialfaglighed med empati, struktur og handlekraft – og trives du i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

På Krisecenter Guldborgsund arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe sikkerhed, tryghed, nye handlemuligheder og en vej videre for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer. Vi er et hus i rivende udvikling, og vi har høje ambitioner – både på vores beboeres og vores fagligheds vegne.

Hvem er vi?

Krisecenter Guldborgsund er et krisecenter efter servicelovens § 109. Vi har 21 lejligheder med plads til kvinder og mænd samt op mod 30 medfølgende børn – og sommetider også familiens kæledyr.

Fælles for vores beboere er, at de har været udsat for vold i nære relationer og derfor har søgt ophold hos os.

Vi er et stort hus, hvor der sker meget i løbet af en dag. Det kræver, at du kan bevare overblikket, være fleksibel og samtidig holde fast i struktur, faglighed og dokumentation.

Hos os arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af fagligheder, fordi vi tror på, at den bedste indsats skabes, når forskellige faglige perspektiver bringes i spil.

Din rolle som rådgiver

Som rådgiver får du en central rolle i den enkelte borgers ophold og forløb på krisecenteret.

Arbejdet spænder fra den første visitation og vurdering af sikkerhedsbehov til samtaler, risikovurderinger, koordinering, myndighedssamarbejde og støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse efter volden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Åben rådgivning til borgere, som ikke er indskrevet på krisecenteret.

  • Visitationssamtaler og vurdering af indskrivningsgrundlag og sikkerhedsbehov.

  • Udarbejdelse og løbende opfølgning på risikovurderinger og relevante sikkerhedstiltag.

  • Ugentlige samtaler med de borgere, du er kontaktperson for.

  • Rådgivning og vejledning omkring blandt andet bolig, økonomi, sociale ydelser, bopæl og forældremyndighed.

  • Koordinering af borgernes sager på tværs af myndigheder og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Handleplansmøder med borgere og betalingskommuner.

  • Udarbejdelse af lovpligtige opholdsplaner.

  • Bisidderfunktion ved eksempelvis møder med kommune, politi, læge, Familieretshuset og Familieretten.

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde omkring både voksne og medfølgende børn.

  • Journalføring, notatpligt og øvrig relevant socialfaglig dokumentation.

Rådgiverfunktionen indebærer dermed både relationsarbejde, myndighedssamarbejde, praktisk socialrådgivning og en betydelig koordinerende funktion omkring den enkelte borgers samlede forløb.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger en erfaren socialrådgiver, som hviler i sin faglighed, kan arbejde selvstændigt og har lyst til at udvikle sig inden for det specialiserede voldsfaglige område.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver

  • Har minimum to års relevant erhvervserfaring.

  • Har solid socialfaglig erfaring og gerne erfaring med udsatte borgere, vold i nære relationer, myndighedsarbejde, familieområdet eller lignende.

  • Er stærk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

  • Kan skabe en professionel og tillidsfuld relation til mennesker, der befinder sig i en krisesituation.

  • Kan arbejde struktureret, prioritere dine opgaver og bevare overblikket, også når planerne pludselig ændrer sig.

  • Forstår betydningen af grundig og rettidig dokumentation.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig ser tværfagligt samarbejde som en naturlig del af arbejdet.

  • Er åben over for faglig sparring, feedback og udvikling af egen praksis.

  • Har mod på at være en aktiv del af huset og beboernes hverdag – vi er et krisecenter, ikke en traditionel kontorarbejdsplads.

Vi lægger vægt på faglighed og erfaring, men også på, hvem du er som menneske. Vi bruger mange timer sammen, og derfor betyder humor, engagement, fleksibilitet og lysten til at bidrage til fællesskabet også noget for os.

Team og organisering

Krisecenter Guldborgsund er kendetegnet ved et tæt og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team bestående af leder, faglig koordinator, socialrådgivere, pædagoger, psykoterapeut, psykolog, nattevagter, administrativ medarbejder, pedel og øvrigt personale

Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af faggrupper og forventer, at alle bidrager til huset, fællesskabet og den fælles kerneopgave.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer ugentligt.

Rådgivernes arbejdstid er som udgangspunkt placeret i dagtimerne, typisk fra kl. 8.00-15.00 og enkelte dage fra kl. 8.00-16.00.

Derudover har den enkelte rådgiver én fast ugentlig aftenvagt fra kl. 11.00-21.00.

Rådgiverne indgår desuden i:

  • Weekendvagt hver 8. weekend, hvor arbejdstiden er lørdag og søndag fra kl. 10.00-16.00.

  • Helligdagsvagter

Personalegruppen planlægger i høj grad selv fordelingen af sommerferie og helligdagsvagter.

Det fungerer rigtig godt i praksis, og medarbejderne er gode til at koordinere indbyrdes og tage hensyn til både hinandens ønsker og krisecenterets behov for bemanding.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på en arbejdsplads, hvor dit arbejde har reel betydning for mennesker i en vanskelig livssituation.

  • Et stærkt og engageret tværfagligt miljø.

  • En arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner og fokus på det specialiserede voldsfaglige område.

  • Mulighed for løbende kompetenceudvikling og efteruddannelse.

  • Faglig sparring og supervision.

  • En hverdag med stor selvstændighed, ansvar og tydelige rammer.

  • En organisation i udvikling, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer faglighed, samarbejde, respekt, humor (også den sorte) og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Og ikke mindst – de bedste og sjoveste kollegaer, som er en god blanding af både mænd og kvinder.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsesform: Fast stilling.

Arbejdstid: 37 timer ugentligt.

Tiltrædelse: 1. februar 2027.

Ansøgning og ansættelsessamtaler

Ansøgningsfrist: Tirsdag den 15. december 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes mandag den 21. december 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Linda MøllgrenLeder, Krisecenter GuldborgsundTelefon: 51 93 07 82 mellem kl. 11.00-13.00Mail: linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Vi søger ikke bare en socialrådgiver, der kan løse en række opgaver. Vi søger en ny kollega, som har lyst til at være en aktiv del af vores hus, vores fællesskab, vores faglige udvikling og den forskel, vi hver eneste dag arbejder for at skabe for mennesker udsat for vold i nære relationer.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: SMD Operators for a New Evening Shift
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced SMD Operator with a keen eye for quality, stable processes and precision-driven electronics manufacturing? Do you thrive in a technical environment where you take responsibility, work in a structured manner and actively contribute to a strong team? Then you could be our next experienced SMD Operator at NECAS A/S.About the positionAs an SMD Operator at NECAS, you will play a key role in the operation of our SMD lines – the heart of our electronics manufacturing. You will be responsible for setting up, monitoring and optimising processes, ensuring that production meets our high quality standards.The electronics you help produce are used in everything from industrial and marine applications to defence and aerospace – industries where precision and reliability are essential.You will become part of a highly skilled team and report to the Team Leader.Your responsibilitiesSMD line operation and preparation
  • Operate and monitor SMD equipment, including solder paste printer, SPI, pick-and-place, AOI and reflow oven
  • Prepare the line for production changeovers, including programmes, materials, feeder setup and documentation
  • Ensure stable operation in accordance with production plans and work instructions
  • Work with supporting processes such as the washing machine and stencil cleaner
Quality and inspection
  • Carry out process and quality inspections, including visual inspection and First Article Inspection
  • Analyse AOI results and respond to deviations
  • Ensure the correct handling of materials and components, including batch control, traceability and shelf life
  • Work in accordance with the IPC-A-610 standard (certification provided where required)
  • Record defects and deviations in the quality management system
Collaboration and continuous improvement
  • Ensure good communication and effective handovers between shifts
  • Share knowledge and support colleagues in their daily work
  • Contribute suggestions for improving processes and workflows
  • Maintain order and structure in the SMD area in accordance with 5S principles
About youWe are looking for a candidate who already has solid experience in SMD production and is able to work independently in a technically demanding role.We expect you to:
  • Have a minimum of 3 years' experience with SMD equipment or electronics manufacturing
  • Be structured and able to maintain an overview, even during busy periods
  • Take responsibility and respond quickly when something deviates from the standard
  • Be a team player who contributes positively to the team
  • Have a technical understanding and an interest in working with advanced equipment
  • Language: good command of English, spoken and written
What we offerAt NECAS, you will become part of a growing company where quality and professional expertise are at the heart of what we do. You will receive:
  • A thorough introduction to our processes and equipment
  • Opportunities for relevant training and certifications, such as IPC-A-610
  • A strong team environment and an informal culture with a high level of professional expertise
  • A workplace in Støvring's newest industrial area, close to the E45 motorway
  • Competitive terms of employment, including pension and health insurance
About NECASNECAS is one of Denmark's leading EMS companies, manufacturing electronics for the industrial, marine/offshore, defence, aerospace and scientific sectors – industries where quality and precision are essential.We are one of the few EMS manufacturers in Denmark with AS9100 certification for the aerospace industry. At NECAS, you will become part of a company experiencing significant growth, where you can develop your professional skills and help push the boundaries of Danish electronics manufacturing.As we say: Built for trust.How to applyThe position will be filled as soon as possible. We are inviting candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We read all applications and will contact candidates we would like to get to know better.If you have any questions, please contact Team Leader Mariana Surleac on +45 92 92 76 20.

Â 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, client services, or strategic account leadership, with significant experience supporting financial services clients.

  • Strong understanding of the financial services industry, including banking, payments, insurance, capital markets, or fintech.

  • Experience selling and expanding technology consulting services across digital engineering, cloud, data, AI, and enterprise transformation.

Who weâre looking for

Youâll report to our Head of Finance and work closely with Sales, CS, RevOps, and People. When you see a problem, you fix it. When a process works, you find a way to make it better.

What youâll do

  • Document processes and controls so our accounting holds up to audit and scales as we grow.

jobs.title: IT Service Desk Technician
jobs.description:
Location: Oslo, Norway

About the role

At Schibsted, reliable IT services are essential to helping our employees do their best work.

We are looking for an IT Service Desk Technician to join our Service Desk team in Oslo, providing high-quality technical support to employees across our organisation, primarily in Norway and Sweden.

Our Service Desk is more than a traditional first-line support function. We resolve approximately 80% of all incoming IT requests and incidents within the team, which means you will have the opportunity to work with a wide range of technical challenges, take ownership of issues and develop your troubleshooting skills.

You will work in an international environment where customer satisfaction, technical expertise and continuous improvement are key priorities. Our IT operations follow IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and ITIL practices, with a strong focus on efficient problem-solving, knowledge sharing and improving the employee IT experience.

Your responsibilities

As an IT Service Desk Technician, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver high-quality IT support: Provide professional, friendly and solution-oriented technical support to employees through phone, email and other support channels.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues: Investigate and resolve incidents involving computers, operating systems, applications, user accounts, access and other workplace technologies.

  • Own incidents and service requests: Register, prioritise, investigate, document and follow up on cases in our ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Halo), taking responsibility for driving issues towards resolution.

  • Ensure a great user experience: Communicate clearly with users, provide regular updates and manage expectations throughout the support process.

  • Drive efficient resolution and knowledge sharing: Contribute to our high resolution rate by developing technical knowledge, documenting solutions and supporting a shift-left approach.

  • Collaborate and continuously improve: Work closely with colleagues and other IT teams to resolve complex issues and improve processes related to Incident, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management.

  • Manage IT equipment and suppliers: Support ordering, inventory management and distribution of IT equipment and accessories, including coordination with external suppliers.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, takes ownership of problems and genuinely likes helping people.

You are curious about technology, comfortable investigating unfamiliar issues and motivated by finding solutions rather than simply passing problems on to someone else.

You enjoy working in an environment where priorities can change quickly and where teamwork, knowledge sharing and customer satisfaction are essential.

Skills and knowledge

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

  • A good understanding of computers, operating systems, software and common workplace IT technologies.

  • The ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a structured and logical way.

  • Familiarity with, or an interest in learning, technologies such as Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.

  • An understanding of the importance of documenting incidents, solutions and technical information.

  • The ability to communicate technical information clearly to users with different levels of IT knowledge.

  • Professional proficiency in Norwegian or Swedish, as well as English, both written and spoken.

Nice to have

The following qualifications are an advantage, but not essential:

  • Previous experience working in an IT Service Desk, IT Support or similar technical support role.

  • Around two years of relevant technical experience or education.

  • Experience working with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or Halo.

  • Knowledge of ITIL principles and IT Service Management processes.

  • Relevant IT certifications or technical training.

  • Experience with IT equipment management, inventory control or supplier coordination.

  • Experience with AI tools and technologies, particularly using AI to improve IT support, automate tasks, enhance troubleshooting or streamline workflows.

We value practical skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn. You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to be considered for the role.

Who you are

We believe the following qualities will help you succeed:

  • Customer oriented: You enjoy helping others, understand their needs and take pride in delivering excellent service.

  • Problem-solving: You approach technical challenges with curiosity, persistence and a structured mindset, taking responsibility for finding solutions.

  • Communication: You explain technical issues clearly, listen actively and keep users informed throughout the support process.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable handling changing priorities, learning new technologies and working in a dynamic IT environment.

  • Collaborative: You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive and supportive team environment.

Why join us?

You will join a Service Desk team in Oslo where technical problem-solving, collaboration and high-quality service go hand in hand.

Unlike traditional first-line support roles, our team handles and resolves the majority of incoming IT issues, giving you the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies and technical challenges.

You will support colleagues across Norway and Sweden, work with modern workplace technologies and contribute to continuously improving how IT services are delivered.

We believe great IT support is about more than fixing technical problems. It is about taking ownership, building trust and making people's working lives easier.

Huolehdit laitteiden toimintavarmuudesta sekä pääset kehittämään toimintatapoja ja suunnittelemaan tulevia investointeja kasvavan tuotannon tarpeisiin.Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:- Tuotantolaitteiden ja kiinteistötekniikan kunnossapidon johtaminen sekä käytännön huolto- ja vianratkaisutehtävät - Ennakkohuoltojen, kunnossapidon mittaroinnin ja dokumentoinnin kehittäminen - Kunnossapidon asiantuntijan esihenkilötyö sekä yhteistyön koordinointi ulkoisten huoltokumppanien ja laitetoimittajien kanssa - Kunnossapidon budjetointi, kustannusten seuranta ja investointitarpeiden suunnittelu - Tuotantolaitteiden, -linjastojen ja tilojen muutostöihin sekä uusien laitteiden käyttöönottoihin osallistuminen Pääset työskentelemään lähellä tuotannon arkea, noin puolet työajastasi kuluu käytännön huoltotehtävissä ja tukenasi on kokenut kunnossapidon asiantuntija. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä erityisesti tuotannon, laadunvarmistuksen ja tuotekehityksen kanssa huolehtien siitä, että kunnossapito vastaa laatuohjatun tuotantoympäristön vaatimuksia.**Millaista osaajaa etsimme?**Etsimme kokenutta ja teknisesti vahvaa kunnossapidon ammattilaista, jolla on kokemusta teollisuuden tuotantolaitteista ja tiimin vetämisestä. Viihdyt tehtävässä, jossa yhdistyvät käytännön tekeminen, suunnittelu ja yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien kanssa.Osaat hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia, priorisoida kiireellisiä tilanteita ja tehdä perusteltuja päätöksiä myös kustannukset huomioiden. Työotteeltasi olet oma-aloitteinen ja järjestelmällinen, ja viet asioita aktiivisesti eteenpäin. Arvostamme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, uteliaisuutta ja halua löytää entistä toimivampia ratkaisuja.**Hakijalta odotetaan:**- Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta ja vahvaa kokemusta teollisuuden tuotantolaitteiden kunnossapidosta - Kokemusta valmistus- ja pakkauslaitteista sekä käytännön osaamista mekaanisten, sähkö- ja paineilmatoimisten sekä logiikkaohjattujen laitteiden huollosta ja vianratkaisusta - Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai tiiminvetovastuusta sekä halua johtaa ja kehittää kunnossapidon toimintaa - Kokemusta ennakkohuoltojen, huoltokumppanien ja kustannusten hallinnasta sekä investointien suunnittelusta - Hyviä yhteistyö- ja organisointitaitoja sekä hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa **Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:**- Kokemus lääke- tai lääkinnällisten laitteiden teollisuudesta sekä GMP-vaatimusten ja auditointien tuntemus - Automaatio-, sähkö- tai instrumentointiosaaminen sekä teknisen piirtämisen, esimerkiksi AutoCADin, tuntemus - Kokemus tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä esimerkiksi teknisessä suunnittelussa, varaosien selvittämisessä ja kunnossapidon kehittämisessä **Tarjoamme sinulle:**- Mahdollisuuden kehittää kunnossapitoa kasvavassa yrityksessä ja vaikuttaa siihen, miten tuotannon toimintavarmuutta parannetaan - Tiiviin yhteistyön laajan asiantuntijaverkoston kanssa tuotannosta tuotekehitykseen ja kansainvälisiin toimittajiin - Modernit tekoälytyökalut, joiden avulla voit tehostaa suunnittelua ja löytää uusia ratkaisuja teknisiin haasteisiin - Matalan hierarkian työyhteisön, jossa ideat viedään nopeasti käytäntöön ja oma kädenjälkesi näkyy aidosti - Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten, kuten liikunta- ja kulttuurietu, laajan työterveyshuollon sekä mahdollisuuden hyödyntää kuukausittaisia CaPS:n henkilöstöetuja; lisäksi käytössä on tulokseen perustuva ryhmäeläkevakuutus **Käytännön asiat:**Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan Galena Pharman palvelukseen. Tehtävä sijoittuu Kuopioon ja tehtävä edellyttää paikan päällä työskentelyä. Yksittäiset etätyöpäivät onnistuvat tarpeen mukaan työtehtävistä riippuen. Tehtävä edellyttää myös ajoittaista matkustusvalmiutta.Toivottu aloitusajankohta on mahdollisimman pian, mutta tarkempi aikataulu sovitaan joustavasti valittavan henkilön kanssa. Palkka tehtävässä asettuu noin 4 000–4600 €/kk välille, ja lopullinen palkka neuvotellaan ehdokaskohtaisesti osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella.**Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?** Hienoa! jobs.title: Partner Solution Architect, Partner Center of Excellence
jobs.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloftâs certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that âEX = CXâ: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

Â 

Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform.

As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner-led implementations from kickoff through go-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner.

You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use.

Â 

Job Responsibilities

What you'll do

Guide Partners to Go-live

Serve as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live. Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities. Help partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner.

Own the Technical Escalation Path

Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects. Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira. Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room. Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items.

Enable the Ecosystem

Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams. Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access. Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem.

Build the Playbook

Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides. Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

Partner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers. Technical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster. Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls. Product and Engineering receive a steady, well-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap. A working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides. Support inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff. Target metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered. Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

What you'll bring

5+ years in a technical, customer- or partner-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post-sale delivery. Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud). Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record. Working knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs Strong troubleshooting instincts. You can isolate whether an issue is configuration, integration, or product defect, and explain it precisely to engineers and executives alike. Solution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders. Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support. Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations. A builder's habit of turning one-off fixes into reusable documentation and process.

Preferred Qualifications

Nice to have

Integration middleware experience: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi. Background in CLM, procurement or source-to-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus. Prior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners. Exposure to ISV/managed-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations. Prior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners.
Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at brad.toothman@agiloft.com.
Â 
Applicants from underrepresented groups such as minorities, veterans, or individuals with disabilities encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed as submitted. There will be no application deadline for this opportunity.

jobs.title: Kantineassistent til vores hovedkontor - skab gode frokostoplevelser på 37 timer om ugen
jobs.description:
Kokkenes Køkken · Vores hovedkontor · Kantineassistent · 37 timer om ugen

En god frokost giver kollegerne et velsmagende måltid og et pusterum i arbejdsdagen. Vi søger en kantineassistent til vores hovedkontor, der har lyst til at bidrage til både maden, servicen og de praktiske opgaver, som får kantinen til at fungere.

Din hverdag

Du får en hverdag med forskellige opgaver omkring klargøring, frokostservering og oprydning. Du bidrager til, at kantinen er indbydende, og at vores kolleger bliver mødt med venlighed og god service.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Klargøring og tilberedning. Du hjælper med at skylle og snitte grøntsager, klargøre råvarer og tilberede enkle retter efter køkkenets anvisninger.

  • Anretning og opfyldning. Du hjælper med at gøre frokosten klar, anrette maden og fylde op under serveringen, så den fremstår frisk og indbydende.

  • Service i kantinen. Du møder vores kolleger venligt og hjælper med praktiske spørgsmål omkring dagens frokost.

  • Opvask og oprydning. Du vasker service og køkkenudstyr op og sørger for, at det kommer på plads og er klar til brug.

  • Rengøring og hygiejne. Du rengør de aftalte arbejdsområder og følger køkkenets anvisninger for fødevarehygiejne og håndtering af råvarer.

I en kantine skal flere opgaver være færdige på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan holde overblik, samarbejde og tilpasse dig dagens opgaver uden at gå på kompromis med kvalitet og hygiejne.

Det får du hos os

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

  • En arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor, hvor du bidrager direkte til kollegernes hverdag.

  • En rolle med både praktiske køkkenopgaver og kontakt med kantinens gæster.

Det kommer du med

  • Du arbejder omhyggeligt og har forståelse for god køkkenhygiejne.

  • Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver og samarbejder om at få dagens arbejde til at lykkes.

  • Du møder stabilt og møder kolleger og gæster med venlighed og respekt.

Erfaring fra kantine, køkken eller lignende servicearbejde er en fordel. Du har lyst til at arbejde med mad og mennesker og giver en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det.

Løn og vilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger Kantineoverenskomsten.

Om os

Kokkenes Køkken er en del af Forenede Service. Vi driver kantiner med fokus på smag, madhåndværk og gæsternes måltidsoplevelse.

Vores værdier udgør fundamentet for vores kultur og er: Ansvar - Engagement - Omtanke

Det betyder, at vi tager ansvar for at levere velsmagende mad, god service og ordentlig hygiejne, så vores gæster får en god måltidsoplevelse. Vi viser engagement ved at have et professionelt udtryk, fremstå ordentligt og præsentabelt og bruge de metoder, vi bliver oplært i. Vi bruger omtanke ved at vise hensyn og respekt for vores gæster og kolleger og ved at passe på de råvarer, det udstyr og de omgivelser, vi arbejder med hver dag.

Sådan søger du

Du søger ved at klikke på knappen Ansøg og uploade dit CV og din ansøgning.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Kotihoidon yrittäjäksi Alinaan
jobs.description: Miltä kuulostaisi päästä rakentamaan omaa hoitoalan huipputiimiä ja menestyvää yritystä? Haluaisitko kehittää kotihoidon palveluita arvojesi mukaiseen suuntaan? Kiehtooko yrittäjyys, mutta et halua hypätä yksin tyhjän päälle? Siinä tapauksessa Alina-yrittäjyys voisi olla juuri sinua varten!**Miten Alina-yrittäjyys toimii?****Alina on Suomen ensimmäinen hoiva-alan franchising-ketju, jonka asiakkaita ovat muun muassa ikäihmiset ja lapsiperheet. Alina-yrittäjänä tarjoat koteihin korkealaatuisia palveluita, joiden avulla asiakkaat saavat elää hyvää ja turvallista elämää omassa kodissaan. Yrittäjänä saat todella auttaa asiakkaita omaan tyyliisi, sydän edellä. Tällä hetkellä etsimme useampia Alina-yrittäjiä eri puolille Suomea.****Miksi Alina-yrittäjäksi ryhtyminen kannattaa?**Kotihoidon palveluiden kysyntä on kasvussa. Saat kehittää yritystäsi arvojesi mukaisesti tunnetussa hoiva-alan ketjussa, joka mahdollistaa asiakkaille arvokkaan elämän omassa kodissa.- Saat käyttöösi vahvan brändimme sekä valmiit, laatusertifioidut palvelutuotteemme. - Tarjoamme lisäksi modernit työkalut ja järjestelmät toimintasi kehittämisen ja kasvattamisen tueksi. - Pääset vaikuttamaan omien työpäiviesi sisältöön ja tulotasoosi. - Ketju ja ammattitaitoiset kenttäpäällikkömme tukevat ja kouluttavat sinua liiketoimintasi eri vaiheissa. **Sovinko Alina-yrittäjäksi?**Sinun ei tarvitse olla kokenut yrittäjä meillä menestyäksesi – riittää, että sinulta löytyy- Sairaanhoitajan, sosionomin, terveydenhoitajan tai lähihoitajan tutkinto. - Aitoa innostusta kehittyä hoiva-alan yrittäjänä ja tiimisi sekä liiketoimintasi johtajana. - Taloudelliset valmiudet ryhtyä yrittäjäksi. - Innostusta tehdä merkityksellistä työtä ihmisten hyvinvoinnin parissa. **Kiinnostuin hakemaan! Miten homma etenee?**Hienoa! Jätä hakemuksesi, jonka jälkeen olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovimme jatkohaastattelun.Voit myös lukea lisää yrittäjyydestä **verkkosivuiltamme**.Jos jokin jäi askarruttamaan mieltäsi, rekrytointivastaava Annamari Tuominen vastaa kysymyksiisi mielellään: 044 755 6901, **annamari.tuominen@norlandia.com.****Tietoa Alina-ketjusta**- Ensimmäinen Alina yritys perustettiin jo vuonna 1993 - Alina-yrittäjät toimivat yli 50 paikkakunnalla Suomessa - Vuoden 2025 Alina-yrittäjä Sari Körkkö valittiin Euroopan parhaaksi franchising-yrittäjäksi 2025 - Vuoden Franchisingketju vuonna 2025, 2023 ja 2019 - Alina yritysten henkilöstötyytyväisyys 4.2/5 - Alina yritysten asiakastyytyväisyys 83 % - Alina oli ehdolla vuoden 2025 eurooppalaiseksi franchisingketjuksi European Franchise Awardissa Alina on osa Norlandiaa, joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. jobs.description: Hledáme školního psychologa / psycholožku – kotvu v rozbouřených vodách (přímo v srdci Tábora)Jsme Základní škola a Mateřská škola Tábor na náměstí Mikuláše z Husi 45 a hledáme k sobě parťáka/parťačku – člověka mladého duchem, klidně trochu alternativního, s otevřenou hlavou a nadhledem. Někoho, pro koho je respektující a partnerský přístup naprostým základem, a kdo nás podrží ve chvílích, kdy máme pocit, že jsme u konce svých sil.Proč se u nás rozhodně nebudeš nudit?Jsme velká škola s neuvěřitelně pestrou a širokou „klientelou“. Pod jednou střechou (a v našich školkách) tu potkáš mrňata řešící ztracenou bačkoru, puberťáky hledající smysl života (a sebe sama), děti se specifickými potřebami i zvídavé osobnosti. A k tomu partu učitelů, kteří svou práci dělají srdcem, staví na partnerské komunikaci, ale občas prostě potřebují někoho, kdo jim pomůže se zhluboka nadechnout a nabrat nový dech. Nuda? To slovo u nás neznáme!!!Co bude tvůj denní chleba (a občas i dort)?•    Být bezpečným přístavem pro děti: Naslouchat jim bez hodnocení, podpořit je a hledat s nimi cestu, když se jim zrovna hroutí svět (nebo jen písemka z matiky).•    Být oporou pro dospělé: Provázet učitele i rodiče v náročných situacích, kultivovat vzájemný dialog a ulevit jim od tlaku ve chvílích, kdy už neví kudy kam.•    Tmelit kolektivy: Vymýšlet a vést preventivní programy, adaptáky a aktivity, díky kterým budou třídy bezpečným místem postaveným na vzájemném respektu.•    Tvořit vlastní projekty: Máš nápad na mindfulness, arteterapii nebo jinou „alternativu“? Sem s tím! U nás máš zelenou.Koho si u nás dokážeme představit?•    Máš v kapse magisterský titul z psychologie (přes tohle bohužel vlak nejede, zákon je zákon).•    Věříš v partnerskou komunikaci – s dětmi, rodiči i kolegy jednáš jako rovný s rovným.•    Dokážeš zachovat klidnou hlavu, když kolem tebe lítají emoce, ale zároveň se nebereš smrtelně vážně.•    Umíš se naladit na svět generace Z, malých předškoláků i vyčerpaných dospěláků.•    Praxe je super, ale pokud jsi čerstvý absolvent/ka s chutí se učit a empatií na rozdávání, rádi ti dáme prostor.Co za to hodíme do placu my?•    Skvělou partu lidí: Přátelský kolektiv, kde se nikdo na nic nehraje a kde se mluví otevřeně. Sborovna u nás není zakázaná zóna, ale místo, kde se fakt rádi potkáváme.•    Svobodu a důvěru: Vedení školy ví, že psycholog není luxus, ale nutnost. Nebudeme ti stát za zády se stopkami, dostaneš důvěru i prostor pro vlastní vizi.•    Férové podmínky: Úvazek 1,0 nebo dle domluvy, plat dle tabulek (12. platová třída) + osobní ohodnocení, které dává smysl.•    Dobíjení baterek: 8 týdnů dovolené, 12 dní studijního volna, podpora dalšího vzdělávání, supervize a další školní benefity.Kdy můžeš naskočit?Ideálně ihned / dle dohody, ale na člověka, se kterým si sedneme, si rádi počkáme.Zní to jako tvůj šálek kávy (nebo matchy)?Pošli nám svůj životopis a pár řádků o tom, kdo jsi a co tě baví, na reditel@zsmikulasezhusi.cz. Žádné formální slohovky, napiš to tak, jak to cítíš.Pracovní poměr na 1 rok s možností prodloužení. Budeme se těšit na viděnou. Kateřina Burian Reif, ředitelka školy

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Agents
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

An AI agent is only as useful as what it knows about your company. For many of the world's leading companies, that knowledge lives in Notion. The AI Knowledge & Capabilities team makes sure every agent working in Notion – built by Notion, by customers, or by other AI companies – finds the right answer, quickly and at a cost that makes sense.

We own the systems that make this work: search, knowledge, and memory. We also own the agent harness – the tools, context, and model choices that turn a model into a working agent. We decide what to build using evals, customer feedback, and product judgment. Our work reaches users directly, and other AI teams at Notion build on it.

We recently shipped Memories, so Notion AI, Custom Agents, and agents connected through MCP can learn and remember across platforms. We also shipped Auto, a model router that delivers frontier quality at 90% lower cost. Next, we're bringing memory, search, and the harness together into one system. Nobody has figured out how to package that yet – we want any company to get a great knowledge system for its agents with a click or a few questions.

You will be a technical leader for the team. You'll set direction across search, knowledge, and the harness, starting hands-on with making agents better and cheaper, and help define how Notion measures AI quality.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set technical direction for search, knowledge, and the agent harness – make the architecture calls, run design reviews, and decide what the team builds next.

 - Make Notion's agents better, faster, and cheaper – starting with the harness: which tools an agent can call, what context it gets, and which model handles each request.

 - Lead how we measure agent quality – evolve the metrics and evals that reflect real usage, and use them to choose what ships.

 - Turn company data into answers agents can use – build agentic search and memory that give every agent the context it needs, at the right latency and cost.

 - Work closely with research – partner with Notion's model research team on evals, model choice, and models trained for agentic work, and get what works into production. You'll also work with search platform and AI product teams on work that spans teams.

 - Grow the team – mentor engineers, review designs, and develop the next tech leads.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production applied AI: You've shipped and iterated on production LLM or agent systems used by real users. You owned how their quality was measured, and you changed course based on what you found.

 - Quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs: You've traded quality against latency and cost in a production system, measured the result, and can explain what you gave up and why.

 - Technical leadership: You've owned the technical direction of a complex system, often across teams, and kept it sound as it grew. You don't wait for a roadmap – you find the problems worth solving, make the case for them, and go deep on the hardest ones yourself.

 - Product sense: You've shipped quality improvements users noticed, and you've shaped new products from scratch – from the data model to what users see. You can explain why they mattered.

 - Shipping something new: You've taken an idea from nothing to a product people use. You try new models and tools early, form your own views, and turn them into product decisions.

 - Making other engineers better: You mentor engineers at every level, guide their designs, and share what you know so it scales past you. Multiple engineers have grown by working with you.

 - Clear communication: You write clearly about tradeoffs, disagree directly, and change your mind when the evidence says to.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've improved LLM cost and quality directly – e.g. model routing, eval-driven harness or prompt tuning, or token efficiency in long-running agents.

 - You've founded a company or been an early engineer at a startup, and built systems that hold up at large scale.

 - Experience working closely with research or model training teams.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $299,000 - $352,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Head of Global Security Assurance
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Trust is essential to how organizations choose and use Notion. As Head of Global Security Assurance, you will build and lead a global, customer-facing pillar of our GRCP function. Your team will help customers understand and trust how Notion protects their data, meets security and compliance expectations, and approaches privacy across our products and services.



You will lead regional customer assurance leaders and partner closely with Privacy, GRC and Security leadership to establish a clear, scalable model for customer trust. You’ll work directly with customers and go-to-market teams on complex security and privacy questions, while turning what you learn into better products, stronger processes and more transparent communications. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set a global strategy, empower experienced regional experts and navigate the details when it matters most.



This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead global customer trust. Set the strategy, priorities and operating model for customer security assurance and customer-facing privacy engagement across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. Balance consistent global standards with regional customer and regulatory needs.

 - Build and grow the team. Lead, coach and develop regional assurance leaders and other specialists. Give them the autonomy, context and executive access to represent Notion confidently with customers; plan coverage, capacity and hiring as demand grows.

 - Earn customer confidence. Serve as a senior security and privacy counterpart for strategic and regulated customers. Lead complex due diligence, executive conversations and escalations, and help teams navigate procurement, renewals and expansion without overstating our controls or commitments.

 - Scale assurance operations. Establish clear intake, prioritization, handoffs and escalation paths for questionnaires, customer calls, security reviews and other requests. Partner with Legal on contractual security and privacy terms, and with subject-matter owners on accurate, timely responses.

 - Make trust understandable. Own the customer assurance content strategy, including the Trust Center, evidence-sharing practices, reusable response libraries, playbooks and go-to-market enablement. Keep materials accurate, consistent and appropriate for the audience.

 - Connect privacy to customer trust. Partner with Privacy and Legal leaders to translate privacy practices, data handling, AI and subprocessor questions into clear customer-facing guidance. Define decision rights and route legal interpretations, privacy assessments and commitments to their accountable owners.

 - Strengthen regional assurance. Work with regional leaders and the compliance team on customer and market requirements, including relevant assessments such as K-FSI, ISMAP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and BSI C5. Coordinate customer-facing and regional engagement while partnering with compliance owners on controls, evidence and audits.

 - Turn customer feedback into action. Identify recurring security, privacy and product gaps; bring customer impact and regional context to Product, Engineering, Security and leadership; and track decisions and follow-through.

 - Support trust through incidents. Partner with incident command, Security, Privacy, Legal and Communications on accurate, timely customer responses and escalations. Build reusable processes that help the team respond consistently while respecting established incident ownership.

 - Improve how the work scales. Use thoughtful automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve intake, knowledge reuse and reporting, with human review, access controls and clear accountability. Track request volume, responsiveness, quality, customer impact and capacity; use the results to guide investment.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience leading and developing security assurance, customer trust, privacy, GRC or related teams, including experienced individual contributors and regional leaders.

 - Experience serving enterprise customers in security or privacy due diligence, including customer conversations, questionnaires, contract security reviews and complex escalations.

 - Ability to translate cloud security architecture, security controls, audit evidence and privacy practices into clear, accurate language for technical and executive audiences.

 - Working knowledge of security assurance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and the ability to navigate regional or industry-specific requirements with specialists.

 - Experience partnering with Privacy and Legal on customer data protection questions, contractual commitments and escalation. Sound judgment about when to involve legal, technical and regulatory subject-matter experts.

 - Demonstrated ability to build scalable operating models, manage competing priorities and use metrics to improve service quality and capacity.

 - Strong cross-functional leadership across Security, Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Sales and customer-facing teams; an empathetic, direct communication style.

 - A builder’s mindset: comfort working hands-on in ambiguity, improving workflows and using automation responsibly while maintaining a high bar for accuracy and confidentiality.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading distributed or follow-the-sun teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC.

 - Experience with regional assurance programs such as K-FSI, ISMAP or BSI C5, or supporting highly regulated customers.

 - Experience building customer trust centers, assurance knowledge bases, AI-assisted response workflows or field security advisory programs.

 - Familiarity with privacy and third-party risk, including customer-facing subprocessor transparency and shared accountability for vendor assurance.

 - Experience at a growing SaaS or cloud company, or relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM or CIPP.




EARLY PRIORITIES 

 - Meet regional assurance and privacy leaders, GTM and partner teams; understand customer demand, current workflows and the most important trust gaps.

 - Agree with GRC, Privacy, Legal and Security on ownership, decision rights, escalation paths and how customer assurance interfaces with audits and third-party risk.

 - Establish a global coverage and capacity plan that protects regional autonomy, supports strategic customers and provides clear leadership escalation.

 - Assess the Trust Center, response library and intake process; identify opportunities to improve quality, speed and reuse without compromising accuracy.

 - Create an initial roadmap and baseline metrics for customer experience, request volume, response times, recurring product gaps and team health.

jobs.title: VP, Communication
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


VP of Communications, Replit

Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit enables anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, to turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, workflows, websites, and software that solves real problems.

We are looking for a Director or VP of Communications to lead Replit’s next chapter of storytelling, trust building, and market leadership.

This is a senior communications role for a creative, strategic, and hands-on leader who can build and scale the communications function as Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI, software creation, and enterprise transformation. This person will own Replit’s external and internal communications strategy, including strategic positioning and company narrative, media relations, analyst relations, executive communications, internal communications, crisis communications, customer storytelling, flagship thought leadership, policy-related communications, and global awareness.

The role requires someone who can push through the noise, make the Replit story heard, and keep it part of the conversation. The Director / VP of Communications will develop a compelling narrative that evolves with the company, the product, and the market, and deliver it across media, policymakers, partners, customers, prospects, and employees. The role will also support Replit’s international awareness, with a focus on key markets in Europe and Asia.

This person must be both strategic and execution-oriented. They should have built or helped lead a communications function at a fast-growing technology company, or led communications and positioning for a leading institution. This is not a traditional press office role of adopting another company’s playbook in its entirety.

The person must be creative, scrappy, maybe even spiky: able to take what they know works as a foundation and build on it to make Replit a unique player that punches above its weight in a crowded, competitive marketplace.

Role

 - Lead and scale Replit’s communications function, including communications strategy, team structure, agency management, operating rhythms, and execution standards.

 - Build an AI-native communications function, with agents running repeatable work so a lean team focuses on judgment, relationships, and creative leaps.

 - Develop and evolve Replit’s corporate narrative as the company expands across AI, developer tools, enterprise, consumer, education, and global markets.

 - Own Replit’s strategic positioning: the upstream frameworks and intellectual capital that make every launch, stage, and story land better.

 - Lead communications programs across company announcements, product launches, enterprise momentum, customer stories, partnerships, policy-related issues, executive visibility, awards, events, and thought leadership.

 - Shape how the market understands Replit as an agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language.

 - Build clear, credible narratives around AI-powered software creation, developer productivity, enterprise adoption, security, governance, education, and the future of work.

 - Develop flagship thought leadership, signature reports, and third-party validator relationships that build enterprise and institutional trust.

 - Partner with the CEO, executive team, and functional leaders on positioning, reputation, media strategy, internal communications, and high-stakes company moments.

 - Build and maintain strong relationships with technology, business, AI, enterprise, developer, policy, and international media.

 - Partner closely with product, engineering, marketing, sales, partnerships, legal, policy, people, and finance to create coordinated communications programs that support company priorities.

 - Lead or support internal communications, including company meetings, leadership messaging, employee announcements, change communications, and moments that help the company stay aligned as it scales.

 - Manage proactive and reactive communications, including rapid response, issues management, crisis communications, and sensitive topics.

 - Prepare executives and spokespeople for media interviews, podcasts, conferences, customer events, internal moments, and industry presentations, and earn premier stages for Replit’s leaders.

 - Support Replit’s global communications strategy, with particular focus on expanding awareness in Europe and Asia.

 - Track the AI, software, developer, enterprise, startup, and policy landscape to identify where Replit should lead, respond, or reframe the conversation.

 - Build a communications culture that values speed, clarity, creativity, judgment, and proof.

Qualifications

 - BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

 - 12+ years of experience in communications, PR, media, corporate affairs, or related fields for Director level; 15+ years for VP level.

 - Experience building, scaling, or significantly expanding a communications or strategic positioning function at a fast-growing technology company or leading institution.

 - Proven experience working directly with founders, CEOs, executives, and senior cross-functional leaders.

 - Strong relationships with technology, business, enterprise, AI, developer, and/or policy media.

 - Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional communications programs on a global level.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for users, developers, enterprise buyers, employees, policymakers, partners, and the press.

 - Strong understanding of the AI landscape and how AI is changing software development, enterprise productivity, and the future of work.

 - Hands-on fluency with AI and agentic tools, with a vision for AI-native communications operations.

 - Track record of flagship thought leadership: signature reports, executive platforms, and ideas that shape an industry’s conversation.

 - Experience earning third-party validation from leading institutions and policy communities for a scrutinized or emerging technology.

 - Experience guiding communications through major inflection points: public-company transitions, landmark policy moments, category creation.

 - Experience across several communications disciplines, including external communications, internal communications, media relations, executive communications, crisis communications, and strategic messaging.

 - Ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling stories without losing substance.

 - Cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to influence and collaborate across product, engineering, sales, marketing, legal, policy, finance, and people teams.

 - Ability to see the big picture while operating in execution mode.

 - Passionate about their craft and the impact they can have.

 - Strong judgment in fast-moving, high-pressure environments.

 - A creative, resourceful, “do more with less” mindset.

jobs.title: SEO - Manager
jobs.description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.
Job Role: SEO / AEO Manager
Job Type: Contract - USA

Job Description

About This Role

Bounteous is leading the charge in dynamic digital experiences and is looking for forward-thinking search experts to help drive measurable impact for some of the world's most recognizable and ambitious brands. In today's AI-driven, zero-click search landscape, our approach helps brands envision, harness, and enable their digital presence across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery platforms, and emerging search experiences.

We are seeking a SEO / AEO Manager to lead holistic search strategy across our client portfolio, spanning traditional SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility across platforms including Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. This individual will drive performance across traditional SEO, AEO, and AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate understands how search has evolved beyond rankings- into entities, AI Overviews, generative search, and full-SERP ownership, and can translate that evolution into business growth. The ideal candidate has already built or scaled an AI-search-visibility practice, not just a traditional SEO program with AI terminology added on top.

This contractor will work cross-functionally with internal teams and client stakeholders to develop and execute advanced search strategies that drive visibility, authority, and measurable ROI, defined jointly with each client at engagement kickoff (see Success Metrics below).

Role & Responsibilities

As the SEO & AEO Manager, you will lead strategic search initiatives across enterprise client accounts, driving business growth and client success as a key member of our search practice.

You will own strategy development, execution oversight, and performance measurement across traditional SEO and AI-driven search ecosystems.

Â 

Key Responsibilities

Search & AEO Strategy Leadership

  • Lead holistic search strategy development, including traditional SEO, AEO, and AI search optimization, to drive full-funnel growth.

  • Develop strategies to capture and optimize for AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, People Also Ask, zero-click search experiences, and conversational queries.

  • Drive entity-based optimization strategies to strengthen brand authority and knowledge graph presence.

  • Partner with content and digital teams to align SEO strategy with E-E-A-T best practices.

AI & Emerging Search Optimization

  • Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.

Predictable, well-run delivery

  • Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
  • Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
  • Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

How You'll Work

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

Experience

  • 8+ years in design, with experience leading design teams.

Leadership and mindset

  • Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.
  • The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.
  • Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.
  • Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

Technical foundation

  • Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.
