Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst tilkaldevikar til Liftra's køkkenteam, som kan træde til ved sygdom, ferie og ander fravær.

Hos Liftra tilbereder vi dagligt frokost til cirka 250 kollegaer. Vi lægger vægt på god mad, kvalitet og et godt samarbejde i køkkenet, hvor der også er plads til at afprøve nye retter og idéer.

Stillingen er uden et fast ugentligt timetal, da antallet af vagter afhænger af behøvet i køkkenet. Vagterne ligger på hverdage i tidsrummet kl. 07:00-15:00.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Tilberedning og anretning af varme og kolde retter

  • Opvask, oprydning og daglig rengøring af køkkenet

  • Andre praktiske opgaver i køkkenet efter behøv

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med madlavning fra et størkøkken eller lignende

  • Har kendskab til fødevarehygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og har sans for orden

  • Tives med at hjælpe til, hvor der er behov

Det tilbyder vi

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med god kollegaer

  • En fleksibel tilkaldeordning med vagter efter behov

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med varierede køkkenopgaver

  • Et køkkenteam, hvor vi værdsætter samarbejde, ansvarlighed og god idéer

Sadan søger du

Har stillingen fanget din interesse? Så upload dit CV og en n kort ansøgning på dansk eller engelsk via vores ansøgningssystem.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Hos Liftra opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, religion, etnicitet eller baggrund.

jobs.description:

This role helps strategic xMatters customers adopt the solution, realize value, and achieve their business goals, supporting customer retention and growth. Â 

As part of the Account Management team, the CSM drives xMatters adoption, value realization, customer satisfaction, and retention across an assigned portfolio. The CSM works across the organization as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback and helping remove barriers to adoption and success. Â 

The CSM is a technical subject matter expert in xMatters and its use cases. In partnership with Account Managers, the CSM shares best practices, provides strategic guidance, and helps customers address complex challenges. The CSM also coordinates internal resources for at-risk customers and contributes to a strong, lasting customer experience.

What you'll do:

Build deep technical and business knowledge of xMatters and its use cases. Work directly with customers to configure functionality, demonstrate capabilities, and identify additional ways to use the solution.Â 

Lead adoption and customer success for assigned strategic xMatters accounts in support of retention and growth goals.Â 

Apply knowledge of the industry, customer operations, and emerging needs to recommend relevant xMatters use cases. Develop practical adoption strategies that align with each customerâs goals.Â 

Develop and lead adoption plans that support customer satisfaction goals, including an NPS score above 50. Monitor progress, identify product or business barriers, and coordinate actions to resolve them.Â 

Review customer health and usage metrics, and develop processes and tools that improve xMatters adoption.Â 

Partner with Account Managers on account plans, customer business challenges, risk mitigation, and opportunities to grow relationships.Â 

Coordinate internal teams to resolve complex customer issues.Â 

Conduct customer health checks by reviewing progress against documented success criteria. Present findings and recommendations that help customers increase the value and use of xMatters.Â 
Develop practical approaches for customers whose needs are not met by standard configurations, working within product capabilities and established processes.Â

Work with Product Management to prioritize customer feature requests, identify capability gaps, and communicate product barriers to adoption and effective use.Â 

What you'll bring:

At least 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as pre-sales engineering or consulting, or implementing technical software solutions in DevOps, or major incident management (MIM).Â 
Experience providing technical account management for large organizations.Â 
Ability to connect product capabilities to customer needs, explain technical concepts clearly, and recommend ways to improve adoption and deliver measurable value.Â 
A track record of improving customer retention and growth through a customer-first approach in a complex software environment.Â 
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate challenging situations professionally with customers and internal teams.Â 
Strong organization and judgment, with the ability to prioritize work across multiple customers and adjust as needs change.Â 
Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage effectively with executive and C-level stakeholders.Â 
Ability to work independently with integrity and accountability.Â 
Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Â 
Resilience, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset. Builds trust with customers and colleagues and contributes to shared team success.Â 
Technical experience with agile delivery, CI/CD, SaaS or cloud environments, REST web services, Java or JavaScript (or other programming experience), ITIL, MIM, NOC or incident processes, and operations monitoring.Â 
Bachelorâs degree in information technology or a related field.Â 

Bonus to have:

Ability to explain the value of approaches such as Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, ITIL, NOC/SRE, or MIM.Â 
Experience or training in implementing web-based software applications.Â 
Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, Pendo, or similar tools for tracking adoption and value realization.

Her får du mulighed for at arbejde i et stærkt fællesskab med fokus på faglighed, nysgerrighed og omsorg – alt sammen for at skabe det bedst mulige liv for vores beboere. 

Skelhøj er et socialpædagogisk botilbud, hvor vi dedikerer os til at skabe et trygt og inkluderende miljø for voksne med varierende behov. Vi anerkender og respekterer individualiteten hos alle vores beboere og stræber efter at forstå deres unikke behov og evner.

Stillingsoplysninger:

Vi søger en dygtig pædagog til vores team 3 og vores team 4. Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer, men vi er lydhør for andre ønsker. I Team 3 og team 4 bor der 7 beboere, med forskellige støttebehov, som gør din arbejdsdag alsidig. Den ene dag arbejder du måske 1:1 og er ude af huset med beboeren og den næste dag er du i huset og varetager flere beboers individuelle støttebehov.

Vi tilbyder et inspirerende arbejdsfællesskab præget af åbenhed, nysgerrighed og en stærk faglig tilgang. Vi værdsætter og støtter hinanden i et positivt og anerkendende arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi ser diversitet som en styrke.

Dine primære opgaver inkluderer:

  • Sikre høj faglig standard i omsorg og støtte til beboerne.
  • Facilitere beboernes indflydelse på deres eget liv.
  • Yde socialpædagogisk støtte baseret på individuelle behov.
  • Opbygge og opretholde en positiv relation til beboernes netværk.

Læs gerne mere om opgaverne i funktionsbeskrivelsen via dette link: 

Socialpædagog: "Vi søger denne jobprofil"

Vores pædagogiske tilgang: Vi arbejder ud fra en neuropædagogisk tilgang med særlig opmærksomhed på low arousal-principper. Vores fokus er at skabe forudsigelighed, struktur og genkendelighed for at fremme ro og tryghed. Vi tager udgangspunkt i beboernes individuelle funktionsniveau, de inddrages i de daglige gøremål med fokus på mestring og aktiv deltagelse i eget liv, for herigennem at vedligeholde og udvikle deres kompetencer. Vi integrerer også bevidst fysiske rammer, dialog og tværfagligt samarbejde for at understøtte beboernes udvikling. Vi modtager supervision og tværfaglig sparring for at optimere og udvikle vores praksis i fællesskabet. 

På Skelhøj er vi i gang med en spændende udviklingsproces, hvor vi i 2025/2026 har haft et uddannelsesforløb for alle medarbejdere, i psykosocial rehabilitering og recovery, så vi sammen dygtiggør os og skabe et stærkt fagligt arbejdsfællesskab. 

Vi er også stolte over, at vi i 2024 var med i opløbet om Socialpædagogernes pris

Og de nominerede til Socialpædagogernes Pris er…

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig introduktion til kerneopgaven.
  • Varierede arbejdsopgaver.
  • Nærværende ledelse.
  • Et team med høj faglighed og fokus på psykologisk tryghed.
  • Engagerede kollegaer, der ser mangfoldighed som en styrke.
  • Skønne beboere.
  • Oplevelser med beboerne på tværs af Skehøjs 4 team samt deltagelse i musikarrangementer, Royal run og meget andet godt. 
  • Naturskønt område.
  • Gode parkeringsmuligheder.
  • 5 min. fra Veksø station. 

Som vores nye kollega er du:

  • Positiv og med en nysgerrig tilgang til brugergruppen.
  • Brænder for pædagogisk arbejde, uanset dit erfaringsniveau.
  • Rummelig, fleksibel og med et godt overblik.
  • Villig til forskelligartede opgaver, herunder personlig pleje.
  • Indstillet på at deltage i beboerferier.
  • Kørekort (ikke et krav men et ønske).

Arbejdstid:

Mellem kl. 7-22 med forventede dag/aftenvagter samt hver anden weekend. Der vil eventuelt være mulighed for enkelte lange vagter.

Ansøgning:

Hvis ovenstående beskrivelse matcher dine kompetencer og interesser, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Vi afholder løbende ansættelsessamtaler.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

I overensstemmelse med gældende overenskomst og principper for Ny Løn. Der vil blive indhentet straffeattest ved ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på Skelhøj

jobs.title: Ønsker du å jobbe i kombinasjon med skolegang?
jobs.description:
Vi på Narvesen Kirkenes Lufthavn søker flere selgere på deltid, som trives i kontakten med kundene, bak kassa, elsker å selge mat og drikke til travle kunder, og som ønsker å bidra til et entusiastisk og godt arbeidsmiljø. Det er mulig, at vi kan tilby fulltid fra høsten 2026.Som selger i Narvesen vil du få varierte arbeidsoppgaver, en hektisk hverdag og gode kolleger som fort kan bli venner for livet. Hvis du har et lite konkurranseinnstinkt, tipper vi at du vil ha det gøy med alle salgskonkurransene vi kjører!

Arbeidstidene vil variere mellom kvelder i ukedager og dag og kvelder i helger.

Dette er en unik mulighet å kombinere jobb med skolegang! Du må ha tilgang til kjøretøy, kunne å jobbe kvelder i ukedager, og i helger. 

Hvem er du?Kanskje du har butikkerfaring, eller du er klar for din første jobb i butikk? Uansett kan du være den riktige for jobben, så lenge du er

  • effektiv. Du takler stress godt, og liker høyt tempo
  • selvstendig. Du trives med å ha ansvar, og finner lett egne løsninger
  • glad i mennesker. Du får påfyll i møte med kundene, og bryr deg om hver eneste en
  • et ordensmenneske. Du liker å ha det rent og ryddig rundt deg
  • positiv. Du er en humørspreder – blant kolleger så vel som kunder

Det er også ett kjempe pluss om du er fleksibel 

Hvorfor Narvesen?Som en del av Reitan Convenience har vi alltid vært opptatt av å bygge en vennlig kultur. Ditt gode humør smitter over på kundene, og vi vet at når de er glade og fornøyde vender de også tilbake. Ja, Narvesen stiller krav til deg som selger, men vi vil også at du skal ha høye forventninger til oss.

Ansettelse - Fortløpende !

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

jobs.title: Knowledge Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Knowledge Engineer based in the United States.

The Knowledge Engineer will play a pivotal role in building the knowledge infrastructure and AI-powered systems that support business operations and customer experiences. In this role, you will design and maintain trusted knowledge repositories, intelligent AI agents, and automated workflows that help teams access accurate information and streamline everyday tasks. Working across departments such as Support, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Engineering, you will transform fragmented business knowledge into structured, AI-accessible resources. You will also develop secure integrations and intelligent automation solutions that enable AI systems to perform routine activities while maintaining appropriate human oversight. By combining expertise in AI engineering, data architecture, and knowledge management, you will help establish scalable and reliable AI capabilities across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an AI-first transformation within a collaborative, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

Design, develop, and maintain a centralized, trusted knowledge infrastructure that makes product documentation, technical resources, business policies, operational procedures, and training materials accessible to AI systems. Consolidate and organize knowledge from multiple platforms, including Google Drive, Confluence, Jira, Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni, HubSpot, Zendesk, Highspot, and Slack, ensuring that each source has clear ownership and scheduled review dates. Collaborate with Data and Business Insights teams to make existing business data AI-ready by providing curated, read-only Snowflake views and standardized metric definitions that align with established reporting systems. Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows for business functions such as customer support ticket triage, renewal research, accounts payable processing, and software reviews. Develop and manage connectors, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and automation integrations that allow AI agents to interact securely with business systems while enforcing appropriate permissions, human approvals, and audit trails. Create automated pipelines that identify changes in documentation, business systems, and operational processes, ensuring that knowledge repositories, AI agents, and workflows remain accurate and up to date. Structure and optimize information for AI retrieval through taxonomy development, metadata management, content chunking, tagging, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Establish evaluation frameworks and quality assurance processes to measure AI agent accuracy, detect outdated or conflicting information, and minimize hallucinations before and after deployment. Maintain a centralized registry of approved AI connectors, prompts, plugins, reusable skills, and workflows to ensure that AI solutions remain secure, standardized, and company-owned. Implement and manage access controls, data permissions, and security practices to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with internal IT and security requirements. Document technical architecture, workflows, integration standards, and operational processes while staying informed about emerging AI technologies and industry best practices. Monitor AI usage, operational costs, adoption, and feedback to identify knowledge gaps, improve answer quality, and prioritize future enhancements. Partner with subject-matter experts across Support, Customer Success, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Product, and Engineering to capture institutional knowledge, map business processes, and establish content ownership. Collaborate with training teams, Product Marketing, and departmental AI champions to transform product documentation, customer support resources, and training materials into AI-accessible knowledge for internal teams and external customers. Integrate AI-powered tools into employee and customer training programs to improve knowledge sharing, self-service capabilities, and operational efficiency.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 5 years of experience in knowledge engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, solutions engineering, or technical knowledge management. Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows using large language model platforms and APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Practical knowledge of agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-driven automation architectures. Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, data pipelines, and AI output evaluation. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript and SQL, with a solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n. Experience working with cloud data warehouses and semantic data layers, particularly Snowflake, dbt, or business intelligence platforms such as Omni. Familiarity with knowledge management platforms and enterprise SaaS applications, including Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, or Zendesk. Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time.

Benefits:

Full-time remote working arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to a company-wide AI transformation and help establish the foundations of an AI-first operating model. High-impact technical role with the opportunity to design and implement production AI agents and intelligent automation workflows. Exposure to modern AI technologies, including large language models, RAG, GraphRAG, MCP, and advanced data integration solutions. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced professionals across engineering, data, finance, product, and customer-facing teams. Opportunity to develop and implement innovative solutions that improve employee productivity and customer experiences. Significant ownership and influence over AI architecture, knowledge management standards, and automation strategy. Professional development opportunities through continuous exposure to emerging AI tools, technologies, and practices.

jobs.title: Kørende kantinemedarbejder med køkkenansvar
jobs.description:

Vi søger en selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst kantinemedarbejder, der kan stå for den daglige transport af mad mellem vores hovedkantine og satellitkantine samt sikre, at både formiddags- og frokostserveringen er klar til vores kollegaer.

Du får en varieret hverdag med praktiske opgaver, hvor du selvstændigt tager ansvar for, at maden bliver transporteret, anrettet og serveret til tiden.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Pakning og læsning af mad i varebilen fra hovedkantinen

  • Transport af mad til og fra satellitkantinen

  • Udpakning, klargøring og anretning af formiddags- og frokostserveringen

  • Opstilling og nedtagning i forbindelse med servering

  • Opvask, oprydning og daglig rengøring af køkkenet

  • Sikre god hygiejne og orden i køkkenet

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kendskab til fødevarehygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og trives med at arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og har sans for orden

  • Har kørekort (kategori B) og er tryg ved at køre varebil

  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde i hverdagen

Det tilbyder vi

Hos Liftra bliver du en del af en international virksomhed med en uformel arbejdskultur, hvor vi værdsætter samarbejde, ansvarlighed og respekt.

  • Et fleksibelt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • En selvstændig rolle med ansvar for dine daglige opgaver

  • Frihed til at planlægge og tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag inden for de daglige serveringstider

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og værdsætter forskellige baggrunde og erfaringer

Sådan søger du

Har stillingen fanget din interesse? Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV på dansk eller engelsk via vores ansøgningssystem.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Hos Liftra opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, religion, etnicitet eller baggrund.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Orthopaedic Surgery - Knee Surgery
jobs.description:
A position as Assistant Professor (35% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Orthopaedic Surgery, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.  The position is combined with an employment at Odense University Hospital.

The position is limited to 4 years.

The research unit

The Research Unit of Orthopaedic Surgery provides a dynamic and multidisciplinary research environment and is engaged in a broad range of research activities. Our research spans clinical and experimental as well as epidemiological research, including registry-based research and accident analysis.

Our team consists of both scientific and technical/administrative staff, including professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, research nurses, secretaries and a laboratory technician.

We have extensive collaborations with other medical specialties and research groups, both nationally and internationally, fostering interdisciplinary research and knowledge exchange.

Research tasks

  • Serve as project lead for the REPLAN research project, with responsibility for its scientific direction, coordination, and overall progress. The REPLAN project investigates whether routine patellar resurfacing reduces patient dissatisfaction and knee pain compared with non-resurfacing in contemporary primary total knee arthroplasty. 

  • Supervise a PhD student, including providing scientific guidance and supporting the progress and completion of the PhD project.

  • Prepare and publish scientific manuscripts in peer-reviewed international journals and present research findings at national and international conferences.

Teaching tasks

  • Contribute to teaching medical students and clinical biomechanics students within orthopaedic surgery, with particular emphasis on knee surgery. 

Expectations and qualifications

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, including exams, supervision within the field of knee surgery. 

The candidate who is hired must complete a Lecturer Training Programme during the period of employment.

The assistant professor must have documented research experience within the area of knee arthroplasty. 

In addition, good cooperation skills are expected in order to further the development of research in the areas mentioned above, both interdisciplinary as well as nationally and internationally. International partners are an advantage, but not a requirement.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Head of Research at The Research Unit of Orthopaedic Surgery, Martin Lindberg-Larsen, e-mail: martin.lindberg-larsen@rsyd.dk, phone: +45 2521 3900 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 6550 3477.

Application deadline

December 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Assistant Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Odense University Hospital, J.B. Winsløws Vej 4, 5000 Odense C.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (MsC and Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Project Assistant at NTU International A/S
jobs.description:
Project Assistant

NTU International is a leading international consulting firm providing programme management and advisory services for development projects worldwide. For almost three decades, NTU has been delivering sustainable development projects and advisory services within engineering, policy, economics, and social fields. With more than 1.100 international projects and studies already completed, and more than 15 project offices around the world, we have established ourselves as a leading consulting company. With the expansion of international activities and clients, NTU’s project pipeline and opportunities have grown significantly, therefore, we are looking for a motivated and result oriented individual, who is interested in experiencing our culture, intensive business environment, challenges as well as being part of our international success.

Key Responsibilities:

·       Provide administrative and clerical support to Project Managers and project teams in the implementation of EU-funded projects.

·       Assist with the preparation, formatting and processing of project documentation, reports, meeting minutes, presentations and other project-related materials, following established templates and instructions.

·       Maintain and update project files, databases, records and document management systems in accordance with internal procedures.

·       Support the organisation of project meetings, workshops, training sessions and other project activities, including scheduling, invitations, logistics and follow-up.

·       Assist with communication and correspondence with project partners, experts, beneficiaries and other stakeholders.

·       Monitor administrative deadlines and follow up on project documentation and information requests.

·       Collect, organise and verify project-related information and supporting documents for review by the responsible Project Managers.

·       Perform other administrative and coordination tasks related to project implementation.

Qualifications and skills:

·       Master’s degree in International Relations, International Business, or a related field.

·       Previous experience in administrative support, project assistance in an international working environment.

·       Good time-management skills and ability to meet deadlines.

·       Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

·       Ability to work independently on assignments while recognising when guidance or approval is required.

·       A cooperative and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively as part of an international project team.

·       Familiarity with EU-funded programmes, project documentation and administrative procedures is an advantage.

Language and skills:

·       English: C2 – Full professional proficiency (mandatory).

 Other information:

If you are interested in this position, please send your CV under the heading “Project Assistant” address it to Mrs. Vaida Cerneckyte-Larsen, e-mail. vac@ntu.eu. Please also make sure that you include one or more telephone numbers.

Only selected candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet i 2027? Vi betaler din flybillet - Book et kald i dag.
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet? Vi betaler din flybillet hvis du vil afsted i februar 2027.

Et sabbatår i udlandet er for mange en livsforandrende oplevelse. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et nyt land, møde mennesker fra hele verden, udvikle dig personligt og styrke dit CV med international erfaring. Men det, som de fleste ikke ved, er hvor tidligt processen faktisk bør starte.

Hvis du drømmer om at rejse ud i vinteren 2027, så er det allerede nu, du skal tage de første skridt. De bedste jobmuligheder, de mest stabile projekter og de mest attraktive destinationer bliver nemlig fyldt langt før afrejse. Samtidig tager det tid at finde det rette match, gennemføre interviews og få styr på alle praktiske detaljer.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i 2027?

1. Du får adgang til de bedste stillinger

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

2. Du sikrer en glidende overgang efter studiet

Når du starter i god tid, kan du planlægge dit sabbatår uden tidspres. Du får ro til at afslutte dit studie, nyde efteråret og samtidig være klar til at rejse ud i januar — uden at skulle haste gennem interviews og praktiske forberedelser.

3. Vi kan matche dig med den helt rigtige virksomhed

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

Fra første samtale til du står på flyet, hjælper vi dig med:

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

  • Bolig og økonomi

  • Kultur og hverdagsliv

  • Interviewforberedelse

  • Praktiske forhold som bank, skat og relocation

Jo tidligere du starter, desto mere ro og overblik får du.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kan se hele oversigten her: https://www.jobhuntworldwide.com/sabbataar-udlandet-gode-tips

Kort sagt får du:

  • Gratis og uforpligtende samtale

  • Hjælp til at finde det rette job i udlandet

  • Professionel interviewforberedelse

  • Rådgivning om bolig, økonomi og kontrakt

  • Relocation‑support (fly, hotel, firmabolig m.m.)

  • Løbende kontakt med relevante virksomheder

  • Tryghed og støtte hele vejen til afrejse

Du kan booke en samtale med os allerede i dag, og så starter vi løbende interviews op med de virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker og din profil.

Book en samtale her: Book et kald

Eller kontakt os direkte: Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

Du kan møde Cathrine her på TikTok

jobs.title: Tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavia matalapainepesijöitä, Low-pressure cleaners for on-call work
jobs.description: Haemme tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavia MATALAPAINEPESIJÖITÄ OUTOKUMPUUN teurastamoon.Tässä tehtävässä vastaat tuotantotilojen pesusta matalapainepesumenetelmin nautateurastamossa korkeiden hygieniavaatimusten mukaisesti. Katsomme eduksesi aikaisemman siivoustyökokemuksen, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme tehtävään henkilöitä, jotka eivät kavahda teurastamoa työympäristönä. Saat meiltä kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään. Pääset osaksi monimuotoista ja ammattimaista tiimiämme. Tehtävä on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttava. Työvuorosi sijoittuvat arkipäiville iltavuoroon kello 15.00–23.00 välille. Huomaathan, että kohteeseen ei kulje hyvin julkista liikennettä ja saatat tarvita autoa työmatkoihisi. Aloitus tehtävissä on sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian.Tehtävästä maksetaan Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen palkkaryhmän 5 mukaista palkkaa (14,58 €/h) sekä mahdolliset lisät.  Vaatimukset:- Innostuneisuutta, asennetta ja heittäytymistä työhön.- Hyvä fyysinen kunto.- Hygieniapassi ja työturvallisuuskortti.- Todennettu negatiivinen tulos salmonellatestistä.- Suomen tai englannin kielen hyvä osaaminen.Arvostamme:- Oma-aloitteista ja tarkkaa työskentelytapaa sekä innokasta asennetta uuden oppimiseen.- Aikaisempaa siivoustyökokemusta.- Halua tehdä ruumiillista työtä.- Kokemuksen ja/tai koulutuksen elintarvikehygienia- tai puhtaanapitoalalta katsotaan eduksi.- Kohteeseen ei kulje julkista liikennettä iltaisin, joten oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on eduksi.Tarjoamme:- Työn, jossa näet oman käden jäljen – työ on palkitsevaa.- Paikan Suomen elintarvikehygienian puhdistuksen kärkipaikalla.- Isona yrityksenä palkan, joka tulee ajallaan.- Kattavan koulutusohjelman, jossa jatkokoulutamme sinusta alan ehdottoman ykkösosaajan.- Mielenkiintoisen sekä muuttuvan työn, jossa pääset toteuttamaan omaa osaamista- Huippu tiimin ja arvostuksen.Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta sen kaikissa merkityksissä, meidän tiimissämme voit olla oma itsesi. Ole osa jotain suurempaa tee merkityksellistä työtä, joka varmistaa asiakkaamme tuotantoprosessin toimivuuden joka päivä ja, että me kaikki kuluttajina saamme turvallista ja puhdasta ruokaa.Hae oheisen linkin kautta viimeistään 3.12.2026.! Käsittelemme kaikki hakemukset ja kerromme jokaiselle hakijalle prosessin etenemisestä.  ---We are looking for low-pressure cleaners for OUTOKUMPU to a slaughterhouse.In this role, you will be responsible for cleaning production facilities using low-pressure washing methods at a cattle slaughterhouse, in accordance with high hygiene standards. Previous cleaning experience is considered an advantage, but above all, we are looking for individuals for the position who are not deterred by a slaughterhouse as a working environment. We will provide you with comprehensive training for the role. You will become part of our diverse and professional team.Your shifts are scheduled on weekdays between 15.00 – 23.00 in the evening. This is a permanent and on-the-call contract and will start as soon as possible according to the agreement. Please note that the location is not well served by public transport, and you may need a car for your commute.In this position, the salary is paid according to the Real Estate Services Collective Agreement (wage class 5, 14,58€/h) plus any applicable supplements.Requirements:- Enthusiasm, attitude, and commitment to work.- Good physical condition.- Hygiene passport and safety card.- Verified negative result for salmonella test.- Proficiency in Finnish or English.We appreciate:- Proactive work style and an enthusiastic attitude towards learning new things.- Willingness to do physical work.- Previous cleaning experience.- Experience and/or education in the food hygiene or cleaning industry is considered an advantage.- Since there is not public transportation to the area at nighttime ability to use your own car is recommended.We offer:- A rewarding job where you can see the results of your hard work.- A place at the forefront of Finnish food hygiene cleaning.- As a large company, a salary that is paid on time.- A comprehensive training program where we will continue to train you to become an absolute top expert in the field.- Interesting and varied work where you can implement your own skills.- A great team and appreciation.We value diversity in all its meanings; in our team you can be yourself. Be part of something bigger, do meaningful work that ensures our customers' production process works every day and that we, as consumers, get safe and clean food.Apply through the link below by December 3, 2026! We will process all applications and inform each applicant about the progress of the process. We at ISS Finland are part of the leading workplace experience and facility management company that is established in over 30 different countries. In Finland we have over 7000 people working at ISS and we operate nationally. The meaning of our operation is to provide placemaking solutions that contribute to better business performance and make life easier, more productive and enjoyable. We create these places with our cleaning, food, technical and workplace services. Cleaning is our largest service sector and we have been developing our know-how in cleaning for over 100 years. Our climate goal is to be carbon neutral in the year 2040 - as an ISS worker you will have the chance to contribute significantly to reaching our goal and the well-being of our planet! jobs.title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja / ECEC Teacher
jobs.description: Sinä uusia mahdollisuuksia tutkaileva varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja,Sunshine Early Learning Centren uusi Hervantajärven päiväkoti etsii kahta uutta varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa liittymään kansainväliseen tiimiimme, sekä englanninkieliseen että suomenkieliseen kielirikasteiseen ryhmään.Olisitko sinä etsimämme innostunut tiimipelaaja ja työstäsi ylpeä ammattilainen? Omaatko erinomaisen englannin kielen taidon, jota haluat hyödyntää ammatillisesti?Me Sunshinessa etsimme joukkoomme varhaiskasvatusalan ammattilaisia, jotka nauttivat aidosti työskentelystä lasten ja perheiden kanssa, arvostavat tiimityötä, edistävät positiivista ja turvallista työilmapiiriä sekä ovat kunnianhimoisia laadukkaan pedagogisen toiminnan ja oppimisympäristön kehittäjiä.Yrityksemme arvot laatu, yhteisöllisyys ja ilo ohjaavat kaikkea toimintaamme ja vuorovaikutustamme henkilöstön, lasten ja perheiden kanssa.Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana ja tiiminvetäjänä vastaat pedagogisen toiminnan suunnittelusta, toteuttamisesta ja arvioinnista, lasten kasvun, oppimisen ja hyvinvoinnin tukemisesta sekä tiimisi päivittäisen pedagogisen työn ohjaamisesta. Varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman perusteiden syvällinen tuntemus on erittäin tärkeää.Työsi tukena toimivat moniammatillinen tiimi, muut opettajat sekä päiväkodin johtaja.Hervantajärven päiväkodissa toimitaan sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Päiväkodissa toimii täysin englanninkielisiä ryhmiä, joissa työskentelevillä opettajilla tulee olla erinomainen englannin kielen taito. Kielirikasteisissa ryhmissä englannin kieltä tuodaan arkeen esimerkiksi laulaen, leikkien ja lorutellen, toiminnan ollessa muutoin suomenkielistä.Kaikki yksikössä työskentelevät tarvitsevat sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa myös päivittäisissä kohtaamisissa asiakasperheiden kanssa sekä kansainvälisessä työyhteisössä toimittaessa.Hervantajärven päiväkoti on aloittanut toimintansa elokuussa 2026. Varhaiskasvatustoiminnan ehdoilla suunniteltu hirsirakenteinen aistiystävällinen rakennus tukee korkealaatuisen varhaiskasvatustoiminnan toteuttamista. Luonnonläheinen sijainti ja moderni puistomainen leikkialue tarjoavat erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kekseliääseen pedagogiseen pihatoimintaan ja luonnossa liikkumiseen.Me huolehdimme sinusta:Vastineeksi tarjoamme lämminhenkisen työyhteisön, jossa saat kasvaa ammattilaisena, oppia uutta, hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi ja vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Tarjoamme kaikille uusille työntekijöille kuuden kuukauden perehdytysohjelman ja henkilökohtaista tutorointia, jatkuvaa koulutusta ja mahdollisuuksia osaamisen kehittämiseen.Tarjoamme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajalle kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka kokoaikaisella työntekijällä sijoittuu välille 2 792,02 – 3 293,23 €/kk. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy työkokemusvuosien sekä mahdollisen erityisosaamiseen perustuvan henkilökohtaisen palkanlisän mukaan. Voimme haastattelutilanteessa keskustella erityisosaamisesi huomioimisesta ja palkan tarkemmasta sijoittumisesta palkkahaitariin.Kelpoisuusvaatimukset:- Tehtävä edellyttää varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuutta Suomen varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukaisesti. Mikäli tutkintosi on suoritettu Suomen ulkopuolella, sen tulee olla Opetushallituksen hyväksymäTyössä vaadittavat luvat ja kortit, ja selvitykset:- Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuus varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) mukaisesti- Lasten kanssa työskentelyyn vaaditaan rikosrekisteriote, joka perustuu lakiin lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä (504/2002).- Työhön valittavalta edellytetään varhaiskasvatusalalla työskenteleviä koskevaa Tartuntatautilain 55§:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystäHakeminen:- Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän soveltuvan hakijan löydettyämme, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 6.12.2026. jobs.title: Thon Gruppen søker Kategorisjef til innkjøpsavdelingen
jobs.description:
Thon Gruppen søker en erfaren, analytisk og kommersielt sterk Kategorisjef innkjøp til vår sentrale innkjøpsavdeling. Du blir en del av et team på åtte personer som arbeider med strategisk innkjøp på tvers av konsernets virksomhetsområder. Hovedvekten av innkjøpsaktiviteten er i Norge, men enkelte avtaler og innkjøpsprosesser berører også våre virksomheter i Sverige, Belgia og Nederland.

Om rollen

Som kategorisjef innkjøp leder du strategiske innkjøpsprosesser fra analyse og strategi, til konkurranse, forhandling og implementering. Du får hovedansvar for Mat & Drikke, et område med et innkjøpsvolum på rundt 400 MNOK, og en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle kategorien på tvers av konsernet. Du skal følge opp og videreutvikle kategoristrategien i tett samarbeid med F&B, relevante brukermiljøer og leverandører.

Dine ansvarsområder vil blant annet innebære:

  • Utvikle og følge opp kategoristrategien for mat og drikke, samt lede strategiske innkjøpsprosesser, konkurranser og forhandlinger

  • Forvalte og videreutvikle eksisterende avtaler og leverandørsamarbeid

  • Analysere priser, volum, kostnadsdrivere og markedsutvikling og identifisere og realisere kommersielle forbedringer og besparelser

  • Lede innkjøpsprosjekter i samarbeid med interne fagmiljøer og eksterne aktører

  • Bidra til økt avtalelojalitet og ansvarlige og bærekraftige innkjøp

Mat og drikke vil være ditt viktigste ansvarsområde, men ikke det eneste. Innkjøpsavdelingen arbeider med et bredt spekter av kategorier, og du vil også få mulighet til å lede innkjøpsprosesser innen andre områder.

Muligheter i rollen

I denne rollen får du jobbe med store innkjøpsvolumer og problemstillinger som berører flere deler av konsernet. Innkjøpsavdelingen har en bred kontaktflate, og stillingen gir derfor et godt innblikk i Thon Gruppen og de ulike virksomhetsområdene. Du får samtidig faglig ansvar og handlingsrom til å drive egne prosesser og påvirke hvordan kategorien utvikles videre. Som en del av et kompetent fagmiljø med god samarbeidskultur får du en variert arbeidshverdag med korte beslutningsveier.

Hvem vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring med strategisk og kommersielt innkjøp. Du forstår hvordan priser og prismodeller bygges opp, hvilke faktorer som driver kostnadene og hvor de kommersielle handlingsrommene ligger. Du har god forståelse for råvarepriser, volum, logistikk og markedsutvikling og bruker denne innsikten aktivt i konkurranser, forhandlinger og avtaleoppfølging. Kjennskap til mat- og drikkebransjen og relevante leverandørmarkeder er en fordel. Du er analytisk og strukturert, samtidig som du er nysgjerrig, initiativrik og fleksibel. Du tar eierskap, driver prosesser og bygger gode relasjoner med både leverandører og interne fagmiljøer. Du har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk og engelsk.

Relevant høyere utdanning innen økonomi, innkjøp, logistikk eller tilsvarende er ønskelig, men relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning. Interesse for hvordan AI og digitale verktøy kan brukes til bedre analyser og mer effektive innkjøpsprosesser er en fordel.

Interessert?

GreatPeople bistår Thon Gruppen i denne rekrutteringen. Ta kontakt med Christina Waale Salomaa (cws@greatpeople.no) eller Henriette Warme Drake (hwd@greatpeople.no) dersom du har spørsmål eller behov for tilrettelegging i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Thon Hotels: En av Norges største hotellkjeder, med over 90 hoteller i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Belgia og Nederland.

Thon Eiendom: Norges største private eiendomsaktør med utleie og salg av bolig- og næringseiendom, samt drift av over 80 kjøpesentre i Norge og Sverige.

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

    • Deltakelse i FNs Global Compact
    • Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisering av våre hoteller
    • Reduksjon av matsvinn
    • Fokus på likestilling og mangfold
    • Støtte til forskning og allmennyttige formål

jobs.title: Er du avdelingslederen vi leter etter i Møre?
jobs.description:
Vi skal være ærlige med deg. Vi har hatt litt uflaks. 

Nå leter vi etter avdelingslederen som faktisk blir værende. 

I Ramudden Møre har vi mange ting på plass. 

Vi har flinke folk. Vi har gode kunder. Vi har spennende prosjekter. Vi har vekst. Faktisk har vi så mye å gjøre at dagene stort sett går fortere enn kalenderen klarer å holde følge med. 

Men én ting har vi ikke helt lykkes med. 

Vi har ikke funnet den rette personen til å lede avdelingen over tid. 

Og det irriterer oss litt. 

Ikke fordi driften stopper opp. Det gjør den heldigvis ikke. Men fordi de dyktige medarbeiderne våre i Møre fortjener en leder som er skikkelig til stede. En som skaper trygghet. En som blir. Og en som ønsker å bygge laget videre sammen med dem. 

Derfor prøver vi igjen. 

 

Hvem ser vi etter? 

Ikke nødvendigvis personen med den lengste CV-en. 

Ikke nødvendigvis personen med flest lederkurs. 

Men personen som får ting til å skje. 

Du liker å være der det skjer. Du foretrekker å snakke med folk fremfor å sitte i møter hele dagen. Du synes det er morsommere å løse utfordringer ute i driften enn å skrive rapporter om dem etterpå. 

Du vet at ledelse handler om mennesker. 

Om å følge opp. 

Om å stille krav. 

Om å være tilgjengelig når noen trenger deg. 

Og om å skape et lag der folk gleder seg til å gå på jobb. 

 

Dette er ikke en kontorjobb med litt ledelse. 

Dette er en lederjobb med mye virkelighet. 

Hos oss har du ansvar for mennesker, kunder, økonomi, drift og resultater. Du skal både ta vare på det vi har og se mulighetene for videre vekst.  

Du kommer til å: 

  • Følge opp medarbeidere og bygge et sterkt lag 
  • Være tett på den daglige driften 
  • Planlegge bemanning, ressurser og leveranser 
  • Støtte prosjektledere og teamledere når det koker litt 
  • Følge opp eksisterende kunder og bygge gode relasjoner over tid 
  • Sikre god kvalitet, HMS og struktur i hverdagen 
  • Bidra til vekst og videreutvikling av avdelingen

Og enkelte dager gjør du litt av alt.

 

Hva tror vi at du har gjort tidligere? 

Kanskje har du ledet et anlegg. 

Kanskje en produksjonsavdeling. 

Kanskje et verksted. 

Kanskje driver du i dag med bygg og anlegg, industri, infrastruktur eller tekniske tjenester. 

Bransjen er mindre viktig enn menneskene du har ledet og resultatene du har skapt. 

Du trenger ikke kunne alt om arbeidsvarsling og trafikksikring fra dag én. 

Men du må like å ta ansvar. 

Like å bygge relasjoner. 

Og like å få folk rundt deg til å lykkes.

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser 

Og kanskje viktigst av alt: 

Du får muligheten til å bli lederen som laget vårt faktisk har ventet på. 

 

Vi er ett team. Ett Ramudden. 

Så hvis du kjenner at dette traff litt mer enn en vanlig stillingsannonse pleier å gjøre, håper vi du tar kontakt. 

Kanskje er det nettopp deg som skal være med å skrive neste kapittel for Ramudden Møre.

Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. jobs.title: Researcher position in computational chemistry
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position in computational chemistry, available at the Hylleraas centre, Department of Chemistry.

The position is for a period of 2 years.

Starting date no later than 01.03.2027.

Place of work is Hylleraas centre, Department of Chemistry at Blindern, Oslo.

Project description

The position is funded by the Research Council of Norway through the Researcher Project for Early Career Scientists (FRIPRO) “APExModel: Addressing Antimicrobial Peptides by Integrating Experiments into Modelling” and lead by Henrique Musseli Cezar. 

Antimicrobial resistance is a critical global health crisis, and new drugs are urgently needed. 

APExModel will establish a set of experimentally-grounded design principles that can aid the development of safer and more effective AMPs. This will be done by developing and applying a new computational framework that integrates experimental data into simulations. The project will also provide: 1) better understanding the molecular mechanisms that govern how AMPs self-assemble in solution, a key factor for their stability and activity; 2) a novel simulation methodology that can accurately model AMPs interacting with cell membranes by using experimental small-angle scattering data to guide the simulations; and 3) insights on the action mechanisms of different AMPs and how they disrupt bacterial membranes.

The most critical R&D challenge is the development of this new simulation methodology. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations provide access to dynamics at atomic resolution, but limitations in simulation timescale and accuracy may compromise the agreement with experiments. Current integrative approaches are limited to systems with spherical symmetry and cannot adequately model the flat, patch-like membrane used in most MD simulations of AMP-membrane studies. This project will overcome this limitation, adding a capability that is currently missing in the field.

Combining expertise from chemistry, pharmacy, and physics, this interdisciplinary project will produce a new open-source simulation tool and the fundamental knowledge required to establish design principles for AMPs.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition of being a leading research faculty. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in chemistry or related fields. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and public defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Relevant experience in Molecular dynamics, Enhanced sampling techniques, Software development, Force field development, Machine learning frameworks, HPC, Statistical mechanics/thermodynamics is a requirement.

Desirable qualifications

  • Additional experience with antimicrobial peptides, drug design or biophysics can be an advantage. 
What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK 595 000 - 650 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records
  • Letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

Hylleraas Centre for Quantum Molecular Sciences operates under the aegis of the Department of Chemistry at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. The Department of Chemistry  is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. 

The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base.

 - Set the bar for product and AI fluency across the team and ensure your team masters Notion’s product and maintains an expert-level knowledge of the AI ecosystem.
   
   


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description: Haemme kokenutta ja tilinpäätöstaitoista kirjanpitäjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Mustasaareen – tarjolla joustava työaika (sovittavissa 3–5 pv/vko), laaja etätyömahdollisuus, palkkaus 2 500–4 000 €/kk kokopäivätyössä (neuvoteltavissa osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan) sekä Epassi-henkilöstöetu!Tehtävän työaika on sovittavissa 3–5 päivää viikossa valittavan tekijän tilanteen ja toiveiden mukaan. Työtä tehdään pääosin etänä, ja Mustasaaren konttorilla työskennellään silloin tällöin muutamina päivinä. Työkielenä on ruotsi, ja suomen kielen taito katsotaan selkeäksi eduksi.Odotamme sinulta: * Vankkaa kokemusta kirjanpidon tehtävistä sekä itsenäistä tilinpäätöstaitoa * Sujuvaa ruotsin kielen taitoa (suomen kielen taito katsotaan mielellään eduksi) * Kokemusta sähköisistä taloushallinnon ohjelmistoista – käytössä ovat Netvisor, Fennoa ja EasorTarjoamme sinulle: * Vakituisen työsuhteen (toistaiseksi voimassa oleva) * Joustavan työajan (sovittavissa 3–5 pv/vko) * Laajan etätyömahdollisuuden yhdistettynä satunnaisiin konttoripäiviin Mustasaaressa * Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen: Kokopäivätyöntekijälle 2 500–4 000 €/kk, neuvotellaan kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan (Henkilöstöalan TES / HELA) * Henkilöstöedut: Epassi-henkilöstöetu ja luotettavan työnantajan tuen * Sijainti: Mustasaari (etätyömahdollisuus, joitain päiviä konttorilla silloin tällöin) * Työsuhde: Vakituinen (toistaiseksi voimassa oleva), työaika sovittavissa 3–5 pv/vko * Palkkaus: 2 500–4 000 €/kk (kokopäivätyö) / neuvoteltavissa (Henkilöstöalan TES / HELA) * Edut: Epassi-henkilöstöetu * Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan / mahdollisimman pianTyöstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!Bokförare – KorsholmVi söker en erfaren och bokslutskunnig bokförare för en tillsvidareanställning i Korsholm – vi erbjuder flexibel arbetstid (enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar/vecka), goda möjligheter till distansarbete, en lön på 2 500–4 000 €/mån för heltidsarbete (förhandlingsbar enligt erfarenhet och kompetens) samt Epassi-personalförmån!Arbetstiden är enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar i veckan utifrån den valda personens situation och önskemål. Arbetet utförs huvudsakligen på distans, med enstaka dagar på kontoret i Korsholm då och då. Arbetsspråket är svenska, och kunskaper i finska ses som en klar fördel.Vi förväntar oss av dig: * Gedigen erfarenhet av bokföringsuppgifter samt självständig bokslutskompetens * Flytande kunskaper i svenska (kunskaper i finska ses gärna som en fördel) * Erfarenhet av digitala ekonomiförvaltningsprogram – vi använder Netvisor, Fennoa och EasorVi erbjuder dig: * En tillsvidareanställning (fast anställning) * Flexibel arbetstid (enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar/vecka) * Goda möjligheter till distansarbete kombinerat med enstaka kontorsdagar i Korsholm * Konkurrenskraftig lön: 2 500–4 000 €/mån för heltidsanställd, förhandlas enligt erfarenhet och kompetens (kollektivavtalet för personalbranschen / HELA) * Personalförmåner: Epassi-personalförmån och stöd från en pålitlig arbetsgivare * Plats: Korsholm (möjlighet till distansarbete, enstaka dagar på kontoret då och då) * Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning, arbetstid enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar/vecka * Lön: 2 500–4 000 €/mån (heltid) / förhandlingsbar (kollektivavtalet för personalbranschen / HELA) * Förmåner: Epassi-personalförmån * Start: Enligt överenskommelse / så snart som möjligtDu får höra mer om arbetet och Duuri-tiimi som arbetsgivare (samt våra personalförmåner, bl.a. Epassi) under intervjun.Fyll i ansökan via länken intill, så kontaktar vi dig för att boka en tid för anställningsintervju. Intervjuerna inleds omgående och valet kan göras redan under ansökningstiden. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Jos koet, että osaamisesi täsmää tähän paikkaan, mutta mielessä on kysymyksiä, voit kysyä niistä suoraan Whatsappilla tai tavallisella tekstiviestillä. Numero on 050 542 1894 (finnish and english).--- Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökyselyMuutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant Manager, Commercial (Sales Leadership)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle
