jobs.title: RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN GAME THEORY FOR MULTI-AGENT AI GOVERNANCE (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description: SD-27033 RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN GAME THEORY FOR MULTI-AGENT AI GOVERNANCEFixed term contract | Belval | 24 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? You will join the AI Readiness and Assessment (AIRA) group of LIST's Human-centered AI, Data and Software (HANDS) unit as the main researcher of AI-LIGNMENT, a 24-month project funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR) under the CORE programme.AI is shifting from systems that answer prompts to agents that plan, decide and act, increasingly combined into multi-agent systems whose behaviour emerges from interaction rather than from any single model. This strains the human oversight, transparency and explainability that the EU AI Act requires. AI-LIGNMENT responds with a governance framework grounded in game theory: it translates regulatory and organisational requirements into a machine-readable admissible action space, interprets collective agent behaviour as trajectories in that space, detects drift towards undesirable regimes before violations occur, and recalibrates incentives, communication, agent identities and information conditions under human oversight. Working closely with the Principal Investigator, a research engineer and an academic mentor from the University of Cambridge, you will be mainly in charge of:•     Formalising alignment and explainability as system-level properties of interaction dynamics in LLM-based multi-agent systems, across collaborative, competitive and parallel-execution architectures.•     Developing a conceptual and formal model that translates regulatory, organisational and domain-specific requirements (notably the EU AI Act) into a machine-readable admissible action space, in connection with a domain-specific language.•     Formalising the observation–evaluation–recalibration governance loop with game-theoretic concepts: trajectory-based evaluation, regime stability, equilibrium selection and early detection of directional drift.•     Designing and running controlled, reproducible experiments and simulations with LLM-based agents to test the project hypotheses and validate system-level indicators.•     Contributing, together with the project's research engineer, to the research prototype: specifying and implementing the game-theoretic analysis module and the recalibration engine that adjusts incentives, communication and identity parameters.•     Validating the framework and prototype on a use case drawn from public administration, through baseline and recalibration experiments, and analysing their effects on system trajectories, compliance and robustness.•     Publishing your results in leading journals and conferences (e.g. IJCAI, ECAI, AIJ, JAIR, FAccT, AIES), presenting them to the research community, and contributing to the open-source release of the framework with its data and reproducibility artefacts.•     Contributing to project deliverables and reports, exchanging with regulatory authorities and public and private partners, supporting PhD students and trainees working on related topics, and helping to identify and prepare new funding opportunities. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? jobs.description: Career Opportunities: Senior Depositary Oversight Specialist (125392)  Your team The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people. Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients. The scope of the role is to take part in all monitoring and control activities of the team relating to the oversight missions of the depositary.  Your role • Carry out the monitoring and control measures set out in the Depositary Oversight control plan in the following areas of oversight:o Valuation of the assets and calculation of the UCI's NAVo Handling of subscriptions and redemptions of UCI units/shareso Compliance of the UCI's instructions/investment decisionso Distribution of the UCI's incomeo Timely settlement of the UCI's transactions • Managing regulatory escalation processes.• Be involved in the regulatory due diligence required for some of the UCI's service providers (central administration, external valuer, AIFM/management companies).• Contribute to the drafting of the various periodic review reports on the results of the depositary control for the management bodies of the UCI, the Bank's management, or the supervisory authorities.• Contribute to the risk/feasibility/compliance analysis to be carried out when accepting new UCI depositary mandates or significant changes in existing mandates.• Perform and keep up to date the depositary risk assessment/scoring for each UCI/sub-fund for which the Bank is acting as depositary and ensure on this basis that appropriate oversight procedures are then implemented and applied.• Help maintain the depositary monitoring and control framework and, if required, define new tasks of controls deemed necessary.• Assist with the regulatory watch of the role, responsibilities, and best practices of UCI depositaries and help ensure compliance with the regulatory framework. Your profile • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Law or Management • At least 7 years' experience in Depositary Oversight or Fund/Investment Compliance within AIFMs, management companies or central administrations in a similar position or in another position dealing with the same domains of activity, such as Fund Accountant, UCI's Auditor, Fund Compliance Officer, etc.• Fluent in french and english • Familiarity with the regulatory environment applicable to the investment activity of UCIs (AIFMD, UCITS) and a sound knowledge of the requirements relating to the depositary function.• Sound general knowledge of the operation of UCIs (calculation of NAVs, processing of redemptions/subscriptions of units, types of UCIs, parties involved in a UCI).• Very good MS Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).• Knowledge of Avaloq/MultiFonds/eFront.• Rigorous and with analytical skills and a keen interest in regulatory matters.• Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with peers and external stakeholders, including clients and supervisory authorities.• Ability to represent the function to an external public.• Ability to cope with stress.• Ability to work independently. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Forte leadership, intelligenza emotiva e sensibilità relazionale, doti fondamentali per gestire sia la transizione interna (passaggio di consegne) sia i rapporti con fornitori di culture diverse. Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi: • životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis/potvrda o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ne stariji od 7 dana od dana prijave na natječaj) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte: vio.karijera@zgh.hr S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja“. Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju. jobs.title: SAVJETNIK / SAVJETNICA ZA ODRŽAVANJE I GRAĐENJE KOMUNALNE INFRASTRUKTURE
jobs.description:
OGLAS za prijem u službu na određeno vrijeme u Upravnom odjelu za komunalno gospodarstvo i investicije na radno mjesto :

Savjetnik za održavanje i građenje komunalne infrastrukture- (1) jedan izvršitelj/ica na određeno vrijeme uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od dva mjeseca.

Opći uvjeti za prijem u službu, propisani u članku 12. ZSN-a: punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo, zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta

Posebni uvjeti : Sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij građevinske ili tehničke struke, najmanje 3 (tri) godine radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, državni ispit II. razine, poznavanje rada na računalu.

Služba se zasniva na određeno vrijeme od šest mjeseci, uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od dva mjeseca. Sukladno članku 28. stavak 2. ZSN-a, služba na određeno vrijeme za obavljanje poslova čiji se opseg privremeno povećao može trajati najduže šest mjeseci i može se produžiti za još šest mjeseci. Sukladno članku 28. stavak 7. ZSN-a, služba na određeno vrijeme ne može postati služba na neodređeno vrijeme. Izrazi koji se, u ovom oglasu koriste u muškom rodu neutralni su i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski spol. Na oglas mogu se javiti osobe oba spola. Za prijem u službu osobe koja je strani državljanin ili osobe bez državljanstva, osim ispunjavanja uvjeta propisanih posebnim zakonom, potrebno je prethodno odobriti tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službene odnose. Prijava na oglas mora obvezno sadržavati: ime i prezime, datum rođenja, adresu podnositelja prijave, broj telefona/mobitela, po mogućnosti adresu e pošte, uz točno navođenje radnog mjesta za koje se prijava podnositelja životopis dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica ili domovnica) dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (diploma) dokaz o radnom iskustvu na poslovima odgovarajuće stručne spreme i struke u trajanju od najmanje tri godine potrebno je kao dokaz zajedno dostaviti sljedeće dokumente navedene u točkama a) ib): a) elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, osnovi osiguranja, početku i prestanku osiguranja, radnom vremenu, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, općini rada-prebivališta te trajanju staža osiguranja - ne starije od 30 dana od posljednjeg dana roka za podnošenje prijave b) dokaz o postojanju radnog iskustva iz kojeg se nedvojbeno može utvrditi radno iskustvo na poslovima odgovarajuće stručne spreme i struke od najmanje tri godine (potvrda poslodavca, ugovor o radu, rješenje o rasporedu ili slično) koji sadrži vrstu poslova, potreban stupanj stručne spreme i razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove,a koje radno iskustvo je evidentirano u elektroničkom zapisu/potvrdi o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu o nepostojanju zapreke iz članaka 15. i 16. ZSN-a koju nije potrebno ovjeravati (obrazac izjave bit će objavljen na web stranici Grada Trogira uz tekst oglasa) vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu o poznavanju rada na računalu koju nije potrebno ovjeravati ili drugi dokaz (preslik indeksa, svjedodžbu srednje škole, odgovarajuće potvrde koje nije potrebno ovjeravati, obrazac izjave bit će objavljen na webu stranici Grada Trogira uz tekst oglasa ) dokaz o položenom državnom ispitu II. razine ako posjeduje dokaz o promjeni osobnog imena ili prezimena ako je ono mijenjano u odnosu na priložene isprave (presliku vjenčanog lista ili rodnog lista i sl.). Natjecati se mogu i kandidati koji nemaju položen državni ispit propisane razine, uz obvezu da se državni ispit polaže u roku od godine dana od dana početka rada u službi utvrđenog rješenja o rasporedu. U službu ne može biti primljena osoba za koju postoji zapreka iz članaka 15. i 16. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi (Narodne novine br. 86/08., 61/11., 4/18., 112/19. i 17/25.), a što će po službenoj dužnosti provjeriti Upravni odjel za lokalnu samoupravu i imovinu grada. Vodi upravni postupak i rješava o upravnim stvarima za koje ima vlast, prema Odluci o ustrojstvu i djelokrugu rada upravnih tijela Grada, za koje ga zaduži pročelnik. Sudjeluje u vođenju poslova tehničke pripreme izrade kapitalnih projekata, te s tim u vezi sudjeluje u pripremi, organiziranju, praćenju ili nadzire ostvarenje kapitalnih projekata u području komunalnog gospodarstva uključujući poslove u vezi gradnje i održavanja objekata i uređaja radi gospodarenja otpadom, osobito odlagališta i reciklažnog dvorišta koje se potpuno ili djelomično financiraju iz proračuna grada; priprema stručne podloge. Surađuje sa tijelima, ustanovama i trgovačkim društvima u čijoj je vlasti razvoj i održavanje i izgradnja objekata i uređaja komunalne infrastrukture sukladno Zakonu o komunalnom gospodarstvu; izrađuje nacrte općih i pojedinačnih akata iz nadležnosti odjela; obavlja poslove koji se odnose na komunalno gospodarstvo. Sudjeluje u stvaranju uvjeta za korištenje nekretnina u vlasništvu Grada u funkciji razvojnih programa. Sudjeluje u izradi programa održavanja i izgradnje objekata i uređaja komunalne infrastrukture sukladno Zakonu o komunalnom gospodarstvu. Sudjeluje u povjeravanju poslova na temelju koncesije i prati realizaciju ugovora; sudjeluje u pripremi nacrta odluka i drugih pravnih akata iz djelokruga gospodarenja imovinom; sudjeluje u imovinsko-pravnim poslovima vezanim uz izgradnju i korištenje objekata i uređaja komunalne infrastrukture. Priprema suglasnosti i posebne uvjete za ishođenje akata o građenju. Izrađuje da potvrde i utvrđuje posebne uvijete za prokope i druge radove na nerazvrstanim cestama i javnim površinama; provodi radnje u svrhu zaštite nerazvrstanih cesta i javnih površina (suradnja s geodetom). Izrađuje i donosi rješenja o utvrđivanju komunalnog doprinosa, naknade za zadržavanje nezakonito izgrađene zgrade u prostoru i/ili spomeničke rente sukladno rasporedu predmeta od pročelnika. Obavlja druge poslove koje mu povjeri pročelnik.

jobs.title: MATERIĀLU UZSKAITES GRĀMATVEDIS
jobs.description:

Aicinām komandai pievienoties precīzu, atbildīgu un uz detaļām orientētu Noliktavas grāmatvedi, kurš/-a nodrošinās noliktavas krājumu un ar tiem saistītās dokumentācijas precīzu uzskaiti

Galvenie pienākumi:

  • Nodrošināt noliktavas preču, rezerves daļu, materiālu un aprīkojuma uzskaiti grāmatvedības un noliktavas sistēmās.
  • Apstrādāt un reģistrēt preču saņemšanas, izsniegšanas un pārvietošanas dokumentus.
  • Pārbaudīt preču pavaddokumentus, piegādātāju rēķinus un pavadzīmes.
  • Veikt noliktavas dokumentu un grāmatvedības datu salīdzināšanu.
  • Sekot līdzi noliktavas atlikumiem un identificēt iespējamās neatbilstības.
  • Piedalīties plānoto un ārkārtas inventarizāciju organizēšanā un rezultātu apkopošanā.
  • Nodrošināt savlaicīgu un korektu dokumentu apriti starp noliktavu, grāmatvedību, iepirkumu un citām uzņēmuma struktūrvienībām.
  • Sekot līdzi rezerves daļu un materiālu uzskaites precizitātei un dokumentācijas atbilstībai uzņēmuma iekšējām procedūrām.
  • Sagatavot nepieciešamos pārskatus un atskaites par noliktavas krājumiem.

Prasības kandidātiem:

  • Vidējā profesionālā vai augstākā izglītība grāmatvedībā, finansēs, ekonomikā vai loģistikā.
  • Iepriekšēja pieredze noliktavas uzskaitē, grāmatvedībā vai līdzīgā amatā.
  • Izpratne par noliktavas uzskaites un grāmatvedības pamatprincipiem.
  • Labas iemaņas darbā ar MS Excel un citām datorprogrammām.
  • Spēja strādāt ar lielu informācijas un dokumentu apjomu.
  • Augsta precizitāte, organizētība un atbildības sajūta.
  • Spēja patstāvīgi organizēt savu darbu un ievē

jobs.title: VHDL Developer - Try & Hire
jobs.description:
We are looking for a VHDL Designer to join our clients FPGA development team in Helsinki, Finland. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, simulating, and testing VHDL-based FPGA solutions. Strong expertise in VHDL, FPGA development workflows, and verification activities is essential.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

The work involves developing FPGA implementations, creating simulation environments and testbenches, and working with timing analysis, registers, signals, pipelined architectures, and integer/fixed-point arithmetic. The development environment includes both Intel/Altera and AMD FPGA platforms.

Required Skills:
 Proficiency in VHDL
 FPGA development environments (Intel/Altera Quartus, AMD Vivado/Vitis)
 Simulation tools (ModelSim, Vivado/Vitis, GHDL)
 Testbench development, including AI-assisted approaches
 Git version control
 Understanding of timing analysis
 Registers and signals
 Pipelined architectures
 Integer and fixed-point arithmetic
 Use of DSP and RAM blocks

Preferred Skills:
 Knowledge of the VUnit testing framework
 High-Level Synthesis (HLS)
 PWM modulation
 PI/PID control
 Digital FIR and IIR filters
 Clarke transformation (ABC XYZ)
 Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs)
 Serial communication
 CRC and line coding
 Clock recovery

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have hands-on experience developing FPGA solutions using VHDL?*
- Have you worked with Intel/Altera Quartus or AMD Vivado/Vitis development environments?*
- Do you have experience creating and maintaining FPGA simulation testbenches?*
- Are you comfortable working with timing analysis, pipelined architectures, and fixed-point arithmetic in FPGA designs?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Hybrid, Pitäjänmäki (Helsinki), 50 % on-site
Start: ASAP, no later than January 2027
Duration: 6 months, with possible permanent employment thereafter (try & hire)
Workload: Full-time, 37.5 h/week

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .

Lokki Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy (Finnish for Seagull Recruitment Services) has been active in providing recruitment services since 2005 and we belong to The Private Employment Agencies Association HPL. Our vision is to provide the best customer experience with our reliable, humane and effortless service around Finland. Our most important asset is a person who, as we know, thrives in a reliable and supportive atmosphere. At Loki you will be supported by your own human resources consultant throughout your employment relationship. At Lokki, we believe in a partnership achieved as a result of flexible service. Explore us and our vacancies: https://www.lokki.fi/.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Over the past year, hundreds of thousands of non-technical knowledge workers from startups to the worlds’ largest companies have used Replit to build apps, dashboards, and other critical tools that help them do their jobs better.



Our early enterprise success has led us to a more ambitious vision: building the operating system for self-driving companies https://replit.com/blog/rise-of-self-driving-company. We believe the shift already underway in software engineering will soon extend to every business function: people will set the vision, and teams of AI agents will work together to carry it out.



We are hiring a Staff/Senior Engineer to join the Enterprise product team and build the platform for companies to create, manage, and govern their own AI teammates. You’ll help build the primitives that allow Agents to work proactively, collaboratively, and learn over time, all while respecting the strict governance and security requirements of enterprise customers.



This is a tiger team that combines complex backend platform engineering with enterprise product needs and touches every major Replit launch. You’ll help decide what products we ship, not just how they are built, and you’ll see your work impact real teams at the largest organizations in the world.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Talk to customers and shape the product. Own technical design and delivery for enterprise-facing features end-to-end, from ideation to delivery.

 - Work on a frontier coding agent. Contribute to the harness and build core primitives that let Replit Agent operate reliably and securely on real-world enterprise systems and data.

 - Define the UX for multiplayer agents. Balance the needs of users and enterprise admins while constructing entirely new, multiplayer AI experiences. No one knows what the ideal collaboration model for agentic work is; you will help us discover it.

 - Build the habitat for enterprise agents. Design and build the permissions, governance, and administration capabilities that enterprises need to trust Replit with mission-critical data and systems. Architect the platform where enterprise customers can build maximally capable, autonomous agents, without sacrificing control.

 - Use the product you build every day. We exclusively use Replit to build Replit. Our industry and tooling is changing rapidly; you get to experience the future before everyone else does.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Full-stack systems thinking. You’re comfortable across the stack - from databases and APIs to frontend frameworks. You need not have experience in any particular language (Agents write the code anyway 🙂), but your fundamentals must be rock-solid.

 - Personal and technical excellence. You hold a high bar for yourself and expect the others around you to do the same. You sweat the small stuff, because you know the micro-decisions compound into delightful user experiences.

 - Extreme ownership. You have a record of shipping high-impact features on aggressive timelines because you refuse to be blocked. Nothing is “someone else’s job”. If it’s broken, you fix it.

 - Product judgement. You can distill ambiguous customer needs into well-defined technical solutions. You are comfortable wearing the PM hat when needed and can act decisively, with conviction in your own judgement.

 - Enterprise empathy. You have experience building B2B or enterprise software products. You understand the needs of different personas in F500 companies, and know what it takes to get complex enterprise features deployed at scale.

 - Genuine passion for our mission. You are excited about shaping the future of human<>agent collaboration and the opportunity to transform how billions of people work. You are motivated by extremely ambitious goals and are excited to tackle the hard problems that come with them.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with enterprise identity, authorization, permissions, or governance systems (SSO, SCIM, RBAC, ReBAC, PBAC).

 - Experience designing distributed services, APIs, and data models, with an understanding of reliability, consistency, scalability, and performance tradeoffs

 - Ex-founder or previous experience in a high-growth startup environment




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit




THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You prefer working exclusively on backend systems without user interaction

 - You're uncomfortable with the pace and changing priorities of a startup environment

 - You require highly structured requirements and aren't comfortable with ambiguity

 - You were a late adopter of coding agents or are hesitant to trust them with complex scope.

 - You are looking for a comfortable and easy job



This is a full-time role that is held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

jobs.description:

VERO MODA is seeking a Regional Buying Manager for our international Planning & Buying team in Aarhus. This role is crucial for strategically leading the development of buying strategies, optimizing stock, and curating assortments that meet global ambitions and local market needs. Your advanced analytical expertise and commercial mindset will be instrumental in driving significant sales and support our global retail success.

YOUR TEAMJoin our vibrant International Planning & Buying department. You will collaborate with local retail managers, country teams, and stakeholders across Europe. We craft data-driven collections and strategies in a fast-paced, international setting, valuing collaboration and pushing retail excellence. As a key member of our team, you will contribute significantly to our collective expertise and strategic direction.

YOUR JOBAs Regional Buying Manager, you will take ownership of and proactively develop and execute buying strategies that boost performance across Europe. You will use sharp commercial instincts and robust data to ensure our assortments and sales plans are not only relevant and impactful, but also future-proofed for sustained growth. Your role is key to achieving topline and EBIT targets, optimizing stock, and guiding local teams to align with our global vision and local demands.

Key responsibilities:

  • Being in the front of development and implementation of comprehensive buying strategies, effectively aligning brand and local market needs.

  • Drive the creation of data-driven product assortments and clear sales plans.

  • Oversee and strategically manage stock control for maximum efficiency and impact on financial targets.

  • Provide expert guidance and support to local teams with market performance insights and tools.

  • Ensure collection relevance and commercial viability by expertly balancing global trends and local preferences.

YOUR PROFILEYou are a highly experienced, strategic, and analytical professional with a passion for retail and women's fashion. You leverage data for complex strategic decisions but also understand the creative and commercial aspects of buying. As a strong and influential communicator, you build relations easily in dynamic, international environments. You are adept at navigating diverse market demands and stakeholder expectations.

We imagine you:

  • Have extensive and demonstrable experience in retail buying or planning in fashion at a senior level.

  • Possess a distinguished proven track record in advanced stock control, in-depth analysis, and strategic reporting.

  • Are an expert and highly proficient in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.

  • Have a deep understanding and strong passion for women's fashion trends and consumer demand.

  • Ideally, bring leadership experience or a strong capacity to mentor junior team members.

WHAT WE OFFERAt VERO MODA, you will be part of a global brand with a clear vision and a collaborative culture. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the buying strategy, impact markets worldwide, and grow within a team that values your ideas. Join us in Aarhus to create inspiring and high-performing women's fashion. This is an opportunity to make a significant strategic impact and further your career in a dynamic international environment.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Head of Retail Buying & Planning at +45 30 85 27 48.

Please upload your CV and application as soon as possible and no later than the 8th of December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting once we have found the right match.

LOCATION: Aarhus C, Denmark.

TRAVEL: Approx. 30 annual travel days.

jobs.title: 2 hjertevarme pædagogmedhjælpere eller pæd. assistenter til Børnehuset Olympus
jobs.description:
Olympus Børnehuset leder efter verdens bedste pædagogmedhjælper………

 

Brænder du for at skabe en tryg, varm og udviklende hverdag for børnehavebørn? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor kvalitet og omsorg går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Børnehuset Olympus er en sammenlagt institution beliggende på to matrikler på henholdsvis Korevej 2 og Fortunavej 1. Korevej er en lille hyggelig børnehave med 20 børn, og Fortuna er en spændende, integreret institution med 18 vuggestuebørn, og 39 børnehavebørn. Det er i børnehaven i afd. Fortuna,  vi mangler hænder.

Børnehuset Olympus er en institution i udvikling, og derfor er der rig mulighed for at være medskaber af et udviklende læringsmiljø, der understøtter alle børns deltagelse i børnefællesskaber, alt sammen med udgangspunkt i Aalborg kommunes børnesyn.

 

Vi søger to pædagogmedhjælpere/pædagogiske assistenter på 37 timer . Begge stillinger er i vores børnehavegrupper på Fortunavej. Vi forventer du kan tiltræde 1. februar 2027.

 

Til den rette pædagogmedhjælper tilbyder vi

  • Skønne børn, forældre og kolleger
  • En hverdag der udstråler ro, nærvær og en varm, hjemlig stemning  
  • Et fagligt stærkt team, der prioriterer refleksion over egen og andres praksis
  • Et miljø hvor der er fokus på udvikling og kvalitet i det pædagogiske arbejde – både i planlægning og praksis – du arbejder under reference til stuens pædagoger.
  • Gode muligheder for sparring og kompetenceudvikling
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor trivsel og samarbejde vægtes højt, og hvor man mødes med smil og et godt humør

 

Vi ønsker os en pædagogmedhjælper der kan

  • Være med til at skabe trygge og udviklende læringsmiljøer for børn i alderen 0–6 år
  • Arbejde anerkendende og relations baseret med det enkelte barn, og har lyst til at være på gulvet blandt børnene 
  • Være med til at planlægge og gennemføre pædagogiske aktiviteter med høj faglig kvalitet
  • Indgå aktivt i samarbejdet med forældre, og ser dem som vigtige samarbejdspartnere 
  • Tage del i det praktiske arbejde i hverdagen, og ser det som en mulighed for vigtige læringsstunder med børnene
  • Bidrage til en varm og inkluderende kultur i huset

 

Vi forventer, at du

  • Først og fremmest går på arbejde for børnenes skyld
  • Er nærværende, anerkendende, omsorgsfuld og tydelig i din tilgang til børnene
  • Trives i en hverdag med både struktur og fleksibilitet
  • Er mødestabil, og kan møde i hele åbningstiden 6.30-16.50
  • Har lyst til at bidrage til et positivt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi har øje for hinanden og respekterer hinandens forskelligheder
  • Gerne har erfaring fra det pædagogiske område – evt. uddannelse som pædagogisk assistent (ikke et krav)

 

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og CV senest den 11. december 2026. Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler umiddelbart efter ansøgningsfristens udløb. 

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til Foa´s overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Gitte Høyrup Christensen, 20638914. Du er ligeledes velkommen til at ringe og aftale et besøg. Forud for ansættelse indhentes reference og børne- og straffeattest.

Arbejdsstedets adresse er Fortunavej 1, 9210 Aalborg SØ.

Send ansøgning

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Send ansøgning" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.

Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på mulighederHos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Power System Flexibility and Energy Markets
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a full-time position as Associate Professor in Power System Flexibility and Energy Markets is open for appointment from April 2027 or soon thereafter

Your work tasksYou will join the Intelligent Energy Systems and Flexible Markets (iGRIDS) research group in the Section for Electric Power Systems and Microgrids at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will actively contribute to the group’s collaborative research, teaching, and broader academic activities.

Your research will address modelling, optimisation and intelligent management of power and integrated energy systems, with emphasis on electricity markets, demand flexibility, uncertainty-aware scheduling and active distribution networks. You will develop computational and data-driven approaches for flexibility across sectors, including power–heat and power–mobility applications.

You will develop and lead research projects, secure external funding and collaborate with academic, industrial and public-sector partners. You will teach and supervise students at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels and support AAU’s problem-based learning (PBL) environment. It is also expected that you will be able to undertake teaching in Danish within the first few years of employment.

Your competenciesApplicants should have Associate Professor-level qualifications in electrical power engineering, energy systems or a related field, with a documented record of original research and teaching. Relevant competencies include:

  • Energy systems and markets: Expertise in modelling, optimisation, and control of integrated energy systems, including energy hubs, sector coupling, electricity markets, energy economics, demand response, flexibility aggregation, and uncertainty-aware scheduling.
  • Grid integration: Experience in integrating renewable energy, storage, and flexible demand into active distribution networks, addressing voltage regulation, congestion management, grid stability, and coordinated flexibility services.
  • Research excellence and leadership: Strong publication record and demonstrated ability to develop research directions, secure competitive funding, and lead national and international collaborative projects, particularly EU-funded initiatives.
  • Teaching and collaboration: Documented experience in university teaching at bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels. Experience in teaching within Flexible Master's Programmes, particularly for industry professionals, is considered an advantage. Ability to contribute to Problem-Based Learning (PBL), communicate effectively in English and collaborate constructively with students, colleagues and external partners.
  • Additional strengths: Experience in experimental validation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and industry-oriented research or teaching is advantageous.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirementsAppointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of employment as an assistant professor but may also be obtained in other ways.  

It is a precondition that applicants have documented research at an international standard. In addition, applicants are assumed to have received supervision and pedagogical skills development and to have obtained a positive written assessment of their teaching qualifications.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of ten publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see The Faculty of Engineering and Science. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this   
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here  

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

Role Description

As anÂ Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Reddit brings people together around their interests, questions, and experiences. Our communities create rich and complex data, and we build tools that help people turn that data into reliable understanding.

The Data Science Platform team develops Rosso, Redditâs analytics agent, and the shared tools that support analytical and scientific work across the company. We are looking for software engineers who enjoy building AI systems that people can depend on: useful workflows, clear interfaces, thoughtful evals, and software that improves through production experience.

In this role, you will own a substantial part of our agent and scientific-tooling platform. You will design and ship capabilities, maintain and improve existing systems, and work with applied scientists and data scientists to make advanced analysis accessible. You will remain close to the code and to the people using it, from an initial prototype through rollout, operation, and ongoing refinement.

Responsibilities

  • Develop evaluation infrastructure and use it continuously. Maintain versioned task sets, automated checks, human-reviewed examples, regression reports, and release gates that expose meaningful failures.
  • Improve agent quality through careful failure analysis and measured changes to prompts, context, tools, model selection, and workflow design, balancing correctness, latency, and cost.
  • Operate production systems with actionable observability, incident response, dependency upgrades, backward-compatible interfaces, staged releases, and rollback paths.
  • Build secure analytical execution and data integrations with appropriate access controls, execution limits, audit trails, provenance, and reproducible artifacts.
  • Partner with scientists to turn validated methods into supported capabilities, preserving input requirements, diagnostics, uncertainty, and limitations through the API and agent experience.
  • Lead technical design and delivery within your area, coordinate with partner teams, review code and designs, mentor engineers, and improve how the team builds and maintains software.

About Node16.ai

Node16.ai is an early-stage Danish technology company developing privacy-preserving artificial intelligence solutions for the financial services industry.

Our mission is to improve the detection and prevention of financial crime by enabling financial institutions to collaborate and share intelligence without compromising sensitive customer and transaction data.

By combining artificial intelligence, federated learning and modern software infrastructure, we aim to make anti-money laundering (AML) processes more effective, secure and scalable.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Software Tester to join our growing team and contribute to the quality, reliability and functionality of our software products.

About the role

As a Junior Software Tester at Node16.ai, you will support the testing and quality assurance of the company’s web applications and software systems.

You will work closely with developers and product stakeholders to prepare and execute software tests, identify and document defects, verify fixes, and support the delivery of reliable software solutions.

This position offers an opportunity to develop practical experience in software testing, quality assurance and test automation within an innovative AI-driven technology company.

•           Test case preparation and documentation: Create, maintain and update test cases, test checklists and testing documentation, including recorded results and observations.

•           Defect identification and verification: Identify, reproduce, document and report software defects, and verify that reported issues have been resolved.

•           Quality assurance and release support: Assist in validating software features, reviewing test results and supporting quality assurance activities throughout software development and releases.

•           Test automation support: Execute, maintain, and update automated test scripts and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines and data workflows.

•           Cross-functional collaboration: Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and release validation alongside developers and product stakeholders.

•           An educational background in computer science, software engineering, information technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

•           An understanding of web applications and general software functionality.

•           Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

•           Attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.

•           The ability to work independently and collaboratively within a small team.

•           Fluent written and spoken English.

•           A willingness to learn new technologies and testing methodologies.

Recent graduates and candidates at the beginning of their software testing or quality assurance careers are encouraged to apply. Prior professional experience is not required.

Desirable qualifications

The following skills and experience would be advantageous but are not mandatory:

•           Basic knowledge of programming or scripting languages such as Python or JavaScript.

•           Familiarity with API testing, SQL or data validation.

•           Exposure to Git, CI/CD pipelines and Agile development methodologies.

•           An interest in artificial intelligence, financial technology, data privacy or financial crime prevention.

•           Hands-on experience in software testing, quality assurance and test automation.

•           Exposure to modern software development practices and AI-driven applications.

•           Close collaboration with the CEO and technical team.

•           Opportunities for professional development as the company grows.

jobs.title: Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad
jobs.description:
Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad

Bigadan is built by people with deep professional expertise and a shared ambition: to create the circular energy solutions of the future. We have been building biogas plants for more than 40 years, in Denmark and abroad, and the coming years are busy. We have expansion and greenfield projects lined up in Denmark and Scandinavia, plus support projects for our clients in Germany and the UK. That is why we are looking for an experienced Site Manager for our Projects team.

Anywhere from 10 to 50+ people from different contractors on site, all needing to deliver at the same time. You are the one holding it all together. And when you hand over, you leave behind a plant that produces biogas for decades.

The role

You lead the site day to day from ground-breaking through commissioning and handover to operations. The people on site are mainly contractors in civil, mechanical, electrical, piping and process works. You report formally to Head of Projects Luke Morris, while Head of Site Managers Stefan Wussow is your manager in day-to-day operations. You work closely with the individual Project Managers and the Site team.

You spend around 80% of your time on site and 20% in the office. Our construction site office and workshop are based in Husum, Germany. Ideally, we would like you to be based in southern Denmark near Kliplev or Husum, but as the role involves a lot of travel, we are recruiting across Denmark and northern Germany. Our projects are spread across Denmark and abroad, including Sweden, Germany, Finland and the UK.

We expect you to be ready for periods of 3–4 weeks living near the site. Employment can be in Denmark or in Germany.

What you do

Site leadership. You coordinate daily activities and contractor progress, plan access, deliveries and lifting operations, and solve problems before they become delays.

Safety. You lead site inspections and toolbox talks and approve risk assessments and method statements. You set the standard on site.

Quality and documentation. You make sure the work follows drawings and specifications, including welding, and keep track of inspections and documentation.

Handover. You manage punch lists and close-out, so we hand over a plant that works from day one.

What makes this role specific

With us, you are not building for a client you will never see again. We operate the plants ourselves afterwards, and our own colleagues will live with what you build for many years. You succeed in this role when you have led the next builds safely to completion, made the right decisions along the way, kept the budget on track, and made both the collaboration and the construction succeed.

We imagine that you:

• have a technical education, e.g. as a mechanical engineer, or a trade background (civil, mechanical or electrical) with hands-on experience

• have at least 5 years' experience as a site manager on industrial, energy, utility or process projects

• know civil, mechanical and electrical works and the health and safety rules on a construction site

• speak and write English and either Danish or German

Experience in biogas or anaerobic digestion is an advantage, but not a requirement. It is also an advantage if you hold a Danish construction safety coordinator certificate (AMK-B), first aid, knowledge of ATEX zones, or experience with welding coordination.

As a person, you are visible on site and make decisions when they need to be made. You can push back on a contractor and still have a good working relationship the next day.

We offer

A central role in a growing company, where you are involved from ground-breaking until the plant is running. You get a competitive salary, either mileage at the official Danish rates or a company van, accommodation and per diem on projects, pension and health insurance, ongoing training and support for relevant certifications. The position is full-time, starting 1 February or 1 March 2027.

About Bigadan

We develop, build, operate and own biogas plants and work across the entire value chain, from sourcing organic residues to producing energy, biogenic CO₂ and biofertiliser. We are around 200 colleagues and have built more than 40 biogas plants in Denmark and abroad.

Every day, we turn manure, food waste and other organic residues into products of value for the energy, agriculture and industrial sectors. This supports security of supply, makes better use of resources and returns nutrients to the soil.

Interested?

The application deadline is Wednesday 30 December 2026. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. If you have questions, please contact Head of Projects Luke Morris on +45 3073 6851 or lm@bigadan.dk.

jobs.title: Experienced farm team leaders for the harvest 2027
jobs.description:
Hyldetoftegaard A/S is looking for several experienced, reliable and motivated Farm Team Leaders to join our team for the 2027 fruit harvest season in Denmark, we employ approximately 200–220 employees.

We are looking for people with practical experience in agriculture, horticulture or fruit production who can lead and organize teams of fruit pickers and make sure that the daily work is well planned and carried out efficiently.

RECRUITMENT DAYS – CRAIOVA, ROMANIA – JANUARY 2027

RAMADA PLAZA CRAIOVA, Craiova, Romania

Recruitment dates:

·        Tuesday, 26 January 2027

·        Wednesday, 27 January 2027

Selected candidates will be invited to attend a short information meeting followed by individual employment interviews.

IMPORTANT – INVITATION ONLY

Attendance is strictly by individual invitation from Hyldetoftegaard A/S.

Only pre-selected candidates with a confirmed invitation will be admitted.

Unannounced visits and attendance without an invitation will be refused.

Applying does not guarantee an interview or an invitation.

English is the working language within the company.

YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

·        Lead and organize a team of fruit pickers.

·        Plan and distribute the daily work among the workers.

·        Give clear instructions and make sure that tasks are understood.

·        Follow up on the team's daily work, progress and productivity.

·        Make sure that fruit picking is carried out efficiently and correctly.

·        Support the team and solve practical problems during the working day.

·        Register and report the team's daily harvest and output.

·        Keep simple and accurate records of workers, working hours and daily production.

·        Communicate daily information clearly to farm management.

·        Help ensure that safety, hygiene and company rules are followed.

ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES

The Team Leaders will also have simple administrative responsibilities. You must be comfortable recording daily information and reporting it to management.

·        Register the team's daily fruit harvest/output.

·        Keep track of daily work and working hours.

·        Prepare simple daily reports.

·        Report relevant information and issues to farm management.

ENGLISH – REQUIRED

You must be able to communicate in English with management, understand information and handle everyday communication.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

·        Previous experience as a team leader, supervisor, foreman or similar position.

·        Experience from agriculture, horticulture, fruit production or another relevant field.

·        Experience leading, motivating and organizing a team of workers.

·        Good communication and organizational skills.

·        Ability to take responsibility and work independently.

·        A positive and respectful approach to working with people from different countries.

·        Good English communication skills – required.

·        Good physical condition and willingness to work alongside the team when necessary.

WORKING PERIOD

The 2027 fruit harvest season runs from early May to mid-September or the end of October, depending on the harvest, we prefer you start in February and until Mid – end of October

The exact employment period will be agreed according to the farm's needs and your availability.

WORKING HOURS

·        Work normally starts at 05:00 or 06:00.

·        Approximately 6–7 working hours per day.

·        6 working days per week, with one changing day off.

·        Flexibility is required during busy periods of the harvest.

SALARY

Farm Team Leaders are employed on a fixed monthly salary.

The starting salary is a minimum of DKK 24.000.

The salary will be agreed according to qualifications, previous experience and the responsibilities of the position.

IBAN bank account:

You can only register one IBAN bank account in your own name for salary payments during your employment period.

ACCOMMODATION

Indoor accommodation is available on or near the farm, for the day’s price. Dkr.70,00 will be deducted from salary.

Shared kitchen, bathroom and laundry facilities. The company provides free access to a washing machine, tumble dryer, electricity, water, heating, internet, and cleaning products for the maintenance of the accommodation provided.

 TAX CARD AND HEALTH INSURANCE CARD

The company will apply for your tax card and health insurance card in accordance with your employment contract. These cards will be valid for the agreed employment period. If you are married, you must provide documentation of your marital status.

TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR FOREIGN EMPLOYEES

Foreign employees working temporarily in Denmark may be eligible for certain tax deductions, depending on their individual tax situation.

 Travel between your home country and Denmark

If you maintain your permanent home in your home country and your personal and financial ties remain there, you may be eligible for a deduction for travel between your home country and your workplace in Denmark. Eligibility depends on your Danish tax status. You must keep documentation of your journeys, such as tickets and receipts. The amount shown for 2026 is approximately DKK 6,000.

Double-household deduction

If your employment in Denmark is temporary and you maintain a home both in Denmark and in your home country, you may, under certain conditions, qualify for a deduction for additional household expenses. This may apply when your work requires you to live away from your permanent home.

To qualify, your employment must generally be temporary, and the distance between the two homes must make daily travel unreasonable. The deduction may be available for up to two years.

For 2026, the standard deduction for double housekeeping is DKK 400 per week without documentation. A higher deduction may be possible if you can document your actual expenses. The total deduction for food, accommodation and double housekeeping is subject to an annual maximum of DKK 34,400 for 2026. 

Important: These deductions are not automatic. You are responsible for checking whether you qualify and for entering the relevant deductions on your Danish tax assessment. Keep your documentation in case the Danish Tax Agency requests it.

TRANSPORT TO DENMARK

You must arrange and pay for your own transport to Denmark.

 If possible, bring your own car. A car can make your stay easier and more convenient, as you may need to travel between different farm locations and your accommodation in nearby houses. It will also give you more freedom to explore the local area.

TRACTOR DRIVING & FORKLIFT CERTIFICATE – ADVANTAGES, NOT REQUIREMENTS

These qualifications are wishes from the company and will be considered positively. However, our main priority is to employ good Team Leaders who can lead people, organize the daily work and take responsibility.

HOW TO APPLY:

If you wish to apply, send an email to job@hyldetoftegaard.dk and you will receive an application form. See more at www.hyldetoftegaard.dk

Applicants wishing to attend an employment interview in Craiova must submit their completed application form and a copy of their ID card in advance.

You will then receive a separate invitation, which must be brought to the interview together with documentation of your previous work experience, as outlined in the instructions

 Important – Application Feedback

Only qualified applicants will be contacted.

If you do not receive a response from the company within 14 days of submitting your application, please consider that your application has not been successful and that you have not been selected to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.

Thank you for your interest and understanding.

jobs.title: Research Assistant followed by a Double Degree PhD position in Urban Design and Pedestrian Experience with AI and VR
jobs.employer: KU - SCIENCE - IGN frb campus omr. 3
jobs.description:
Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen Within the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (MSCA), University of Copenhagen is offering a 1-year Research Assistant (RA) position starting 1 April 2027 (or as soon as possible thereafter), which then leads to a 3-year PhD fellowship for a Doctoral Candidate (DC). The combined position is part of the research project STEP-UP (Safe, Thriving, and Engaged Pedestrians in Urban Public Spaces), which is funded by the European Union’s Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA), Doctoral Networks (DN), Call: HORIZON-MSCA-2025-DN-01. The STEP-UP network supports 10 PhD Candidates in investigating pedestrian behaviour and mobility in urban environments. The 10 PhD projects are closely linked, contributing complementary perspectives to a shared research agenda in three areas: individual and interpersonal aspects of pedestrian behaviour, environmental and infrastructural barriers to walking, and interactions between pedestrians and other road users. The aim is to improve the understanding of pedestrian mobility and support the development of safer and more inclusive urban public spaces. STEP-UP brings together academic and non-academic partners to train 10 doctoral candidates through an international Joint Doctorate programme. The candidates benefit from joint supervision by researchers at partner institutions, an integrated doctoral training programme, and opportunities for interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral collaboration, including research secondments at partner organisations. In addition to specialised scientific knowledge, they develop transferable skills in areas such as research communication and dissemination. The programme prepares them for careers in research and other fields related to transport and urban development. For a description of the STEP-UP project and descriptions of all 10 PhD positions, please visit the STEP-UP project’s website https://www.project-stepup.eu/ STEP-UP is based on 4-year double PhD degree programs. This means that the successful applicant will also be enrolled in a partner university’s PhD programme. Job and project description The RA position will entail carrying out a literature review of the research field, identifying current research gaps, and preparing for data collection. The PhD position will entail carrying out the research activities of the research project as described below. Your key tasks as a PhD fellow at the Faculty of SCIENCE are to:
  • Conduct an independent research project under supervision.
  • Complete PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participate in active research environments including a mandatory stay for a minimum of 12 months at the partner university (see below for further details).
  • Contribute to teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project (e.g., at conferences, meetings, etc.)
  • Write a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
About the research project The project “Analysis of pedestrian experience and behaviour using Artificial Intelligence and Virtual Reality” will investigate how streetscape design elements influence pedestrian experience and behaviour using AI and VR. Advances in AI-driven environment generation and VR immersion now enable the creation and systematic testing of diverse, immersive streetscape scenarios, allowing assessment of pedestrian experience and behaviour that was previously infeasible. This PhD project will: (1) use AI tools to generate and manipulate 3D streetscape scenarios representing diverse urban design interventions; (2) integrate these environments into a VR platform for immersive pedestrian-experience; (3) conduct controlled experiments measuring emotional, behavioural and perceptual responses to assess walkability, experience and behaviour; and (4) run co-creation workshops with diverse groups (young and older adults, diverse genders and people with disabilities) and stakeholders (municipalities, local businesses, NGOs) to validate, critically assess and refine the methodology and findings. Partner university: University of Leeds. Planned secondments at University of Leeds: M12–M17 and M36–M47 Main Supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Kostas Mouratidis, University of Copenhagen, email: km@ign.ku.dk. Co-supervisor: Prof. Natasha Merat, University of Leeds, email: N.Merat@its.leeds.ac.uk Place of employment The primary place of employment will be Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art hardware and software. More information on the department can be found here: https://ign.ku.dk/english/ During the PhD programme of research the candidate will be on a secondment for minimum 12 months in total at the partner university. Required qualifications As an applicant you must have:
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at UCPH, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Urban Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Psychology, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Sociology, or related-disciplines. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at the University of Leeds, you are required to fulfil the requirements described here: https://environment.leeds.ac.uk/transport-research-degrees/doc/entry-requirements-3
  • Fluency in English (see Entry requirements | University of Leeds) and excellent communications skills.
Applicants will also be required to meet the European Commission’s MSCA Doctoral Network eligibility criteria, notably:
  • Mobility Rule - Applicants can be of any nationality and must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the start of their employment at UCPH. Compulsory national service, short stays such as holidays, and time spent as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention are not considered.
  • Doctoral Candidate requirement – the applicant must not be in possession of a doctoral degree at the first day of the employment. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis, but who have not yet been awarded the doctoral degree are not eligible.
Please note that you will only be considered for the position if you fulfil both above eligibility criteria. Who are we looking for? We are looking for candidates within the field(s) of spatial, engineering, or behavioural sciences. Applicants can have a background in Urban and Regional Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Psychology, Sociology, or related disciplines. The following experiences and skills will be emphasised. Applicants are encouraged to provide relevant details and supporting evidence, where applicable:
  • Urban design / urban planning
  • Human-environment interactions
  • Data analysis / statistical analysis
  • Programming and/or design skills
Personal attributes that are desirable:
  • Strong motivation for high-quality research
  • Collaborative spirit
  • Systematic approach to research
  • Attention to detail
Key criteria for the assessment of applicants
  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Relevance of studies, coursework, and thesis
  • Relevant work experience (if any)
  • Publications (if any)
  • The grade point average achieved
  • Other professional activities
  • Language skills
  • Quality and relevance of project proposal
  • The successful applicant is also required to be enterprising and to possess good interpersonal skills
Terms of employment The arrangement concerns two separate fixed-term positions: initially as a Research Assistant, leading towards an appointment as a PhD fellow. The respective durations of the two positions are 1 year and 3 years. The position as a PhD fellow is contingent upon the successful enrolment of a suitable candidate in the PhD School at the University of Copenhagen, as well as satisfactory completion of the Research Assistant period. These assessments will be carried out 3-6 months prior to the expiry of the Research Assistant contract. The start date is 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the requirements from the European Commission related to the MSCA programme and the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,850 DKK/roughly 4,260 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund. Application and assessment procedure Your application, written in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” below and must include the following documents in PDF format:
  • Motivated letter of application (max. one page)
  • A project proposal (max 5 pages where the candidate presents a proposal on how they wish to approach their project including theory and methods)
  • CV incl. education, experience, language skills, publication list (if any), and other skills relevant for the position
  • Certified copy of original master’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD position employment, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. Applicants with a master´s degree from abroad should also enclose a short description of the grading scale used. Certified copy of original bachelor’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If the applicant has completed a combined bachelor’s and master’s education (e.g. 5-year combined master’s), the applicant should submit the combined diploma, transcript of records, and authorised English translations if issued in other language than English or Danish.
  • Language diplomas or language test results (if any)
The deadline for applications is 20 December 2026, at 23.59pm CET. We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements. The further process After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. The assessor makes a non-prioritised assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement. Once the assessment work has been completed, each applicant can comment on the part of the assessment that relates to him/herself. The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. You may read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/ For more information on working and living in Denmark visit http://ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility) and https://www.workindenmark.dk. Interviews are expected to take place in the begining of February 2027. Questions For specific information about the PhD position, please contact the principal supervisor, Kostas Mouratidis at km@ign.ku.dk. The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.
