jobs.title: MONTER/KA III (821206) U ODJELU STROJARSKOG ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

•SSS/KV – strojarskog ili metalskog smjera

•2 godine radnog iskustva

•vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

•sudjeluje u svim monterskim radovima na terenu i u radionici; izmjeni crpnih agregata, izmjeni zaporno - regulacijske armature (zasuni, hidrostopovi, leptirice ručne i elektro-mot.), rekonstrukcije cijelih strojarnica, komora, objekata, generalnih popravaka crpnih agregata, kompresora i ostalih strojeva, utovar i istovar crpnih agregata i ostale opreme uz pomoć dizalice na kamion •sudjeluje u izmjeni, montaži i demontaži svih vrsta cijevnih instalacija, ventila, uređaja i opreme vezane uz objekte crpljenja •vrši izradu raznih konstrukcija, pomoćnih naprava, bravarskih radova na izradi fazonskih komada, upora i sl. •samostalno izvodi popravke i remonte crpnih agregata i ostalih pomoćnih uređaja manjih kapaciteta i gabarita •po potrebi, sudjeluje u radovima na održavanju hidroforskih postrojenja •obavezan je odazvati se na poziv dispečera poradi intervencije i izvan radnog vremena

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821206) u Odjelu strojarskog održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

•životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada •dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) •dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis/potvrda o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ne stariji od 7 dana od dana prijave na natječaj) •presliku važeće vozačke dozvole •uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja)

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821206) u Odjelu strojarskog održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

jobs.title: OPERATER ZA UPOV I CP (PODRUŽNICA NIN-VIR-PRIVLAKA-VRSI)
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar a u skladu sa Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Ivan Bašić, dipl. ing. el. objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto: Operater za UPOV i CP

(Podružnica Nin-Vir-Privlaka-Vrsi)

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Zahtijevana kvalifikacija: KV/SSS/VKV — završena trogodišnja strukovna škola ili srednja škola; Razine: 3., 4.1., 4.2., 5. - Tehničko usmjerenje — strojarstvo, elektrotehnika, kemijski smjer ili drugi srodan tehnički smjer

Mjesto rada: Nin

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 6 mjeseci radnog iskustva u srodnim tehničkim ili pogonskim poslovima; radno iskustvo na UPOV-u ili crpnim postajama je prednost

Vozačka dozvola B kategorije, poželjno C kategorija

Ostala znanja i vještine: osnovno poznavanje SCADA/NUS sustava poželjno; znanja sukladno pozitivnoj zakonskoj regulativi i aktima Društva; fizička sposobnost za rad u pogonu i na terenu; osposobljavanje za rad s opasnim kemikalijama

Plaća: Visina plaće utvrdit će se unutar pripadajućeg platnog razreda, ovisno o stručnim kvalifikacijama, radnom iskustvu, kompetencijama i drugim objektivnim kriterijima, sukladno važećim internim aktima Društva; Kandidati će prije pristupanja razgovoru biti obaviješteni o pripadajućem platnom razredu i predviđenom rasponu bruto plaće za navedeno radno mjesto.

Opis posla:

  • Svakodnevno praćenje i rukovanje opremom i uređajima na UPOV-u te na crpnim postajama (CP) odvodnje i vodoopskrbe na području Podružnice;
  • Vođenje tehnološkog procesa pročišćavanja otpadnih voda na UPOV-u prema Pravilniku o radu i održavanju uređaja, uputama i ostalim aktima;
  • Rutinsko održavanje opreme UPOV-a i crpnih postaja: remont, servis, zamjena ulja, podmazivanje zasuna i opreme za pročišćavanje;
  • Rukovanje zasunima i zapornicama ručnim ili daljinskim upravljanjem; pokretanje i zaustavljanje crpki prema uputama nadređenog;
  • Nadopuna kemikalija u spremnike prema radnim postupcima i uputama; rukovanje opasnim kemikalijama sukladno propisanim mjerama sigurnosti;
  • Praćenje i bilježenje parametara rada opreme, alarma i događaja te izvještavanje Voditelja UPOV-a Podružnice o anomalijama;
  • Praćenje rada NUS-a crpnih postaja; obavještavanje nadređenih o dojava s terena;
  • Svakodnevno održavanje opreme, uređaja, građevina i okoliša UPOV-a te crpnih postaja;
  • Priprema i organizacija odvoza i zbrinjavanja otpada prema Pravilniku o zbrinjavanju otpada s pročišćivača otpadnih voda;
  • Vođenje dnevnih statistika i zapisa o radu UPOV-a i crpnih postaja; vođenje obveznih knjiga i evidencija;
  • Sudjeluje, prema rasporedu, u radu dežurne službe i pripravnosti za obavljanje hitnih intervencija:

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme;
  3. Elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu;
  4. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije;

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Prethodna provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata provest će se putem intervjua, tijekom kojeg će se procjenjivati poznavanje poslova i radnih zadataka iz opisa radnog mjesta.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Operater za UPOV i CP „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/

Rok za predaju prijava je 30.11.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično u svakoj fazi postupka, bez obveze navođenja razloga.

jobs.title: Praktisk medarbejder til heste- og smådyrsværksted på Tinnetgaard
jobs.description:
Vil du bruge dine praktiske kompetencer og din erfaring med heste i et meningsfuldt pædagogisk arbejde med unge?  

På Tinnetgaard søger vi en engageret og praktisk stærk medarbejder til vores heste- og smådyrsværksted. Stillingen rummer både drift, dyrehold og pædagogisk arbejde med unge med særlige behov. Heste- og smådyrsværkstedet er en central del af vores tilbud. Her bruger vi arbejdet med dyr og natur som en ramme for ansvar, mestring, ro og relation. 

Om Tinnetgaard 

Tinnetgaard er en Bo- og Erhvervsskole for unge med særlige behov. Vores pædagogiske tilgang er praksisnær og relations båret. Vi arbejder med struktur, tydelighed og meningsfulde aktiviteter som fundament for trivsel og udvikling. 

Om stillingen 

Stillingen forener to spor: 

Det praktiske og landbrugsfaglige 

  • Daglig pasning, fodring og pleje af heste og smådyr 

  • Håndtering, træning og generel hestefaglig vurdering 

  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af hegn, udearealer, mv og struktur i driften 

Det pædagogiske arbejde 

  • Inddragelse af de unge i daglige opgaver 

  • Skabe trygge, forudsigelige rammer og tydelig struktur 

  • Arbejde relations orienteret og anerkendende 

  • Understøtte de unges udvikling gennem ansvar og praktisk deltagelse 

  • Samarbejde tværfagligt med kolleger omkring den enkelte unge 

Du skal kunne balancere faglig tydelighed med ro og rummelighed. Arbejdet kræver både praktisk handlekraft og pædagogisk forståelse. 

 

Vi søger dig, der: 

  • Har erfaring med heste og praktisk arbejde i omkring heste  

  • Har erfaring med traktorkørsel og maskinkendskab 

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og udendørsopgaver året rundt 

  • Har interesse for – eller erfaring med – unge med særlige behov 

  • Er robust, stabil og relations kompetent 

  • Kan sætte tydelige rammer og bevare roen 

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for både dyr og mennesker 

  • Pædagogisk erfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har den rette erfaring og tilgang. 

  • Er indstillet på varierede arbejdstider. Arbejdet indebærer en aftenvagt om uge og weekendarbejde ca. hver 3. weekend.  

  • Stillingen er en 37 timers stilling. 

Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.  

Skriftlig ansøgning med referencer sendes til Henning Kristensen pr. mail til henning@tinnetgaard.dk Der er ingen rundvisning uden forudgående aftale. For yderlig information kan Henning kontaktes på 2752-2946.  

Vi ansætter når den rette ansøger er fundet.  

Læs om Tinnetgaard på www.tinnetgaard.dk eller på vores Facebook.

jobs.title: Afdelingsleder til McDonald’s Kronen Vanløse
jobs.description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for et stærkt team og være med til at skabe resultater – hver eneste dag?

Hos McDonald’s Kronen Vanløse søger vi en engageret og handlekraftig afdelingsleder, der brænder for ledelse, mennesker og restaurantdrift. Vi leder efter dig, der trives i en hverdag med højt tempo, mange bolde i luften og et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi sammen arbejder for at skabe gode gæsteoplevelser og resultater, vi kan være stolte af.

Som afdelingsleder bliver du en vigtig del af restaurantens lederteam, hvor du får ansvar for dit eget område og samtidig bidrager aktivt til den samlede drift og udvikling af restauranten.

Dine ansvarsområder

Som afdelingsleder får du en central rolle i at sikre, at restauranten fungerer effektivt, og at både gæster og medarbejdere oplever en hverdag præget af kvalitet, struktur og godt samarbejde.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

·       Sikre den daglige drift inden for dit eget ansvarsområde med fokus på kvalitet, service og gæstetilfredshed.

·       Skabe gode rammer for medarbejdernes trivsel, udvikling og samarbejde.

·       Arbejde målrettet med restaurantens økonomi, nøgletal og driftsresultater.

·       Sikre, at McDonald’s standarder for kvalitet, service, renlighed og fødevaresikkerhed efterleves.

·       Bidrage til planlægning og gennemførelse af lokale markedsføringsaktiviteter og kampagner.

·       Følge op på restaurantens mål og omsætte planer til konkrete handlinger i hverdagen.

·       Samarbejde tæt med restaurantchefen og det øvrige lederteam om at udvikle restauranten og optimere arbejdsgangene.

·       Træde til som en del af den daglige ledelse, når restaurantchefen ikke er til stede.

Dit ansvarsområde kan løbende tilpasses restaurantens behov, og du skal derfor have lyst til at arbejde bredt med både mennesker, drift og forretningsmæssige resultater.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er en synlig og nærværende leder, der formår at skabe følgeskab gennem tydelig kommunikation, engagement og gode relationer.

Du tager ansvar, følger op på aftaler og går forrest, når der er brug for det. Samtidig ved du, at gode resultater skabes gennem mennesker, og at et stærkt team kræver både klare forventninger, løbende feedback og plads til udvikling.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

·       Har erfaring med ledelse og gerne fra restaurationsbranchen, detailhandel eller en anden driftsorienteret organisation.

·       Trives med at arbejde struktureret med mål, nøgletal og opfølgning.

·       Kan bevare overblikket og træffe beslutninger, også når tempoet er højt.

·       Er god til at motivere, udvikle og engagere medarbejdere.

·       Arbejder løsningsorienteret og tager initiativ til at forbedre arbejdsgange.

·       Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø.

·       Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og restaurantens skiftende behov.

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar, udvikle dine ledelseskompetencer og skabe resultater sammen med andre.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

Hos McDonald’s Kronen Vanløse bliver du en del af et lederteam, hvor samarbejde, ansvarlighed og udvikling er afgørende for vores fælles succes.

Vi tilbyder dig:

·       En fuldtidsstilling på gennemsnitligt 37 timer om ugen.

·       En fast månedsløn

·       Pensionsordning hos PFA Pension.

·       Sundhedsforsikring.

·       Ferie med løn og ferietillæg efter gældende regler samt feriefridage efter virksomhedens gældende vilkår.

·       Mulighed for relevant efteruddannelse og videreudvikling af dine ledelseskompetencer.

·       En hverdag med ansvar, variation og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel for både medarbejdere og forretning.

·       Et stærkt lederfællesskab, hvor vi arbejder sammen om at skabe gode gæsteoplevelser og nå vores mål.

Arbejdstiden planlægges i vagtplanen og kan variere i forhold til restaurantens åbningstider og driftsbehov.

Vil du være med på holdet?

Hvis du kan se dig selv som en del af vores lederteam, og du motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem mennesker, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Arbejdssted: McDonald’s Kronen Vanløse, Vanløse Torv 1, 2720 Vanløse.

Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt

Send din ansøgning og dit CV, og fortæl os, hvorfor netop du er den rette til at være med til at udvikle vores restaurant og skabe en hverdag, hvor både gæster og medarbejdere trives.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description:
Do you have a strong technical mindset and a passion for structure, quality, and well-prepared offshore execution? Do you want to play a key role in ensuring that service campaigns are executed safely, efficiently, and with the highest documentation standards? Then you might be our new Project Engineer within Balance of Plant Support at Semco Maritime. Your positionAs our new Project Engineer, you will be a vital part of the Balance of Plant Support team, where your primary responsibility will be to ensure the technical preparation and documentation required for safe and efficient offshore execution.You will work closely with Project Managers, Site Managers, HSE, and engineering disciplines to ensure that all documentation — including RAMS, checklists, and execution plans — is complete, accurate, and aligned with project and client requirements. In this role, you will be at the forefront of ensuring documentation excellence and quality across our service projects.At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value, and through your work you will actively contribute to maintaining and strengthening our safety culture by ensuring that offshore activities are thoroughly prepared and documented.Your place of work will be at either Global HQ in Esbjerg, in Copenhagen, in Aarhus, in Hamburg or in Emden in Germany, with occasional travel related to service campaigns. The position is full-time. “High-quality technical preparation is the foundation for safe offshore execution. In this role, you will make a direct impact on how our projects are prepared and delivered.”  - Senior Manager, BoP Support, Michael Andersen Your tasks & responsibilitiesAs Project Engineer within BoP support, you will support the planning and execution of service activities through structured and high-quality documentation.Your key tasks will include:
  • Preparing and maintaining project documentation for offshore service activities
  • Developing RAMS, work descriptions, and execution plans in close collaboration with project teams
  • Creating and maintaining offshore checklists and readiness documentation
  • Ensuring documentation complies with internal standards, client requirements, and applicable regulations
  • Supporting Project Leaders and Site Managers with documentation reviews and updates
  • Ensuring high-quality reporting before, during, and after offshore execution
  • Contributing to continuous improvement of documentation standards, templates, and processes
  • Supporting tender activities by providing technical input, developing execution concepts, and contributing to scope, methodology, and resource planning
 Your profile & qualificationsWe are looking for a structured and detail-oriented Project Engineer who takes ownership of quality and thrives in a collaborative project environment.To succeed in this role, you likely have:
  • A relevant technical education, for example within marine, mechanical, electrical, offshore, or a similar engineering discipline
  • Experience in project engineering, service operations, or offshore execution (advantageous)
  • A good understanding of the requirements associated with offshore or industrial project execution
  • Experience working with RAMS, work packs, Service Reporting or other execution documentation
  • A high focus on quality, structure, and accuracy
  • Strong communication skills in English. German is considered an advantage
  • A proactive and solution-oriented mindset

How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Enterprise, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how enterprise software is sold and the Solutions Consultant is the cornerstone of that model. As an SC for the Enterprise market for France, you’ll own the full customer journey: from prospecting, first meeting through workflow design, commercial close, workflow implementation, expansion & renewal planning. You are the single owner of your accounts, accountable for ensuring what you sell actually gets realized.

You’ll build live in front of customers, translate workflow designs into commercial outcomes, and be a trusted partner with genuine continuity across the entire relationship. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


ABOUT NOTION IN FRANCE

While our local team is still growing, France is already Notion’s largest market in EMEA by number of users. Teams at more than 80% of CAC 40 companies use Notion, and we’re proud to support French organisations including Qonto, Pennylane, Alan and AXA Climate. As we grow our presence in France, you’ll have the opportunity to build on that momentum and help shape what comes next. ⁠⁠ ⁠⁠ ⁠⁠ ⁠⁠

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the full customer lifecycle—new logo, expansion, and renewal—as the single account owner for your book of business, with responsibility for ensuring credits sold translate into credits consumed

 - Build and own a strong pipeline of self-sourced opportunities across your target accounts through proactive outbound prospecting.

 - Design and build workflow solutions live with customers: the discovery is the demo, not the slide deck—you’ll run discovery, design current-to-future-state workflow architecture, and co-build in Notion with the customer

 - Partner with BDRs on target account planning and co-own the outbound motion for your book, running direct outreach to priority stakeholders alongside BDR-sourced pipeline

 - Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path

 - Guide customers through early implementation with a clear adoption plan and handoff to Outcomes Architects for ongoing multi-workflow expansion

 - Partner with Outcomes Architects (OA) on onboarding, adoption plans, expansion strategies, and renewal execution—owning the commercial arc while OAs drive day-to-day workflow adoption

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience selling technical products to technical buyers in the enterprise segment (3000+ employees)

 - Be a self-starter who owns your pipeline—proactively generating opportunities through prospecting and outbound outreach, and driving them from first contact through to conversion.

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot in front of a customer without a specialist in the room

 - Strong prospecting, discovery and qualification instincts, with the ability to map customer workflows and translate them into commercial outcomes and adoption plans

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder interactions including procurement, legal, and security review cycles

 - Strong

 - You can own the room - you operate with agency and urgency to bring new ideas and workflows to our customers and present simple ways to solve complex problems

 - A self-starter who owns your pipeline—proactively generating opportunities through prospecting and outbound outreach, and driving them from first contact through to conversion

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools & learning new ways of working

 - Native or bilingual level fluency French business-level English proficiency.

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new logo acquisition and expansion motions
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or CS team as part of an integrated customer motion

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €270,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Hybrid




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Massage Therapist (Zero hour Contract)
jobs.description:
The role:

As a Massage Therapist in our Copenhagen team, your role is to ensure clients' well-being by performing relaxing and cosmetic treatments following our established protocols. You'll also maintain our relaxation spaces in top condition with all the necessary materials for a perfect AIRE experience.

Key responsibilities:

Customer Experience:

  • Deliver relaxing treatments, including body and facial treatments and exfoliations, following AIRE's protocols and techniques for each. 

  • Clearly communicate treatment details and product information to clients, following our provided manual and protocols. 

  • Keep an ample supply of necessary products for customer experiences, promptly reporting any shortages or low stock. 

  • Maintain consistency in couples' treatments and coordinate effectively with partner therapists for a seamless experience.

Workplace:

  • Keep work areas clean and ready for customer experiences per company protocols. 

  • Supervise facility sanitation, product maintenance, and cleaning between treatments.  

  • Ensure environmental conditions meet protocol standards for noise, temperature, and humidity.

You'll receive thorough training to explore our diverse range of treatments and truly grasp the essence of AIRE's unique approach.

We're excited to welcome you to our team in Copenhagen and invite you to immerse yourself in the AIRE experience! 

Who we are looking for:

  • You have at least one year of experience in a similar role.

  • You hold a valid Massage Therapist course or certification

  • Fluent in English, and if you know Danish, that's a fantastic bonus!

  • You're genuinely customer-focused and excel at connecting with people

  • Your schedule is flexible, allowing you to work evenings, holidays, and weekends when necessary

Why you should join us:

  • Salary: Your hourly salary will be 182 DKK.

  • Zero hour Contract.

  • Supplement Pay: You will earn a supplement pay on weekends and holidays

  • Additional Pay Opportunities: You can earn extra pay through tips. In addition, we pay overtime

  • Career Progression: Explore career progression opportunities within our Therapists team: Senior Therapist, Supervisor, Manager

  • Pension Contribution: AIRE will contribute to your pension scheme

  • Referral Program: Get rewarded for referring potential colleagues

  • Birthday Gift: Enjoy an AIRE experience on your birthday!

  • Discounts: Benefit from 30% off on all our AIRE experiences

  • Canteen Perks: Access to coffee at our canteen, and fruits on the weekends!

  • Inclusive Work Environment: At AIRE, team spirit is our greatest asset! We are proud to have a welcoming and inclusive work environment where everyone's opinions and backgrounds are heard and respected. 

Copenhagen location

You will be delighted with our place in Copenhagen, located in the Carlsberg Byen district, where the former Carlsberg factory has been given a new lease of life and now is part of the magical AIRE atmosphere.

About

Looking ahead, we're excited about our upcoming Los Angeles and Madrid facilities soon.

jobs.title: DGI Storkøbenhavn søger løbekonsulent
jobs.description:
Deltidsstilling med tiltrædelse 1. februar 2027

Vil du være en del af en organisation, som går forrest i udviklingen af idrætsforeningerne? Har du en faglighed inden for løb og et stærkt foreningskendskab? Har du erfaringer med funktionel træning og udvikling af træningstilbud? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i DGI Storkøbenhavn.

Vi søger en konsulent, som kan arbejde strategisk og er en drivkraft i udviklingen af løbeklubberne i Storkøbenhavn. Med udgangspunkt i din faglige viden og erfaring skal du samarbejde med klubberne om udvikling, aktiviteter og uddannelse af trænere og ledere. Du understøtter dem i deres dagligdag og er deres sparringspartner. 

Udover et tæt makkerskab med atletikkonsulenten og den administrative koordinator vil du indgå i teams med kolleger, som dækker andre idrætter. Generelt søger vi at skabe et godt arbejdsfællesskab med masser af mulighed for sparring og samarbejde.

Det er især vigtigt, at du kan drive og udvikle vores kursus- og uddannelsesområde, så vores tilbud til løbeklubber, frivillige og trænere er relevante og af høj kvalitet. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • kvalificere vores udbud af kurser og uddannelser
  • afdække behov hos foreninger og omsætte dem til relevante tilbud
  • udvikle nye kurser, uddannelser og skræddersyede forløb
  • rekruttere de rette undervisere og samarbejde tæt med dem
  • arbejde med synlighed og øge deltagelsen på vores kurser

Cirka halvdelen af stillingen er varetagelse af vores indsatser i Trackfit, som udrulles nationalt. Trackfit er et træningstilbud til alle, der har lyst til en solid og sjov grundtræning, hvor hele kroppen aktiveres. Konceptet har mange variationsmuligheder og kan målrettes både unge og voksne. Du skal sætte fart på udbredelsen af Trackfit i både atletik- og løbeklubber. 

Din profil:

  • Faglig viden om Løb og gerne også funktionel træning
  • Et skarpt blik for både udvikling og udbredelse af kurser og uddannelser
  • Erfaring som konsulent eller projektleder; du ved, hvordan man skaber fremdrift og resultater
  • Erfaring med foreningsudvikling og gerne kendskab til løbeklubberne i Storkøbenhavn
  • En udadvendt og opsøgende tilgang; du trives med at skabe relationer og netværk
  • Kompetent bruger af administrative systemer

Læs mere om DGI Løb & Gang samt Trackfit og DGI Atletik 

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 25 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse d. 1. februar 2027

Aften-/weekendarbejde kan forekomme.

DGI Storkøbenhavn

Som idrætsforeningernes udviklingshus arbejder vi for at understøtte og udvikle idrætsforeningerne i en by i konstant forandring. Vi dækker 11 kommuner og repræsenterer over 650 idrætsforeninger, der har mere end 300.000 medlemmer. Vi tilbyder et godt arbejdsmiljø med ca. 50 passionerede medarbejdere. Kontoret ligger i moderne lokaler centralt i København på Vesterbrogade. AnsøgningSpørgsmål vedrørende stillingen kan rettes til idrætschef Bettina Güleryüz på bdg@dgi.dk, tlf. 28 30 50 51 

Ansøgningen sendes senest søndag d. 13. december kl. 23.59Der afholdes samtaler tirsdag d. 15. december og evt. anden samtale torsdag d. 17. december

jobs.title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Team Lead (APJ)
Manager, Forward Deployed Architect, Japan & Korea
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Manager, Forward Deployed Architect, Japan & Korea, you will lead a team that helps enterprise customers turn AI ambition into operational reality. You will manage and develop Forward Deployed Architects across Japan and Korea, helping customers build meaningful workflows and solutions while establishing the practices that enable consistent, high-quality delivery.

This is a player-coach role for a builder, seller, and people leader. Your primary impact will come through the performance and growth of your team, rather than through personally owning delivery. You will stay close to customers and engagements, working with account teams from presales through delivery, coaching your team, and contributing hands-on when needed. You will report to the Head of Services, Forward Deployed, APAC.

You will partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcome Architects to identify opportunities, shape engagements, and connect proposed solutions to customer outcomes. You will also manage staffing and delivery, support commercial and contractual processes, and build repeatable ways of working with internal teams and service partners.

You will partner with Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) managers on engagements that require engineering expertise. The FDA organization owns time-bound Services engagements, including discovery, solution architecture, implementation, launch readiness, enablement, outcome delivery, and handoff. FDE owns engineering-intensive implementation requiring production code or deep technical specialization. Together, you will establish clear engagement boundaries, staffing and escalation mechanisms, quality standards, and a unified customer experience.

This is an opportunity to help define what forward-deployed work looks like at Notion as we evolve into an Agent OS. You will help customers put new AI-powered workflows into practice, share what works with partners, and shape an emerging service in a fast-changing environment.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

Customer delivery

 - Guide the Japan and Korea portfolio from discovery and solution design through implementation, enablement, and handoff, keeping customer outcomes at the center of each engagement.

 - Review delivery health, scope, budget, timelines, and risks; coach team members through challenges and support escalations and change requests.

 - Stay close to strategic engagements and customer stakeholders, providing guidance and executive support when needed.

 - Assign the right team members to engagements, establish co-delivery approaches, and provide hands-on implementation support when needed.

 - Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and other stakeholders when engagements require engineering expertise, with clear ownership and handoffs.

 - Improve delivery quality and consistency through playbooks, templates, reference architectures, quality reviews, and lessons learned, developed and shared with teams and service partners.

Pre-sales and solution scoping

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants, Outcome Architects, and account teams to identify customer needs and opportunities for paid and unpaid Services engagements.

 - Lead or support discovery and shape proposals, defining desired business outcomes, solution approach, deliverables, implementation plans, timelines, and risks.

 - Qualify and prioritize incoming opportunities against customer needs, commercial value, delivery risk, and available capacity. Make clear decisions to accept, defer, redirect, or decline work.

 - Develop a target-account strategy and proactively drive joint Services proposals with Solutions Consultants during your first six months.

 - Manage Services opportunities and forecasts, and support customer contracts, waivers, and change orders throughout the engagement lifecycle.

 - Turn recurring customer needs into packaged solutions, and share field insights and lessons with regional peers, Product, Engineering, PMM, and Services leadership.

Team management and operations

 - Hire, onboard, manage, and retain Forward Deployed Architects across Japan and Korea, setting clear expectations and managing performance against the FDA levels framework.

 - Develop team members through engagement reviews, shadowing, work-product feedback, coaching, and regular career conversations.

 - Turn delivery experience into practical guidance and training; set standards for discovery, solution architecture, implementation, engagement leadership, and customer enablement.

 - Manage staffing and capacity across presales and delivery, matching work to skills and availability while protecting time for onboarding, coaching, and reusable assets.

 - Build effective operating practices and run a regular cadence to review pipeline, demand, allocation, delivery health, and risks, adjusting priorities as needs change.

 - Collaborate with FDA and FDE managers in other regions to share engagement updates, learning, and best practices.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in professional services, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing technology role.

 - Experience across the enterprise services lifecycle, from presales and discovery through proposals, contract management, and delivery. Strong commercial and delivery judgment, including estimation, margin awareness, risk, change control, and escalation.

 - Experience managing and developing a team, including hiring, onboarding, feedback, performance management, career development, and team health.

 - Ability to turn personal expertise into repeatable coaching, training, and standards that improve team performance, and experience developing packaged services or reusable delivery methods and assets.

 - Experience managing staffing and capacity across concurrent engagements, and designing intake and prioritization processes that balance customer urgency, strategic value, delivery risk, and available capacity.

 - Hands-on experience building and delivering technology or AI solutions, with tangible examples and a builder mindset. Technical fluency across areas such as AI workflows, enterprise systems, APIs, integrations, data, automation, and governance; production coding is not required, but you must be able to reason through tradeoffs and partner credibly with FDE.

 - Strong customer-facing discovery, communication, problem-solving, and solution architecture skills, with the ability to review complex work, guide teams, and align stakeholders around outcomes.

 - Fluency in Japanese and English, and the ability to work across teams and customers in Japan and Korea.

 - Comfort navigating ambiguity, learning quickly, and adapting strategy and execution as the business evolves.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Fluency in Korean.

 - Experience designing, building, or selling AI agent workflows.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCP, Workers, coding agents, or developer-platform workflows. Prior Notion experience is not required.

 - Experience partnering with engineering teams and service partners on customer engagements.

 - Experience building or improving a team, practice, or operating model.
   
   #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Product and Marketing
Premium Support Engineer (Japan)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Provide swift, high-priority support to Premium customers, responding within strict SLAs.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Identify recurring issues and collaborate internally to reduce time-to-resolution.

 - Contribute to internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Professional fluency in English and Japanese, both written and verbal.

 - Experience providing rapid-response support to high-value or enterprise customers.

 - Strong debugging skills with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication under time pressure — able to convey technical concepts clearly and calmly.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale.

This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume.

 - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping.

 - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on.

 - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load.

 - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles.

 - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter.

 - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck.

 - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress.

jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. Description & Expectation:

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the R&D team and take a key role in shaping and driving our defence product portfolio.

You will join the R&D organisation and work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business. The role combines strategic product management, defining product direction, priorities, positioning, and roadmap, with the operational responsibility of turning that direction into clear development priorities and ensuring progress across the organisation.

Our defence products combine RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into integrated solutions for the detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

You will work closely with engineering, commercial teams, partners, and end users to understand operational needs, translate market and customer insight into product priorities, manage and communicate the product roadmap, and help drive development from early concepts through product releases and continued improvement.

This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between the big picture and the detail: understanding where the product needs to go, while also staying close enough to development, customers, and delivery to help make it happen.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to take end-to-end ownership of product development and evolution. You will:

  • Own and drive product roadmaps aligned with Quadsat's strategy, market opportunities, and customer needs.
  • Translate customer, operational, and commercial input into clear product priorities and development initiatives.
  • Drive development from concept through implementation, validation, release, and continued improvement.
  • Maintain an overview of scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and progress, and communicate product status clearly across the organisation.

  • Facilitate collaboration across R&D, Business Development, Marketing, Production, Quality, and other key stakeholders.
  • Stay close to customers, partners, and the defence industry, working with the commercial organisation to understand emerging needs and translate them into product direction.

The role offers significant ownership and the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we bring it to market, while remaining closely involved in the technical development required to make it happen.

Knowledge & Skills:

In addition, you bring:

  • Experience translating customer or market needs into technical products and development priorities.

  • Experience from the defence industry or another mission-critical technical domain.
  • A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

jobs.title: RF Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

jobs.description:

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret souschef til Hoppes Kitchen & Drinks, beliggende i de charmerende omgivelser på Læderstræde i København K. Har du en passion for mad, stærke lederevner og lyst til at tage ansvar i et dynamisk køkken, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

  • Støtte, motivere og vejlede køkkenteamet under både daglig drift og travle serviceperioder

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har solid erfaring som kok, gerne med erfaring fra en lignende stilling

Hos Hoppes Kitchen & Drinks tror vi på, at glade medarbejdere skaber de bedste gæsteoplevelser. Vi prioriterer trivsel, respekt og samarbejde – og vi sørger for, at du får både udfordringer, ansvar og opbakning i dit daglige arbejde.

jobs.title: Restaurantdriftsleder / Restaurant Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Restaurant Operations Manager

About Us

At Bagel Bites, we believe that good food, excellent customer service, and efficient restaurant management go hand in hand.

Following a restructuring of our management team, we are looking for a responsible, motivated, and flexible employee to take charge of the restaurant's daily operations.

The position combines restaurant management, kitchen duties, customer service, purchasing, and administrative responsibilities. The successful candidate must be willing to take an active role in all aspects of the restaurant's operations, including physically working in the kitchen.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the overall daily operation of the restaurant. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Managing and coordinating the restaurant's daily operations.

  • Supervising employees, delegating tasks, preparing work schedules, and ensuring efficient teamwork.

  • Preparing and serving fast food, including sandwiches, burgers, bagels, and other menu items.

  • Actively participating in kitchen activities, food preparation, cleaning, and maintaining hygiene standards.

  • Purchasing raw materials, ingredients, and other necessary supplies for the restaurant.

  • Managing inventory, monitoring stock levels, and ensuring the availability of necessary ingredients.

  • Handling customer service, taking orders, and resolving customer inquiries or complaints.

  • Developing and implementing marketing initiatives to promote the restaurant.

  • Managing the company's social media accounts and online presence.

  • Assisting with financial and administrative tasks, including budgeting, sales monitoring, reporting, and basic accounting.

  • Ensuring compliance with food safety regulations, hygiene requirements, and company procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

We are looking for a candidate who has:

  • Relevant education or practical experience in restaurant management, hospitality, or the food service industry.

  • Experience in kitchen operations and fast-food preparation.

  • Good organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to manage employees and delegate responsibilities.

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.

  • Knowledge of purchasing, inventory management, and supplier coordination.

  • Basic understanding of financial administration and accounting.

  • Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and handle multiple tasks.

  • A flexible and hands-on approach, with willingness to perform both managerial and practical kitchen duties.

Application

If you believe your experience and skills match our requirements, we encourage you to send your application and CV to:

Email: info@sundsult.dk or rkbgaps@gmail.com

Please use the subject line: "Application – Restaurant Operations Manager".

 

 

 

Restaurantdriftsleder

Om os

Hos Bagel Bites mener vi, at god mad, fremragende kundeservice og effektiv restaurantledelse går hånd i hånd.

Efter en mindre omstrukturering af vores ledelsesteam søger vi nu en ansvarsbevidst, motiveret og fleksibel medarbejder, der kan varetage ansvaret for restaurantens daglige drift.

Stillingen omfatter en kombination af restaurantledelse, køkkenarbejde, kundeservice, indkøb og administrative opgaver. Den rette kandidat skal være indstillet på at deltage aktivt i alle dele af restaurantens drift, herunder også praktisk arbejde i køkkenet.

Arbejdsopgaver og ansvarsområder

Som Restaurantdriftsleder får du ansvaret for den overordnede daglige drift af restauranten. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil omfatte:

  • At lede og koordinere restaurantens daglige drift.

  • At føre tilsyn med medarbejderne, uddelegere arbejdsopgaver, udarbejde arbejdsplaner og sikre et effektivt samarbejde i teamet.

  • At tilberede og servere fastfood, herunder sandwiches, burgere, bagels og andre menuprodukter.

  • At deltage aktivt i køkkenarbejdet, herunder madlavning, klargøring af råvarer, rengøring og overholdelse af hygiejnestandarder.

  • At stå for indkøb af råvarer, ingredienser og øvrige nødvendige forsyninger til restauranten.

  • At administrere lagerbeholdningen, overvåge lagerstatus og sikre, at de nødvendige råvarer altid er tilgængelige.

  • At varetage kundeservice, modtage bestillinger og håndtere kundehenvendelser og eventuelle klager.

  • At udvikle og gennemføre markedsføringsinitiativer med henblik på at promovere restauranten.

  • At administrere virksomhedens sociale medier og online tilstedeværelse.

  • At bidrage til økonomiske og administrative opgaver, herunder budgettering, overvågning af omsætning, rapportering og grundlæggende regnskabsopgaver.

  • At sikre, at gældende fødevaresikkerhedsregler, hygiejnekrav og virksomhedens interne procedurer overholdes.

Kvalifikationer og kompetencer

Vi søger en kandidat, der har følgende kvalifikationer og kompetencer:

  • Relevant uddannelse eller praktisk erfaring inden for restaurantledelse, hotel- og restaurationsbranchen eller fødevarebranchen.

  • Erfaring med køkkendrift og tilberedning af fastfood.

  • Gode organisatoriske og ledelsesmæssige evner samt erfaring med personaleledelse og uddelegering af arbejdsopgaver.

  • Gode kommunikations- og kundeservicekompetencer.

  • Kendskab til indkøb, lagerstyring og koordinering med leverandører.

  • Grundlæggende forståelse for økonomisk administration og regnskab.

  • Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og håndtere flere forskellige arbejdsopgaver.

  • En fleksibel og praktisk tilgang til arbejdet samt villighed til både at varetage ledelsesmæssige opgaver og deltage aktivt i køkkenets daglige arbejde.

Ansøgning

Hvis du mener, at dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer matcher vores krav, opfordrer vi dig til at sende din ansøgning og dit CV til en af følgende e-mailadresser:

E-mail: info@sundsult.dk eller rkbgaps@gmail.com

jobs.title: Mötesbokare (BDR) till Köpenhamn, (45 000sek grundlön)
jobs.description: Vi har en tydlig vision: Att bli Skandinaviens ledande aktör inom förebyggande arbetsmiljöarbete genom digitala videoinstruktioner.Vi har redan etablerat oss på den danska marknaden och nu satsar vi stort på Sverige!Därför söker vi 4 nya mötesbokare (BDR) som vill vara med och utveckla vår svenska verksamhet.Hos oss blir du en del av ett socialt och ambitiöst team där vi arbetar målmedvetet, firar våra framgångar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre varje dag.Vi sitter i Köpenhamn, med smidig pendling från Malmö med tåg.Din lön och dina möjligheterVi tror på att goda prestationer ska belönas.    En konkurrenskraftig fast grundlön baserad på din erfarenhet.    En attraktiv bonusmodell där dina resultat syns direkt på lönebeskedet.    Möjlighet att påverka din egen inkomst genom dina prestationer.Hos oss får du både tryggheten i en fast lön och möjligheten att tjäna mer när du lyckas.Vad erbjuder vi dig?    En spännande tillväxtresa: Bli en del av vår satsning på den svenska marknaden och bidra till att bygga något stort.    En meningsfull produkt: Hjälp företag att skapa säkrare arbetsplatser och ta hand om sina medarbetare.    En stark gemenskap: Vi arbetar tillsammans mot tydliga mål, stöttar varandra och firar våra framgångar.    Individuell utveckling: Vi ser dina styrkor och hjälper dig att utveckla dina kompetenser genom personlig coaching, feedback och löpande utbildning.    En ambitiös säljkultur: Vi har höga mål och arbetar fokuserat för att nå dem, samtidigt som vi värdesätter trivsel, gemenskap och arbetsglädje.    En arbetsplats med energi: Härliga kollegor, god stämning, gemensamma aktiviteter och en vardag där det ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet.    Bra förmåner: God lunch varje dag, kaffe och ett trevligt kontor i Köpenhamn.    Karriärmöjligheter: Vi växer och vill gärna utveckla framtidens specialister, toppsäljare och ledare internt.Vem är du?Vi tror att det finns många olika personligheter som kan lyckas inom försäljning. Det viktigaste för oss är din inställning, ditt engagemang och din vilja att utvecklas.Vi föreställer oss att du:    Har erfarenhet av mötesbokning eller vill utvecklas till att bli riktigt duktig på det.    Är kommunikativ och tycker om att skapa kontakt med nya människor.    Är målmedveten, uthållig och motiveras av att se resultat.    Vill utveckla dina färdigheter och är öppen för feedback och coaching.    Trivs i en miljö där vi arbetar mot gemensamma mål och samtidigt har roligt tillsammans.    Talar flytande svenska och vill arbeta med den svenska marknaden.Du behöver inte vara färdigutvecklad som säljare när du börjar hos oss. Det viktiga är att du har viljan att lära dig och bli bättre.Vad kommer du att göra?Som BDR får du en viktig roll i vår svenska tillväxtresa.Du kommer att kontakta svenska företag, presentera hur man kan hjälpa dem med arbetsmiljö och säkerhet samt boka kvalificerade möten åt våra säljare.Du får en strukturerad introduktion, löpande stöd och personlig coaching för att utvecklas i din roll.Vi arbetar med tydliga mål och följer upp våra resultat, men vi vet också att människor utvecklas på olika sätt.
